text: 雞先生問：「點樣搭車出去呀？」
eng: Mr. Chicken asked, "How can we travel out?"

text: 雞先生話：「我哋可唔可以行路去呢？」
eng: Mr. Chicken suggested, "How about we go on foot?"

text: 雖然唔使錢，但係太遠喇，佢哋行唔到！
eng: Although it doesn't cost money, it's too far for them to walk!

text: 雖然地鐵可以去到好多地方，但係地鐵站閂咗，佢哋冇得搭呀！
eng: Although the MTR can take you to many places, the station is closed, so they can't take it!

text: 雞先生話：「噉我哋可唔可以搭小巴呢？」
eng: Mr. Chicken suggested, "Then, how about we take the minibus?"

text: 雖然小巴好快，但係好少位，要排好耐隊！
eng: Although the minibus is fast, there are very few seats, and the queue is long!

text: 但係佢哋對腳太短喇，踩唔到單車。
eng: Unfortunately, their legs are too short to pedal the bike!

text: 最後佢哋發現，原來附近有巴士站呀！
eng: In the end, they discovered there was a bus stop nearby!

text: 可以搭巴士去呀！
eng: They can take the bus!

text: 嘟咗八達通，坐好巴士，佢哋出街玩喇！
eng: They tapped their Octopus Card, got on the bus, and headed downtown to play!

text: 呢個係阿樂，佢嘅頭髮好長，要剪喇。
eng: This is Ah-Lok, and his hair is quite long. It's time for a haircut.

text: 媽媽話：「我幫你剪頭髮啦。」
eng: Mom said, "I'll help you with a haircut."

text: 阿樂笑。剪得唔靚啊！
eng: Ah-Lok laughed. The haircut doesn't look good!

text: 同學仔都笑佢，阿樂喊。
eng: His classmates all laughed at him, and Ah-Lok cried.

text: 老師話：「我哋唔應該笑人㗎。
eng: The teacher said, "We shouldn't laugh at others."

text: 個個都唔一樣。睇下呢啲相……」
eng: "Everyone is unique. Look at these pictures..."

text: 「貓仔嗰兩隻眼大啲，雀仔個頭細啲，兔仔對耳長啲，龜仔啲手腳短啲。」
eng: "The kitten has big eyes, the bird has a small head, the rabbit has long ears, and the turtle has short limbs."

text: 「你哋係咪想隻隻都一樣啊？」
eng: "Do you all want to be the same?"

text: 「你哋同我，有咩唔一樣啊？」
eng: "What's different between us?"

text: 同學話：「我係男仔，你係女仔。」
eng: A classmate said, "I'm a boy, and you're a girl."

text: 「我長頭髮，你短頭髮。」
eng: "I have long hair, and you have short hair."

text: 「我件衫舊啲，你件衫新啲。」
eng: "My clothes are old, and yours are new."

text: 「我條褲短啲，你嗰條長啲。」
eng: "My pants are shorter, and yours are longer."

text: 「我得少少書，你有好多書。」
eng: "I only have a few books, and you have many books."

text: 老師話：「噉你哋同我，有咩一樣啊？」
eng: The teacher asked, "What do we have in common?"

text: 「我鍾意踢波，鍾意嘅同學舉手啦﹗」
eng: "I like playing soccer. Raise your hand if you do too!"

text: 「我鍾意唱歌，有冇人都鍾意？」
eng: "I like singing. Does anyone else enjoy it?"

text: 「我鍾意食包，有冇人都成日食？」
eng: "I like eating bread. Does anyone else eat it often too?"

text: 「人人都有啲嘢，同你一樣，同你唔一樣。
eng: "Everyone has something in common with you, and something different.

text: 老師個個同學都愛，明唔明白啊？」
eng: And your teacher loves all students, do you understand?"

text: 同學仔都拍手，大聲笑。
eng: The students all clapped their hands and laughed loudly.

text: 《藍藍同黃色大門》
eng: "Lam Lam and the Yellow Gate"

text: 星期六上晝，藍藍喺屋企做緊功課。
eng: On Saturday morning, Lam Lam was at home doing her homework.

text: 爸爸話：「爸爸瞓一陣。我起身嗰陣，你要做好晒功課㗎！」
eng: Dad said, "Daddy sleeps for a while. When I get up, you must have done all your homework!"

text: 藍藍繼續做功課。做下做下，佢開始覺得眼瞓。
eng: Lam Lam continued to do her homework. Doing it, she started to feel sleepy.

text: 呢個時候，黃色書包變得越嚟越大，最後仲出現咗一道黃色大門！
eng: At this time, the yellow school bag became bigger and bigger, and finally a yellow gate appeared!

text: 藍藍諗住開門入去睇下……
eng: Lam Lam thought about opening the door and going in to see...

text: 點知跌咗入一個又黑又深嘅地方！
eng: Unexpectedly she fell into a dark and deep place!

text: 「哎吔！救命呀！有冇人啊？」
eng: "Oh! Help! Is there anyone?"

text: 突然，喺藍藍面前出現咗一隻會講人話、踩住單車嘅兔仔。
eng: Suddenly, in front of Lam Lam appeared a rabbit that could talk and ride a bicycle.

text: 藍藍好驚噉話：「唔好意思呀！我都唔知點解自己會嚟咗呢度！」
eng: Lam Lam said in fear, "I'm sorry! I don't even know why I'm here!"

text: 原來隻兔仔係呢度嘅國王。
eng: It turns out that the little rabbit is the king here.

text: 國王話：「你係第一個聽到我講嘢嘅小朋友。
eng: The king said: "You are the first child here that can hear me.

text: 不如我帶你四圍行下啦。上車！」
eng: How about I show you around. Get on the bike!"

text: 藍藍覺得呢度好靚。
eng: Lam Lam thinks it's beautiful here.

text: 雀仔話：「兔國王早晨！」
eng: The bird said, "Good morning King Rabbit!"

text: 國王話：「早晨，今日想唱咩歌呀？」
eng: The king said, "Good morning, what song do you want to sing today?"

text: 雀仔話：「不如唱《有隻雀仔跌落水》？
eng: The bird said, "How about singing 'A little bird fell into the water'?"

text: 龜仔話：「係呀！不過冇『被水沖去』！我哋有救返佢上嚟。」
eng: The turtle said, "Yes! But It wasn't 'washed away'! We did get him back up."

text: 國王話：「你哋好叻喎！」
eng: The king said, "You are very clever!"

text: 跟住佢哋見到兩隻貓仔喺度打交。
eng: Then they saw two kittens fighting here.

text: 白貓指住啡貓話：「佢想食我個蛋糕呀！」
eng: The white cat pointed at the brown cat and said: "He wants to eat my cake!"

text: 國王話：「我哋唔可以冇問過就拎人哋啲嘢食，都唔可以打交，要做好朋友呀。」
eng: The king said, "We can't take someone else's food without asking, but we also we can't fight; be good friends."

text: 啡貓話：「哦……噉我哋一人一半啦！」
eng: The brown cat said, "Oh... so we'll have half each!"

text: 豬仔話：「國王早晨！我好肚餓，但係我冇錢買嘢食......」
eng: The little pig said, "Good morning King! I am hungry, but I have no money for food..."

text: 國王話：「我有紅蘿蔔，請你食吖。」
eng: The king said, "I have carrots, please eat."

text: 豬仔話：「多謝你呀！」
eng: The little pig said, "Thank you!"

text: 國王話：「唔使客氣！」
eng: The king said, "You're welcome!"

text: 國王帶藍藍嚟到一個大箱前，問藍藍想唔想飛。
eng: The king brings Lam Lam to a large box, and asks Lam Lam if she wants to fly.
"Fly?" "Yes, fly!"

text: 一眨眼，佢哋就上咗天喇！
eng: In the blink of an eye, they were in the sky!

text: 藍藍話：「原來飛係咁自由，咁開心㗎！多謝你呀！」
eng: Lam Lam said, "It turns out that flying is so free, so happy! Thank you!"

text: 國王話：「唔使客氣！」
eng: The king said, "You're welcome!"

text: 突然一陣大風吹埋嚟，吹跌咗藍藍，藍藍跌咗入隧道。
eng: Suddenly a strong wind came up, and blew Lam Lam over; Lam Lam fell into a tunnel.

text: 原來藍藍喺書檯上瞓着咗，黃色大門變返做黃色書包。
eng: It turns out that Lam Lam had fallen asleep on the desk, and the yellow gate turned into the yellow school bag.

text: 爸爸問：「你做晒啲功課未呀？」
eng: Dad asked, "Have you done all your homework yet?"

text: 藍藍話：「我頭先見到好多動物，隻隻都識講嘢！」
eng: Lam Lam said, "Just now I saw a lot of animals, all of them could talk!"

text: 爸爸話：「你一定係發白日夢，快啲做埋啲功課啦！」
eng: Dad said, "You must be daydreaming; quickly, do your homework!"

text: 藍藍好掛住黃色大門入面嘅世界，一個和平、自由、開心、令佢永遠記得嘅美好世界！
eng: Lam Lam misses the world inside the yellow gate, a peaceful, free, happy world, that she will always remember!

text: 哮喘發作
eng: Asthma Attack

text: 場景：學校操場
eng: Scene: School Playground

text: 老師：仲有最後兩分鐘！
eng: Teacher: Only two minutes left!

text: 志明：（喘）跑埋最後兩分鐘就可以休息喇⋯⋯
eng: Chi Ming: (Gasping) Just two more minutes and I can rest...

text: 偉俊：志明，你冇嘢吖嘛？
eng: Wai Chun: Chi Ming, are you okay?

text: 志明：我……有啲唞唔到氣呀⋯⋯
eng: Chi Ming: I... am having trouble breathing...

text: 偉俊：係咪哮喘發作呀？
eng: Wai Chun: Is it an asthma attack?

text: 志明：（點頭）係呀⋯⋯
eng: Chi Ming: (Nodding) Yes...

text: 偉俊：我哋停低休息下先啦，慢慢呼吸。老師！老師！
eng: Wai Chun: Let's stop and rest for a bit, take deep breaths. Teacher! Teacher!

text: 老師：偉俊，發生咩事呀？
eng: Teacher: What's the matter, Wei Jun?

text: 偉俊：志明哮喘發作呀。
eng: Wai Chun: Chi Ming is having an asthma attack.

text: 老師：志明，慢慢坐低呼吸。平時你哮喘發作嗰陣會點做㗎？
eng: Teacher: Chi Ming, sit down slowly and breathe. What do you normally do when you have an asthma attack?

text: 志明：我有支哮喘藥……
eng: Chi Ming: I have an inhaler...

text: 老師：你支哮喘藥放咗喺邊度呀？
eng: Teacher: Where did you put your inhaler?

text: 志明：⋯⋯更衣室⋯⋯
eng: Chi Ming: ...In the changing room...

text: 老師：偉俊，你可唔可以幫手攞志明支哮喘藥過嚟呀？
eng: Teacher: Wai Chung, can you get Chi Ming's inhaler for him?

text: 偉俊：知道。（偉俊攞咗哮喘吸入器過嚟）
eng: Wai Chung: Got it. (Wai Chung brings the asthma inhaler)

text: 偉俊：呢支藥係咪你㗎？
eng: Wai Chung: Is this your inhaler?

text: 志明：（點頭）
eng: Chi Ming: (Nodding)

text: 偉俊：要用幾多下呀？
eng: Wai Chun: How many puffs do you need?

text: 志明：……四下……（使用哮喘吸入器後）
eng: Chi Ming: ...Four puffs... (After using the inhaler)

text: 老師：而家好啲未呀？需唔需要再噴多下呀？
eng: Teacher: Are you feeling any better now? Do you need to use it again?

text: 志明：唔使啦，好返好多。
eng: Chi Ming: No need, I feel much better now.

text: 老師：需唔需要送你去醫院呀？
eng: Teacher: Should we take you to the hospital?

text: 志明：唔使去醫院，唔該晒。
eng: Chi Ming: No need for the hospital, thank you very much.

text: 偉俊：當有人哮喘發作時，叫佢哋先坐低休息，慢慢呼吸，唔使驚，同埋幫助佢哋使用哮喘吸入器，仲要儘快話俾大人知。
eng: Wai Chun: When someone has an asthma attack, make them sit down, rest, and breathe slowly. Don't panic, and help them use their inhaler, and inform an adult as soon as possible.

text: 偉俊：媽媽，咩事呀？
eng: Wei Jun: Mom, what's going on?

text: 偉偉由動物園返嚟，話想喺屋企養隻恐龍。
eng: Wei Wei returned from the zoo and said that he wanted to raise a dinosaur at home.

text: 偉偉聽完唔開心，繼續玩佢嘅車車。
eng: Wei Wei was unhappy after listening to it and continued to play with his car.

text: 偉偉爸爸同媽咪成日都要返工，得阿婆陪佢，阿婆會朝頭早帶偉偉落公園玩。
eng: Wei Wei's father and mother have to go to work all day, and his grandmother has to accompany him, and his grandmother will take Wei Wei to the park to play early.

text: 去到樓下，有一架金色巴士停咗喺度。
eng: Go downstairs and there is a golden bus parked here.

text: 有人叫偉偉：「上嚟啦！」
eng: Someone called Wei Wei: "Go up!"

text: 於是佢就上咗去。
eng: So he went up.

text: 點知道一睇，個司機原來係一隻有彩虹色嘅恐龍。
eng: How do you know that a driver turned out to be a rainbow-colored dinosaur.

text: 入面原來已經有紫色嘅兔仔、淺藍色嘅豬仔、銀色嘅烏龜同粉紅色嘅老鼠仔坐喺度。
eng: There were already purple rabbits, light blue piglets, silver and pink mouse children sitting here.

text: 偉偉同大家講：「各位早晨！」
eng: Wei Wei said to everyone, "Everyone, early!"

text: 坐低落嚟，架巴士開始郁，啲花花、大樹、大海、沙灘、屋仔同車仔向後面消失，前面又出現咗太陽同雀仔。
eng: Sit down, the bus starts to move, flowers, trees, the sea, the beach, houses and cars disappear to the back, and the sun and birds appear in front of them.

text: 偉偉由窗望出出面，原來架巴士已經飛咗上天空，佢哋同架巴士喺雲同雲中間飛行。
eng: Wei Wei looked out of the window, it turned out that a bus had flown into the sky, and they and a bus flew between clouds and clouds.

text: 偉偉一邊大叫一邊拍手：「好嘢！」
eng: Wei Wei shouted and clapped his hands: "Okay!"

text: 「偉偉肚餓，要食嘢喇！」
eng: "Wei Wei is hungry, he wants to eat!"

text: 彩虹恐龍講。
eng: Rainbow dinosaur said.

text: 車上面嘅朋友仔由車外面拎咗啲食物出嚟。有啲乜嘢呢？
eng: A friend and child in the car came out with some food from the outside of the car. What's the matter?

text: 紫色兔仔講：「我有大樹糖糖！」
eng: The purple bunny said, "I have big tree sugar candy!"

text: 淺藍色豬仔講：「我有屋仔包包！」
eng: the light blue piglet said, "I have a house bag!"

text: 銀色龜仔講：「我有花花菜菜！」
eng: Silver said, "I have cauliflower!"

text: 粉紅老鼠仔講：「我有大海汽水！」
eng: Pink mouse son said, "I have sea soda!"

text: 之後佢哋叫偉偉食咗好多嘢，偉偉好飽，點知佢哋繼續要偉偉食。
eng: After that they asked Wei Wei to eat a lot, Wei Wei was very full, how did they know that they continued to ask Wei Wei to eat.

text: 偉偉大叫：「夠喇夠喇！」
eng: Wei Wei Wei shouted: "Enough is enough!"

text: 點知一叫，架巴士撞咗落嚿雲度，偉偉跌咗落彩虹滑梯，滑咗落去……
eng: How do you know that the bus hit a cloud down, Wei Wei fell down the rainbow slide, and slipped down...

text: 「哎吔！救命！」
eng: "Ouch! Help!"

text: 佢最後醒咗，手上仲拎住媽咪買嘅彩虹恐龍公仔，原來佢一直喺自己張牀，發咗個夢。
eng: He finally woke up, still holding his mother to buy a rainbow dinosaur doll, it turned out that he had been opening his own and dreaming.

text: 佢而家好肚餓。
eng: He's hungry now.

text: 今朝起身，媽媽同我講早晨。
eng: When I got up this morning, Mom said to me good morning.

text: 我都同媽媽講早晨。
eng: I also said good morning to Mom.

text: 媽媽對住我笑。
eng: Mom smiled at me.

text: 喺學校，我見到陳老師。
eng: At school, I saw Teacher Chan.

text: 我同陳老師講早晨，陳老師都同我講早晨，仲讚我乖。
eng: I said good morning to Teacher Chan, and she said good morning to me and praised me for being good.

text: 入到班房，我見到小明。
eng: When I entered the classroom, I saw Siu Ming.

text: 小明係我嘅好朋友。
eng: Siu Ming is a good friend of mine.

text: 我同小明講早晨，小明都同我講早晨，仲同我拍手，我好開心。
eng: I said good morning to Siu Ming, and Siu Ming said good morning to me and clapped his hands at me. I was very happy.

text: 我又見到阿麗。
eng: I also saw Ah-Lai.

text: 阿麗係我嘅同學。
eng: Ah-Lai is my classmate.

text: 阿麗好靚，我好鍾意佢。
eng: Ah-Lai is very pretty, I like her a lot.

text: 我同阿麗講早晨，佢冇同我講早晨。
eng: I said good morning to Ah-Lai, but she didn't say good morning to me.

text: 我再同佢講早晨，佢都冇同我講早晨。
eng: I said good morning to her again, but she didn't say good morning to me.

text: 我有啲唔開心。
eng: I was a little unhappy.

text: 放學返到屋企，媽媽問我做乜唔開心。
eng: When I got home from school, Mom asked me why I was unhappy.

text: 我話俾媽媽聽阿麗唔同我講早晨。
eng: I told Mom that Ah-Lai did not say good morning to me.

text: 我問媽媽阿麗係唔係唔鍾意我。
eng: I asked Mom if Ah-Lai doesn't like me.

text: 媽媽叫我聽日再同阿麗講早晨。
eng: Mom told me to say good morning to Ah-Lai again tomorrow.

text: 第二日返學，我一返到學校就同阿麗講早晨。
eng: The next day at school, as soon as I arrived at school I said good morning to Ah-Lai.

text: 阿麗同我講返早晨。我好開心。
eng: Ah-Lai said good morning to me. I was very happy.

text: 「我好開心。我好鍾意阿麗。」
eng: "I'm so happy. I love Ah-Lai."

text: 星期日嘅沙灘
eng: Sunday beach

text: 今日係星期日。
eng: Today is Sunday.

text: 我拎住我部相機，搭咗巴士去淺水灣。
eng: Holding my camera, I took the bus to Repulse Bay.

text: 佢喺香港島，係一個好多人識嘅沙灘。
eng: It's on Hong Kong Island, it's a well-known beach.

text: 我之前揾過佢嘅相，嗰度好靚㗎，我好鍾意，我想去嗰度好耐㗎喇。
eng: I've looked for pictures of it before, it's beautiful, I like it, I've wanted to go there for a long time.

text: 我住喺上環，搭巴士要一個鐘。
eng: I live in Sheung Wan, it takes an hour by bus.

text: 我朝早九點鐘出門口，十點鐘去到。
eng: I go out at nine o'clock in the morning, and arrive at ten.

text: 今日天氣好好，少少熱，有風嗰陣，都幾舒服。
eng: Today the weather is nice, a little hot, and when there is wind, it's quite comfortable.

text: 天空有太陽，冇乜雲，好藍，好靚。
eng: The sky has the sun, no clouds, very blue, very beautiful.

text: 我用相機影咗今日第一張相。
eng: With my camera I took the first photo of the day.

text: 沙灘有好多人，有人游水，有人踢波，有人瞓覺。
eng: On the beach there are a lot of people, some swimming, some playing football, some sleeping.

text: 嗰度又有好多小朋友，我見到有一啲女仔玩沙，有一啲男仔玩水。
eng: There are also a lot of kids there, I see a little girl playing in the sand, and a little boy playing in the water.

text: 有一個女仔問：「你估水入面有冇魚？」
eng: One girl asks, "Do you think there are any fish in the water?"

text: 佢個朋友仔答佢：「我唔知！我淨係知海入面冇雀仔。」
eng: Her friend replies, "I don't know! I only know there are no birds in the sea.”

text: 我又聽到有人唱歌，我聽唔明佢唱緊乜嘢。
eng: I also hear someone singing, but I can't understand what he was singing.

text: 佢唱得好好聽。「哎吔！」
eng: He sings very well. "Ouch!"

text: 我突然聽到一個男仔叫 ──佢跌親啊。
eng: I suddenly hear a boy screaming - he fell down.

text: 唔知道佢痛唔痛呢？
eng: I don't know if he is in pain?

text: 我見佢冇喊，好叻噉企咗起身。
eng: I see that he isn't crying, and that he smartly stood up.

text: 佢媽媽跑去問佢：「你有冇事啊？」
eng: His Mom runs to him and asks, "Are you all right?"

text: 個男仔大聲噉答：「冇事！」
eng: The boy replies loudly, "It's okay!"

text: 「我好鍾意沙灘，我想日日都嚟玩啊！」
eng: "I love the beach, I want to come every day to play!"

text: 「噉樣，好啦，我哋聽日再嚟玩吖。」
eng: "So, okay, let's play again tomorrow."

text: 「好嘢！」佢哋喺度笑，我都喺度笑，然後幫佢哋影咗一張相。
eng: "Good!" They laughed here, and I laughed here, and I helped them take a picture.

text: 返到屋企之後，我望住佢哋張相 ──我都好鍾意沙灘，我都想再去一次淺水灣啊。
eng: When I got home, I looked at their pictures - I love the beach too, and I also want to go to Repulse Bay again.

text: 出街食飯
eng: Going out to eat

text: 今日爸爸媽媽同我出街食飯。
eng: Today Dad and Mom went out with me to eat.

text: 我哋去到餐廳坐低。
eng: We went to the restaurant and sat down.

text: 叔叔問我哋食乜嘢，爸爸答：「呢個，呢個，同呢個。」
eng: An uncle asked us what we ate, and Dad replied, "This, this, and this."

text: 啲嘢食嚟咗，枱上面有一碟魚，一碟菜同一碟肉。
eng: The food came, and on the table there was one fish dish, one vegetable dish, and one meat dish.

text: 爸爸食一碗飯多少少，媽媽食一碗飯，我食少少飯。
eng: Dad ate one bowl of rice and a bit, Mom ate one bowl of rice, and I ate a little bit of rice.

text: 食完飯，姨姨問我哋：「飲唔飲湯？」
eng: After eating, an auntie asked us, "Do you want soup?"

text: 媽媽話：「好啊！兩碗，唔該！」
eng: Mom said, "Okay! Two bowls, please!"

text: 姨姨放低兩碗湯，媽媽叫我試下自己飲湯。
eng: The auntie put down two bowls of soup, and my mother told me to try the soup myself.

text: 我想學爸爸拎住碗湯飲，我掂下個碗，碗湯好熱。
eng: I want to learn from my father how to hold the bowl of soup to drink, so I touch the bowl, but the bowl of soup is very hot.

text: 我睇一睇媽媽，媽媽叫我唔好驚。我知道喇！
eng: I took a look at Mom, and she told me not to be afraid. I know!

text: 媽媽爸爸都喺度，我唔使驚㗎！
eng: Mom and dad are here, so I don't need to be afraid!

text: 我再試多一次，我拎到喇！
eng: I tried one more time and I got a hold of it!

text: 好熱！好重！啊——碗湯跌咗落地下，個碗爛咗，我好驚叔叔姨姨會鬧我，驚到喊咗出嚟。
eng: It's hot! It's heavy! Ah — The bowl of soup dropped on the floor, the bowl broke; I am so afraid the uncle and auntie will scold me, and I cry out in fear.

text: 姨姨見到個碗爛咗，不過佢冇鬧我，仲問我：「你哋有冇事啊？
eng: The auntie saw that the bowl was broken, but he didn't scold me, she even asked me, "Are you all right?"

text: 等我清理下先。唔好喊啦，冇嘢喇！
eng: Wait until I'll clean it up first. Stop crying, it's okay!

text: 叔叔叫我哋坐去第二張枱，仲拎咗碗新嘅湯畀我，呢次媽媽餵我飲。
eng: The uncle told us to sit at the next table, and brought me a new bowl of soup, this time my mother fed me.

text: 我覺得呢度啲湯同嘢食都好好味，叔叔同姨姨都好好人。
eng: I thought that here the soup and the other food are delicious, and the uncle and auntie are also very nice people.

text: 要走喇，我同姨姨講：「我好鍾意嚟呢度食飯！」
eng: When it was time to go, I told the auntie, "I love coming here to eat!"

text: 姨姨答我：「多謝你啊！下次再嚟吖！拜拜！」
eng: The auntie replied to me, "Thank you! Next time come again! Bye bye!”

text: 「好啊！拜拜！」下次我要自己飲湯！
eng: "Okay! Bye bye!" Next time I need to drink the soup on my own!

text: 我好多嘢諗，因為我有好多嘢唔明。
eng: I think a lot of things, because I have a lot of things that I don't understand.

text: 好似今日上晝噉，爸爸媽媽同我出去玩。
eng: Like this morning, Dad and Mom went out with me to play.

text: 我哋首先搭地鐵，我唔鍾意；
eng: We first took the subway, which I didn't like;

text: 之後我哋坐船，我唔鍾意；
eng: then we took the boat, which I didn't like;

text: 跟住我哋轉搭電車，我都唔鍾意；
eng: then we changed and took the tram, which I also didn't like;

text: 後來我哋仲坐小巴同巴士，我全部唔鍾意。
eng: afterwards we also took the minibus and bus, all of which I did not like.

text: 我鍾意車仔，我問爸爸媽媽點解唔坐車仔，爸爸媽媽話要搭公共交通工具，我唔明。
eng: I like little cars, I asked Dad and Mom why they didn't take little cars; Dad and Mom said we need to take public transport; I didn't understand that.

text: 今日晏晝爸爸媽媽同我去一個地方睇動物，嗰度有汪汪叫嘅狗仔，我唔鍾意；
eng: This afternoon Dad, Mom and I went to a place to see animals, and there were puppies barking, which I didn’t like;

text: 有喵喵叫嘅貓仔，我唔鍾意；
eng: there were kittens meowing, which I didn't like;

text: 有喺籠裏面跑嘅倉鼠，我唔鍾意；
eng: there were hamsters running in cages, which I didn't like;

text: 有食緊草嘅兔仔，我唔鍾意；
eng: there were little rabbits eating grass, which I didn't like;

text: 有游緊水嘅魚仔，我唔鍾意；
eng: there were small fish swimming in the water, which I didn't like;

text: 有唔郁嘅龜仔，我唔鍾意；
eng: there were small turtles that didn't move, which I didn't like;

text: 有吱吱叫嘅雀仔，我都唔鍾意。
eng: there were chirping birds, which I didn't like either.

text: 爸爸媽媽問我鍾意乜嘢，我話呢啲我全部唔鍾意，我鍾意恐龍。
eng: Dad and Mom asked me what I liked, and I said I didn't like any of these, I like dinosaurs.

text: 我問爸爸媽媽點解唔帶我睇恐龍，佢哋話呢個世界再冇恐龍，我唔明。
eng: I asked Dad and Mom why they didn't show me dinosaurs, and they said there were no more dinosaurs in this world; I didn't understand.

text: 我諗嚟諗去諗咗成日都唔明，不過我鍾意諗嘢，應該有日會明白嘅！
eng: I think about it and think about it all day and don't understand, but I like to think about things, and I should understand it one day!

text: 今日下晝，我同我個仔都着咗新衫同新褲，一齊出去玩。
eng: This afternoon, my son and I both put on new shirts and new pants, and went out together.

text: 我哋搭船過海，天氣好好，海上面有太陽，又有少少雲，天空好靚。
eng: We took a boat across the sea, the weather was nice, there was sun on the sea, and a little cloud, the sky was beautiful.

text: 跟住，我哋搭巴士去沙灘。
eng: Next, we took the bus to the beach.

text: 我幫阿仔除鞋，先知道佢兩隻襪唔一樣。
eng: I helped my son take off his shoes, and learned that his two socks were different.

text: 我話：「唔好意思，爸爸幫你着錯襪啊。」
eng: I said, "Sorry, dad helped you put on the wrong socks."

text: 「係喎！」阿仔笑，拎對襪畀人睇，人人都笑。
eng: "Yes!" my son laughed, he took his socks and showed them around, and everyone laughed.

text: 佢真係好叻仔，喺沙上面畫咗一隻貓同兩支花，又用沙砌咗一間屋仔。
eng: He was really nice, he painted a cat and two flowers in the sand, and also built a house out of sand.

text: 阿仔話：「爸爸，呢間屋係我哋嘅。」
eng: My son said, "Daddy, this house is ours."

text: 我話：「咁細間？爸爸、媽媽同你，三個人住一間好大嘅屋，好唔好啊？」
eng: I said, "So small? Dad, Mom and you, three people live in a big house, okay?"

text: 阿仔拍拍手。玩到七點鐘，月亮出嚟，一樣好靚。
eng: My son clapped his hands. He played until seven o'clock, the moon came out, just as beautiful.

text: 我哋肚餓，返屋企，日日都係噉就好喇。
eng: We got hungry and went home; if every day is like this then it's all good.

text: 我有好多嘢想同個仔做，同佢食飯，同佢去公園玩，又有唔少嘢想幫個仔做，幫佢沖涼，唱歌畀佢聽。
eng: I have a lot of things I want to do with my son, eat with him, go to the park with him, and also have a lot of things I want to do for my son, help him take a shower, and sing to him.

text: 轉天氣，我會問佢凍唔凍？熱唔熱？
eng: When the weather changes, I will ask him if he is cold or not? Hot or not?

text: 佢覺得凍，我會幫佢着多件衫，着多條褲。
eng: If he feels cold, I will help him wear more shirts and more pants.

text: 一個好爸爸應該要明白個仔，明白佢諗咩，知道佢鍾意咩，唔好亂估。
eng: A good father should understand his son, understand what he thinks, know what he likes, and not blindly guess.

text: 呢啲嘢，唔難做，但係想做得好，唔易㗎。
eng: These things, they aren't difficult, but if you want to do them well, it's not easy.

text: 阿樂嘅屋企唔細，有三間房、兩個廁所同兩個廳。
eng: A-Lok's home is not small, with three rooms, two toilets and two living rooms.

text: 佢屋企有好多人，有兩個大人同三個小朋友。
eng: At his home there are many people, two adults and three children.

text: 屋企成日都好嘈，啲嘢又好亂。
eng: At home it is also always noisy, and things are also messy.

text: 枱上面有未洗嘅碗同碟，爸爸同媽媽都唔想洗，佢哋都覺得洗碗好辛苦。
eng: On the table there are unwashed bowls and dishes, neither Dad nor Mom wants to wash them, they both find washing dishes very hard.

text: 張櫈上面又有三件衫同埋四條褲喇，阿樂想坐都坐唔到。
eng: On the chair there are also three shirts and four pairs of pants, and when A-Lok wants to sit down, he can't.

text: 阿樂想去廁所。左面嘅廁所有人，爸爸喺入面沖涼。
eng: A-Lok wants to go to the toilet. The toilet on the left is occupied, Dad is taking a shower.

text: 佢轉右，右面嘅廁所都有人，佢拍門。
eng: He turns right, the toilet on the right is also occupied, he knocks on the door.

text: 佢細佬同佢講：「不如你落下面公園啦。」
eng: His younger brother says to him, "Why don't you go down to the park."

text: 佢覺得好嬲，佢知道細佬一定喺入面玩緊電話。
eng: He gets angry, he knows his brother is surely playing on the phone inside.

text: 佢唔係亂估，佢見過。
eng: He is not blindly guessing, he has seen it.

text: 佢落街，去廁所，再返上嚟，同媽媽講返呢件事。
eng: He goes down on the street, goes to the bathroom, then comes back up again and tells Mom about this matter.

text: 媽媽話：「做人哥哥，唔應該同細佬嘈。」
eng: Mom says, "As the older brother, you shouldn't argue with your younger brother."

text: 佢覺得冇人明白佢，真係好想喊。
eng: He feels that no one understands him, and really wants to cry.

text: 成日有人話男仔唔應該喊，佢覺得噉諗有啲問題。
eng: There are always people who say that boys should not cry, and he thinks that is a problem.

text: 男同女都好，想喊，就喊。
eng: Boys and girls both can do it, if they want to cry, then they cry.

text: 佢入房，喊咗一陣，行出房。
eng: He goes into a room, and after crying for a while, he walks out of the room.

text: 細妹睇緊電視，佢哋一齊睇，睇到笑唔停。
eng: Little Sister is watching TV, they watch it together, watch it and laugh non-stop.

text: 小朋友就係噉樣，喊一陣，笑一陣，一日就過咗。
eng: Children are exactly like that, cry for a while, laugh for a while, until the day has passed.

text: 大人唔喊，又唔笑，日日都好難過。
eng: Adults don't cry, nor laugh, and every day feel unwell.

text: 朝早，太陽出嚟，熱醒咗蟲仔。
eng: One morning, the sun came out and the heat woke up Little Caterpillar.

text: 「我一啲都唔靚，冇動物會鍾意我。」
eng: "I'm not pretty at all, no animal will like me."

text: 蟲仔唔開心，於是去問其他動物佢靚唔靚。
eng: Little Caterpillar was not happy, so he went to ask other animals if he is pretty.

text: 蟲仔見到狗哥哥。「狗哥哥，我靚唔靚啊？」
eng: Little Caterpillar saw Brother Dog. "Brother Dog, am I pretty?"

text: 狗哥哥好高、好大隻，好多動物都鍾意佢，佢都好鍾意其他動物。
eng: Brother Dog is tall and big, many animals like him, and he likes other animals.

text: 「靚啊！我覺得隻隻動物都好靚。」
eng: "Pretty! I think every animal is pretty."

text: 蟲仔聽到狗哥哥噉講，有少少開心，然後走咗。
eng: When Little Caterpillar heard Brother Dog speak like that, he was a little happy, and left.

text: 蟲仔見到貓姐姐。「貓姐姐，我靚唔靚啊？」
eng: Little caterpillar saw Sister Cat. "Sister Cat, am I pretty?"

text: 貓姐姐冇答蟲仔；佢係聽唔到，定係唔睬蟲仔呢？
eng: Sister Cat didn't answer Little Caterpillar; did she not hear him, or did she ignore Little Caterpillar?

text: 蟲仔望住貓姐姐，佢啲毛白雪雪，蟲仔覺得好靚。
eng: Little Caterpillar looked at Sister Cat, her hair white, and Little Caterpillar thought she was pretty.

text: 等咗一陣，貓姐姐答：「我最靚。」
eng: After waiting for a while, Sister Cat replied, "I am the prettiest."

text: 然後貓姐姐就走咗。
eng: Then Sister Cat left.

text: 蟲仔又見到牛伯伯。「牛伯伯，我靚唔靚啊？」
eng: Little Caterpillar also saw Uncle Cow. "Uncle Cow, am I pretty?"

text: 牛伯伯笑住講：「傻仔。如果你覺得自己靚，噉你就靚㗎喇。」
eng: Uncle Cow smiled and said, "Silly boy. If you think that you're pretty, then you're pretty."

text: 蟲仔唔明牛伯伯講緊咩。「噉我靚唔靚啊？」
eng: Little Caterpillar didn't understand what Uncle Cow was saying. "So, am I pretty?"

text: 「靚。」蟲仔好開心，然後返咗屋企。
eng: "Pretty." Little Caterpillar was so happy, and went home.

text: 「爸爸，媽媽，我靚唔靚啊？」
eng: "Dad, Mom, am I pretty?"

text: 「靚。你大個咗之後，一定好靚。」
eng: "Pretty. And after you grow up, you will be very beautiful."

text: 原來，蟲仔嘅爸爸媽媽係蝴蝶啊。
eng: As it turns out, Little Caterpillar's parents are butterflies.

text: 燒傷
eng: Burn

text: 志明：我換一換啲炭先，大家小心呀。
eng: Zhiming: I'll change some charcoal first, everyone be careful.

text: （志明夾起燒緊嘅炭，轉身，嚿炭撞到身後嘅穎兒）
eng: (Zhiming picked up the burning charcoal, turned around, and this charcoal hit Ying'er behind him)

text: 穎兒：哎呀！（手背、手指紅咗）
eng: Ying'er: Oops! (The back of the hand and fingers are red)

text: 志明：（立即放低炭）對唔住呀！我唔知你喺後面，有冇事呀？
eng: Zhiming: (immediately put down the charcoal) Sorry, I don't know if you are behind, is there anything wrong?

text: 穎兒：好痛呀！
eng: Ying'er: It hurts!

text: 偉俊：你隻手紅咗呀，可能燒傷咗，陣間可能會腫同起水泡。
eng: Wei Jun: Is your hand red, it may be burned, and the formation may be swollen and blistered.

text: 你快啲除咗隻戒指先，然後用自來水沖最少十分鐘。
eng: You quickly remove only the ring first, and then rinse with tap water for at least ten minutes.

text: （十分鐘後）
eng: (after ten minutes)

text: 然後立即用自來水沖最少十分鐘，噉樣可以減少痛、腫同埋疤痕，仲有唔好整穿水泡。
eng: Then rinse immediately with tap water for at least 10 minutes to reduce pain, swelling and scarring, as well as not to penetrate the blisters.

text: 妮妮同哥哥去主題樂園玩
eng: Nini and her brother go to the theme park to play
bookTitle: 妮妮同哥哥去主題樂園玩

text: 今日陽光好大，爸爸媽媽帶妮妮同哥哥去主題樂園玩。
eng: Today the sun is very strong, and Mom and Dad took Nini and her brother to the theme park to play.
bookTitle: 妮妮同哥哥去主題樂園玩

text: 妮妮同哥哥一齊玩遊船河、摩天輪，同埋睇好刺激嘅恐龍劇場。
eng: Nini and her brother play together, the Ferris wheel, and the thrilling dinosaur theater.
bookTitle: 妮妮同哥哥去主題樂園玩

text: 玩完之後，妮妮同哥哥都成身汗喇。
eng: After playing, Nini and her brother were sweating all over.
bookTitle: 妮妮同哥哥去主題樂園玩

text: 爸爸媽媽帶咗佢哋一齊去餐廳食雪糕。
eng: Mom and Dad took them to a restaurant for ice cream.
bookTitle: 妮妮同哥哥去主題樂園玩

text: 哥哥拎住杯雪糕。
eng: Brother holding a cup of ice cream.
bookTitle: 妮妮同哥哥去主題樂園玩

text: 突然，有個小朋友跑嚟跑去，唔小心撞咗埋去哥哥度。
eng: Suddenly, a child ran around and accidentally bumped into his brother.
bookTitle: 妮妮同哥哥去主題樂園玩

text: 哥哥杯雪糕跌咗落妮妮心愛嘅公主裙度呀！
eng: My brother lost a cup of ice cream in Nini's beloved princess dress!
bookTitle: 妮妮同哥哥去主題樂園玩

text: 嗚嗚嗚…妮妮條公主裙變咗一撻撻啡色，唔靚喇。
eng: Woooo Nini's princess dress changed a piece of tart brown and was not pretty.
bookTitle: 妮妮同哥哥去主題樂園玩

text: 妮妮不停喊。哥哥覺得佢冇做錯，所以唔同妮妮講「對唔住」。
eng: Nini kept crying. My brother thinks he didn't do anything wrong, so he doesn't say "I'm sorry" to Nini.
bookTitle: 妮妮同哥哥去主題樂園玩

text: 妮妮決定以後唔同哥哥玩喇！
eng: Nini decided not to play with her brother in the future!
bookTitle: 妮妮同哥哥去主題樂園玩

text: 睇睇下，有人拍妮妮個頭。
eng: Look, someone patted Nini on the head.
bookTitle: 妮妮同哥哥去主題樂園玩

text: 抬頭一望，原來係爸爸同哥哥呀！
eng: When I look up, it turns out to be my father and brother!
bookTitle: 妮妮同哥哥去主題樂園玩

text: 哥哥拎住妮妮最鍾意食嘅爆谷，話要同妮妮分享。
eng: My brother took Nini's favorite popcorn and said he wanted to share it with Nini.
bookTitle: 妮妮同哥哥去主題樂園玩

text: 哽塞
eng: Choking

text: 場景：返學路上
eng: Scene: On the way to school

text: 偉俊：（跑）喂！志明！你又係起身遲咗呀？
eng: Wei Jun: (Run) Hey! Zhiming! Are you up late again?

text: 志明：（一路跑一路食包）係呀！
eng: Zhiming: (Running all the way while eating bags) Yes!

text: 偉俊：跑住食嘢你唔驚哽親咩？
eng: Wei Jun: Aren't you afraid of choking while running?

text: （志明突然停下，臉色慢慢變紅，呼吸困難）
eng: (Zhiming stopped suddenly, his face slowly turned red, and he had difficulty breathing)

text: 偉俊：（停下）做咩呀？
eng: Wei Jun: (Stop) What to do?

text: （志明眼神驚慌地望住偉俊，一句話都講唔出）
eng: (Zhiming's eyes looked at Weijun in panic, unable to say a word)

text: 偉俊：（驚訝）你唔係真係哽親呀嘛？
eng: Weijun: (surprised) Aren't you really choking?

text: （志明俾唔到回應）
eng: (Zhiming can't give a response)

text: 偉俊：自己咳唔咳到出嚟呀？
eng: Weijun: Can't you cough yourself?

text: （志明嘗試咳但唔成功。）
eng: (Zhiming tried to cough but was unsuccessful.) )

text: 偉俊：唔使驚，我試下幫你。
eng: Wei Jun: Don't be afraid, I'll try to help you.

text: （偉俊企喺志明身後，雙手橫抱志明腰部，志明腰部向前彎曲，一個拳頭放喺肚上半部，胸骨以下位置，另一隻手包住拳頭）
eng: (Wei Jun stands behind Zhiming, holding Zhiming's waist with both hands, Zhiming's waist is bent forward, one fist is placed on the upper half of the stomach, below the sternum, and the other hand is wrapped around the fist)

text: 偉俊：我數一、二、三，你試下用力咳。一、二、三！
eng: Wei Jun: I count one, two, three, you try to cough hard. One, two, three!

text: （志明咳嘅同時，偉俊用力向內並向上壓志明腹部）
eng: (While Zhiming coughs, Weijun presses Zhiming's abdomen inward and upwards)

text: 偉俊：再嚟！一、二、三！
eng: Weijun: Come again! One, two, three!

text: （志明咳嘅同時，偉俊用力向內並向上壓志明腹部）
eng: (While Zhiming coughs, Weijun presses inward and upwards)

text: （麵包從志明口中吐出，志明大力唞氣）
eng: (bread spits out of Zhiming's mouth, Zhiming breathes vigorously)

text: 志明：……唔該晒……頭先唞唔到氣，爭啲暈低……
eng: Zhiming: ... Thank you so much...... Just now it was difficult to breathe, and I almost fainted...

text: 偉俊：今次知味道啦，之後唔好再跑住食嘢喇。
eng: Wei Jun: I know the taste this time, and don't run around eating after that.

text: 偉俊：人哽親嘅時候，會講唔到嘢，呼吸困難，大力咳或者咳唔到，臉色通紅，慢慢皮膚、嘴唇變紫，亦可能會失去意識。
eng: Wei Jun: People choke up for time, can not speak, difficulty breathing, strong cough or cough, face red, slowly skin and lips turn purple, may also lose consciousness.

text: 幫助哽親嘅人時，急救者要企喺哽親嘅人身後，雙手橫抱佢腰部，哽親嘅人腰部向前彎曲，急救者一個拳頭放喺肚上半部，
eng: When helping a choked person, the first aid provider should stand behind the choked person, hold his waist with both hands, bend the choked person's waist forward, put one fist on the upper part of the stomach,

text: 胸骨以下位置，另一隻手包住拳頭，哽親嘅人咳嘅同時，急救者用力向內並向上壓佢腹部，直至卡喺喉嚨嘅物件吐出。
eng: below the sternum, the other hand wraps the fist, the choked person interrupts, the first aid person presses inward and upwards on his abdomen until the object stuck in the throat is spit out.

text: 如果唔成功，就要儘快打九九九送院求助。
eng: If it is not successful, call 999 and send it to the hospital for help as soon as possible.

text: 龍媽媽想揾最好嘅月餅畀八個仔女。
eng: Mama Dragon wanted to find the best mooncakes for her eight children.

text: 龍媽媽話：「我要去月亮揾最好嘅月餅。」
eng: Mama Dragon said, "I need to go to the moon to find the best mooncakes."

text: 龍媽媽可以飛上天空，可以飛上月亮。
eng: Mama Dragon can fly into the sky, and can fly to the moon.

text: 不過佢攰喇，佢問獅子先生借架太空船用。
eng: But she was tired, and she asked Mr. Lion to borrow his spaceship.

text: 獅子先生話：「好啊，你用我架太空船啦。我架太空船新㗎，用電嘅。」
eng: Mr. Lion said, "Okay, use my spaceship. My spaceship is new, it's electric."

text: 龍媽媽話：「唔該晒獅子先生，我一陣返。」
eng: Mama Dragon said, "Thank you, Mr. Lion, I'll be back in a while."

text: 獅子先生問：「你去邊度啊？」
eng: Mr. Lion asked, "Where are you going?"

text: 龍媽媽答：「唔講得㗎。」
eng: Mama Dragon replied, "I can't tell."

text: 獅子先生話：「我會睇住你嘅小朋友。不過，用之前一定要叉電。」
eng: Mr. Lion said, "I will watch your children. However, before using it be sure to charge the batteries."

text: 龍媽媽趕時間，冇聽獅子先生話。
eng: Mama Dragon was in a hurry, and didn't listen to Mr. Lion.

text: 佢坐太空船，好快噉飛咗上月亮。喺嗰度，佢揾到最好嘅月餅。
eng: She took the spaceship, and quickly flew to the moon. There, she found the best mooncakes.

text: 佢放啲月餅入一個大袋，想返屋企。佢撳掣，太空船唔郁。
eng: She put some mooncakes in a big bag, and wanted to go home. She pushed the button, but the spaceship didn't move.

text: 佢見到太空船冇晒電！
eng: She saw that the spaceship had run out of power!

text: 哎吔！呢度有月餅，但係冇地方叉電。
eng: Alas! There are mooncakes here, but there is no place to charge the batteries.

text: 佢飛嗰陣太趕，冇話畀人聽佢要去乜嘢地方！
eng: She was in such a hurry when she flew that she didn't tell anyone where she was heading to!

text: 已經夜喇，龍仔龍女唔見媽媽，一齊喺屋企喊。
eng: It was already night, the dragon children didn't see their mom, at home they cried together.

text: 獅子先生同龍仔龍女講：「不如我哋一齊上山，揾太空船！」
eng: Mr. Lion said to the dragon children, "Why don't we go up the mountain together to find the spaceship!"

text: 最後，佢哋見到龍媽媽飛返嚟。
eng: Eventually, they saw Mama Dragon fly back.

text: 龍媽媽冇坐太空船，自己飛，飛咗好耐！
eng: Mama Dragon did not take a spaceship, she flew by herself, and flew for a long time!

text: 佢哋大家都好開心，仲叫嗰個地方做「九龍」。
eng: All of them were so happy that they called that place "Kowloon".

text: 即係九條龍！佢哋都冇唔記得好好人嘅獅子先生。
eng: That means nine dragons! They also did not forget the kind Mr. Lion.

text: 「獅子山」就係同龍仔龍女一齊等媽媽嘅獅子先生。
eng: "Lion Rock" is where Mr. Lion waited with the dragon children for their mom.

text: 記得啊！去邊度都一定要同人講！
eng: Remember! Wherever you go, be sure to tell people!

text: 電話有時會冇電㗎。同埋，我哋唔識飛㗎！
eng: The phone sometimes runs out of battery. Also, we don’t know how to fly!

text: 骨折
eng: Fracture

text: 偉俊：（跑）快啲啦！套戲開場喇！
eng: Wei Jun: (Run) Hurry up! Set of play openings!

text: 志明：（跑）志明：（跌落樓梯）（用手撐）哎呀！
eng: Zhiming: (Run) Zhiming: (Falling down the stairs) (supported by hand) Oops!

text: 偉俊：你點呀？
eng: Wei Jun: How do you?

text: 志明：手腕好痛呀⋯⋯
eng: Zhiming: The wrist hurts very much... ⋯

text: 偉俊：你隻左手手腕紅咗又腫咗喎，仲好似變咗形，唔知會唔會係骨折。
eng: Weijun: Your left wrist is red and swollen, and it seems to be deformed, I don't know if it will be a fracture.

text: 用我件衫墊住，用右手支撐住手腕先，唔好郁到佢。
eng: Padding with my dress, first support your wrist with your right hand, and don't touch him.

text: 我同你打九九九，去醫院睇下好啲。
eng: I'll call you nine nine nine and go to the hospital to see if it's better.

text: 偉俊：人喺高嘅地方跌落嚟或者畀物件撞到，可能會造成骨折，骨折嘅地方可能會痛、瘀、腫，或者形狀唔自然。
eng: Wei Jun: If a person falls or is hit by an object in a high place, it may cause fractures, and the fractured place may be painful, ironic, swollen, and may be unnatural in shape.

text: 用手、軟墊或者布支撐住骨折嘅地方，唔好畀佢郁動。
eng: Support the fractured area with your hands, cushions, or cloth, and do not let him move.

text: 之後快啲打九九九。
eng: Hurry up and hit 999 after that.

text: 骨折嘅地方要一直支撐住直到有人嚟到幫手。
eng: The fracture should be held until someone comes to help.

text: 恐龍樂園
eng: Dinosaur Paradise

text: 大家好，我叫阿魚，今日啱啱十歲。
eng: Hello everyone, I'm called Ah-Yu, I just turned ten today.

text: 我之前晚晚都會發一個好真嘅夢，好似真係去咗一個地方，我叫嗰個地方做恐龍樂園，入面有好多唔同嘅恐龍。
eng: Every night I used to have a very real dream, as if I really went to a place, a place that I called dinosaur paradise, where there are many different dinosaurs.

text: 我第一次去嗰陣仲係得七歲，第一眼係見到隻恐龍蛋。
eng: When I first visited it I was still seven years old, and the first thing I saw was a dinosaur egg.

text: 突然，有隻恐龍喺蛋入面走出嚟，我驚到嗌咗一聲！
eng: Suddenly, a dinosaur came out of the egg, and I cried out in fear!

text: 但睇見隻恐龍傻傻望住我個樣，我忍唔住笑咗。
eng: But seeing this dinosaur looking at me stupidly, I couldn't help but laugh.

text: 我同佢講：「不如我叫你恐龍仔啦。」佢好開心。
eng: I said to him, "Why don't I call you Dinosaur Kid." He was so happy.

text: 我又望下四周，原來呢度仲有好多唔同恐龍，有啲識飛，有啲識游水。
eng: I looked around again, turns out there were many different dinosaurs here, some could fly, some could swim.

text: 佢哋唔會打交，仲會好開心噉一齊玩。
eng: "They don't fight, and have fun playing together.", false),

text: 如果我有架車或者識飛就好喇！噉我就可以再行遠啲，睇多啲。
eng: If only I had a car or knew how to fly! Then I could go further, and see more.

text: 之後我晚晚都會夢到同恐龍仔一齊玩。
eng: Afterwards, every night I would dream about playing with the dinosaurs.

text: 一年之後，恐龍仔變咗大恐龍，我估佢仲大隻過一架車。
eng: A year later, Dinosaur Kid had become a big dinosaur, I guess he was even bigger than a car.

text: 我估佢差少少就會大隻過一架飛機。
eng: I think he's almost bigger than a plane.

text: 我以為我同佢會一直開開心心噉玩落去，點知到我九歲嗰年……
eng: I thought he and I would keep playing happily, but when I was nine...

text: 我爬咗上恐龍仔個頭，好開心噉同佢講：「恐龍仔，我過埋今日就十歲，大個仔喇！」
eng: I climbed on the head of the dinosaur, and happily said to him, "Dinosaur Kid, I will be 10 years old after today. I'm a big boy!"

text: 點知平時成日笑嘅恐龍仔，呢次聽完粒聲都唔出。
eng: But the dinosaur, who usually laughs, didn't make a sound after listening this time.

text: 恐龍仔諗咗一陣，終於走咗去蘋果樹度，笑住噉拎咗個蘋果畀我。
eng: The little dinosaur thought for a while, and finally went to the apple tree, smiled and gave an apple to me.

text: 我好開心噉同恐龍仔講：「多謝！我最鍾意食蘋果！」
eng: I happily said to the little dinosaur, "Thanks! I love apples!"

text: 突然，我聽到頭上有把聲講：「阿魚。」我嚇咗一跳，望一望原來係恐龍仔！
eng: Suddenly, I heard a voice above my head say, "Ah-Yu." I was startled, and when I looked, turns out it was the little dinosaur!

text: 我仲諗住問佢係幾時學識講嘢，佢就先一步話：「呢次可能係我哋最後一次見喇。」
eng: I was about to ask him when he learned to talk, but he was one step ahead and said, "This is probably the last time we see each other."

text: 「吓！點解呀？」我即刻問。
eng: "Ugh! Why?" I asked immediately.

text: 佢話：「因為你已經大個仔喇。每個小朋友心入面都有一個樂園，到佢哋十歲就會消失……包括我。好開心喺呢三年識到你，呢三個蘋果就送畀你啦。」
eng: He said, "Because you've grown up. Every child has a paradise in their hearts that disappears when it gets ten years old ... including me. So happy to have known you in these three years, and these three apples are for you."

text: 「鈴鈴……」鬧鐘響起，我一起身就望到牀邊有三個蘋果。自此之後我就冇再見過恐龍仔。
eng: "Ring ring..." The alarm clock rang, and as soon as I got up I saw three apples by the bed. Since then I haven’t seen the little dinosaur.

text: 如果有人問我嘅好朋友係邊個，我會答：「恐龍仔。」
eng: If someone asked me who my best friend was, I would answer, "Dinosaur Kid."

text: 志明：哎呀！（救波時唔小心，個頭撞到場邊長櫈）
eng: Zhiming: Oops! (Accidentally saved the ball, and hit the sideline longrest)

text: 志明：（額頭腫起）好痛啊……
eng: Zhiming: (forehead swollen) It hurts...

text: 偉俊：你點啊？（望住佢個頭）
eng: Weijun: What's wrong with you? (looking at his head)

text: 腫晒喎，我去問下體育館啲人有冇冰袋可以敷下先。
eng: swollen, I went to ask the gymnasium if there were any ice packs to put on.

text: （偉俊攞完冰袋返嚟之後，用毛巾包住冰袋敷喺腫嘅位）
eng: (After Wei Jun came back after taking the ice pack, wrap the ice pack with a towel and put it on the swollen seat)

text: 偉俊：我打畀你家姐，睇下佢嚟唔嚟到接你走。
eng: Wei Jun: I'll call your sister to see if he can pick you up.

text: ……偉俊：係喎志明，你呢次考試點啊？
eng: ...... Wei Jun: Yes, Zhiming, how are you doing this exam?

text: 偉俊：聽日老師話要帶新書返學校，記得喇。
eng: Wei Jun: Tomorrow the teacher said to bring new books back to school, remember.

text: （偉俊不停同志明傾計）……偉俊：你家姐到咗喇。
eng: (Wei Jun keeps talking about his plans) ... ... Wei Jun: Your sister has arrived.

text: 家姐：你個頭做咩腫到噉啊……
eng: Sister: Why is your head swollen like this... ... ...

text: 偉俊：志明頭先唔小心，個頭撞到場邊長櫈，已經用咗冰袋敷腫個位。
eng: Wei Jun: Zhiming accidentally hit the bench on the sidelines just now, and has already used an ice pack to apply the swollen position.

text: 如果返到屋企，志明意識唔清醒、頭暈、頭昏腦脹嘅話，就打九九九去醫院啦。
eng: If you return home and Zhiming is unconscious, dizzy, and dizzy, call 999 and go to the hospital.

text: 家姐：唔該晒你啊。
eng: Sister: Thank you.

text: 偉俊：當有人撞親個頭嘅時候，應該即刻用毛巾或者衫包住冰凍嘅嘢敷腫起嘅位，噉樣可以冇咁痛同埋消腫。
eng: Wei Jun: When someone hits the head, they should immediately wrap the frozen thing with a towel or clothes to apply the swollen position, so that it is less painful and swollen.

text: 同公公婆婆食飯
eng: Having a meal with Grandpa and Grandma

text: 我有一個細妹同哥哥，我哋唔係喺香港出世，我哋喺美國出世，
eng: I have a little sister and an older brother, we were not born in Hong Kong, we were born in the United States,

text: 我哋都係喺美國學校讀書，我哋少講廣東話，講英文多啲。
eng: we also went to American schools, and we speak less Cantonese, and more English.

text: 每年暑假我哋都同爸爸媽媽一齊返香港，去同公公婆婆一齊食飯。
eng: Every year for summer holidays we, together with Dad and Mom, return to Hong Kong, to have a meal with Grandpa and Grandma.

text: 到暑假喇！今日我哋返香港喇，我哋好開心。
eng: The summer holidays have arrived! Today we go back to Hong Kong, we are so happy.

text: 第一日落機有啲攰，第二日先去睇公公婆婆。
eng: The first day after getting off the plane we were a bit tired, the second day we then went to see Grandpa and Grandma.

text: 第二日，我哋去咗公公婆婆屋企同佢哋食飯。
eng: On the second day, we went to Grandpa and Grandma's home to have a meal with them.

text: 飯枱上面有好多餸，有菜、有肉、有魚。
eng: On the table there were many dishes, with vegetables, meat, and fish.

text: 婆婆問我：「你鍾意食乜嘢？」
eng: Grandma asked me, "What do you like to eat?"

text: 我好開心噉講：「都係我鍾意食嘅嘢。
eng: I said happily, "I like to eat everything.

text: 我喺美國成日食肉，返到香港想食菜，一陣我食多幾碗飯先。」
eng: In the US I always eat meat, when I've returned to Hong Kong I want to eat vegetables, later I will eat a few bowls of rice."

text: 突然門鐘有聲。係媽媽嘅細佬都嚟咗同我哋一齊食飯。
eng: Suddenly the door bell rang. It was my mother's younger brother who also came to eat have a meal with us.

text: 我用廣東話叫佢「叔叔。」
eng: I called him "[Paternal] Uncle" in Cantonese.

text: 佢笑住話：「我唔係叔叔，係舅父。
eng: He smiled and said, "I'm not a [paternal] uncle, I'm a [maternal] uncle.

text: 媽媽嘅細佬係舅父，爸爸嘅細佬先係叔叔，記住喇。」
eng: Mom's younger brother is a [maternal] uncle, and Dad's younger brother is a [paternal] uncle, remember that."

text: 我笑笑口講：「啊！真係有啲唔好意思，廣東話真係好難啊，睇嚟我要講多啲，學多啲先喇。」
eng: I smiled and said, "Oh! I'm really sorry, Cantonese is really difficult, it seems that I have to speak more, learn more."

text: 問路
eng: Asking for directions

text: 今日我同媽媽去探公公同婆婆。
eng: Today I went with my Mom to visit Grandpa and Grandma.

text: 公公婆婆屋企好遠，我好少見佢哋。
eng: Grandpa and Grandma's house is far away, and I rarely see them.

text: 搭巴士搭咗好耐。落車之後，有一個公園。
eng: Long ride by bus. After getting off the bus, there is a park.

text: 我哋行咗入去。公園好大，好多嘢玩。
eng: We walked in. The park is big and there are lots of things to play with.

text: 我想喺度玩一陣，媽媽唔想。
eng: I wanted to play here for a while, Mom doesn't want to.

text: 行咗一陣，媽媽突然停低，望下左，望下右。佢唔知行邊好。
eng: After walking for a while, Mom suddenly stopped, looked to the left, looked to the right. She didn't know where to go.

text: 媽媽問我：「家欣，你知唔知道，點去公公婆婆屋企啊？」
eng: Mom asked me, "Ka Yan, do you know how to go to Grandpa and Grandma's house?"

text: 我唔知道，唔記得咗。
eng: I don't know, I forgot.

text: 媽媽話：「不如你試下問人啦。之後一定要同人講唔該啊。」
eng: Mom said, "Why don't you try to ask someone. Afterwards you need to say 'thank you' to them."

text: 我見到有個女人坐喺張櫈上面，於是行去問佢：
eng: I saw a woman sitting on a chair [bench], so I went to ask her:

text: 「唔好意思啊姨姨，你知唔知道點去香城大廈？」
eng: "Sorry Auntie, do you know how to get to the Heung Sing building?"

text: 姨姨諗咗一陣，答我：
eng: The auntie thought for a while, and replied to me:

text: 「妹妹，你先喺呢度向嗰邊行，行到公園門口轉右，一路行，去到街市嗰度。街市對面就係喇。」
eng: "Sister, you first go from here towards that side, walk to the park entrance and turn right, keep going until you get to the wet market. It's right opposite of the wet market."

text: 記得點行之後，我大聲同姨姨講：「唔該晒姨姨！」
eng: After remembering how to go, I said out loud to the auntie, "Thank you, Auntie!"

text: 姨姨摸摸我個頭，同我講：「唔使客氣。不過我係姐姐嚟㗎，唔係姨姨啊！」
eng: The auntie touched my head and said to me, "You're welcome. But please call me bigger sister, not auntie!"

text: 媽媽喺隔籬，自己一個喺度笑。媽媽笑，跟住姐姐都喺度笑。點解佢哋喺度笑嘅？
eng: Mom was nearby, and was laughing by herself. Mom laughed, and then the sister laughed as well. Why are they laughing here?

text: 食橙
eng: Eating oranges

text: 我由細到大都好鍾意食生果，特別係鍾意食橙。
eng: I grew up loving to eat fruit, especially oranges.

text: 你問我點解鍾意食橙，我都唔係好記得喇。
eng: If you ask me why I like eating oranges, I can't quite remember.

text: 晚晚放工返到屋企就係一路食橙，一路睇電視。
eng: Every night when I come home from work, I eat oranges and watch TV.

text: 有次睇睇吓電視瞓着咗，夢見自己變咗做橙汁大王，好耐冇見嘅媽媽就變咗做橙汁魔法師，同我一齊喺橙橙國入面玩同食橙。
eng: Once while watching TV I fell asleep, and dreamed that I had become the orange juice king, and my mother, who I hadn't seen for a long time, became an orange juice magician; and together with me we played and ate oranges in the orange country.

text: 到我醒返嗰陣已經係第二朝，見到嘅嘢好多都已經唔記得咗，即刻沖涼又返工。
eng: By the time I woke up, it was the next morning, and a lot of the things I had seen I had already forgotten, so I took a shower and went back to work.

text: 喺路邊見到有個小朋友拉住佢媽媽隻手玩。
eng: In the streets I saw a child pulling his mother's hand to play.

text: 佢媽媽行行下，突然踎低畀咗一嚿橙個小朋友食。
eng: His mother walked a bit, then suddenly squatted down and gave a piece of orange to the child to eat.

text: 見到佢哋食橙我又記得返，我媽媽都係好鍾意橙，我細個佢成日同我分一嚿橙食。
eng: Seeing them eating an orange I also remembered, my mother also loved oranges, and when I was little she always shared an orange with me.

text: 之後每次食橙，我都有一種幸福嘅感覺。
eng: After that, every time I ate an orange, I had a feeling of happiness.

text: 今日放工，不如買袋橙去媽媽屋企食飯啦﹗
eng: Today after work, why not buy a bag of oranges and go to your mother's house for dinner!

text: 盒
eng: The Box

text: 我有一個細木盒，放咗喺屋企。
eng: I have a small wooden box that I keep at home.

text: 盒入面都係我鍾意嘅嘢。
eng: The box is also full of things that I like.

text: 盒入面啲公仔好靚，係啲豬仔公仔，我好鍾意。
eng: In the box there are beautiful dolls, they are little piggy dolls, I love them.

text: 啲公仔細啲，佢哋大隻啲。
eng: The dolls are smaller, but they [the piggy dolls] are bigger.

text: 我想同佢哋做朋友，同佢哋一齊玩。
eng: I want to be friends with them and play with them.

text: 盒入面有好多車仔。
eng: In the box there are a lots of little cars.

text: 我好鍾意玩，有巴士、地鐵、小巴同電車。
eng: I love playing; there are buses, metros, minibuses and trams.

text: 我全部都搭過。我鍾意搭車，我都鍾意行路。
eng: I've ridden them all. I love to ride and I love walking.

text: 我想去多啲地方。盒入面有一張紙，我用佢嚟畫公仔。
eng: I want to go to more places. In the box there is a piece of paper that I use in the box that I use to draw the dolls.

text: 我鍾意畫公仔。我識畫火柴人，又識畫雪人。
eng: I like to draw dolls. I can draw stick people and I can draw snow people.

text: 我鍾意雪人多過火柴人。
eng: I like snow people more than stick people.

text: 我想去睇雪，同爸爸媽媽一齊砌雪人。
eng: I want to go and see snow, and build a snowman with Mom and Dad.

text: 冇反應冇呼吸
eng: No response and no breathing

text: 場景：家
eng: Scene: Home

text: 偉俊：嫲嫲，我返嚟喇！（冇人應聲）
eng: Weijun: Grandma, I'm back! (No one answered)

text: 偉俊：（四處張望）唔應我嘅？唔通出咗去？嫲嫲！
eng: Wei Jun: (Looking around) Should not be mine? Did you go out? Grandma!

text: （發現嫲嫲倒卧喺地上，面色蒼白，冇呼吸，胸口冇起伏）
eng: (Found grandma lying on the ground, pale, not breathing, no chest heaving)

text: 偉俊：（衝埋去）嫲嫲！嫲嫲！（搖佢膊頭）你聽唔聽到我講嘢呀？
eng: Wei Jun: (rushing over) Grandma! Grandma! (shaking his shoulder) Do you hear me?

text: （鄰居姨姨經過門口，聽到叫聲）
eng: (Aunt neighbor passes by the door and hears a call)

text: 姨姨：（拍門）偉俊，發生咩事呀？
eng: Aunt: (Knock) Wei Jun, what happened?

text: 偉俊：（大叫）嫲嫲瞓咗喺地下，面色蒼白，冇呼吸，叫佢冇反應呀！
eng: Wei Jun: (yelling) Grandma slept on the ground, pale, not breathing, told him to not respond!

text: 姨姨：唔好緊張，我有學過急救，你開門俾我入嚟幫嫲嫲啦。（開門）
eng: Aunt: Don't be nervous, I have studied first aid, you open the door for me to come in to help grandma. (Open door)

text: （姨姨用十秒時間檢查頸動脈脈搏，同時觀察胸口起伏以檢查呼吸）
eng: (Aunt takes ten seconds to check the carotid pulse while observing chest heaving to check breathing)

text: 姨姨：偉俊，立即打九九九叫救護車。
eng: Aunt: Wei Jun, immediately call 999 to call an ambulance.

text: 同埋打去管理處叫佢哋攞部自動體外心臟去顫器上嚟。
eng: And call the management office and ask them to take an automatic external cardiac defibrillator up.

text: （姨姨打開嫲嫲件衫做心外壓）
eng: (Aunt opens grandma's dress to do extracardiac pressure)

text: （救護員到場接手繼續進行心外壓）
eng: (Ambulance worker arrives at the scene to take over and continues extracardiac pressure)

text: 救護員：婆婆係你哋邊個呀？
eng: Ambulance: Mother-in-law is which of you?

text: 姨姨：我係鄰居，呢個係佢個孫。
eng: Aunt: I am a neighbor, this is his grandson.

text: 救護員：有冇婆婆身份證喺度呀？同佢登記返資料。
eng: Ambulance: Is there a mother-in-law's ID card here?

text: 偉俊：（遞上身份證）有呀。
eng: Wei Jun: (Hands over ID card) Yes.

text: 救護員：幾時發現佢失去意識㗎？最後見到佢冇事係幾時呀？
eng: Ambulance: When was he found unconscious? When was he last seen that he was fine?

text: 偉俊：頭先四點半鐘放學返嚟就見到佢瞓咗喺地下，冇呼吸，冇反應。
eng: Wei Jun: Just now when I came back from school at half past four, I saw him lying on the ground, not breathing, not responding.

text: 今朝出門口返學之前佢話心口有啲唔舒服。
eng: Before leaving the door for school this morning, he said that he felt a little uncomfortable in his chest.

text: 救護員：可唔可以俾我睇下佢平時食開嘅藥呀？
eng: Ambulance: Can you show me the medicine he usually takes?

text: 偉俊：（遞藥）呢度。（救護員將嫲嫲送往醫院）
eng: Wei Jun: (Delivering medicine) Here. (The ambulance worker sent the grandmother to the hospital)

text: 偉俊：當發現有人倒卧地上，叫佢冇反應，並且冇呼吸嘅時候，應該立即揾人幫手，
eng: Wei Jun: When you find that someone is lying on the ground, telling him to be unresponsive and not breathing, you should immediately find someone to help,

text: 打九九九叫救護車，同埋盡快進行心外壓，救護員到場後同佢哋交待事發經過。
eng: call 999 to call an ambulance, and perform extracardiac pressure as soon as possible, and the ambulance staff will explain to them after they arrive at the scene.

text: 生日
eng: Birthday

text: 我叫一心，十九歲，我係佢女朋友。
eng: My name is Yat Sum, I'm nineteen years old, and I'm his girlfriend.

text: 佢今日生日，我整咗曲奇送畀佢，我想佢開心。
eng: It's his birthday today, I made cookies for him, I want him to be happy.

text: 曲奇係用朱古力整，我知道佢鍾意食朱古力。
eng: The cookies are made with chocolate, and I know he loves to eat chocolate.

text: 其實曲奇好難整，我又唔係好識整，驚會唔好食。
eng: Actually, cookies are hard to make, and I don't know how to make them. I'm afraid they won't taste good.

text: 今日晏晝，我同佢出街，搭巴士去咗海邊嘅公園。
eng: This afternoon, I go out with him, take the bus to the park by the sea.

text: 我哋坐喺樹下，我望住佢，佢就一味玩電話。
eng: We sit under a tree, I look at him, and he just plays with his phone.

text: 我拍下佢個肚，問：「你肚唔肚餓啊？」
eng: I pat his stomach and ask, "Are you hungry?"

text: 「吓？少少啦。」「噉你數三聲吖！」
eng: "Huh? A little." "Then count from three!"

text: 「吓？哦。三、二、一……」我喺我個袋度拎咗啲曲奇出嚟。
eng: "Huh? Oh. Three, two, one…" I pull the cookies out of my bag.

text: 「今日你生日，我整咗曲奇畀你啊！」
eng: "Today is your birthday, I made some cookies for you!"

text: 佢望住我同我手上嘅曲奇，笑咗笑——好傻、好靚仔，我好開心。
eng: He looks at me with the cookies in my hand, and smiles - so silly, so handsome, and I'm so happy.

text: 唔知佢會唔會鍾意食我整嘅曲奇呢？
eng: I wonder if he will like the cookies that I made?

text: 「啲曲奇好唔好食啊？」
eng: "Do the cookies taste good?"

text: 好難食，啲曲奇又苦又硬。我望住佢，同佢講：「好好食啊！」
eng: They taste so bad, the cookies are bitter and hard. I look at her and say, "They're delicious!"

text: 佢望住我，又望住我手上嘅曲奇，笑咗笑——好甜、好靚女，佢好開心。
eng: She looks at me, and at the cookie in my hand, and smiles - so sweet, so pretty, she's so happy.

text: 我食晒佢整畀我嘅曲奇，跟住佢錫咗我幾啖……有啲口渴添。
eng: I ate all the cookies she had made for me, then she kissed me a few times … a bit thirsty.

text: 我叫允行，今日開始廿一歲，我係佢男朋友。我好愛我女朋友。
eng: My name is Wan Hang, today I'm 21 years old, and I'm her boyfriend. I love my girlfriend very much.

text: 巴士上面有個人跌咗落嚟
eng: Someone fell on the bus

text: 「救命！」巴士上面有個阿叔跌咗落嚟，佢喺度喊。
eng: "Help!" On the bus, an uncle has fallen down, and he was crying.

text: 我問佢：「發生咩事？」
eng: I asked him, "What happened?"

text: 佢話：「頭先我行上去，上面有個小朋友，喺度又跑又跳，跑上跑落。
eng: He said, "I just got on, and there was a kid there, running and jumping around, running up and down.

text: 跟住一個唔小心，我嘅鎖匙同電話，就喺袋入面跌咗出嚟，一跌就跌咗落嚟下面。
eng: Then by accident, my keys and phone, which were in my pocket, fell out, and then fell underneath [the seat].

text: 我想落嚟執返鎖匙同電話，行落去嗰陣，架巴士郁咗一郁，跟住我就跌親。」
eng: I wanted to go down and pick up my keys and phone, and as I walked down, the bus moved and I fell."

text: 有好多人過咗嚟幫佢。佢話眼同鼻有啲痛，手同腳就冇事。
eng: A lot of people came to help him. He said his eyes and nose hurt a bit, but his hands and feet were fine.

text: 有人幫佢執返鎖匙同電話落個袋裏面。
eng: Someone helped him put his keys and phone back into his pocket.

text: 又有人企起身畀個位佢坐，佢坐低咗之後就瞓咗。
eng: Also someone got up and gave him a seat; after he sat down he went to sleep.

text: 有個婆婆話：「最緊要人冇事！」
eng: A grandma said, "The most important thing is that people are okay!"

text: 之後我企喺度睇書，玩咗一陣電話，又聽咗一陣歌。
eng: Then I stood and read, played on the phone for a while, and listened to music for a while.

text: 去到我落車嗰陣阿叔都未起身。
eng: By the time I got out off the bus the uncle hadn't gotten up.

text: 落車之後我覺得有啲肚餓，就去咗隔籬街一間餐廳度食飯。
eng: After getting off the bus I felt a bit hungry, so I went to eat at a restaurant on the next street.

text: 冇反應有呼吸
eng: Unresponsive breathing

text: 偉俊：我哋玩多鋪啦！
eng: Weijun: We play many stores!

text: 穎兒：我玩夠喇，轉人玩啦。
eng: Yinger: I've played enough, and I've changed people to play.

text: 志明頭先話頭暈都冇點玩過，我去問下佢而家玩唔玩先。
eng: Zhiming just said that he didn't play much with dizziness, so I went to ask him if he played first.

text: （穎兒起身揾志明）穎兒：志明！你喺邊呀？
eng: (Ying'er gets up to find Zhiming) Ying'er: Zhiming! Where are you?

text: （廁所門開咗一半，穎兒發現志明對腳瞓咗喺地下）
eng: (Half open the toilet door, Ying'er finds Zhiming sleeping on the ground with his feet on the ground)

text: 穎兒：（推門）（踎低，搖志明膊頭）喂！志明！你冇事吖嘛？聽唔聽到我講嘢呀？喂！
eng: Yinger: (Push the door) (squat, shake Zhiming's shoulder) Hey! Zhiming! Are you okay? Can you hear me? Hey!

text: （志明冇回應）（偉俊聽到叫聲衝入廁所）
eng: (Zhiming didn't respond) (Weijun heard the cry and rushed into the toilet)

text: 偉俊：發生咩事呀？
eng: Weijun: What happened?

text: 穎兒：志明暈咗呀！嗌佢冇反應！
eng: Ying'er: Zhiming fainted! Shout that he didn't respond!

text: 偉俊：（踎低，搖志明膊頭）志明！聽唔聽到我哋講嘢呀？
eng: Weijun: (squatting down, shaking Zhiming's shoulder) Zhiming! Can't hear us?

text: （偉俊觀察志明胸口起伏）
eng: (Wei Jun observes the rise and fall of Zhiming's chest)

text: 偉俊：胸口有起伏，即係有呼吸，但係叫極都冇反應，
eng: Wei Jun: There are ups and downs in the chest, that is, there is breathing, but there is no response to how to call,

text: 不如打九九九叫救護車啦，同埋打電話俾志明媽媽。
eng: it is better to call 999 to call an ambulance, and call Zhiming's mother.

text: 穎兒：（點頭）（打電話）（救護員到場）
eng: Ying'er: (nodding) (calling) (ambulance worker present)

text: 救護員：個男仔係你哋邊個呀？屋企有冇大人喺度？
eng: ambulance man: Which of you is a boy? Is there an adult in the family here?

text: 偉俊：我哋係佢嘅朋友。而家冇大人喺度，志明媽媽返緊嚟。
eng: Wei Jun: We are his friends. Now there are no adults here, in Zhiming's mother is back.

text: 救護員：有冇佢身份證喺度呀？同佢登記返資料。
eng: Ambulance: Is his ID card here? Register back with him.

text: 偉俊：（遞上身份證）有呀。
eng: Wei Jun: (Hands over ID card) Yes.

text: 救護員：幾時發現佢冇咗意識㗎？最後見到佢冇事係幾時呀？
eng: Ambulance: When did you find out that he was unconscious?

text: 穎兒：頭先五點我推門入廁所發現佢瞓咗喺度，嗌極冇反應。
eng: Ying'er: Just now at five o'clock I pushed the door into the toilet and found that he was sleeping here, shouting extremely unresponsive.

text: 一個鐘之前仲同緊佢打緊機，不過玩咗陣佢話有少少頭暈，所以去咗休息。
eng: I was playing electric with him an hour ago, but after playing for a while he said he was a little dizzy, so he went to rest.

text: 救護員：佢有冇咩長期疾病，例如糖尿病、心臟病，又或者貧血？
eng: Ambulance: Does he have any long-term medical conditions, such as diabetes, heart disease, or anemia?

text: 偉俊：佢有貧血。
eng: Wei Jun: He has anemia.

text: 救護員：佢平時有冇食開嘅藥㗎？
eng: Ambulance: Does he usually take prescribed medicine?

text: 偉俊：我唔知佢有冇食開藥，要問返佢媽媽先知。
eng: Wei Jun: I don't know if he took prescribed medicine, I have to ask his mother to find out.

text: （救護員將志明送往醫院）
eng: (The ambulance worker took Zhiming to the hospital)

text: 偉俊：當發現有人倒卧地上，胸口有起伏，有呼吸，但叫佢冇反應嘅時候，
eng: Wei Jun: When it is found that someone is lying on the ground, his chest is heaving, there is breathing, but he is not responsive,

text: 應該立即揾人幫手，打九九九叫救護車，通知大人，救護員到場後同佢哋交待事發經過。
eng: he should immediately find someone to help, call 999 to call an ambulance, notify the adults, and explain to them after the ambulance arrives.

text: 親愛嘅你:上星期識到你之後，我真係開心到傻，你又靚又叻，我真係好鍾意你。
eng: Dear you: After meeting you last week, I'm so stupidly happy; you're both beautiful and smart, I really like you.

text: 我好想同你一齊去食飯飲嘢，然後去公園望下天空望下樹，
eng: I would love to go to dinner and drink with you, and then go to the park to look at the sky and the trees,

text: 或者去海邊望下海，跟住返屋企玩下貓貓狗狗，再一齊上牀瞓個靚覺，
eng: or go to the seaside and look at the sea, then go home and play with the cats and dogs, and then go to bed together for a nice sleep,

text: 之後生返三四五個小朋友，日日同佢哋一齊踢波打波唱歌去街。
eng: after that, give birth to three, four, five children; every day play football, play ball, sing songs, go out with them.

text: 救命！諗到都開心。
eng: Help! I'm happy to think about it.

text: 唔知你明唔明白我講咩。
eng: I don't know if you understand what I'm saying.

text: 唔明？唔緊要，我可以同你講多次。
eng: Don't understand? Never mind, I can tell you again.

text: 聽日下晝三點鐘，我會喺你屋企樓下間超市門口等你，希望你可以落嚟。
eng: Tomorrow at three o'clock in the afternoon, I’ll be waiting for you at the door of the supermarket downstairs from your house, hoping you can come down.

text: 打風落雨？我唔怕！
eng: Typhoon and rain? I'm not afraid!

text: 如果你出現，我就會好用力噉攬住你。約實你喇。
eng: If you show up, I will hug you hard. I'm going to ask you out.

text: 你嘅未來男朋友，香蕉仔上
eng: Your future boyfriend, Little Banana

text: 屋企人
eng: Family

text: 今日，爸爸、媽媽、哥哥、細妹都喺屋企。
eng: Today, Dad, Mom, Big Brother, and Little Sister are all at home.

text: 哥哥同細妹都想出街，哥哥想去打波，細妹想同同學行街。
eng: Brother and Sister both want to go out; Brother wants to play ball, and Sister wants to go shopping with her classmates.

text: 但係今日落大雨，佢哋出唔到街；
eng: But today it's raining heavily, and they can't go out;

text: 佢哋全日都喺屋企：哥哥玩手機，細妹睇書。
eng: They are at home all day: Brother plays with his mobile phone, and Sister reads a book.

text: 細妹鍾意靜，唔鍾意嘈，佢喺嘈嘅地方睇唔到書。
eng: Sister likes to be quiet, doesn't like to be noisy, at noisy places she can't read books.

text: 哥哥同細妹唔同，佢唔怕嘈。
eng: Brother is not like Sister, he is not afraid of noise.

text: 噉今日屋企嘈唔嘈？
eng: So, is the home noisy today or not?

text: 細妹覺得有啲嘈，佢睇唔到書；
eng: Sister feels it's a bit noisy, she can't read her book;

text: 哥哥打緊機，都覺得有少少嘈。
eng: Brother is playing with his phone, he also feels it's a bit noisy.

text: 點解屋企咁嘈？
eng: Why is it so noisy at home?

text: 因為爸爸喺廳睇緊電視，部電視好大聲。
eng: Because Dad is watching TV in the living room, and the TV is very loud.

text: 媽媽唔覺得嘈；
eng: Mom doesn't feel it's noisy;

text: 佢諗緊另一啲嘢，聽唔到部電視嘅聲。
eng: she's thinking about something else and can't hear the TV.

text: 媽媽諗緊咩呢？
eng: What is Mom thinking?

text: 哥哥同細妹都唔知。
eng: Neither Brother nor Sister knows.

text: 爸爸知唔知呢？
eng: Does Dad know?

text: 佢要知，但係佢唔知。
eng: He must know, but he doesn't.

text: 媽媽喺廁所出嚟，大聲噉問爸爸：「你覺唔覺得我唔同咗？」
eng: Mom comes out of the toilet and asks Dad loudly: "Do you think I'm different?"

text: 哥哥問細妹：「你覺唔覺得媽媽條問題好難答？」
eng: Brother asks Sister, "Don't you think Mom's question is hard to answer?"

text: 喺廳嘅媽媽大叫：「唔係啊！係我重咗啊！」
eng: In the living room Mom shouts, "No! I got so big!"

text: 細妹同阿哥講：「我覺得媽媽嘈過部電視。」
eng: Sister says to Brother, "I think Mom is noisier than the TV."

text: 恐龍仔，對唔住啊！
eng: Little Dinosaur, I'm sorry!

text: 我要送你畀我嘅好朋友。
eng: I'm going to introduce you to my good friend.

text: 佢係阿賢，佢屋企好細，冇嘢玩。
eng: He is Billy, his home is very small, and he has nothing to play with.

text: 佢好好人㗎，你肚餓，佢畀嘢你食，你口渴，佢畀水你飲。
eng: He is a good man; when you are hungry, he gives you something to eat, when you are thirsty, he gives you water to drink.

text: 天氣好，佢同你落公園玩。
eng: When the weather is good, he goes with you down to the park to play.

text: 嗰度有花，同埋雀仔。
eng: There, there are flowers and birds.

text: 有啲雀仔大過你，重過你，你唔好驚，佢哋唔食你㗎。
eng: Some birds are bigger than you, and heavier than you - don't be afraid, they won't eat you.

text: 有啲雀仔細過你，輕過你，你唔好食佢哋啊。
eng: Some birds are smaller than you, and lighter than you - don't eat them.

text: 佢哋都好曳，喺天空飛，成日便便，你冇佢哋咁曳。
eng: They are also naughty; they fly in the sky, poop all day - you are not as naughty as they are.

text: 天氣再好啲，你哋搭巴士，去沙灘。
eng: When the weather is even better, you take the bus and go to the beach.

text: 晏晝，有太陽，好熱。
eng: In the afternoon, when the sun is out, it is very hot.

text: 夜晚，有月亮，凍咗，要着多件衫啊。
eng: At night, when the moon is out and it has cooled off, you need to wear more clothes.

text: 天氣唔好，你哋唔好去街喇，喺屋企唱歌啦。
eng: When the weather is bad, you don't go out; instead you sing at home.

text: 佢唱歌，你拍手，唔好笑佢唱得難聽啊。
eng: He sings, you clap your hands; don't laugh when he sings badly.

text: 你應該靜啲，阿賢有一個好細嘅細妹，成日要瞓覺㗎。
eng: You should be quiet, Billy has a very small little sister who always has to sleep.

text: 你有咩想要，同阿賢講啦，佢同我一樣，都明白你講咩㗎。
eng: Whatever you want, tell Billy, he is like me, he also understands what you say.

text: 我好掛住你。──阿樂上
eng: I miss you so much. ── Joy

text: 媽媽送咗一架車仔，同一隻恐龍仔畀阿樂。
eng: Mom has given a small car and a little dinosaur to Aa-Lok.

text: 阿樂好鍾意佢哋，成日拎佢哋嚟玩，同佢哋一齊瞓。
eng: Aa-Lok liked them very much, always brought them to play, and slept with them.

text: 有一日起身，阿樂變到好細粒，同車仔一樣大，而恐龍仔唔見咗。
eng: One day when he got up, Aa-Lok became very small, as big as the little car, and the little dinosaur disappeared.

text: 阿樂話：「嘩！張床好大呀！」
eng: Aa-Lok said, "Wow, the bed is huge!"

text: 佢坐上車仔，車仔郁，佢哋喺張床上面，轉咗三個圈。
eng: He sat on the little car, the car moved, and they were on the bed, spinning in circles three times.

text: 佢問車仔：「不如我哋同埋媽媽一齊玩啦。」
eng: He asked the little car: "Why don't we play with Mom."

text: 車仔答：「媽媽咁大個，坐上嚟，架車會行唔到。」
eng: The little car replied: "Mom is so big, if she sits down, the car won't be able to go."

text: 阿樂話：「又係喎！」
eng: Aa-Lok: "True!"

text: 阿樂又問：「我哋去緊咩地方呀？」
eng: Aa-Lok asked again, "Where are we going?"

text: 車仔答：「公園。」
eng: The little car replied, "The park."

text: 車仔行過嘅地方，有幾支花呀。
eng: Where the trolley went to, there were some flowers.

text: 再轉多一個圈，車仔停咗。
eng: After going around one more circle, the little car stopped.

text: 阿樂問：「咦？做咩停呀？」
eng: Aa-Lok asked, "Huh? Why stop?"

text: 車仔答：「我都唔知呀。」
eng: The car replied, "I also don't know."

text: 阿樂落車，車仔下面有一條條黑色、好長嘅嘢，車仔行唔到。
eng: Aa-Lok got off the car; on the little car there were black strips, very long ones, and the car couldn't go.

text: 係唔係老鼠仔條尾呢？
eng: Is it the tail of a little mouse?

text: 阿樂「嘩」一聲，覺得好驚。
eng: Aa-Lok said "wow" and felt so scared.

text: 佢諗一諗，知道屋企冇老鼠。
eng: He thought about it, he knew there are no mice in the house.

text: 係唔係貓仔條尾呢？
eng: Is it the tail of a kitten?

text: 佢又諗一諗，知道貓仔條尾大好多。
eng: He thought about it again, he knew a kitten's tail was much bigger.

text: 跟住佢諗到，係佢嘅頭髮呀！
eng: Then he thought of something, it's its hair!

text: 頭髮變到好長、好大、好重。
eng: Hair becomes very long, big, and heavy.

text: 佢拎走頭髮，車仔又郁到喇。
eng: He took the hair, and the little car moved again.

text: 佢上車，車仔轉多兩個圈，好似飛噉樣，跳上跳落。
eng: He got on the car, the little car spun around two times, as if it were flying, jumping up and down.

text: 原來係貓仔入咗房，跳咗上床，用手拍拍張床，令架車亂跳。
eng: It turned out that the kitten entered the room, jumped on the bed, patted the bed with its paw, and causing the car to bounce around.

text: 「哎吔！」阿樂覺得好驚，要車仔行快啲。
eng: "Aah!" Aa-Lok felt so scared that he asked the little car to go faster.

text: 貓仔唔知道佢係阿樂，好曳，想車仔停。
eng: The kitten didn't know that it was Aa-Lok, and was very naughty, wanting to stop the little car.

text: 跟住有啲聲，係恐龍仔呀！
eng: Then there was a sound, it was little dinosaur!

text: 而家恐龍仔好大隻，有十個阿樂咁大。
eng: Now the little dinosaur was very large, ten times the size of Aa-Lok.

text: 貓仔驚，跑走咗。
eng: The kitten was afraid and ran away.

text: 阿樂拍拍手，同恐龍仔一齊唱歌。
eng: Aa-Lok clapped his hands, and sang with the little dinosaur.

text: 玩多一陣，已經過咗一個下晝，阿樂要瞓喇。
eng: After playing a bit more, it's already afternoon, and Aa-Lok needs to sleep.

text: 起身，佢變返大個仔，手上面拎住車仔同恐龍仔。
eng: When he got up, he had transformed back into a grown up boy, with his hands holding the little car and the little dinosaur.

text: 鄉愁
eng: Nostalgia

text: 讀完書之後，佢去咗外國公司返工，同外國人結婚。
eng: After finishing his studies, he went to work for a foreign company and married a foreigner.

text: 而家，佢已經好少講中文又好少睇中文書嘞。
eng: Now, he rarely speaks Chinese rarely reads Chinese books.

text: 「呢首歌我好鍾意，叫『春夏秋冬』」
eng: "I like this song very much, it's called "Spring, Summer, Autumn and Winter""

text: 「呢部戲喺你家鄉拍，叫《阿飛正傳》。」
eng: "This drama was filmed in your hometown, called "A Fei Zhengzhuan". "

text: 呢本書有好多詩，係一個好叻嘅詩人寫嘅。
eng: There are many poems in this book, written by a very clever poet.

text: 其中一首叫「鄉愁」。
eng: One of them is called "Homesickness".

text: 聽完之後，我諗起我家鄉
eng: After listening, I remembered my hometown

text: 十年前，鄉愁係呂宋島，我喺呢度，屋企喺嗰度。
eng: Ten years ago, homesickness was Luzon, I was here, my home was there.

text: 而家呢，鄉愁係有好多細路仔笑聲嘅屋，我喺呢度，笑聲喺嗰度。
eng: Now, nostalgia is a house with a lot of children's laughter, here I am, laughter is there.

text: 我好鐘意呢首詩，呢本書。
eng: I love this poem, this book.

text: 望
eng: Looks

text: 我今日唔使返工，想出去行吓。
eng: I don't have to work today and want to go out for a walk.

text: 出面好好太陽，有少少雲，又唔係好熱。
eng: Outside it's very sunny, a little cloudy, and not very hot.

text: 我鍾意呢啲天氣。
eng: I like this weather.

text: 我驚下晝行山好多人，唔去喇，都係去公園好啲。
eng: I'm afraid in the afternoon there will be a lot of people hiking, so I won't go. I'd rather go to the park.

text: 我慢慢噉跑完七圈，停咗一陣，跟住行去海邊。
eng: I slowly ran seven laps, paused for a while, and then walked to the beach.

text: 近橋嗰度嘈啲，我睇下貓仔就走喇。
eng: There was a little noise near the bridge, I looked at a kitten and then left.

text: 遠啲嗰度有座塔，上到去睇日落靚啲㗎。
eng: In the distance there is a tower, going up there will give a more beautiful view of the sunset.

text: 唔使要好多嘢，噉樣已經好好。
eng: You don't need a lot of things, like that's already good.

text: 估唔到，我未上到去塔頂，個天已經開始落雨。
eng: Unexpectedly, before I could get to the top of the tower, it started to rain.

text: 我一個人喺下低，企咗一陣，見到有個人行咗落嚟，企喺我側邊。
eng: I stood alone underneath, and stood there for a while, when I saw a man come down, and stand next to me.

text: 佢望住手上面隻錶，又望吓海，喺度笑緊，我覺得佢好好睇。
eng: He looked at the watch in his hand, and looked at the sea, smiling; I thought he looks good.

text: 睇到佢望我，我個心跳得好快，面都紅晒，個身都熱晒。
eng: When I saw him looking at me, my heart was beating fast, my face was all red, and my body was hot.

text: 佢笑咗一笑，指一指出面。
eng: He smiled and pointed outside.

text: 咦？停咗雨喇喎。
eng: Huh? It had stopped raining.

text: 佢指一指向上，側一側頭，對眼望住我。
eng: He pointed upwards, tilted his head sideways, and looked into my eyes.

text: 我笑咗出聲，學佢乜都唔講噉行上去。
eng: I laughed out loud, like him I walked up without saying anything.

text: 佢都上咗嚟。我哋一齊睇日落。
eng: He also came up. Together we watched the sunset.

text: 又橙又紫嘅天空，落完雨之後好靚。
eng: Orange and purple sky, beautiful after rain.

text: 噉就已經好好。
eng: So that's already good.

text: 喺度撞到呢個人，噉就仲好。
eng: Bump into this person here, that's even better.

text: 講啲咩好？佢鍾唔鍾意我講咁多嘢？
eng: What should I say? Does he want me to say something?

text: 心入面諗咗好多，好似海浪噉，冇停過。
eng: I thought a lot of things, like the waves of the ocean, it didn’t stop.

text: 我係咪諗多咗？
eng: Am I thinking too much?

text: 佢睇一睇隻錶，開咗聲先：「真係啱啱好。」
eng: He looked at the watch, and broke the silence first, "It's just right."

text: 「係啊。你又會知嘅？」
eng: "It is. And you'd know this?"

text: 「撞啱㗎咋，咁啱場雨好快完。」
eng: "It's just a coincidence, the rain ends quickly."

text: 又咁啱我哋喺度。
eng: Another coincidence is that we are right here.

text: 阿仔
eng: Son

text: 今日係星期六唔使返工，咪諗住喺屋企瞓返一個上晝。
eng: Today is Saturday, no need to go to work, so I'm thinking of staying at home for a whole morning.

text: 點知老婆好早醒咗，佢喺牀上郁嚟郁去，跟住突然拍拍我隻手：「老公！老公！好起身啦！」
eng: Unexpectedly, my wife woke up early, she moved around on the bed, and then suddenly patted my hand: "Husband! Husband! Get up!"

text: 我仲未瞓夠，唔係好想理佢：「咩事啊老婆？幾點啊而家……」
eng: I hadn't slept enough yet, and don't really want to pay attention to her: "What's the matter, wife? What time is it now..."

text: 「仲問我幾點？十一點都嚟緊喇！」「噉又點啊……」
eng: "You still ask me what time it is? It's eleven o'clock!" "So what..."

text: 「你唔記得阿仔等陣兩點返到香港咩？我哋要去機場接佢啊！你再唔起身，我嬲㗎喇！」
eng: "Don't you remember that later at two o'clock our son will be back in Hong Kong? We need to go to the airport to pick him up! If you still don't get up, I'll be angry!"

text: 聽到佢話會嬲，我即刻醒返啲啲，但係諗兩諗覺得唔對路：「老婆，阿仔好似係聽日先返喎……」
eng: Hearing her say she'll be angry, I woke up immediately, but after thinking about it I felt something didn't make sense: "Wife, our son seems to be coming back tomorrow..."

text: 「咦？係喎……噉不如我哋諗下聽日搭巴士定係地鐵去機場吖？」
eng: "Huh? Yes... So how about we think about taking the bus or the subway to the airport tomorrow?"

text: 我哋阿仔二十一歲，十八歲去咗英國讀書，去咗三年。
eng: Our son is twenty-one years old, at the age of eighteen he went to the UK to, he went for three years.

text: 而家佢讀完書喇，今日喺英國搭飛機，聽日返到香港。
eng: Now he has finished his studies, today he will take the plane in the UK, tomorrow he will return to Hong Kong.

text: 唔知佢而家點呢？係肥咗定係瘦咗？有冇高到？有冇識返個女朋友？
eng: I wonder how he is doing now? Has he become fat or thin? Has he become taller? Has he found a girlfriend?

text: 聽日佢會唔會同埋個女仔嚟香港㗎？
eng: Tomorrow, will he come with a girl to Hong Kong?

text: 佢三年嚟少咗講廣東話，唔知仲記唔記得點講廣東話呢？
eng: He has spoken little Cantonese for three years, I wonder if he still remembers how to speak Cantonese.

text: 佢會唔會同我哋講英文㗎？
eng: Will he speak English to us?

text: 我同老婆啲英文好水皮，一啲都唔叻㗎。
eng: I and my wife's English is not so good, not smart at all.

text: 老婆成日鬧我唔錫阿仔，我覺得係佢唔明白阿爸對阿仔嘅愛啫。
eng: My wife always scolds me for not kissing my son, I think it's because she doesn't understand a father's love for his son.

text: 我都好掛住阿仔，好想快啲到聽日㗎！
eng: I also miss my son, and I can't wait for tomorrow!

text: 我哋要永遠喺埋一齊！
eng: We want to be together forever!

text: 心心喺孤兒院長大，佢最好嘅朋友就係孤兒院養嘅狗仔旺財。
eng: Growing up in an orphanage, his best friend is the orphanage's dog, Wangcai.

text: 旺財肥嘟嘟，眼仔碌碌，每次見到心心都會好開心噉汪汪叫，又跟岀跟入。
eng: Wangcai is fat, his eyes are sluggish, and every time he sees his heart, he will scream happily and follow him.

text: 今日晏晝，心心如常準備好狗糧，打算餵旺財食午餐。
eng: This afternoon, Xinxin prepared dog food as usual, intending to feed Wang Cai for lunch.

text: 咦？旺財呢？唔見咗嘅？
eng: Huh? What about Wangcai? Gone?

text: 心心大嗌：「旺財！旺財！夠鐘食飯喇！」
eng: Heart cursing: "Wangcai! Wangcai! It's time to eat!"

text: 佢四圍揾旺財，最後發現旺財瞓咗喺花園地下，好唔舒服噉。
eng: He went around picking up Wangcai, and finally found Wangcai lying under the garden, as if he was very uncomfortable.

text: 院長先生即刻帶旺財去睇獸醫。
eng: Mr. Dean immediately took Wang Cai to the veterinarian.

text: 獸醫托一托眼鏡，話：「旺財已經二十歲，好老喇。
eng: The veterinarian holds a pair of glasses, "Wang Cai is twenty years old, very old.

text: 狗一老，就會易病。我估計，佢應該仲有幾個月生命。」
eng: When dogs are old, they are susceptible to disease. I estimate that he should have a few months to live.

text: 心心好唔開心，夜晚一個人睇電視，唔肯同其他小朋友講嘢。
eng: The heart is very unhappy, watching TV alone at night, and refusing to talk to other children.

text: 電視做緊旅遊節目。
eng: TV is doing travel shows.

text: 主持人話：「傳說喺喜瑪拉雅山頂有一種藥，食完之後咩病都醫得好，仲會長生不老！」
eng: The host said: "Legend has it that there is a medicine on the top of the Himalayas, which can cure any disease after eating, and will live forever!"

text: 心心即刻上網搜尋喜瑪拉雅山嘅資料，執齊食物，放埋旺財入書包，準備岀發。
eng: Xinxin immediately searched the Internet for information about the Himalayas, packed up food, put it in Wangcai's school bag, and prepared to distribute it.

text: 去到門口，居然撞到院長！「你咁急趕住去邊呀？」院長攔住心心。
eng: When I got to the door, I actually bumped into the dean! "Where are you in such a hurry?"

text: 心心話：「我要上山揾藥救旺財！」
eng: Heart: "I want to go up the mountain to take medicine to save prosperity!"

text: 院長好有耐性噉同心心講：「嗰啲只係傳說，唔係真㗎！
eng: The dean patiently said with one heart: "Those are just legends, not true!

text: 心心唔忿氣，佢唔理院長，一枝箭衝去火車站。
eng: The heart is not convinced, he does not care about the dean, and an arrow rushes to the train station.

text: 就噉樣，佢哋一人一狗開始咗揾萬能藥嘅旅程。
eng: In this way, they began their journey to find a panacea by one person and one dog.

text: 佢哋喺山腳租咗一隻牛。
eng: They rented a cow at the foot of the mountain.

text: 隻牛揹住旺財，心心拖住隻牛，行咗一個星期，終於由山腳行到山頂。
eng: A cow carried prosperity on its back, led a cow in his heart, walked for a week, and finally walked from the foot of the mountain to the top of the mountain.

text: 山頂有個和尚。
eng: There is a monk at the top of the mountain.

text: 心心問和尚：「你好，我哋係上嚟求藥㗎。請問呢度係咪有萬能藥？」
eng: Heart to ask the monk, "Hello, we are coming up to ask for medicine." Is there a panacea here?"

text: 和尚話：「係。請施主過嚟呢邊……」
eng: The monk said, "Yes." Please come over here ... "

text: 心心既愕然又震驚，話：「點解要噉做？」
eng: The heart was both stunned and shocked, "Why do you do this?"

text: 和尚話：「呢個就係長生不老藥。
eng: Monk: "This is the elixir of life."

text: 禿鷹食咗貓，貓嘅一部分就變咗禿鷹，另一部分變咗泥土，最後會開花。」
eng: The vulture eats the cat, and part of the cat becomes a vulture, the other part becomes dirt, and finally it will bloom.

text: 心心眼濕濕，話：「我想永遠同旺財一齊，唔想佢變成禿鷹！唔想佢變成花！」
eng: Tears welling up in my heart, "I want to be with Wang Cai forever, I don't want him to become a vulture, I don't want him to turn into a flower!"

text: 心心好失望，最後同旺財一齊落山。
eng: I was very disappointed, and finally fell with Wang Cai.

text: 喜瑪拉雅山風景優美，空氣清新，白雪雪噉。
eng: The Himalayas are beautiful, the air is fresh and snowy.

text: 旺財見到好開心，喺雪地上面跑嚟跑去，好似突然精靈咗好多。
eng: Wang Cai was so happy to see it, running around on the snow, as if suddenly there were a lot of elves.

text: 回程路上，心心見到雪地上面多咗好多腳印——有自己嘅，有旺財嘅。
eng: On the way back, I saw that there were many more footprints on the snow - those who had their own, those who had prosperity.

text: 返到孤兒院，心心離遠就見到院長喺門口。
eng: Back at the orphanage, my heart saw the director at the door in the distance.

text: 院長好緊張噉跑出嚟，大嗌：「心心！旺財！你哋終於返嚟喇，我好擔心你哋呀！」
eng: The dean ran out nervously, cursing: "Xinxin! Wangcai, you have finally returned, I am worried about you!"

text: 心心忍唔住眼淚，話：「院長你講得啱，呢個世界根本就冇萬能藥……」
eng: Xinxin couldn't hold back tears, "Dean, you are right, there is no panacea in this world..."

text: 院長聽到都心有戚戚焉，佢攬住心心，心心攬住旺財，三個攬住一齊喊，喊咗好耐。
eng: The dean heard it all in his heart, he held his heart, his heart held Wangcai, and the three of them cried together and cried for a long time.

text: 冇幾耐，花園開咗新嘅花。
eng: It didn't take long for the garden to bloom with new flowers.

text: 「我會永遠記得旺財。」院長話。
eng: "I will always remember Wangcai." The dean said.

text: 同樣，心心永遠都會記得，佢同旺財去過喜瑪拉雅山，好開心，好幸福，雪地上面有過佢哋兩個嘅腳印。
eng: Likewise, Xinxin will always remember that he and Wang Cai went to the Himalayas, so happy, very happy, and there were footprints of both of them on the snow.

text: 十公主
eng: Ten princesses

text: 我打開一本封面寫住「十公主」嘅相簿。你哋估唔估到邊個係我呢？
eng: I opened a photo album with "Ten Princesses" on the cover. Don't you guess who I am?

text: 「中間嗰個先係我，其他九個係我啲家姐扮我。
eng: "The middle one is me, and the other nine are my sisters pretending to be me.

text: 我哋係唔係好似樣呢？哈哈！」我笑笑口噉講。
eng: Are we like words? Haha!" I said with a smile.

text: 我哋一家人可以話文武雙全——我哋個個都有唔同才能，八家姐識跳舞，五、六、七家姐就好叻踢波。
eng: Our family can say that we are both civil and martial - each of us has different talents, the eighth sister can dance, and the fifth, sixth and seventh sisters are very smart to play football.

text: 只係七家姐出世冇耐就因為意外冇咗隻腳，踢唔到波，但係佢都好樂觀面對。
eng: It's just that the seventh sister was born not long ago because of the accidental loss of foot, and he couldn't play football, but he was also optimistic to face it.

text: 「你哋睇下呢張相，我哋嗰陣喺公園玩，爬咗上樹呢兩個就係五同六家姐，佢哋好曳㗎！
eng: "Look at this photo, I was playing in the park at that time, climbing up the tree, these two are the fifth and sixth sisters, they are very naughty!"

text: 有一次大家姐喺樹下睇書，睇到瞓著咗。於是佢哋靜雞雞剪咗大家姐啲頭髮！
eng: Once the big sister was reading under a tree and saw that she was asleep. So they quietly cut Big Sister's hair!

text: 大家姐一起身見到，激到鬧咗佢哋一大餐！」我諗返當日情景，忍唔住笑咗出聲。
eng: The big sister came to see it together, and she was so angry that she scolded them for a big meal!" I wanted to go back to the scene of the day, and I couldn't help but laugh and make a sound.

text: 有一日，我同三家姐喺度踢波，突然有班男仔走埋嚟，大聲話：
eng: One day, my third sister and I were playing football here, and suddenly a boy from the class came up to me and said loudly:

text: 「女仔人家踢咩波呀？又唔夠我哋男仔嚟，畀個場我哋用啦！你哋去玩公仔啦，哈哈哈哈……」
eng: "What kind of football do girls play? It's not enough for us boys, give us a field! You guys go play with stuffed animals, hahahaha..."

text: 我嗰陣好嬲，唔通女仔就唔踢得波？唔做得工程師？
eng: I was angry, don't girls play football? Don't be engineers?

text: 唔做得醫生？男仔就一定叻過女仔？呢啲唔係男仔專利嚟㗎！
eng: If you don't become a doctor, a boy must be smarter than a girl? Isn't it a boy's patent!

text: 當我想同佢哋理論嗰陣，大家姐出聲：「聽你哋噉講，即係如果我哋同你哋比賽，你哋贏梗啦？」
eng: When I wanted to theorize with them, the big sister said, "Listen to you guys, if we compete with you, of course, you win?"

text: 「喂！你哋有冇聽到呀？佢哋想同我哋比賽喎！
eng: "Hey, did you hear? They want to compete with us!

text: 你哋連教練都冇，又冇戰術，又冇球技，人又唔夠，仲想同我哋比？哈哈哈哈…..」
eng: You don't even have a coach, you don't have tactics, you don't have ball skills, you don't have enough people, and you still want to compare with us?

text: 其中一個男仔好睇唔起我哋噉。雖然我哋之間成日鬧嚟鬧去，但每次有事我哋都會一齊面對。
eng: One of the boys looked down on us. Although we are always scolding each other, we face something together every time.

text: 「我哋一共十姐妹，派五個對你哋五個乜都夠，差在你哋接唔接受挑戰啫。」大家姐笑住問。
eng: "There are ten of us sisters, and sending five of you is enough for the five of you, only if you accept the challenge. The big sister asked with a smile.

text: 「嚟咪嚟！你哋想冇面，我哋唔會阻止！」男仔咬住牙講。
eng: You don't want to lose face, we won't stop it!" said the boy, gritting his teeth.

text: 大家姐細細個就同爸爸一齊睇唔同球類運動，研究戰術，冇耐仲做埋學校球隊嘅助教。
eng: When she was a child, my eldest sister watched different ball games with her father, studied tactics, and worked as an assistant coach for the school team for a long time.

text: 以大家姐嘅戰術，加埋三、五同六家姐嘅球技，最後我哋五個女仔大勝對手十比零！
eng: With the tactics of the big sister, plus the skills of the third, fifth and sixth sisters, in the end, the five of us girls beat the opponent 10-0!

text: 之後班男仔咩聲都冇出就走咗喇。左邊係三家姐，右邊係二家姐——唔好睇佢哋噉，佢哋好聰明㗎！
eng: The boys in the back class left without making a sound. On the left is the third sister, on the right is the second sister - it is not good to look at them, they are very smart!

text: 頭先講嗰班男仔咪輸咗波嘅，佢哋之後唔服氣，居然第二日再嚟公園，話要同我哋鬥智！
eng: Just now said that the group of boys should not lose, they were not convinced, and actually came to the park the next day, saying that they would fight with us!

text: 佢哋有六個中六學生，仲要讀書好似幾好。見佢哋「武」唔得，就嚟「文」鬥，我哋笑咗出聲！
eng: They have six high school seniors, and it seems good to have to study. Seeing that they can't do "martial arts\

text: 講讀書，我哋都有高手，就係二同三家姐！班男仔好衰，見我哋兩個中五學生，特登問啲中六嘅問題。
eng: Speaking of reading, we all have masters, that is, the second and third sisters! The boys in the class are very bad, seeing us two middle five students, deliberately asking some questions about the third year of high school.

text: 但我兩個姐姐笑咗笑，二家姐就話：「理科（即係數學、化學等等）題目交畀你，其他等我嚟。」
eng: But my sister smiled, and the second sister said, "I'll give you science (that is, mathematics, chemistry, etc.) topics, and let me talk about the rest."」

text: 佢哋係我三家姐同九家姐。三家姐真係好神奇，佢除咗讀書叻，仲畀人一種親切感，好容易吸引人同佢做朋友。
eng: They are my third sister and ninth sister. The third sister is really amazing, in addition to reading smartly, he also gives people a sense of intimacy, and it is easy to attract people to be friends with him.

text: 至於九家姐，哈，同我一樣，百厭星一名，但佢搞笑功夫真係不得了，次次激嬲屋企人都好快哄得返佢哋，又係一個奇人。
eng: As for Sister Jiu, ha, like me, there is a naughty star, but his funny kung fu is really amazing, and every time he gets angry, the family quickly coaxes only them, and he is a strange person.

text: 「講到呢度，都想講返我九個家姐依家點。
eng: "Speaking of which, I want to talk about how my nine sisters are now.

text: 佢哋有啲做咗老師、醫生、社工，有啲就代表香港隊出去比賽。」我嘴角上揚噉講。
eng: Some of them worked as teachers, doctors, social workers, and some went out to play for the Hong Kong team. I said with the corners of my mouth rising.

text: 最後講下影響我好大嘅爸爸，佢係一個好傳統嘅男人，成日都想生返個仔，所以我哋個名都係叫「帶弟」﹑「來弟」噉。
eng: Finally, my father, who has a great influence on me, is a very traditional man who wants to give birth to a son all day, so our names are "Dai Brother" and "Lai Brother".

text: 但去到我個名就唔同，佢改咗我個名叫「阿妹」，噉我就問佢點解啦。
eng: But my name was different, he changed my name to "sister\

text: 點知佢好温柔噉笑住話我知：「『妹』係由『女』同『未』組成，我希望就算係女仔都好，都有能力改變呢個世界嘅未來。」
eng: Who knew that he smiled very gently and said: "'Sister' is composed of 'female' and 'un', I hope that even if it is a girl, it has the ability to change the future of this world."

text: 相簿上面嘅「十公主」就係佢親筆寫嘅。
eng: The "Ten Princesses" on the album was written by him.

text: 白白
eng: Snow White [name]

text: 我屋企有一隻貓，爸爸媽媽叫佢做白白。
eng: I have a cat at home, Dad and Mom call her Snow White.

text: 白白係一隻白色嘅貓。
eng: Snow White is a white cat.

text: 佢係女仔嚟，同我唔一樣，我係男仔。
eng: She's a girl, unlike me, I'm a boy.

text: 我鍾意白白，唔知白白鍾唔鍾意我？
eng: I like Show White, but I don't know if Snow White likes me or not?

text: 我摸白白，白白唔睬我。
eng: I touch Snow White, but Snow White ignores me.

text: 我驚白白唔鍾意我，我想佢鍾意我啊！
eng: I'm afraid Snow White doesn't like me, but I want her to like me!

text: 我鍾意白白，白白鍾意食魚，同我唔一樣，我唔鍾意食魚。
eng: I like Snow White; Snow White likes to eat fish, unlike me, I don't like to eat fish.

text: 點解白白鍾意食魚？我覺得魚唔好食。
eng: Why does Snow White like to eat fish? I think fish doesn't taste good.

text: 家姐同白白一樣，佢覺得魚好食。
eng: My sister is just like Snow White, she thinks fish tastes good.

text: 家姐成日話佢好鍾意食魚蛋。魚蛋係咩嚟㗎？
