eng: My sister always says she likes to eat fish balls. What are fish balls?

text: 雞仔喺雞蛋出嚟，噉魚仔係唔係喺魚蛋出嚟？
eng: Chickens come out of chicken eggs; this way, do fish come out of fish balls?

text: 我問家姐，家姐唔睬我。
eng: I asked my sister, but my sister didn't respond to me.

text: 白白唔鍾意食菜，同我唔一樣，我鍾意食菜，菜好好食。
eng: Snow White doesn't like to eat vegetables, unlike me, I like to eat vegetables, vegetables taste good.

text: 我有一次畀幾條菜白白食，白白食咗一條，然後即刻唔食。
eng: I once gave Snow White some vegetable to eat, Snow White ate some, but then immediately sopped eating.

text: 爸爸話我曳，我唔明啊。
eng: Dad said I was naughty, but I didn't understand it.

text: 點解我食菜，爸爸話我叻；白白食菜，爸爸話我曳？
eng: Why when I eat vegetables does Dad say I'm smart; but when Snow White eats vegetables, Dad says I'm naughty?

text: 白白唔鍾意沖涼，同我一樣，我都唔鍾意沖涼。
eng: Snow White doesn't like taking a shower, just like me, I also don't like taking a shower.

text: 我唔去沖涼，媽媽鬧我；白白唔沖涼，媽媽唔鬧佢。
eng: When I don't take a shower, Mom scolds me; when Snow White doesn't take a shower, Mom doesn't scold her.

text: 點解嘅？白白唔沖涼都係好白、好靚，我好鍾意白白。
eng: Why? Even though Snow White doesn't take a shower, she's still white and beautiful, I like Snow White very much.

text: 白白以前好細隻，同我一樣。
eng: Snow White used to be very small, just like me.

text: 白白而家好肥，同我唔一樣。
eng: Snow White is now very fat, not like me.

text: 點解白白肥咗嘅？
eng: Why did Snow White get fat?

text: 有一日，屋企多咗幾隻好細好細嘅貓仔。
eng: One day, at home there were more little kittens.

text: 我問家姐點解，家姐話白白做咗媽媽喇。
eng: I asked my older sister why, and my sister said that Snow White had become a mom.

text: 嘩！白白做咗媽媽啊，我好鍾意白白同白白嘅仔女。
eng: Wow! Snow White had become a mom, I so like Snow White and Snow White's children.

text: 佢哋叫咩名好？
eng: What are their names?

text: 植物王國
eng: Plant Kingdom

text: 媽咪話只要種多啲樹，樹王國就會畀張入場券你入去睇下佢哋嘅世界。
eng: Mom said that if you plant a little more trees, the tree kingdom will give you an admission ticket to see their world.

text: 媽咪話入面有好多識行嘅樹，啲河水仲識唱歌，周圍都充滿歡笑聲。
eng: Mom said that there were many trees that could walk, some rivers could sing, and there was laughter everywhere.

text: 我細細個就聽到入晒迷，如果我爬上一樖識行嘅樹，噉佢咪可以帶我周圍去？
eng: I was fascinated when I was a kid, if I climb a tree that I can walk on, then he can take me everywhere?

text: 哈哈，人哋騎馬，我就騎樹，諗起都興奮……
eng: Haha, people ride horses, I ride trees, I think about it ...

text: 所以，由四歲開始，我每年生日都會叫姐姐帶我去種一樖樹。
eng: So, from the age of four, I asked my sister to take me to plant a tree every year on my birthday.

text: 一樖、兩樖、三樖……去到今年終於要種第九樖喇！
eng: One, two, three ... ... Finally planting the ninth one this year!

text: 我一朝早就拉埋姐姐去後山種樹，我哋掘窿、埋樹苗、平土……
eng: I took my sister to plant trees in the back mountain in the morning, and we dug holes, entered saplings, leveled the soil ...

text: 我對手好似裝咗摩打噉嘭嘭聲做晒啲嘢，最後用力扤實啲泥土——第九樖樹苗終於種好喇！
eng: I rattled like an engine, and finally pressed the dirt hard - the ninth sapling was finally planted!

text: 我又踩下啲泥，唔通唔夠平？冇喎，周圍咩事都冇。
eng: I stepped on some mud again, isn't it cheap enough? No, there's nothing going on around.

text: 我頭耷耷噉返屋企，一日、兩日、三日……成個月都冇事發生。
eng: I went home with my head down, one day, two days, three days ... Nothing happened all month.

text: 唔通媽咪只係想我種多啲樹？又一年過去。
eng: Did Mom just want me to plant more trees? Another year passed.

text: 喺我生日嘅前一晚，我準備瞓覺嘅時候，突然聽到後面有咯咯嘅敲窗聲。
eng: The night before my birthday, I was getting ready to go to bed when I suddenly heard a gurgling knock on the window behind me.

text: 我擰轉頭，咩都冇。可能係聽錯？咯咯。又有兩下。
eng: I looked back and there was nothing. Maybe you heard you wrong? Cluck. Two more times.

text: 今次我行埋去睇真啲——唔通有雀仔？定係太大風，有雜物撞到窗？
eng: This time I walked over and looked at the real thing—were there birds? Or was it too windy and debris hitting the window?

text: 我嚇一嚇，仔細一睇，原來塊葉係有眼耳口鼻，仲有手手腳腳！
eng: I was frightened, and upon closer inspection, it turned out that the leaves had eyes, ears, mouth, nose, and hands, feet, and feet!

text: 我即刻諗起媽咪講過嘅樹王國，就話：「你哋係樹王國？發生咩事啊？有咩我可以幫手？」
eng: I immediately remembered what my mother had said about the Tree Kingdom, so I said, "Are you the Tree Kingdom?

text: 「樹王國？唔係啊，我哋係植物王國，快啲嚟啦，冇時間喇！」
eng: "Tree Kingdom? No, we are the plant kingdom, hurry up, there is no time!"

text: 樹葉人仔細細，但好大力，佢一掹，我就向前飛，仲要飛得超快，快到咩都望唔到。
eng: The leaf man is careful and thin, but with great force, as soon as he throws it, I fly forward, and I fly super fast, so fast that I can't see anything.

text: 當我企返穩嘅時候，我已經喺一個幾乎俾藍色淹沒嘅世界。
eng: By the time I got my feet back, I was already in a world that was almost overwhelmed by blue.

text: 「呢度係植物王國？我以為應該係多啲綠色，至少唔應該係藍色？」我話。
eng: I thought it should be a little more green, at least not blue?" I said.

text: 喺植物王國入面，唔單止全部路人嘅衫褲係藍色，就連地板、建築全部都係藍色！
eng: In the plant kingdom, not only the clothes of all passers-by are blue, but even the floors and buildings are blue!

text: 葉仔好慘噉話：「唉，人類世界越嚟越少大樹，連帶我哋植物王國都受影響，大家越嚟越唔開心，慢慢所有嘢都變晒做唔開心嘅藍色……」
eng: Ye Zi said miserably: "Alas, there are fewer and fewer big trees in the human world, and even our plant kingdom is affected, everyone is becoming more and more unhappy, and slowly everything has changed to an unhappy blue..."

text: 「噉我有咩可以幫到你哋？你帶我嚟一定有原因！」
eng: "Then how can I help you? There must be a reason why you took me!"

text: 「我留意咗你好耐，知道你係一個好愛大自然嘅人，每年都會種樹。」
eng: "I have been paying attention to you for a long time and know that you are a person who loves nature very much and plants trees every year.

text: 葉仔拉住我不斷行：「只要你同我哋國王講，呢個世界仲有人類係愛大自然嘅，國王一定會對人類有返信心，大家都會開心返！」
eng: Ye Zi pulled me and kept walking: "As long as you tell our king that there are still human beings in this world who love nature, the king will definitely have faith in human beings, and everyone will be happy to return!"

text: 話咁快，葉仔就帶我嚟到國王面前。
eng: Soon, Son Ye brought me to the king.

text: 國王連鬍鬚都係藍色嘅，成堂眉都垂晒落嚟，睇落好似隨時都會喊噉。
eng: The king even had a blue beard, and his entire eyebrows drooped, making him look as if he would cry at any moment.

text: 「人類，你嚟做咩呀？」國王好虛弱噉講。
eng: "Human, what are you doing?" said the king weakly.

text: 「國王，你好。我聽講你對人類冇晒信心，不過其實有唔少人都仲好鍾意大自然，好努力噉保護你哋！
eng: "Hello, King. I've heard that you don't have faith in humans at all, but there are many people who love nature and work hard to protect you!

text: 就好似我噉，我自四歲開始，每年都會種一樖樹，聽日就係第十年喇！」

eng: The king raised his head at this time, and he looked at me and said, "But you have so little strength alone, is it any use to only have ten trees?"

text: 「人類嘅力量貴在可以互相感染，每個人十樖十樖噉種，數量唔可以睇小……」
eng: "The strength of human beings is that they can infect each other, and each person planted ten trees like ten, and the number cannot be taken lightly..."

text: 聽完我呢番話，國王慢慢由藍色變成綠色——佢見到希望喇！
eng: After listening to my foreign language, the king slowly changed from blue to green - he saw hope!

text: 成個國家嘅藍色都即刻換返做唔同嘅顏色！

text: 葉仔開心到跳跳紥紥噉帶我喺王國周圍行，我哋去睇植物市集、花花雜技、拔草大賽……

text: 哇，原來植物王國有咁多嘢玩！

text: 正當我行得越嚟越興奮，突然有一粒石仔撠到我向前一仆——咯咯。
eng: Just as I was walking more and more excitedly, suddenly a small rock hit me and fell forward - cluck.

text: 我擘大眼，望到俾風吹咗兩下嘅玻璃窗，窗邊有一塊綠葉。
eng: I opened my eyes and saw a glass window blown twice by the wind, and there was a green leaf by the window.

text: 我拎喺手，笑咗笑。我又點會唔記得今日係種樹嘅大日子呢？
eng: I held it in my hand and smiled. How could I forget that today is the big day for planting trees?

text: 波板糖

eng: Xiao Ling asked Xiao Ming: "You have already used sixteen yuan, do you still have money to buy wave candy after that?"

text: 唔該晒你
eng: Thank you so much

text: 第一次，係喺間餐廳度見到佢。
eng: The first time I saw him in a restaurant.

text: 佢同緊嗰陣嘅男朋友一齊食飯。

text: 之後我聽到佢男朋友講唔想再一齊。

text: 佢喊，佢問男朋友記唔記得今日係咩日子。
eng: He cried, and he asked his boyfriend if he remembered what day it was.

text: 原來嗰日係佢生日。

text: 個男仔之後行開咗。

text: 我見到佢面上仲有好多淚水。

text: 跟住，我上前俾咗張紙巾佢。

text: 佢轉身走，行出咗間餐廳。
eng: He turned and walked out of the restaurant.

text: 唔知點解，見到佢喊，我個心有少少痛。係咪好傻？
eng: I don't know why, but seeing him cry made my heart ache a little. Isn't it silly?

text: 第二次，喺餐廳隔離間七-十一見到佢。
eng: The second time, I saw him in the restaurant isolation room 7-11.

text: 佢喺度叮緊嘢食。
eng: He tinks something inside to eat.

text: 我對佢笑咗一笑，點一點頭。唔知佢記唔記得我呢。
eng: I smiled at him and nodded. I don't know if he remembers me.

text: 我拎住個杯麵，諗住行去俾錢。
eng: I grabbed a cup of noodles and prepared to go and give the money.

text: 「十五個八吖。」「哎呀，我唔記得帶銀包。」
eng: "Fifteen eighties. "Oh, I don't remember bringing my wallet. 」

text: 「八達通吖。」「嘟！」佢幫我俾咗錢。
eng: "Octopus. "Toot!" he helped me give the money.

text: 「一人幫返一次。」佢笑住噉講。
eng: "One person helps you back." He said with a smile.

text: 原來佢笑起上嚟，係咁靚。
eng: It turned out that he laughed, it was so beautiful.

text: 「唔該晒你。」係我第一句同佢講嘅説話。
eng: "Thank you. That was the first thing I said to him.

text: 第三次見到佢，係喺小巴站度。
eng: The third time I saw him was at the bus station.

text: 「十五個八，小意思啦。」「你出港島？」「係呀。」
eng: "Fifteen eights, little meaning. "You're out of Hong Kong Island?" 」

text: 嗰次我哋並肩坐，車程二十分鐘。
eng: That time we sat side by side, a twenty-minute drive.

text: 我知佢個名叫阿心，同埋佢個電話號碼。
eng: I know his name is Ah Xin, and his phone number.

text: 我以為我哋之間嘅緣份可以一路延續落去。
eng: I thought our relationship could go on on one side.

text: 點知，一場大雨，令到寫喺我手掌心嘅電話號碼甩晒色。
eng: Who knows, a heavy rain made the phone number written in the palm of my hand fade.

text: 係幾多號呢？模糊嘅記憶，撞咗好幾次。
eng: Vague memory, bumped several times.

text: 「喂，發記。」「我想揾阿心。」「冇阿心吖。濾水芯就有。」
eng: "Hey, Hair. "I want to find my heart. "There is no heart. The water filter element is there. 」

text: 「喂。」「我想揾阿心。」「打錯。」
eng: "Hey. "I want to find my heart. "Typically. 」

text: 之後，我冇再撞過阿心。
eng: After that, I didn't hit my heart again.

text: 我努力工作，一路都冇拍拖。
eng: I worked hard and didn't fall in love on one side.

text: 而阿心呢個人，一路都記喺我心入面。
eng: And Ah Xin, this person, is remembered in my heart on one side.

text: 某日，學校家長日。有個熟悉嘅身影出現喺課室出面。
eng: Someday, School Parents' Day. A familiar figure appeared in the classroom.

text: 「係你？」「咦，好耐冇見。你幾好嘛？」係阿心。

text: 「我個仔上堂乖唔乖呀？」「都…都乖呀。」
eng: "Is my son well-behaved in class?" It's all good. 」

text: 估唔到會噉撞返佢。
eng: I didn't expect to bump back into him like this.

text: 阿心冇乜點變，笑起上嚟都係咁靚。
eng: The heart has not changed in particular, and the smile is still so beautiful.

text: 「唔該晒你，睇住我個仔。」
eng: "Thank you, looking at my son. 」

text: 呢句「唔該晒你」，同八年前嗰句比，感覺唔同咗。「唔使客氣。」
eng: This "thank you" feels different from the one eight years ago. "You're welcome. 」

text: 阿心呢個名，或者係時候放低喇。
eng: The name Ah Xin, maybe it's time to let go.

text: 「嗡嗡嗡~嗡嗡嗡~」係咩聲嚟呢？
eng: "Buzz, buzz" what's that sound?

text: 希希開眼，望一望，佢見到黃色、黑色、間條、六隻腳。
eng: Haley opens his eyes, looks around, he sees something yellow, black, striped, with six legs.

text: 「啊！蜜蜂啊！好驚啊！」
eng: "Ah! Bees! I'm so scared!"

text: 蜜蜂先生問：「希希唔好驚，不如你同我一齊飛吖？」
eng: Mr. Bee asks, "Haley, don't be afraid, why don't you and me fly together?"

text: 希希諗：「飛？我又唔識飛。」
eng: Haley thinks, "Fly? I don't know how to fly."

text: 「你望吓自己？」希希望望自己，佢見到黃色、黑色、間條、六隻腳。
eng: "Do you scare yourself?" Haley looks at himself, he sees something yellow, black, striped, with six legs.

text: 「啊！我係隻蜜蜂啊！！！」「跟住我！」
eng: "Ah! I'm a bee!!" "Follow me!"

text: 蜜蜂先生同希希一齊飛到去公園度。
eng: Mr. Bee and Haley fly to the park together.

text: 去到公園，唔係玩，而係去同啲花講早晨。
eng: Go to the park, not to play, but to say good morning to the flowers.

text: 「早晨花花。」「早晨花花。」「早晨花花。」去完一度，又一度，又一度。
eng: "Good morning flowers." "Good morning flowers." "Good morning flowers." Going once, and another time, and another time.

text: 有時蜜蜂先生仲會錫啲花。
eng: Sometimes Mr. Bee will even kiss the flowers.

text: 「蜜蜂先生，你腳上面黃色一點一點嗰啲係咩嚟㗎？」

text: 蜜蜂先生答：「呢啲係花粉。」「花粉有咩用㗎？」
eng: Mr. Bee replied, “It's pollen.” “What’s the use of pollen?”

text: 「我哋拎住啲花粉去其他花，佢哋先會生啲果實出嚟，然後果實又會生啲花出嚟。」
eng: “We carry the pollen to other flowers, and they grow fruit out, and then the fruit grows flowers.”

text: 「果實？即係蘋果都要？」「係呀，好多食物都要㗎。」
eng: "Fruit? That means apples need this?" "Yes, many foods do."

text: 「噉如果冇晒蜜蜂係咪會冇晒食物㗎？」
eng: "So if there are no bees, there will be no food?"

text: 「係呀。冇蜜蜂就會冇晒植物，又會冇晒食物㗎喇。」
eng: "Yes. Without bees there would be no plants, and there would be no food at all."

text: 希希同蜜蜂先生一齊飛返屋企，見到好多小朋友。
eng: Haley flew with Mr. Bee home, and they saw a lot of children.

text: 啲小朋友變到好大好大。
eng: The children became very big.

text: 呢啲咁大嘅小朋友見到黃色、黑色、間條、六隻腳嘅希希同蜜蜂先生。
eng: These big children saw the yellow, black, striped, six-legged Haley and Mr. Bee.

text: 佢哋即刻大嗌：「啊！蜜蜂啊！」
eng: They immediately yelled, "Ah! Bees!"

text: 有幾個小朋友追住佢哋跑，想打佢哋。
eng: A few children chased after them, and tried to hit them.

text: 蜜蜂先生同希希一齊飛高，避開咗啲小朋友。
eng: Mr. Bee and Haley flew high together, and evaded those children.

text: 「頭先佢哋再追近啲，我就會用條尾支針㗎喇。我哋只可以用一次。」
eng: "Earlier if they got closer, I'd use the stinger. We can only use it once."

text: 「我知道，老師都有講過，蜜蜂有支針，所以我本來先咁驚你。點解淨係可以用一次嘅？」
eng: "I know, the teacher also said that bees have a stinger, that's why I was so afraid of you. Why can it only be used once?"

text: 「哦......如果啲小朋友好驚你針佢哋，可以點做？」
eng: "Oh... if the kids are afraid you'll sting them, what can be done?"

text: 「佢哋可以企喺度唔郁，慢慢等我哋飛走。噉就得㗎喇。」
eng: "They can just stand there and not move, patiently wait for us to fly away. That's fine."

text: 飛到返屋企，蜜蜂先生同希希講拜拜。
eng: Having flown home, Mr. Bee and Hayley said goodbye.

text: 希希望望自己，黃色、黑色、兩隻手、兩隻腳。
eng: Hayley looked at himself, yellow, black, two hands, two legs.

text: 希希同自己講，之後都會好多謝蜜蜂，唔會再驚蜜蜂喇。
eng: Hayley told himself, later he will be very grateful to the bees, and no longer be afraid of bees.

text: 婆婆今年幾歲？
eng: How old is mother-in-law?

text: 喺一個休閒嘅周末，大部分都市人仲瞓緊嗰陣，
eng: On a casual weekend, when most urbanites are still sleeping,

text: 佢哋知道今日係婆婆生日，於是準備咗蛋糕同佢慶祝。
eng: They knew that today was their mother-in-law's birthday, so they prepared a cake to celebrate with him.

text: 個蛋糕雖然好靚，但就係少咗啲嘢——冇錯，就係蠟燭！
eng: This cake is beautiful, but it's missing something – yes, candles!

text: 但究竟要插幾多枝蠟燭至啱呢？似乎冇人知道婆婆幾多歲喎……

text: 佢哋去到婆婆屋企，婆婆坐喺藤椅上面享受緊窗外面照入嚟嘅陽光。

text: 婆婆諗咗一陣，然後慢吞吞噉回答：「幾歲……唔記得喇。」
eng: The mother-in-law thought for a while, and then replied slowly: "How old ... Don't remember. 」

text: 婆婆聽完笑咗笑，之後回應：「幾多歲真係咁重要咩？」
eng: The mother-in-law smiled after hearing this, and then responded: "Is it really so important how old you are?"

text: 婆婆見佢兩個咁緊張，就好努力噉諗下自己到底幾多歲，不過都係記唔起。
eng: Seeing that they were so anxious, her mother-in-law tried very hard to think about how old she was, but she still couldn't remember.

text: 然後，佢摸咗摸兩個乖孫個頭，話：「我真係唔記得喇，不過印象中，我五歲嗰年咁啱就係英女皇到訪印度嘅大日子。」
eng: Then, he touched the heads of his two good grandchildren, "I really forgot, but I remember that when I was five years old, it was the big day of the Queen of England's visit to India."

text: 佢哋即刻二話不說衝去圖書館，開始喺書架度揾舊報紙。
eng: They immediately rushed to the library without saying a word and began to search the shelves for old newspapers.

text: 佢哋好快就查出英女皇係喺一九九七年去過印度。

text: 於是，佢兩個又跑返婆婆間屋度問婆婆。

text: 婆婆見到佢兩個跑嚟跑去，就問：「點呀？知道我幾多歲未？」

eng: When the mother-in-law saw their reaction like this, she knew that they couldn't find the answer, so she laughed loudly.

text: 「婆婆，你唔想知道自己幾多歲咩？點解你可以一啲都唔關心㗎？」
eng: "Mother-in-law, don't you want to know how old you are?

text: 婆婆見佢兩個咁著緊，反而笑得仲開心，話：「點解你哋咁在乎我個年齡呢？」
eng: Seeing that they cared so much, the mother-in-law smiled happily, "Why do you care so much about my age?"

text: 婆婆：「點解生日就一定要插返同自己歲數一樣嘅蠟燭？生日嘅重點係蠟燭咩？」
eng: Mother-in-law: "Why do you have to insert candles that are the same age as yourself on your birthday?

text: 佢兩個諗咗一陣，就答：「生日嘅重點就梗係婆婆啦！」
eng: They thought for a while, so they replied, "Of course, the focus of birthday is mother-in-law!"

eng: Mom: I am not afraid of difficulties if I have the heart. And even if it's not for doing, learning is important for your growth.

text: 學到咁上下，你就會揾到自己嘅興趣，學習就會變成一件開心嘅事！
eng: Learn, you will find your own interest, and learning will become a happy thing!

text: 女：我知！我嘅興趣係跳舞！
eng: F: I know! My hobby is dancing!

text: 媽：但你都係學咗幾個月跳舞之後，至知道自己鍾意跳舞，係咪？
eng: Mom: But you still learned to dance for a few months before you knew that you liked to dance, didn't you?

text: 女：都係……噉爸爸可唔可以教我揸巴士啊？
eng: F: It's too... Can Dad teach me to touch the bus?

text: 爸：首先你要揾幼稚園老師教你好多基本嘅知識，然後大個就可以揾啲識揸巴士嘅人教你。
eng: Dad: First you have to find a kindergarten teacher to teach you a lot of basic knowledge, and then when you grow up, you can find someone who can drive a bus to teach you.

text: 女：爸爸教我基本知識咪可以囉？
eng: F: Can Dad teach me the basics?

text: 爸：爸爸媽媽好多時要返工教唔到你，而且我哋識嘅嘢又同幼稚園老師唔同，所以你要去幼稚園學啊
eng: Dad: Mom and Dad often have to go to work to teach you, and we know each other differently from kindergarten teachers, so you have to go to kindergarten to learn ah

text: 女：有咩唔同？
eng: F: What's the difference?

text: 媽：幼稚園老師知道點樣教你可以令你學得快啲啊。不如等我哋返屋企再講多啲你聽？
eng: Mom: Kindergarten teachers know how to teach you and you can learn faster. Why don't we go home and talk a little more, you listen?

text: 女：好！
eng: F: Good!

text: 幼稚園好多嘢玩
eng: Kindergarten has a lot of things to play

text: 媽媽洗咗啲生果畀阿女。
eng: The mother washed some fruit for her daughter.

text: 媽：幼稚園老師都會畀生果你做茶點。
eng: Mom: Kindergarten teachers will make you refreshments for fruit.

text: 女：唔係媽媽畀咩？
eng: F: Didn't my mother give it?

text: 爸：爸爸媽媽唔會跟你去幼稚園啊。
eng: Dad: Mom and Dad won't go to kindergarten with you.

text: 女：我唔要！
eng: F: I don't want it!

text: 媽：個個小朋友嘅爸爸媽媽都去幼稚園嘅話，幼稚園入面就會有太多人㗎喇！
eng: Mom: Every child's parents go to kindergarten, and there will be too many people in the kindergarten!

text: 但唔使驚㗎阿女，幼稚園老師會陪住你同其他小朋友，又會睇實你哋有冇整親或者唔開心！
eng: But don't be afraid daughter, the kindergarten teacher will accompany you and other children, and will see if you are hurt or unhappy!

text: 佢哋同我哋一樣會錫你，需要時會幫你、鼓勵你！
eng: They will kiss you just like we do, help you and encourage you when you need it!

text: 女：同爸爸媽媽一樣？
eng: F: Same as mom and dad?

text: 媽：係呀！老師會每日安排唔同嘅活動畀你哋，例如講故仔、玩遊戲！
eng: Mom: Yes, the teacher will arrange different activities for you every day, such as storytelling, playing games!

text: 唔止噉，佢哋仲會教每個小朋友一樣嘅嘢，好似唱歌、跳舞、做運動、畫畫、做勞作……
eng: Not only that, they will teach every child the same things, singing, dancing, doing sports, drawing, doing work...

text: 女：好多嘢玩……
eng: F: A lot of things to play with...

text: 媽：係啊，邊玩邊學！
eng: Mom: yes, where to learn!

text: 老師會睇吓你玩得好唔好、學得好唔好，然後話返畀我哋知你鍾意做啲乜，又會同我哋講可以做啲乜去幫你學得好啲。
eng: The teacher will see if you are playing well and learning well, then let us know what you like to do, and then tell us what you can do to help you learn better.

text: 所以其實喺你學習嘅時候，爸爸媽媽都係同你一齊㗎。
eng: So in fact, when you study, Mom and Dad are still with you.

text: 爸：係啊。有時老師仲會幫你哋分組做唔同活動。女：分組？
eng: Dad: yes. Sometimes the teacher will help you do different activities in groups. F: Group?

text: 爸：例如老師話要三個人一組玩，噉你就要揾多兩個組員一齊玩。
eng: Dad: For example, if the teacher says to play in groups of three, then you have to find two more group members to play together.

text: 女：如果我唔想三個人一齊玩呢？
eng: F: What if I don't want three people to play together?

text: 爸：阿女，你要同人玩，至可以學到同人分享同多啲新玩法，因為好多遊戲要多啲人至玩到，又或者要多啲人玩至好玩。
eng: Dad: Daughter, you have to play with people to learn to share with others and play a little more, because many games require more people to play, or more people to play to be fun.

text: 而且喺幼稚園，你要聽老師話，老師教你嘅規矩要遵守，例如去廁所要排隊、老師講嘢要保持安靜、喺走廊唔好亂跑……
eng: And in kindergarten, you have to listen to the teacher, the teacher taught you to follow the rules, such as queuing up to go to the toilet, keeping quiet when the teacher talks, not running around in the corridor ...

text: 女：點解幼稚園啲規矩同我哋屋企啲唔同嘅？
eng: F: Why are some of the rules of kindergarten different from our family?

text: 媽：因為出面嘅人同小朋友比屋企多好多，所以會有多啲唔同嘅規矩。
eng: Mom: Because there are many more people and children outside than at home, there will be a little more different rules.

text: 個個都守規矩，啲小朋友至可以安全噉玩同好好學習。
eng: Everyone follows the rules, so that some children can play and study as safely.

text: 你諗吓，如果老師講緊一個你好鍾意嘅故仔，但其他小朋友好嘈，你會點做？
eng: Think about it, what would you do if the teacher told a story that you liked very much, but the other children were noisy?

text: 女：我會叫佢哋唔好嘈！
eng: F: I would tell them not to argue!

text: 媽：噉你又諗吓，如果有啲小朋友係噉跑，撞低咗你，你會點做？
eng: Mom: Then think again, if some children run like this and knock you down, what will you do?

text: 女：我會同老師講！
eng: F: I'll tell the teacher!

text: 女：哦！爸：唔知道有咩規矩要守唔緊要，平時留心聽老師講嘢，有咩唔明就舉手問。
eng: F: Oh, Dad: It doesn't matter if you don't know what rules to follow, usually pay attention to the teacher, and raise your hand and ask if you don't understand.

text: 老師話要一齊玩就一齊玩，一齊玩仲可以學到合作精神。
eng: The teacher said that if you want to play together, you can play together, and you can learn the spirit of cooperation by playing together.

text: 女：合作精神？
eng: F: Cooperative spirit?

text: 爸：即係大家一齊做好一件事，例如今晚爸爸幫手整飯，媽媽整魚，你呢？
eng: Dad: It's just that everyone does one thing together, such as tonight Dad helps make rice, mom whole fish, how about you?

text: 女：我唔知……媽：你可以幫手洗碗呀。
eng: F: I don't know... Mom: You can help wash the dishes.

text: 幫人係一件開心嘅事，你幫多啲人，慢慢就會明白㗎喇。
eng: Helping people is a happy thing, you help more people, slowly you will understand.

text: 女：好，我以後都幫手洗碗！
eng: F: Okay, I'll help wash the dishes in the future!

text: 媽：好努力噉喎！
eng: Mom: I'm working this!

text: 我要做超人
eng: I want to be Superman

text: 我想做超人拯救世界，等啲人冇咁慘。
eng: I want to be Superman to save the world and make people less miserable.

text: 爸爸媽媽都讚好，因為超人成日都好努力幫人。
eng: Mom and Dad also praise because Superman tries to help people all day.

text: 但媽媽話超人識得自己換衫，我就揀自己鍾意嘅衫褲嚟換。
eng: But my mother said that Superman knows how to change his clothes, so I chose my favorite clothes to change.

text: 有啲鈕扣錯咗，但媽媽話超人細個時都係試好多次至做到，所以我都要學超人咁努力。
eng: A little wrong button, but my mother said that Superman tried many times when he was a child, so I have to learn Superman to work so hard.

text: 爸爸話，做超人仲要識得自己去廁所。
eng: Dad said that to be Superman, you also know how to go to the toilet yourself.

text: 我冇見過超人去廁所，但超人咁叻，一定識得自己去廁所。
eng: I have never seen Superman go to the toilet, but Superman is so smart that he must know how to go to the toilet himself.

text: 我去完廁所就自己沖廁、抹屁股、吱皂液洗手，但整濕咗少少件衫。
eng: I washed my hands after the toilet, wiped my butt, and squeaked soap, but I wet the dress a little.

text: 爸爸話我隻手離個水喉太遠，所以整濕。
eng: Dad said my hand was too far from a faucet, so it got wet.

text: 我決定做超人之後要將個洗手盆變細啲，大人細路都唔會再整濕衫。
eng: I decided to make the basin smaller after I became Superman, so that adults and children would no longer get their clothes wet.

text: 爸爸媽媽話，超人要識得自己做好多嘢。
eng: Mom and Dad say that Superman knows how to make a lot of things himself.

text: 因為雖然超人有好多好朋友，但有時佢都會得自己一個，冇人幫到佢。
eng: Because although Superman has many good friends, sometimes he is only himself, and no one can help him.

text: 而且佢先要有能力幫到自己同屋企人，至可以幫到隔籬同世界其他嘅人。
eng: And he has to be able to help himself and his family, so that he can help the rest of the world next door and the world.

text: 超人唔係一開始就咩都做到。
eng: Superman doesn't do everything in the beginning.

text: 佢都係不斷自己去試好多次，成功之後再幫其他小朋友，做老師同朋友眼中嘅「小超人」，然後大個就同啲好朋友一齊做「大超人」，繼續幫更多嘅人。
eng: He also continues to try many times by himself, and after success, he will help other children, be a "little superman" in the eyes of teachers and friends, and then grow up to be a "big superman" with some good friends and continue to help more people.

text: 做超人要先由自己做起，所以，有一樣嘢我覺得要再加油嘅，就係要識得自己一個人玩。
eng: To be Superman, you have to start with yourself, so one thing I think I need to work on is to know how to play alone.

text: 因為爸爸好忙，喺屋企都要做嘢，我要做爸爸嘅「小超人」，自己一個玩玩具。
eng: Because Dad is very busy and has to work at home, I want to be Daddy's "little superman" and play with toys by myself.

text: 我諗住用呢啲玩具去諗我嘅拯救世界大計！
eng: I'm going to use these toys to think about my plan to save the world!

text: 今日我第一日返學。媽媽拖住我隻手，同我一齊行。
eng: Today is my first day of school. Mom took my hand, and together we went.

text: 我大個女喇！行啦！行啦！
eng: I'm a big girl! Let's go! Let's go!

text: 呢度係學校。有好多小朋友啊！
eng: This is the school. There are a lot of children!

text: 有人搭巴士，有人坐車，有人踩單車，有人行路返學，同我一樣。
eng: Some people take the bus, some people take the car, some people ride bicycles, some people walk to school, just like me.

text: 我哋到門口。媽媽企喺門口，我自己行入去。
eng: We arrive at the door. Mom stands in the doorway, and I walk in by myself.

text: 呢度好多人。我唔識佢哋。
eng: Here there are a lot of people. I don't know them.

text: 一步。兩步。我行下停下。
eng: One step. Two steps. I walk and stop.

text: 好驚啊！媽媽呢？
eng: So scared! What about Mom?

text: 我跑返去媽媽度。我要媽媽，我唔想返學！
eng: I run back to Mom. I need Mom, I don't want to go to school!

text: 大家都入晒去喇！老師行出嚟。
eng: Everybody went in! The teacher comes out.

text: 媽媽話：「媽媽喺度等你放學。」
eng: Mom says, "Mom is waiting for you here after school."

text: 「拜拜媽咪，我返學喇！」
eng: "Bye bye Mom, I go to school!"

text: 今日媽媽得閒，佢想靜靜睇下書。
eng: Today Mom is free, and wants to quietly read a book.

text: 不過仔仔都一樣好得閒。佢冇嘢做。
eng: But her son is free as well. He has nothing to do.

text: 佢成日都唔聽話，開始想做啲好曳嘅事。
eng: All day he didn't listen, and started to act very naughty.

text: 仔仔嘈住話：「媽媽，攞嗰邊嗰個藍色盒畀我！
eng: The child shouted, "Mom, give me that blue box over there!

text: 我想要嗰個藍色盒！我想睇下裏面有乜嘢！」
eng: I want that blue box! I want to see what's in it!"

text: 媽媽答佢：「等陣先攞畀你啦！」
eng: Mom replied, "Wait a moment, I'll take it for you!"

text: 仔仔企上張櫈度，佢想自己攞個藍色盒落嚟。
eng: The child stood in a chair, and he wanted to take a blue box by himself.

text: 媽媽大叫：「唔好啊！阿仔！你一攞走最下面個盒，上面啲盒都會跌落嚟㗎！」
eng: Mom shouted, "No! Son! As soon as you take the bottom box, the boxes on top will fall!"

text: 仔仔嬲咗媽媽，佢覺得媽媽唔幫佢。
eng: The child was angry at Mom, he felt that his Mom did not help him.

text: 媽媽見到仔仔唔開心，諗住同仔仔出去行下。
eng: Mom saw that her child is unhappy, and thought she should go out with her child.

text: 「嚟啦，阿仔！同媽媽一齊去街市啦！」
eng: "Come, son! Go with your Mom to the market!"

text: 媽媽同仔仔去揾賣生果嘅伯伯。
eng: Mom and her child went to find the old man who sells fruit.

text: 媽媽諗住買啲蘋果返去。
eng: Mom intended to buy some apples and go back.

text: 仔仔見到啲橙，佢望住最下面嗰個話：「我想要嗰個橙！」
eng: When the son saw the oranges, he looked at the very bottom one and said: "I want that orange!"

text: 賣生果嘅伯伯鬧佢：「唔准！你隻曳曳豬！你一攞走最下面個橙，上面啲橙都會跌落嚟㗎！」
eng: The old man who sold the fruit scolded him: "Not allowed! You're a naughty piggy! As soon as you take the bottom orange, the oranges on top will fall down!"

text: 仔仔走咗入一間賣書嘅舖頭度。佢見到好多書。
eng: The child walked into a store selling books. He saw a lot of books.

text: 佢望住最下面嗰本書話：「我想要嗰本書！」
eng: He looked at the book at the very bottom and said: "I want that book!"

text: 賣書嘅哥哥叫停佢：「停手啊！細路！你一攞走最下面嗰本書，上面啲書都會跌落嚟㗎！」
eng: The brother who sold the book yelled to stop him: "Stop! Kid! As soon as you take the bottom book, the book on it will fall down!"

text: 仔仔又走到去賣點心嘅叔叔度。叔叔堆高啲咖喱角。
eng: The child walked again to the uncle who sold dim-sum. The uncle had piled high some curry puffs.

text: 仔仔見到啲咖喱角，佢望住最下面嗰嚿話：「我想食嗰嚿！」
eng: When the son saw the curry puffs, he looked at the very bottom one and said: "I want to eat that one!"

text: 賣點心嘅叔叔話佢：「唔好！你一攞走最下面嗰嚿，上面啲咖喱角都會跌落嚟㗎！你攞最上面嗰嚿咖喱角啦！」
eng: The dim-sum seller said to him, "No! As soon as you take the bottom one, the curry puffs all will fall down! Take the curry puff at the very top!"

text: 之後仔仔走去賣花嘅婆婆度，佢喊住口噉話：「我要掹走下面嗰朵花！」
eng: Afterwards, the son walked to the grandma who sold flowers, and he cried and said, "I want to pluck the bottom flower!"

text: 仔仔想攞啲乜嘢都攞唔到，佢好唔開心，又叫又喊。
eng: The child couldn't get anything he wanted, he was very unhappy, screaming and crying.

text: 其他人唔知道佢咩事，都好關心佢。
eng: Other people didn't know what he had, all cared about him.

text: 呢個時候，媽媽望住啲狗仔，踎低話：「我想要嗰隻，黑色嗰隻。」
eng: At this moment, Mom stared at some puppies, crouched down and said, "I want that one, the black one."

text: 仔仔突然唔再喊，佢對媽媽話：「唔好！唔好要嗰隻。」
eng: The child suddenly stopped crying, and he said to Mom, "No! Can't have that one!"

text: 「我哋要上面嗰隻。」仔仔講完之後，佢輕輕抱最上面嗰隻狗仔。
eng: "We want the one above." After the son finished speaking, he gently took the puppy on the very top.

text: 「黑色嗰隻狗仔喺最下面。媽媽一抱走佢，上面啲狗仔會跌落嚟，啲狗仔會受傷㗎！」
eng: "The black puppy is at the very bottom. As soon as Mom takes him away, the puppies above will fall down, the puppies will get hurt!"

text: 聽到仔仔噉講，媽媽對佢笑咗一笑，話：「你明白就好喇！」
eng: Hearing the child say this, Mom smiled at him and said, "You finally get it!"

text: 我叫小歌。我有我自己張牀，呢度係我自己嘅地方。
eng: I'm called Siu-go. I have my own bed, and this is my own place.

text: 我鍾意喺度瞓覺。不過我想瞓嗰陣，成日都有人撳門鐘。
eng: I love sleeping here. But when I want to sleep, someone always rings the doorbell.

text: 個門鐘好曳曳，佢喺度「鈴鈴」、「鈴鈴」噉樣嘈住我。
eng: The door bell is very naughty, and when it goes "Ding Dong!", "Ding Dong!" it disturbs me.

text: 我覺得好嘈。我轉一轉身，向住第二邊。
eng: I find it very noisy. I turn around and face the other side.

text: 跟住到個電話叫喇，佢喺度「滋滋」、「滋滋」噉樣嘈住我。
eng: Then comes a phone call, and when it goes "Buzz Buzz!", "Buzz Buzz!" it disturbs me.

text: 之後，我又轉下個身，試下瞓覺。真係唔開心啊！
eng: After that, I turn around again and try to sleep. I'm really unhappy!

text: 又有人喺度「咚」、「咚」噉樣嘈住我。
eng: Again there is someone going "Dong!", "Dong!" and it disturbs me.

text: 我瞓唔到。「啷啷」、「啷啷」！
eng: I can't sleep. "Tring Tring!", "Tring Tring!"

text: 呢次又係邊個嘈住我啊？出面有人踩單車！
eng: Who is disturbing me this time again? Someone outside is riding a bicycle!

text: 佢喺度撳緊單車上面個鐘。
eng: He is right here ringing the bell on his bicycle.

text: 媽媽走過嚟，佢問我：「小歌，乜你未瞓咩？」
eng: Mom walks over, she asks me, "Siu-go, why aren't you sleeping yet?"

text: 我望住媽媽，對眼大一大。
eng: I looked at Mom and my eyes widened.

text: 我用對眼同媽媽講：「我都想瞓啊！不過出面好嘈，好多聲音，我點瞓啊？」
eng: I said to Mom with my eyes, "I want to sleep too! But it's very noisy outside, there are many sounds, how can I sleep?"

text: 「鈴鈴」、「滋滋」、「咚」、「啷啷」！我向住邊邊，都一樣畀啲聲嘈住。
eng: "Ding Dong!", "Buzz Buzz!", "Dong!", "Tring Tring"! No matter which side I'm facing, I get disturbed by these sounds.

text: 鍾意顏色嘅熊人
eng: Bear man who likes color

text: 佢係熊人。聽人講佢好鍾意顏色㗎！
eng: He is a bear man. I heard that he likes colors very much!

text: 佢間屋有好多唔同顏色嘅畫。
eng: his house has a lot of paintings of different colors.

text: 不過佢自己就白雪雪，一啲顏色都冇，佢好唔開心啊。
eng: But he himself is white, there is no color at all, he is very unhappy.

text: 佢走出間屋，想揾多啲唔同嘅顏色。
eng: He walked out of the house looking for a little more different colors.

text: 佢走到樹下面，有啲嘢滴咗落佢個頭度。
eng: He went under the tree and something dripped into his head.

text: 係蜜糖啊！蜜糖係黃色嘅。
eng: It's honey! Honey is yellow.

text: 佢對耳仔都變咗黃色。
eng: His ears have turned yellow.

text: 有隻蜜蜂喺佢耳仔隔籬飛。
eng: A bee flies next door to his ear.

text: 佢想走，不過佢跌親啊！佢跌咗落啲泥度。
eng: He wanted to go, but he fell into the mud!

text: 啲泥係啡色嘅，搞到佢個肚都變咗啡色。
eng: The mud was brown, making his stomach brown.

text: 佢見到啲西瓜。西瓜出面好綠，入面好紅，睇起嚟好好食。
eng: He saw these watermelons. The watermelon is green on the outside and red on the inside, which looks delicious.

text: 佢切開個西瓜，拎咗一楷嚟食。
eng: He cut open a watermelon and took a handful to eat.

text: 楷西瓜搞到佢個口都紅晒。
eng: The watermelon made his mouth red.

text: 跟住佢揾到啲藍色嘅花。啲花可以用嚟做顏料。
eng: Then he found some blue flowers. These flowers can be used to make pigments.

text: 而家佢兩隻手都變咗藍色。
eng: Now both of their hands have turned blue.

text: 之後，佢瞓低喺綠草上面。就係噉樣，佢背後都變咗綠色。
eng: After that, he slept on the green grass. That's it, his back turned green.

text: 有工人油緊油喎。熊人睇到眼都唔轉，佢覺得啲顏色好靚。
eng: There is worker oil. The bear man didn't turn his eyes when he saw it, and he thought these colors were beautiful.

text: 原來佢對腳踩咗落啲油度啊！而家佢對腳都變咗粉紅色。
eng: So he stepped on his feet and lost some oil! Now his feet have turned pink.

text: 睇下！熊人佢唔再白雪雪喇。
eng: Look! Bear Man, he is no longer in vain.

text: 佢兩隻耳仔變咗黃色，個口變咗紅色，對手變咗藍色，
eng: their ears turned yellow, their mouths turned red, their opponents turned blue,

text: 對腳變咗粉紅色，個肚變咗啡色，後面仲變咗綠色。
eng: their feet turned pink, their stomachs turned brown, and their backs turned green.

text: 佢跌咗落去啲水度。
eng: He fell into the water.

text: 佢慢慢起身，由啲水度走出嚟。
eng: He gets up slowly and runs out of the water.

text: 不過啲水洗甩晒佢身上嘅顏色啊！
eng: But the water washed away the color on his body!

text: 佢又試白雪雪，咩顏色都冇晒喇！
eng: He tried it for nothing again, and there was no color!

text: 我頂帽喺架上面，我唔夠高攞。
eng: My hat is on the shelf, I'm not tall enough to reach it.

text: 爸爸幫我拎我頂帽。爸爸好高啊。
eng: Dad helps me get my hat. Dad is tall.

text: 我件衫掛咗喺櫃入面，我唔夠高攞。媽媽幫我拎我件衫。
eng: My clothes are hanging in the cabinet, I'm not tall enough to reach them. Mom helps me get my clothes.

text: 媽媽都幾高，不過爸爸高啲。
eng: Mom is also quite tall, but Dad is taller.

text: 我本書放喺張枱上面，我家姐幫我拎我本書。
eng: My book is put on the table, my older sister helps me get my book.

text: 家姐都高，不過媽媽高過佢。
eng: My sister is also tall, but Mom is taller than her.

text: 哥哥拎住我個袋。家姐企喺哥哥隔籬。
eng: My older brother is holding my bag. My sister is standing next to my brother.

text: 我見到家姐高過哥哥。不過哥哥高過我。
eng: I see my sister is taller than my brother. But my brother is taller than me.

text: 爸爸高過媽媽，媽媽高過家姐，家姐高過哥哥，哥哥高過我。
eng: Dad is taller than Mom, Mom is taller than Sister, Sister is taller than Brother, Brother is taller than me.

text: 我係屋企入面最矮嗰個。我大咗之後，要變高先得！咪住先！
eng: I am the shortest person in the family. When I'm older, I need to get taller! Wait a minute!

text: 我哋屋企養咗隻狗仔，佢叫阿早。阿早拎咗我隻鞋仔。
eng: We have a puppy at home, he is called Ar-Cho. Ar-Cho took my shoes.

text: 我叫佢即刻畀我。阿早先係屋企入面最矮嗰個。
eng: I tell him to give them to me right away. For now, Ar-Cho is the shortest one in the family.

text: 我高過阿早。阿早唔夠我高，佢矮過我。
eng: I am taller than Ar-Cho. Ar-Cho is not as tall as me, he is shorter than me.

text: 我唔夠哥哥高，我矮過哥哥。哥哥矮過家姐。
eng: I'm not as tall as my brother, I'm shorter than my brother. And Brother is shorter than Sister.

text: 我都矮過家姐。家姐矮過媽媽。
eng: I am also shorter than my sister. And Sister is shorter than Mom.

text: 哥哥同我都矮過媽媽。媽媽矮過爸爸。
eng: My brother and I are shorter than Mom. Mom is shorter than Dad.

text: 家姐、哥哥同我都矮過爸爸。
eng: Sister, Brother and I are shorter than Dad.

text: 爸爸係我哋屋企最高嗰個，阿早係最矮嗰個。
eng: Dad is the tallest one in our family, and Ar-Cho is the shortest one.

text: 我唔想淨係高過阿早。
eng: I don't want to only be taller than Ar-Cho.

text: 我想大咗之後變高啲，好似爸爸噉樣，做屋企最高嗰個！
eng: I want to get taller when I get older, like my dad, and be the tallest one in the family!

text: 呢度住咗好多動物。佢係隻驢。佢個名叫阿高。
eng: A lot of animals live here. He's a donkey. His name is Bheema.

text: 阿高好鍾意瞓覺。佢成日瞓到好晏都唔起身。
eng: Bheema loves to sleep. He always sleeps late and doesn't get up.

text: 其他動物食早餐嗰陣，阿高仲瞓緊。
eng: While the other animals eat breakfast, Bheema is still sleeping.

text: 佢成日都冇早餐食，啲早餐畀其他動物食晒。
eng: He always didn't eat breakfast, and the breakfast was all eaten by other animals.

text: 今日阿高又冇早餐食喇。佢覺得好肚餓，好唔開心。
eng: Today Bheema didn't have breakfast again. He felt hungry and unhappy.

text: 住喺隔籬嘅牛牛問佢：「點解你咁唔開心嘅？」
eng: Gauri [cow], who lives next door, asked him, "Why are you so unhappy?"

text: 阿高答佢：「我冇食早餐，好肚餓啊！」
eng: Bheema replied to him, "I didn't eat breakfast, I'm so hungry!"

text: 牛牛話：「不如聽日我叫醒你食早餐吖！」
eng: Gauri [cow] said: "How about tomorrow I'll wake you up for breakfast!"

text: 阿高話：「好啊！唔該你！」
eng: Bheema said: "Okay! Thank you!"

text: 到咗第二日，牛牛都係叫唔醒阿高。
eng: The next day, Gauri [cow] still couldn't wake up Bheema.

text: 到咗晏晝，阿高去到海邊，佢要送貨畀狗狗。
eng: In the afternoon, Bheema went to the beach, he needed to deliver goods to Moti [dog].

text: 狗狗見到阿高，問佢：「點解你咁唔開心嘅？」
eng: Moti [dog] saw Bheema and asked him, "Why are you so unhappy?"

text: 阿高答佢：「我已經兩日冇食早餐喇！」
eng: Bheema replied to him, "I haven't eaten breakfast for two days!"

text: 狗狗話：「不如聽日我叫你起身，一齊食早餐吖！」
eng: Moti [dog] said, "How about tomorrow I'll wake you up, and we have breakfast together!"

text: 阿高話：「好啊！唔該你！」
eng: Bheema said: "Okay! Thank you!"

text: 到咗第二朝，狗狗都係叫唔醒阿高。
eng: The next morning, Moti [dog] also couldn't wake Bheema.

text: 今日，阿高一樣冇早餐食。佢冇晒力噉瞓喺啲草度。
eng: Today, Bheema again didn't eat breakfast. So he didn't have any energy and lay down in the grass.

text: 雞先生行過，見到阿高，問佢：「點解你睇落咁攰嘅？」
eng: Cheenu [chicken] walked by, he saw Bheema, and asked him, "Why do you look so tired?"

text: 阿高答佢：「我三日冇食早餐喇，我好唔開心！」
eng: Bheema replied to him: "I haven't eaten breakfast in three days, I'm very unhappy!"

text: 雞先生話：「聽朝等我叫醒你啦！我一定可以嘅！」
eng: Cheeny [chicken] said, "Let me wake you up tomorrow morning! For sure I can do it!"

text: 阿高話：「好啊！唔該你！」
eng: Bheema said: "Okay! Thank you!"

text: 第二朝，雞先生好大聲叫，都係叫唔醒阿高。
eng: The next morning, Cheenu [chicken] screamed loudly, but he also couldn't wake up Bheema.

text: 其他動物點叫醒佢，阿高都係醒唔到。佢好唔開心。
eng: Other animals tapped him to wake him up, but Bheema still couldn't wake up. He was very unhappy.

text: 第二日朝早，其他動物開始食早餐喇，阿高仲瞓緊。
eng: The next morning, the other animals started eating breakfast, and Bheema was still sleeping.

text: 呢個時候，有隻烏蠅飛落阿高個鼻度。
eng: At this moment, a fly flew into Bheema's nose.

text: 「乞……嚏！」阿高打咗個大乞嚏。
eng: "Ac...choo!" Bheema sneezed loudly.

text: 阿高醒咗喇！佢坐起身，問：「我係點醒㗎？」
eng: Bheema woke up! He sat up and asked, "How did I wake up?"

text: 烏蠅答佢：「我叫醒你㗎！你想唔想我朝朝都噉樣叫醒你啊？」
eng: The fly replied to him, "I woke you up! Do you want me to wake you up like that every morning?"

text: 「好啊！」阿高答佢。「係你先叫醒到我咋！唔該你啊！」
eng: "Okay!" replied Bheema to him. "Only you can wake me up! Thank you!"

text: 烏蠅話：「唔使客氣！噉我哋食早餐啦！」
eng: The fly said, "You're welcome! Then let's have breakfast!"

text: 今日天氣好好，最啱出去玩。我同朋友仔坐晒喺度。
eng: The weather is nice today, it's the best time to go out and play. I sit with my friends right here.

text: 有啲乜嘢玩？呢度有石頭。
eng: What is there to play? Here there are some stone.

text: 試下拋高啲石頭，然後用隻手接返住佢哋吖。
eng: Try throwing stones high, then catch them with one hand.

text: 呢度有大樹。有人喺樹上面整咗個韆鞦。
eng: Here there is a big tree. Someone has put a swing on the tree.

text: 不如打韆鞦吖！我坐上韆鞦度，你喺後面推我。
eng: Let's play on the swing! I'll sit on the swing, and you'll push me in the back.

text: 我一路玩一路叫：「好嘢！我飛緊噉啊！」
eng: I played and shouted, "So great! It's like I'm flying!"

text: 不過玩嗰陣都要小心，唔好發生意外喎！
eng: But be careful when playing, don't have an accident!

text: 我細妹攞咗條繩出嚟，佢最叻係跳繩。
eng: My little sister got a rope out, she is the best at jumping rope.

text: 我同小花拎住條繩，一人拎住一邊。
eng: I and Siu-Faa held the rope, each holding one side.

text: 細妹開始跳喇。「一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八、九、十……」
eng: Little Sister started jumping. "One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten..."

text: 細妹跳到好多下，個個都話佢叻。
eng: Little sister can jump a lot, everyone says she's good at it.

text: 同多啲人一齊玩，會開心啲㗎！
eng: Playing with more people is more fun!

text: 我叫我細佬出嚟玩，唔好留喺屋企。
eng: I told my little brother to come out and play, and not stay at home.

text: 細佬鍾意瀡滑梯，一路瀡一路叫：「好嘢！我飛緊噉啊！」
eng: Little Brother likes the slide, he slid down and shouted, "Hurray! It's like I'm flying!"

text: 不過玩嗰陣都要小心，唔好發生意外喎！
eng: But be careful when playing, don't have an accident!

text: 有冇人想同我一齊玩啊？我返入屋，叫家姐出嚟玩。
eng: Is there someone else who wants to play with me? I went back inside and called my big sister to come out to play.

text: 家姐問我：「噉玩啲咩好先？」
eng: Big Sister asked me, "So what shall we play?"

text: 我答佢：「你出到去就有好多嘢玩㗎喇！」
eng: I replied to her, "When you go out there are a lot of things to play with!"

text: 而家有好多人。最啱玩捉伊人。
eng: Now there are a lot of people. Best for playing hide-and-seek.

text: 邊個做捉人嗰個？猜過先知！
eng: Who plays the catcher? We play rock-paper-scissors to find out!

text: 嚟啦，我哋猜啦！
eng: Come, we play rock-paper-scissors!

text: 大家鍾意玩乜就玩乜。
eng: Everyone can play whatever s/he likes.

text: 你鍾意打韆鞦就打韆鞦，佢鍾意跳繩就跳繩。
eng: If you like to swing then play on the swing. If s/he likes to jump rope then jump rope.

text: 自己一個人玩咩好啊？
eng: What's good to play alone?

text: 試下自己同自己踢波吖！都一樣好好玩㗎！
eng: Try playing football with yourself! It's just as fun!

text: 數下有幾多動物
eng: Count how many animals there are

text: 喺水邊，有一隻大笨象。
eng: By the water, there is an elephant.

text: 佢好口渴，慢慢噉行緊去飲水。
eng: He is thirsty, and slowly walking to drink water.

text: 有其他動物都喺度飲緊水喎。
eng: There are other animals drinking water too.

text: 原來係長頸鹿嚟，佢哋條頸好長。
eng: It turns out to be giraffes, they have long necks.

text: 你數唔數到呢度有幾多隻長頸鹿？係兩隻啊。
eng: Can you count how many giraffes there are here? It's two.

text: 呢度有三隻好大嘅動物，佢哋叫水牛。
eng: Here there are three very large animals called buffaloes.

text: 呢度仲有四隻白雪雪嘅雀仔，全部都去緊飲水。
eng: There are also four snow-white birds here, all of them going to drink water.

text: 好多動物都走嚟飲水喎。你數唔數到有咩？
eng: Many animals came to drink water. Can you count them?

text: 有五隻羚羊，同六隻野豬啊。
eng: There are five antelopes, and six wild boars.

text: 好多斑馬跑過嚟飲水，有七隻咁多啊！
eng: Many zebras ran over to drink water, there are seven of them!

text: 斑馬跑得好快，踢到啲沙都飛起晒。
eng: The zebras ran so fast, they kicked the sand flying up.

text: 有啲動物會住喺水入面㗎。睇下，而家就有八隻青蛙同九條魚喺度。
eng: Some animals live in the water. Look, right now there are eight frogs and nine fish.

text: 有隻獅子喺度大叫。佢都好想飲水。
eng: There is a lion roaring. He also wants to drink water.

text: 你知唔知道邊啲動物會驚獅子？
eng: Do you know which animals are afraid of lions?

text: 原來長頸鹿、水牛、羚羊、野豬、斑馬都驚獅子㗎！
eng: It turns out that giraffes, buffaloes, antelopes, wild boars, and zebras are afraid of lions!

text: 驚獅子嘅動物都走晒喇，得返大笨象同雀仔留低。
eng: All the animals that are afraid of lions are gone, leaving only the elephants and birds behind.

text: 青蛙同魚就繼續喺水入面。
eng: The frogs and fish remain in the water.

text: 小朋友，不如數下而家有幾多隻動物吖！
eng: Children, why not count how many animals there are now!

text: 我成日都出去出面。出面日日都有唔同嘅天氣。
eng: I go out all day. Outside every day there is a different weather.

text: 今日係星期日，天氣好好，有太陽，有海風。
eng: Today is Sunday, the weather is nice, there is the sun, there is a sea breeze.

text: 一路食雪糕，一路慢慢行，呢種感覺好正。
eng: It's a great feeling to walk well while eating ice cream.

text: 今日係星期一。太陽公公好勤力，佢曬到條街好熱。
eng: Today is Monday. Grandpa Sun worked very hard, and he was very hot on the street.

text: 佢太勤力喇，我坐喺樹下面，都出晒汗。
eng: He worked so hard that I sat under the tree and sweated.

text: 連棵大樹都畀佢曬到就嚟枯乾喇！
eng: Even a big tree was dried up by him!

text: 今日係星期二，出面吹緊大風。啲風吹到大樹都企唔直。
eng: It's Tuesday and it's windy outside. A little wind blows to the big tree and can't stand straight.

text: 我都爭啲跌親。我要用手撳實條裙，唔好畀啲風吹走。
eng: I almost fell too. I'm going to press my skirt tightly with my hands and don't let those winds blow away.

text: 今日係星期三，天空上面有好多雲。
eng: Today is Wednesday and there are a lot of clouds above the sky.

text: 啲雲黑蚊蚊，睇嚟好似想落雨噉。
eng: Point cloud black blocks that look like you want to rain.

text: 我睇唔到個太陽，有啲唔開心。
eng: I can't see the sun and I'm a little unhappy.

text: 今日係星期四，天氣好凍。
eng: Today is Thursday and it's so cold.

text: 我件衫好短，凍到我係噉震。
eng: My dress is short, so cold that I am so shocked.

text: 我應該要着多件衫，令自己唔好凍親。
eng: I should wear more clothes so that I don't get cold.

text: 今日係星期五。落咗成日雨。
eng: Today is Friday. It rained all day.

text: 啲雨喺個天空度落落嚟。
eng: Point rain falling in one sky.

text: 唔知天空上面係咪有人喊緊？
eng: I wonder if anyone is crying in the sky?

text: 今日係星期六，天空好多黑雲，仲行雷閃電。
eng: Today is Saturday, there are many black clouds in the sky, and there is thunder and lightning.

text: 啲雷聲好嘈，搞到我對耳仔好辛苦。
eng: The point of thunder is very noisy, and it makes my ears very hard.

text: 我要返入屋企喇！畀雷打中會受傷㗎！
eng: I'm going home! I'll get hurt if I hit the lightning!

text: 今日又係星期日喇！我好開心。
eng: It's Sunday again! I'm so happy.

text: 知唔知點解我咁開心？因為我見到彩虹啊！
eng: I know why I'm so happy, because I see rainbows!

text: 彩虹有好多顏色，有紅、橙、黃、綠、青、藍、紫，真係好靚啊！
eng: Rainbows have many colors, red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, purple, really beautiful!

text: 今日，我同爸爸、媽媽、細佬，一齊出去睇婆婆。
eng: Today, I went out with Dad, Mom, and my little brother to see Grandma.

text: 我好耐冇見婆婆喇！我好掛住佢。
eng: I haven't seen Grandma for a long time! I miss her so much.

text: 婆婆屋企出面有個大花園。
eng: Outside Grandma's house there is a big garden.

text: 花園度有芒果樹。
eng: In the garden there is a mango tree.

text: 芒果樹上面有好多雀仔。
eng: On the mango tree there are lots of birds.

text: 我匿咗上去芒果樹上面，靜靜坐喺度。
eng: I hid above the mango tree and sit quietly right here.

text: 呢度好正，冇人知道我匿喺度。
eng: It's great here, nobody knows I'm hiding here.

text: 爸爸以為我匿喺水井度，佢揾唔到我。
eng: Dad thinks I'm hiding in the well, he can't find me.

text: 媽媽以為我匿喺啲牛度，佢都揾唔到我。
eng: Mom thinks I'm hiding with the cows, she also can't find me.

text: 啊！婆婆隻狗仔揾到我！佢知道我喺度！
eng: Ah! Grandma's puppy found me! He knows I'm right here!

text: 原來婆婆見唔到我，佢好驚。佢揾緊我。
eng: Turns out Grandma couldn't see me, she was so scared. She's looking for me.

text: 我落返嚟，攬住婆婆，叫佢唔使驚。「我會聽話㗎喇。」
eng: I go back down, hug Grandma, tell her not to be afraid. "I'll behave."

text: 聽到我噉講，婆婆對住我笑。
eng: Hearing me say this, Grandma smiles at me.

text: 史先生種香蕉好叻，仲識整最好食嘅香蕉小食。
eng: Mr. Shi is very smart in growing bananas and will make the best banana snacks.

text: 不過佢嬲個樣都係最得人驚嘅，佢嬲嘅時候，樣好得人驚，面好紅，眼好大。
eng: But his angry look is also the most intimidating, when he is angry, he looks scary, his face is very red, and his eyes are big.

text: 佢一嬲，人人都走晒。佢老婆、仔女、朋友都怕咗佢。
eng: He was angry all his life, everyone was gone. His wife, children, and friends were afraid of him.

text: 啲動物雞飛狗走。佢小小事都會嬲。
eng: Some animals, chickens fly and dogs go. His little things can also be angry.

text: 啲嘢種得唔好啦，頭髮剪得唔靚啦，電視有問題啦，咩嘢都會嬲。
eng: These things are not used, the hair is not cut beautifully, there is a problem with the TV, everything will be angry.

text: 有日，史先生唔開心，冇人知點解。但係佢見到啲香蕉好靚。
eng: One day, Mr. Shi is unhappy, and no one knows why. But he saw that some bananas were beautiful.

text: 佢話：「啲香蕉好靚，可以整好好食嘅小食。」佢開心少少。
eng: He said, "Bananas are beautiful and make a delicious snack." He was a little happier.

text: 呢個時候，有好多馬騮跳過嚟。跳到史先生鍾意嘅香蕉上面。
eng: At this time, there are a lot of monkeys jumping over. Jump on top of Mr. Shi's favorite banana.

text: 史先生又嬲嘞。佢好嬲好嬲。嬲到面好紅，腳都好紅。
eng: Mr. Shi is angry again. He was angry and angry. So angry that his face was red and his feet were red.

text: 馬騮話：「怕咗佢，我哋走啦。」
eng: The monkey said: Afraid of him, let's go. "

text: 佢哋一路走，一路將啲香蕉皮掉落地。
eng: They walked along the way, dropping banana peels to the ground.

text: 史先生一路追，一路鬧。點知，佢踩到香蕉皮，跌低咗。
eng: Mr. Shi chased all the way and scolded at the same time. Who knows, he stepped on the banana peel and fell.

text: 佢想爬起身，再追馬騮。但係，佢唔小心，又跌多一次。
eng: He wants to get up and chase the monkey again. However, he was not careful and fell again.

text: 佢嘅口同面都係泥。呢個時候，馬騮已經走咗嘞。
eng: His mouth and face are mud. By this time, the monkey was gone.

text: 史先生望住自己，眼耳口鼻、手手腳腳、衫褲鞋襪都係泥。
eng: Mr. Shi stared at himself, his eyes, ears, mouth, nose, hands, feet, clothes, shoes and socks were all mud.

text: 佢覺得自己個樣好好笑。一開始係嘻嘻笑。
eng: He thinks his appearance is funny. It started with a giggle.

text: 跟住係呵呵笑。最後係哈哈哈哈笑到有眼水。
eng: followed by a huh. Finally, hahahaha laughed with tears.

text: 佢笑得好大聲。連馬騮都嚟睇。
eng: He laughs loudly. Even the monkeys came to see.

text: 佢笑得好大聲，大人細路個個都過嚟。
eng: He laughs loudly, adults and children come over.

text: 大家都冇聽過史先生噉樣笑。
eng: No one has ever heard Mr. Shi laugh like this.

text: 史先生一直笑，哈哈哈。大家都跟住佢笑。
eng: Mr. Shi kept laughing, hahaha. Everyone laughed along with him.

text: 馬騮笑，香蕉笑，大人細路，隻隻動物都一齊笑。原來笑係咁開心嘅。
eng: Monkeys laugh, bananas laugh, adults and children, animals laugh together. It turns out that laughter is so happy.

text: 而家，佢有時都會嬲，不過都鍾意笑。佢係笑得最大聲嘅。
eng: Now, he is sometimes angry, but he also likes to laugh. He laughed the loudest.

text: 嫲嫲屋企出面有個菜園，佢鍾意種菜畀自己食。
eng: Outside of Grandma's home there is a vegetable garden, she likes to plant vegetables for herself to eat.

text: 喺菜園度，有好多好好食嘅嘢。
eng: In the vegetable garden, there is a lot of good food.

text: 嫲嫲叫我幫佢手，摘啲番茄、矮瓜同豆返嚟。
eng: Grandma asked me to help her, pick some tomatoes, eggplants and beans and bring them back.

text: 我拎住啲番茄、矮瓜同豆返嚟畀嫲嫲。
eng: Holding those tomatoes, eggplants and beans I came back to give them to Grandma.

text: 嫲嫲話：「冇錯，摘啱晒，真係叻仔！」
eng: Grandma said, "Alright, all picked correctly, very smart boy!"

text: 跟住，嫲嫲叫我幫佢揾啲薯仔返嚟。
eng: Then, Grandma asked me to help her find some potatoes and bring them back.

text: 嫲嫲叫我慢慢揾。佢話淨係用眼睇唔到啲薯仔㗎。
eng: Grandma asked me to search slowly. She said if I only used my eyes, I couldn't see those potatoes.

text: 我淨係摸到啲草，揾唔到薯仔喺邊。
eng: I only touched a little grass, and couldn't find where the potatoes were.

text: 我返去同嫲嫲講：「菜園入面冇晒薯仔喇。」
eng: I went back to my grandmother and said, "In the garden there are no potatoes."

text: 嫲嫲話：「有㗎。你試下慢慢揾，一定揾到㗎！」
eng: Grandma said, "Yes there are. If you try to search slowly, you will definitely find them!"

text: 我去多次菜園。狗仔小黑都同我一齊行。
eng: I went to the vegetable garden many times. The puppy Blackjack also went with me.

text: 突然間，小黑又跑又跳，仲喺度大叫。佢個樣好開心。
eng: Suddenly, Blackjack ran and jumped, and even yelled here. He looked so happy.

text: 我跟住佢跑，睇下有咩事。
eng: I ran after him, see what was the matter.

text: 小黑聞到啲薯仔喺邊。佢個鼻真係好犀利。
eng: Blackjack smelled where these potatoes were. His nose is really terrific.

text: 「你真係好叻啊！係你先揾到咋！」我摸摸佢個頭。
eng: "You're really smart! It's you who found it!" I petted his head.

text: 原來啲薯仔生喺泥下面，唔似矮瓜噉畀人見到㗎。
eng: It turns out that those potatoes are born below the soil, and are not like eggplants that can be seen by people.

text: 星期日，文仔媽媽買咗件新雨褸畀佢。
eng: On Sunday, Aa-Man's mom bought a new rain coat for him.

text: 件雨褸橙紅色，好靚，文仔好想着住佢。
eng: The rain coat is orange-red, very beautiful, and Aa-Man really wants to wear it.

text: 媽媽話：「阿仔，雨褸淨係落雨嗰陣先着㗎咋！」
eng: Mom says, "Son, the raincoat can only be worn when it rains!"

text: 星期一，天氣好好，太陽好曬。啲花都開得好靚。
eng: On Monday, the weather is nice, and the sun is bright. The flowers are all in beautiful bloom.

text: 文仔問媽媽：「今日會唔會落雨啊？」
eng: Aa-Man asks Mom, "Will it rain today?"

text: 媽媽話：「應該唔會喇。」
eng: Mom says, "Probably not."

text: 星期二，個天好藍，淨係得一嚿白雲。
eng: On Tuesday, the sky is blue, just one white cloud.

text: 文仔唔開心，佢諗：「今日一定冇雨落喇。」
eng: Aa-Man is unhappy, he thinks, "Today for sure there won't fall any rain."

text: 星期三，天氣好熱，個太陽非常曬，犀利過之前。
eng: On Wednesday, the weather is very hot, the sun is very bright, stronger than before.

text: 文仔想喺屋企入面着件雨褸，點知熱到出晒汗。
eng: Aa-Man wants to wear the raincoat at home; unexpectedly it's hot until he is all sweaty.

text: 文仔好唔鍾意，佢問：「點解仲未落雨㗎？」
eng: Aa-Man really doesn't like it, he asks, "Why hasn't it rained yet?"

text: 媽媽都答佢唔到。
eng: Mom also couldn't answer him.

text: 星期四，天空上面有好多嚿雲。
eng: On Thursday, in the sky there are a lot of clouds.

text: 文仔攞住件雨褸，走出出面，喺公園等落雨。
eng: Aa-Man takes the rain coat, walks outside, and waits in the park for the rain.

text: 不過，孔雀先生同佢講：「啲雲咁高咁白，今日唔會落雨㗎！」
eng: However, Mr. Peacock says to him, "The clouds are so high and white, today it won't rain!"

text: 星期五，啲雲開始變黑喇。
eng: On Friday, the clouds began to turn black.

text: 文仔又攞住件雨褸，走去公園度等落雨。
eng: Aa-Man again takes the rain, and walks to the park to wait for the rain.

text: 孔雀先生話：「你咁想落雨，我幫你跳隻求雨舞啦！」
eng: Mr. Peacock: "You want rain so much, I'll help you dance a rain dance!"

text: 星期六，個天空好嘈：「嘭！」
eng: On Saturday, the sky is very noisy: "Boom!"

text: 發生咩事呢？係行雷啊！
eng: What happened? It was thunder!

text: 文仔好開心，佢問：「係咪好快就會落雨喇？」
eng: Aa-Man is so happy, he asks: "Will it rain soon?"

text: 青蛙哥哥答佢：「係啊，好快就會落雨㗎喇！」
eng: Brother Frog replies to him: "Yes, it will rain soon!"

text: 最後，個天真係落雨喇！
eng: Finally, it really rained!

text: 文仔同青蛙哥哥都好開心，佢哋喺雨入面跳舞。
eng: Aa-Man and Brother Frog are so happy, they dance in the rain.

text: 不過文仔係咪唔記得咗啲嘢呢？
eng: But didn't Aa-Man forget something?

text: 呢個時候，媽媽大聲叫：「文仔，你件雨褸啊！」
eng: At this moment, Mom shouts: "Aa-Man, wear the rain coat!"

text: 蝴蝶飛到高一高，佢喺天空跳緊舞。
eng: The butterfly flies to a high altitude, and he dances tightly in the sky.

text: 蜜蜂停低飲杯茶，佢要多糖唔飛沙。
eng: The bee stops for a cup of tea, he wants polysaccharides and does not fly sand.

text: 碟上有條紅衫魚，佢喺呢度覺覺豬。
eng: There is a red shirt fish on the plate, where he sleeps in.

text: 狗仔攞唔到個波，青蛙跳高接住咗。
eng: The puppy can't get a ball, and the frog jumps high.

text: 太陽一陣間落山，曬到鴨仔成身橙。
eng: The sun sets in a while, and the ducklings are orange.

text: 靚靚花朵紫又紅，上面有條青毛蟲。
eng: Beautiful flowers are purple and red with a green caterpillar on them.

text: 貓仔雖然戴橙帽，都遮唔住啲黑毛。
eng: Although the kitten wears an orange hat, it can't cover up a little black hair.

text: 細細粒嘅老鼠仔，住嗰間屋都唔曳。
eng: Petite mouse children, it's not bad to live in that room.

text: 啡毛狐狸好密實，行街要着四隻襪。
eng: The coffee fox is very hidden and wears four socks when shopping.

text: 草蜢一身都係綠，打開本書仔細讀。
eng: Grasshoppers are all green, open this book and read carefully.

text: 黑色山羊坐住船，喺河上面轉緊圈。
eng: Black goats in boats, spinning tightly on the river.

text: 見到淺水有鱷魚，走得太慢就執輸。
eng: See crocodiles in shallow water, run too slow and miss.

text: 生日蛋糕好好味，阿蛇食到舔舔脷。
eng: The birthday cake is delicious, and the snake licks its tongue.

text: 雞媽媽想學寫字，雞仔踩污糟張紙。
eng: Chicken mother wants to learn to write, chicken steps on dirty paper.

text: 老虎成身黑又黃，佢喺水邊曬太陽。
eng: The tiger is black and yellow, and he basks in the sun by the water.

text: 動物背後嘅故事，諗到我再話你知。
eng: The story behind the animal, think of me and say you know.

text: 水對我哋好緊要。平時嘅生活唔可以冇咗水。
eng: Water is important to us. Normal life can't be without water.

text: 水由一隻杯流入第二隻杯嗰陣，會有聲。
eng: When water flows from one cup into another cup, there will be a sound.

text: 我好鍾意聽呢種聲。
eng: I enjoy listening to this sound.

text: 條街落緊雨。我都好鍾意聽雨聲。
eng: It's raining on the street. I also love listening to the sound of rain.

text: 雨就係由天空落落嚟嘅水。
eng: Rain is water falling from the sky.

text: 有咗雨水，啲樹先可以生高啲。
eng: With rain, the trees can grow taller.

text: 我哋仲可以裝住啲雨水，留返嚟用。
eng: We can also hold some rainwater, keep it for later use.

text: 夏天成日都落大雨。爸爸叫我留返喺屋企入面。
eng: In the summer it rains heavily all the time. Dad tells me to stay inside the house.

text: 不過我覺得好悶，我冇聽爸爸話，出咗去玩。
eng: But I felt so bored that I didn’t listen to my father, and went out to play.

text: 啲雨淋到我濕晒。
eng: The rain made me wet.

text: 爸爸叫我返入屋：「阿女，噉樣淋雨會病㗎！」
eng: Dad told me to go back into the house. "Daughter, you'll get sick in the rain like this!"

text: 爸爸叫我即刻沖涼換衫，仲幫我梳返好個頭。
eng: Dad told me to immediately take a shower and change clothes, then he helped me comb my hair back.

text: 雨唔可以日日都落。
eng: Rain cannot fall every day.

text: 如果唔係，出面會水浸。
eng: Otherwise, it will be flooded outside.

text: 冇雨落嗰陣，太陽會出嚟。我就可以出去玩喇。
eng: When no rain falls, the sun comes out. I then can go out and play.

text: 我見到媽媽抱住細佬，我都想媽媽抱下我。
eng: I see Mom holding my little brother, I also want Mom to hold me.

text: 媽媽話：「阿女，我抱唔到你啊！你太大個喇！」
eng: Mom says, "Daughter, I can't hold you! You're too big!"

text: 貓仔成日都自己跑出街，我都想自己返學。
eng: The kitten always goes out by itself, I also want to go to school by myself.

text: 爸爸話：「咪自己一個行返學校啊！你太細個喇！」
eng: Dad says, "Don't go to school by yourself! You're too small!"

text: 細佬瞓緊，我想同佢一齊瞓。
eng: My little brother is sleeping, I want to sleep together with him.

text: 爺爺話：「唔好瞓細佬張牀喎，你太大個喇。」
eng: Grandpa says, "Don't sleep in your brother's bed, you're too big."

text: 公園有好多嘢玩，我想同細佬一齊去。
eng: In the park there are a lot of things to play, I want to go together with my little brother.

text: 嫲嫲話：「唔好帶細佬出去啊，你太細個喇。」
eng: Grandma says, "Don't take your little brother out, you're too small."

text: 點解啲大人講嘅嘢咁搞笑嘅？
eng: Why are the things that adults say so funny?

text: 我係太大個吖，定係太細個啊？
eng: Am I too big, or too small?

text: 我太大個，着唔到條舊裙仔。
eng: I'm too big, I can't wear the old dress.

text: 我太細個，媽媽唔准我入廚房。
eng: I'm too small, Mom doesn't allow me in the kitchen.

text: 我太大個，爺爺同唔到我玩騎牛牛。
eng: I'm too big, Grandpa can't play piggy-back riding with me.

text: 我太細個，帶唔到細佬去街。
eng: I'm too small, can't take my little brother out.

text: 貓仔你知唔知，我而家係太大個定係太細個？
eng: Kitten, do you know, am I too big or too small now?

text: 我真係唔明白。邊個答到我？
eng: I really don't understand. Who can answer me?

text: 媽媽對我笑一笑，佢話：「阿女，你啱啱好夠大個返學校。」
eng: Mom smiles at me and says, "Daughter, you're just big enough to go to school."

text: 爸爸大聲噉笑，對住我話：「阿女，你啱啱好夠細個，騎到我膊頭。」
eng: Dad laughs out loud and says to me, "Daughter, you're just small enough to ride on my shoulders."

text: 爺爺輕輕噉笑，佢同我講：「你啱啱好夠大個帶我出去行街。」
eng: Grandpa laughs softly and says to me, "You're just big enough to take me out for a walk."

text: 嫲嫲好開心噉笑，對住我話：「你又啱啱好夠細個，鍾意聽我講童話。」
eng: Grandma smiles happily and says to me, "You're also just small enough to like listening to me tell fairy tales."

text: 「你幾大個都好，我哋都係咁錫你㗎！」
eng: "No matter how old you are, we love you so much!"

text: 爸爸、媽媽、爺爺同嫲嫲都噉樣講。我好開心。
eng: Dad, Mom, Grandpa and Grandma all say so. I'm very happy.

text: 小歌、阿高、小花同阿細係好朋友。
eng: Siu-go, Aa-gou, Siu-faa and Aa-sai are good friends.

text: 今日，佢哋四個一齊玩車仔。
eng: Today, the four of them play with cars.

text: 小歌揀咗架私家車。
eng: Siu-go chose a private car.

text: 架車係綠色嘅。
eng: The car is green.

text: 阿高揀咗架巴士。
eng: Aa-gou chose a bus.

text: 架巴士係紅色嘅。
eng: The bus is red.

text: 阿細揀咗部貨車。
eng: Aa-sai chose a lorry.

text: 部貨車係藍色嘅。
eng: The lorry is blue.

text: 「準備，一，二，三！」佢哋推晒四架車仔出去。
eng: "Prepare, one, two, three!" They pushed all four carts out.

text: 呢個時候，黑白色嘅狗仔點點突然衝過去！
eng: At this moment, the black and white puppy Dim-dim suddenly rushed over!

text: 「點點贏咗啊！」估唔到點點快過晒啲車仔！
eng: "Dim-dim won!" I didn't expect Dim-dim to be faster than all the cars!

text: 「不過喺街上面，啲車開得好快㗎，所以要小心啊！」
eng: "But on the streets, the cars drive very fast, so be careful!"

text: 大家喺街上面都要小心安全啊！
eng: Everyone should be careful and safe on the street!

text: 晚晚我都心思思，想聽媽咪講故事。
eng: Every night I was itching and wanted to hear my mom tell stories.

text: 青蛙諗到鬼主意，打電話話畀人知。
eng: The frog thinks of a ghost idea and calls someone to know.

text: 國王啲鬚真係長，老鼠當係遊樂場。
eng: The king's beard is really long, and the mouse should be a playground.

text: 有時朝早打開窗，會見到識飛大象。
eng: Sometimes when you open the window in the morning, you will see flying elephants.

text: 老虎行路唔帶眼，唔小心跌咗落山。
eng: The tiger walks without eyes and accidentally falls off the mountain.

text: 好彩畀狐狸救返，老虎先唔使咁慘。
eng: Fortunately, it was rescued by the fox, so that the tiger did not have to be so miserable.

text: 故事世界好得意，動物好多新奇事。
eng: The story world is cute and the animals are a lot of novelty.

text: 聽住媽咪講故事，我瞓着咗都唔知。
eng: Listening to my mom's story, I didn't even know when I fell asleep.

text: 有時我望住個天空，就會好想飛。
eng: Sometimes I look at the sky, and I want to fly.

text: 於是我同爸爸講：「如果有啲嘢可以令人好方便噉飛就好喇！」
eng: So I said to Dad, "If only there was something that would allow people to fly conveniently!"

text: 爸爸整咗件新發明出嚟：「睇下，係竹蜻蜓啊！將佢戴喺頭上面，就可以飛上天空㗎喇！」
eng: Dad made a new invention: "Look, it's a bamboo dragonfly! Put it on your head and you can fly into the sky!"

text: 爸爸戴住佢飛咗上天空。我望住爸爸越飛越高，同佢講拜拜。
eng: Dad flew into the sky wearing it. I watched Dad fly higher and higher and said goodbye to him.

text: 爸爸都同我講拜拜，佢笑住噉飛走咗。
eng: Dad said goodbye to me too, and he flew off with a smile.

text: 爸爸冇整第二隻竹蜻蜓畀我，我冇得飛。我覺得好悶。
eng: Dad didn't make me a second bamboo dragonfly, I couldn't fly. I feel bored.

text: 我問貓仔：「你想唔想上天空玩啊？」
eng: I asked the kitten, "Do you want to play in the sky?"

text: 貓仔話：「想啊！不如你都發明啲嘢上天空吖！」
eng: The cat said, "I want to! How about you also invent something to go up to the sky!"

text: 我返入屋。枱上面仲有好多嘢。
eng: I went back into the house. There was a lot more on the table.

text: 「就等我發明啲嘢出嚟啦。」我噉樣諗。
eng: "Let me invent something," I thought.

text: 得咗喇！呢對係識得跳上天空嘅鞋！
eng: Got it! These are shoes that let you jump into the sky!

text: 我着住佢，輕輕一跳，就跳到好高喇。
eng: I put them on, and with a light jump, I jumped so high.

text: 我走出街，喺街上面跳嚟跳去。
eng: I walked out, and jumped up and down on the street.

text: 我好似超人噉啊！
eng: I'm like Superman!

text: 我跳上天空。雀仔見到我都覺得驚！
eng: I jumped into the sky. The birds felt scared when they saw me!

text: 我跳出天空，跳上太空。太空好黑啊！
eng: I jumped out of the sky and into space. It's so dark in space!

text: 不過太空太高喇！我跌緊落去啊！
eng: But space is too high! I'm falling down!

text: 我跌返落去天空度。爸爸見到我跌落嚟。
eng: I fell back into the sky. Dad saw me falling down.

text: 佢用兩隻手接住我。
eng: He caught me with both hands.

text: 落返嚟之後，爸爸改良咗我對鞋。
eng: After coming back down, Dad improved my shoes.

text: 而家，我、爸爸同貓仔都可以跳上太空玩喇！
eng: Now, me, dad and the kitten can all jump into space and play!

text: 今日，阿中同好多朋友仔一齊喺公園玩捉伊人。
eng: Today, Aa-Zung and many friends play hide-and-seek in the park.

text: 阿中做捉人嗰個。
eng: Aa-Zung plays the catcher.

text: 佢遮住對眼，開始數：「一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八、九、十、十一十二……」
eng: He covers his eyes, and begins to count: "One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten, eleven, twelve..."

text: 佢要數到五十先可以擘大眼，開始捉人。
eng: He needs to count to fifty before he can open his eyes, and start catching people.

text: 佢啲朋友仔即刻匿埋，唔畀阿中揾到。
eng: His friends immediately went into hiding, to not let Aa-Zung find them.

text: 高仔匿喺大樹後面。
eng: Gou-Zai hides behind a big tree.

text: 早藍匿喺架黃色車後面。
eng: Zou-Laam hides behind a yellow car.

text: 愛花匿喺門後面。
eng: Oi-Faa hides behind a door.

text: 佢離遠望住阿中。
eng: She looks at Aa-Zung from a distance.

text: 肥仔匿喺個籃下面。
eng: Fei-Zai hides under a basket.

text: 佢仲未匿好喎，仲見到佢對腳。
eng: He has not been hiding well yet, because you can still see his feet.

text: 阿紅匿喺個桶入面。
eng: Aa-Hung hides in a bucket.

text: 佢覺得個桶夠大。
eng: He thinks the bucket is big enough.

text: 「二十一、二十二、二十三……」數數下，阿中停咗落嚟。
eng: "Twenty-one, twenty-two, twenty-three ..." After counting a bit, Aa-Zung stopped.

text: 「二十三之後係咩啊？」原來阿中唔識數到五十。
eng: "What is after twenty-three?" Turns out Aa-Zung can't count to fifty.

text: 阿中數到二十三就擘大眼，噉係唔啱㗎！
eng: Aa-Zung counted to twenty-three then opened his eyes, that's not right!

text: 老鼠仔同大山羊
eng: Little Mouse and Big Goat

text: 老鼠仔成日都郁嚟郁去，佢最鍾意喺出面玩。
eng: Little Mouse runs around all day, he loves to play outside the most.

text: 今日，老鼠仔想玩跳飛機，不過冇人同佢一齊玩，佢覺得好悶。
eng: Today, Little Mouse wants to play hopscotch, but no one is around to play with him, and he feels bored.

text: 「係喎，大山羊應該得閒㗎！」老鼠仔噉諗。
eng: "Oh right! Big Goat should be free!" thought the Little Mouse.

text: 「揾佢同我一齊玩咪得囉！」
eng: "Let's find him to play together!"

text: 大山羊成日都好得閒。
eng: Big Goat is always free.

text: 佢鍾意一個人釣魚，由朝早釣到夜晚。
eng: He likes to fish by himself, fish from morning to evening.

text: 而家，大山羊喺屋企度瞓覺。
eng: Now, Big Goat is at home sleeping.

text: 老鼠仔去到大山羊間屋度，敲佢門口。
eng: Little Mouse has arrived at Big Goat's house, knocks on his door.

text: 大山羊瞓緊，唔知道老鼠仔嚟咗。
eng: Big Goat is sleeping, not knowing that Little Mouse has come.

text: 老鼠仔又喺窗度叫：「大山羊！出嚟同我玩吖！」
eng: Little Mouse called at the window again: "Big Goat! Come out and play with me!"

text: 大山羊答佢：「唔好啦，我想瞓覺啊！」
eng: Big Goat answered him, "No, I want to sleep!"

text: 老鼠仔捐入大山羊間屋度。
eng: Little Mouse crawled into Big Goat's house.

text: 「起身啦，大山羊！」老鼠仔摷醒佢。
eng: "Get up, Big Goat!" the Little Mouse shook him to wake him up.

text: 「兩個人一齊玩，好開心㗎！」
eng: "When two people play together, it's so much fun!"

text: 最後，大山羊出咗屋企。
eng: Finally, Big Goat came out.

text: 「肯郁下啲手腳，人都醒啲㗎！」老鼠仔噉講。
eng: "If you are willing to move your hands and feet, people will wake up!" said Little Mouse.

text: 大山羊唔識點跳飛機。老鼠仔教佢玩。
eng: Big Goat doesn't know how to hopscotch. Little Mouse taught him to play.

text: 大山羊話：「真係好好玩喎！老鼠仔你講得啱啊！不如聽日我哋都一齊出嚟玩吖！」
eng: Big Goat said, "It's really fun! Little Mouse, you're right! How about tomorrow we go out and play together again!"

text: 冷線好有用
eng: Cold wire is useful

text: 婆婆拎咗個冷線球出嚟。啲冷線係紅色嘅。
eng: mother-in-law took a cold line ball out. Some cold lines are red.

text: 婆婆用佢嚟幫細佬織冷帽。
eng: Mother-in-law uses it to help her brother weave cold hats.

text: 黑貓仔睇落好鍾意啲冷線喎。
eng: The black kitten looks like the cold line.

text: 佢係噉玩啲冷，玩到啲手手腳腳都畀啲冷綁住咗。
eng: He played a little cold like this, and played until his hands and feet were tied up with a little cold.

text: 我同家姐都攞咗啲冷線嚟玩。
eng: My sister and I both took some cold wire to play.

text: 我哋玩花繩，用條冷線變咗好多嘢出嚟。
eng: We play with flower rope and change a lot of things out with a cold line.

text: 我又用條冷線綁住個氣球，等個氣球唔好飛走。
eng: I tied another balloon with a cold wire and waited for the balloon not to fly away.

text: 公公成日揾唔到眼鏡。
eng: Father-in-law always can't find glasses.

text: 我哋用條冷線綁住佢，等公公掛住佢。
eng: We tied him with a cold thread and waited for his father-in-law to miss him.

text: 公公讚我哋叻。
eng: Father-in-law praised us for being great.

text: 我哋又用條冷線綁住啲旗仔，幫屋企扮靚。
eng: We tied these little flags with a cold thread to help dress up the house.

text: 係咪好靚呢？冷線真係好有用。
eng: Isn't it beautiful? Cold wire is really useful.

text: 你數唔數到我哋用佢嚟做咗幾多樣嘢呢？
eng: You can't count how many things we've done with it?

text: 一隻手有五隻手指。
eng: One hand has five fingers.

text: 我有兩隻手，有十隻手指。
eng: I have two hands and ten fingers.

text: 你都一樣有兩隻手，有十隻手指。
eng: You also have two hands and ten fingers.

text: 我用對手拎好多嘢，拎紙、拎筆、拎咩都得。
eng: I pick up lot of things with my hands; I take paper, pens, anything.

text: 我用對手嚟拉重嘢，車都拉得郁。
eng: I use my hands to pull heavy stuff, they even can move a car.

text: 有咗兩隻手，我做到好多嘢。
eng: With two hands, I can do a lot.

text: 我用對手摸到好多嘢，掂住唔同嘅嘢，我一掂就知係咩。
eng: With my hands I can touch a lot of things, touch different things; once I touch them I know what they are.

text: 舉高對手嗰陣，我攞到啲好高嘅嘢。
eng: Raising my hands up high, I can take things from very high up.

text: 不過個盒太高喇，我唔小心整跌咗。
eng: But the box was too high, and I accidentally make it fall.

text: 盒入面嘅嘢跌晒落嚟，我要執返好佢。
eng: All the contents of the box have fallen, I need to pick them up again.

text: 呢度亂到噉，睇嚟要慢慢執喇。
eng: It's such a mess here, it seems it takes a long time to clean it up.

text: 好彩我有呢對手。
eng: Luckily I have these hands.

text: 我輕輕郁下啲手指，執乜嘢都唔難。
eng: I move my fingers slightly, and it isn't hard to pick up anything.

text: 手指仲可以用嚟指嘢。
eng: Fingers can also be used to point to things.

text: 我指住書上面嘅字，好快就睇完本書喇。
eng: I point to the words on the book, and quickly the book is finished.

text: 手同腳
eng: Hands and feet

text: 我哋嘅身體有兩隻手，兩隻腳。
eng: Our body has two hands and two feet.

text: 有咗手同腳，我可以跑。我跑得幾快㗎。
eng: With hands and feet, I can run. I can run pretty fast.

text: 有咗手同腳，我亦都可以跳。我跳得幾高㗎。
eng: With hands and feet, I also can jump. I can jump quite high.

text: 我可以聽住歌跳舞。我覺得跳舞好好玩。
eng: I can dance to music. I think dancing is fun.

text: 我可以游水。我鍾意喺夏天游水。
eng: I can swim. I love swimming in the summer.

text: 我又可以跳繩。我跳到好多下㗎。
eng: I also can jump rope. I can jump very often.

text: 我仲可以踢波。我鍾意同朋友一齊踢波。
eng: I also can play football. I like playing football with my friends.

text: 有咗手同腳，我做好多嘢都好方便。
eng: With hands and feet, I do a lot of things easily.

text: 不過我唔識飛。因為我唔似雀仔噉有對翼。
eng: But I can't fly. Because unlike birds I don’t have wings.

text: 彩虹嘅顏色
eng: The colors of the rainbow

text: 彩虹好靚，佢有好多顏色。你數唔數到佢有咩顏色？
eng: The rainbow is beautiful, it has many colors. Can you list [count] all its colors?

text: 紅。就好似我細佬噉，佢着住紅色衫，揸住個紅蘋果。
eng: Red. Just like my brother, he is wearing red clothes, holding a red apple.

text: 橙。橙係橙色嘅。我隻貓同我條金魚都係橙色嘅。
eng: Orange. Oranges are orange. My cat and my goldfish are also orange.

text: 黃。香蕉同蛋黃都係黃色嘅。佢哋都好好食。
eng: Yellow. Both bananas and egg yolks are yellow. They are both very tasty.

text: 綠。呢啲樹葉、竹葉，全部都係綠色嘅。大自然入面，好多植物嘅葉都係綠色㗎。
eng: Green. These leaves, bamboo leaves, are all green. In nature, the leaves of many plants are green.

text: 青。有咩係青色？啲草、青蛙同草蜢都係青色嘅。坐喺草地上面吹吹風，好舒服㗎。
eng: Light green. What is light green? Grass, frogs and grasshoppers are all light green. Sitting in the grass with the wind blowing above, that's very comfortable.

text: 藍。日頭好天嗰陣，天空通常都係藍色嘅。望住藍天白雲，個人都開心啲！
eng: Blue. During the day when the weather is good, the sky is usually blue. Staring at the blue sky and white clouds, everyone is happier!

text: 紫。我鍾意紫色，我種咗啲紫羅蘭。我仲有條紫色嘅裙，我最鍾意着住佢㗎喇。
eng: Purple. I like purple, I planted some violets (flower). I also have a purple dress, I like to wear this most.

text: 彩虹有紅、橙、黃、綠、青、藍、紫呢啲顏色。試下油返出嚟吖！
eng: Rainbows have red, orange, yellow, green, light green, blue, and purple. Try to paint and make them come out!

text: 我可以做啲咩？
eng: Can I do something?

text: 今日唔使返學校，我好得閒。
eng: I don't have to go back to school today, I'm free.

text: 「媽媽，我有乜嘢可以做㗎？」我噉問。
eng: "Mom, what can I do?" I asked.

text: 我係咪可以玩波波？好耐冇玩過喇。
eng: Can I play bobo? I haven't played it in a long time.

text: 平時我眼界唔差，都掟得幾準㗎。
eng: Usually my vision is not bad, and I throw it quite accurately.

text: 我係咪可以同細佬玩？我都想多啲同佢一齊。
eng: Can I play with my brother? I want to be with him more.

text: 我係咪可以打鼓？我打得唔錯㗎。
eng: Can I play the drums? I play well.

text: 我係咪可以踩單車？
eng: Can I ride a bike?

text: 我啱啱學，踩得唔快，要練習多啲。
eng: I just learned, I didn't pedal fast, I have to practice a little more.

text: 我係咪可以着下件新衫？
eng: Can I wear a new dress?

text: 件衫顏色好靚，我好鍾意㗎。
eng: This dress is beautiful in color, I like it.

text: 我係咪可以幫手捲毛冷？
eng: Can I help roll the yarn?

text: 捲好佢之後，用起嚟都方便啲。
eng: After winding him, it is easier to use.

text: 我係咪可以幫啲花淋水？
eng: Can I help some flowers with water?

text: 我係咪可以畀啲草羊仔食？
eng: Can I give some grass lambs to eat?

text: 我仲可以畫畫，畫下大自然。
eng: I can also draw and draw nature.

text: 我係咪可以放紙鷂？
eng: Can I fly a kite?

text: 只要有少少風，紙鷂就會飛得好高㗎喇。
eng: As long as there is a little wind, the kite will fly high.

text: 或者我自己睇書吖。
eng: Maybe I read the book myself.

text: 我最鍾意睇笑話，會一路睇一路笑。
eng: I like to watch jokes the most, and I laugh while watching them.

text: 佢走入廚房揾媽媽：「媽媽，聖誕禮物收埋咗喺邊？」
eng: He went into the kitchen to find Mom: "Mom, where are the Christmas gifts hidden?"

text: 媽媽答佢：「份禮物收埋咗喺聖誕老人度囉。」
eng: Mom replied to him, "The gifts are hidden with Santa Claus."

text: 佢出廳問爸爸：「爸爸，聖誕禮物收埋咗喺邊？」
eng: He went out to the living room and asked Dad, "Dad, where are the Christmas gifts hidden?"

text: 爸爸答佢：「喺個秘密嘅地方啊。」
eng: Dad replied to him, "They're in a secret place."

text: 「上面寫住送畀姨姨嘅，呢份唔係我嘅。」
eng: "It says it's for my aunt, this one is not mine."

text: 「送畀叔叔……都唔係呢份。」
eng: "To Uncle ... This one's also not it."

text: 佢周圍噉揾，都揾唔到佢份聖誕禮物。
eng: He has searched everywhere, but couldn't find his Christmas present.

text: 佢突然睇到喺張牀下面有份禮物。
eng: He suddenly saw that under the bed there was a gift.

text: 「係我㗎！我份聖誕禮物喺度啊！」
eng: "It's mine! My Christmas present is here!"

text: 佢想知道入面係乜嘢。
eng: He wanted to know what was inside.

text: 佢好想聖誕快啲嚟到。
eng: He really wanted Christmas to come soon.

text: 「你好啊，我有啲細粒，我哋個個個樣又一樣，你知唔知我哋邊個打邊個啊。
eng: "Hello, I'm a bit small, and we all look the same, do you know who is who?

text: 細細聲同你講吖，我係第四個啊，你睇唔睇到我啊？」
eng: I'll whisper it to you, I'm the fourth, can you see me?"

text: 我哋行路冇聲㗎，成日都係一大班人靜雞雞喺度行嚟行去。
eng: We walk silently, and there is always a large group of people quietly walking around here.

text: 「我醒唔醒啊？我揾到一架車仔，我哋坐上去又行快啲啦！」
eng: "Am I smart or not? I found a little car, let's get on it and go faster!"

text: 你聽到其他動物好嘈。我哋唔同，我哋好靜㗎。
eng: You hear other animals making noise. We are different, we are very quiet.

text: 我哋唔出聲，聞下個氣味咪知嗰邊有冇問題出現。
eng: We don't make a sound, when we smell something then we know if there is a problem.

text: 嗰種氣味話你知：「跟住我一定有好嘢食，跟住我嚟啦！」
eng: The type of smell tells you, "Follow me there surely is something good to eat, come and follow me!"

text: 呢種氣味話你知：「停一停！唔好去嗰邊啊，嗰邊有問題啊！」
eng: The type of smell tells you, "Stop here! Don't go over there, there's a problem over there!"

text: 我哋同你一樣，最鍾意蛋糕，同埋唔同嘅甜嘢。
eng: We're like you, we like cakes the most, and different sweet things.

text: 望到都開心，你睇到甜嘢開唔開心先？
eng: Seeing something makes me happy. When you see something sweet does it make you happy?

text: 「想唔想睇下我嘅老鼠仔？唔好睇我細細粒，其實我都幾打得。冇人有我咁大力。」
eng: "Do you want to see my biceps [little mouse]? It's not good to underestimate me because I'm small, I'm actually quite powerful. No one has as much strength as me."

text: 門閂咗都唔緊要，我哋行上去都冇問題。
eng: It doesn't matter if the door is closed, we have no problem walking up.

text: 唔講你唔知，我哋係一大班人一齊住架，住喺一齊好開心，有事上嚟都有人幫手。
eng: Don't say you don't know, we are a large group of people living together, living together happily, and when things come up there are always people to help you.

text: 《阿十又發白日夢》
eng: "Aa-Ten is daydreaming again"

text: 阿媽：「起身啦！」
eng: Mom: "Get up!"

text: 阿十：「我個名叫阿十，我有四個家姐、五個哥哥同埋小狗阿花。
eng: Aa-Ten: "My name is Aa-Ten, and I have four older sisters, five older brothers and a little dog Aa-Fa.

text: 唔好睇我個樣好細，我已經十歲㗎喇，啱啱升小五。」
eng: Don't let my young appearance fool you, I'm already ten years old, just started fifth grade."

text: 阿十：「唉！又要起身喇。」
eng: Aa-Ten: "Sigh! I need to get up again."

text: 我開始喺度諗：「如果我條頸伸到好長，噉我坐喺張牀度，就睇到好遠嘅嘢，
eng: I started thinking, "If my neck stretches out very long, then I can sit on my bed and see something far away,

text: 我咪唔使去學校囉，我都係小朋友嚟，唔使去學校最開心！」
eng: then I don't have to go to school, and I'm also a child, so if I don't have to go to school I'll be so happy!"

text: 「如果我對腳好長好長，我咪行一陣就到學校囉！」
eng: "If I have long, long legs, I'll walk for a bit and already be at my school!"

text: 「如果我對手好長好長，我咪唔使起身都拎到櫃入面嘅衫囉！」
eng: "If my hands are super long, I don't have to get up and just take the clothes from the wardrobe!"

text: 「如果我個胃好大好大，我咪食到好多阿媽嘅飯囉！我最鍾意食！」
eng: "If my stomach is super big, I'll eat a lot of Mom's food! That's my favorite!"

text: 「如果我有大肚腩，約埋朋友一齊玩！佢哋可以喺我個肚度跳嚟跳去！」
eng: "If I have a big belly, I'll ask my friends to play together! They can jump around on my belly!"

text: 「如果我有大耳仔，靠對耳仔唔使睇，我可以靜靜噉聽下雀仔聲。」
eng: "If I have big ears, I can use them instead of looking, I can quietly listen to the birds singing."

text: 如果我 ⋯⋯阿媽：「阿十，你出門口未啊？換衫啦！」
eng: If I'm ... Mom, "Aa-Ten, you still haven't gone out? Change your clothes!"

text: 我：「知喇！」媽媽嬲喇！係噉先啦！我要去學校喇！
eng: Me: "I know!" Mom is so angry! Talk to you later! I need to go to school!

text: 唔關我事㗎
eng: None of my business

text: 「我叫阿六，今年啱啱十歲喇。平時我最鍾意畫畫喇！
eng: "My name is Aa-Six, and I am just ten years old. Usually, I like drawing the most!

text: 唔記得講下今日兩個主角，狗仔叫阿大，貓仔叫阿細。」
eng: I forgot to mention today's two protagonists, the puppy is called Aa-Big, and the kitten is called Aa-Small."

text: 今日星期六，阿媽出去買嘢，阿六就坐咗喺度畫畫。
eng: Today is Saturday, Mom went out shopping, and Aa-Six sat there painting.

text: 阿大好想知阿六喺度做緊咩啊，所以諗住跳過去睇下。
eng: Aa-Big wanted to know what Aa-Six was doing, so he planned to jump over and take a look.

text: 點知，阿大跳咗去阿細張床度。
eng: However, Aa-Big jumped into Aa-Small's bed.

text: 阿細：「阿大，你做咩要整亂我張床啊！搞錯啊。」
eng: Aa-Small: "Aa-Big, why are you messing with my bed! Are you kidding me?"

text: 阿細依家好嬲。
eng: Aa-Small is very angry now.

text: 阿細唔理整跌晒所有嘢，淨係想追返阿大。
eng: Aa-Small doesn't care if he knocks things over, only wants to catch Aa-Big.

text: 阿細：「阿大，你唔好走啊！你要同我講對唔住！」
eng: Aa-Small: "Aa-Big, don't go! You must say sorry to me!"

text: 突然，阿細見到前面冇得行，跟住想即刻停喺度。
eng: Suddenly, Aa-Small saw that in front of him was nothing to walk on, and then wanted to stop at once.

text: 阿大見到阿細跌緊落嚟，佢想去幫阿細。點知佢哋兩個撞喺一齊。
eng: Aa-Big saw Aa-Small falling down, and he wanted to help Aa-Small. Unexpectedly, they bumped into each other.

text: 阿細好嬲噉鬧緊阿大：「你做咩撞我，老虎唔發嬲，當我係病貓！」
eng: Aa-Small scolded Aa-Big angrily: "Why do you bump into me? Just because I'm not angry, doesn't mean I'm a pushover!"

text: 阿大好唔開心，想同阿細講返清楚。
eng: Aa-Big is very unhappy, and wants to tell Aa-Small clearly.

text: 阿大突然追住阿細，阿細好驚，所以跳咗上張食飯枱度。
eng: Aa-Big suddenly chased Aa-Small, and Aa-Small was so scared, he jumped on the dining table.

text: 點知阿六突然聽到開門聲。佢心諗：大件事喇！
eng: Unexpectedly, Aa-Six suddenly heard the sound of the door opening. He thought: big trouble!

text: 阿六望住阿媽，好驚噉講：「阿媽，如果我同你講，唔關我事，你信唔信我啊？」
eng: Aa-Six looked at Mom, so scared he said: "Mom, if I tell you that it has nothing to do with me, do you believe me or not?"

text: 豬豬飛行日記
eng: Piggy's flight diary

text: 「我叫豬豬，其實我好想有朝一日可以好似蝴蝶噉喺度飛。」
eng: "My name is Piggy. In fact, I really want to one day be able to fly like a butterfly."

text: 蝴蝶見到豬豬就同佢講啦：「跟住我一齊飛啦，你睇下我依家飛得幾開心。」
eng: When the butterfly saw Piggy, he said to him: "Follow me and let's fly together, look at me how happy I am flying now."

text: 豬豬都想有樣學樣，兩隻手拍下拍下。
eng: Piggy so wanted to follow his example, swinging his hands up and down.

text: 「其實我都想飛啊，但係我冇翼，飛唔到啊。好想有人可以幫下我。」
eng: "Actually, I also want to fly, but I don't have wings, so I can't fly. I wish someone could help me."

text: 豬豬突然望下後面，佢發現咗啲嘢。
eng: Piggy suddenly looked behind him and noticed something.

text: 「啊！我諗到喇。我可以用樹葉去整對翼，噉就可以喺天上飛啦。」
eng: "Ah! I think I can do it. I can use the leaves to make a pair of wings, then I can fly in the sky."

text: 蝴蝶喊住同豬豬講：「我知你好想飛，但係用樹葉係唔得架，你噉樣飛唔到架，會受傷架。」
eng: The butterfly cried and said to the pig, "I know you really want to fly, but you can't do it with leaves, you can't fly like this, you will hurt yourself."

text: 豬豬有啲失落噉講：「點解我仲未飛到嘅？唔得！我要再試多一次，依次應該得。」
eng: Piggy was a little disappointed and said, "Why haven't I flown yet? No! I'm must try one more time, this time it should work."

text: 豬豬輕輕一跳，兩隻手拎住樹葉拍下拍下。
eng: Piggy jumped slightly, both hands holding leaves and going up and down.

text: 豬豬好開心噉講：「你哋睇下，我飛到喇！」
eng: Piggy said happily: "Look at me, I've flown here!"

text: 點知開心唔夠三秒，佢就跌咗落嚟。
eng: However, he was happy for less than three seconds, then he fell down.

text: 豬豬好唔開心噉講：「點解我會跌落嚟嘅？唉，我都好想我有一日可以喺天上面飛啊。」
eng: Piggy said unhappily, "Why did I fall? Sigh! I so wish that one day I can fly in the sky."

text: 咩都鬥一餐
eng: Fighting about everything

text: 我叫小紅，佢係我朋友，叫阿細，係一隻狗仔。
eng: My name is Joy, this is my friend, his name is Riri, he is a puppy.

text: 我成日同佢講我叻過佢，佢唔肯信。
eng: I always tell him that I'm smarter than him, but he won't believe me.

text: 我笑笑口講：「你睇下！我有個鼻。」
eng: I smile and say, "Look! I have a nose."

text: 阿細指住個鼻，同緊我講：「我都有啦。」
eng: Riri points to his nose, and says to me, "I have it too."

text: 我話：「叻仔喎，噉你有冇耳仔先？」
eng: I say, "Smart boy, do you have ears?"

text: 佢又掂下自己隻耳仔，同緊我講：「你有嘅嘢我都有。」
eng: He touches one of his ears again, and says to me, "You have it, and I have it too."

text: 我話：「你睇下我對眼幾大。」
eng: I say, "Look how big my eyes are. "

text: 佢慢慢企起身，眨下自己對眼，佢大啲。
eng: He slowly stands up, blinks his eyes, he is a little bigger.

text: 我話：「犀利喎！我有一對腳，你跟住我一齊跳好唔好？」
eng: I say, "Awesome! I have a pair of feet, can you jump with me?"

text: 佢好開心噉跑跑跳跳，想同我講梗係冇問題啦。
eng: He was so happy running and jumping, because he wants to tell me that of course it was no problem.

text: 我話：「唉，你睇下我條脷幾短。」
eng: I say, "Sigh! Look, my tongue is quite short."

text: 佢坐咗喺度，望住自己條脷想講：「唔緊要，我都一樣咁短」
eng: He sat down, looked at his tongue and said, "It's okay, mine is just as short."

text: 我話：「哈哈，多謝你。我係唔係醒過你啊？」
eng: I say, "Haha, thank you. Am I smarter than you?"

text: 佢諗咗一陣，望一望我，想話佢醒啲。
eng: He thought for a moment, looked at me, and wanted to say he's smarter.

text: 我話：「最後喇，我有一對手。」
eng: I said, "Finally, I have two hands."

text: 佢轉咗去後面，笑返我，佢有條尾，我冇。
eng: He turned back and laughed back at me, he had a tail, I didn't.

text: 我哋好鍾意大家，日日都一齊玩。
eng: We love each other, and play together every day.

text: 釣魚日記
eng: Fishing diary

text: 阿一好早起身，跟住講：「唉，好眼瞓，又係時候去釣魚喇！」
eng: Aa-One got up very early and said, "Sigh, so sleepy, it's time to go fishing again!"

text: 阿一行咗一陣，咁啱又撞見阿二，諗住叫佢一齊去。阿二都話想去。
eng: Aa-One walked for a while, then incidentally met Aa-Two again, and wanted to ask him to go together. Aa-Two also said he wanted to go.

text: 突然佢哋撞見阿五。阿五問佢哋做緊咩。
eng: Suddenly they met Aa-Five. Aa-Five asked what they were doing.

text: 阿一：「我哋去釣魚啊，你一唔一齊去啊？」
eng: Aa-One: "We're going fishing, will you come with us?"

text: 佢哋冇理到阿五，轉身兩個人走咗。阿五最後都係跟住一齊去。
eng: They didn't care about Aa-Five, they both turned around and left. In the end, Aa-Five went with them after all.

text: 佢哋到咗之後，見到好多條魚，佢哋好開心喺度講：「正啊！好多魚啊。」
eng: After they had arrived, they saw a lot of fish, they were so happy to be there and said, "Great! So many fish!"

text: 突然有條魚游過嚟。佢哋驚咗一驚，第一次見到條魚大過佢哋對腳。
eng: Suddenly a fish swam over. They were shocked, it was the first time that they saw a fish bigger than their feet.

text: 佢哋好想捉到嗰條魚。阿一同阿二嘈起上嚟。
eng: They would love to catch that fish. Aa-One and Aa-Two argued about it.

text: 阿一：「你都冇力嘅，捉唔到佢㗎喇，等我嚟啦！」
eng: Aa-One: "You don't have the strength, you can't catch it, let me do it!"

text: 阿二：「你睇下我啲老鼠仔先啦。」
eng: Aa-Two: "Look at my biceps [little mouse] first."

text: 佢哋兩個都拉住條魚竿。
eng: Both of them pulled the fishing rod.

text: 「啪」一聲，阿一跌咗喺度，阿二跌咗落水。
eng: "Snap" it sounded, Aa-One fell right there, Aa-Two fell into the water.

text: 佢哋唔知道，其實係啲魚做咗手腳……
eng: What they didn't know, actually those fish tricked them ...

text: 奇幻旅程
eng: Fantastic Journey

text: 我好鍾意同阿魚去街，今日同佢去街有好多嘢發生。
eng: I love going out with Aa-Fish, and when I went out with her today a lot of things happened.

text: 我成日都會覺得啲花花草草會同我拍手。
eng: I always feel like the flowers and plants will clap my hands.

text: 我哋慢慢噉行，有件得人驚嘅事發生咗。
eng: We walked slowly, and something scary happened.

text: 有隻狗仔望住我，佢同我講：「前面會有我嘅朋友，你見到可以同佢哋玩下。」
eng: There was a puppy looking at me, and he said to me, “Up front there will be my friends, you see you can play with them.”

text: 我以為聽錯咗，行多幾步，點知真係有貓、老鼠、雀仔同樹同我玩。
