eng: I thought I had misheard, and walked a few more steps, but then there were really cats, mice, birds and trees playing with me.

text: 我好開心，終於可以同動物傾計喇。
eng: I was so happy, finally I could talk to animals.

text: 突然我見到有粒石頭。
eng: Suddenly I saw a stone.

text: 原來啲石頭都識講嘢，佢哋好凍，所以我將佢哋放喺褲袋。
eng: Turns out the stones also could talk, they were cold, so I put them in my trouser pocket.

text: 我行咗一陣，原來我將好多嘢都放咗落褲袋。
eng: I walked for a while, and it turned out that I had put a lot of stuff in my pocket.

text: 行過阿十屋企，佢送咗啲豆俾我，拎返屋企食。
eng: When we passed by Aa-Ten's house, she gave me some beans to take home to eat.

text: 嚟到阿八間舖頭，佢就送咗一個夾仔俾我，聽講係會自己識跳嚟跳去。
eng: When we came to Aa-Eight's shop, he gave me a pin, I heard that it can jump around on its own.

text: 去到阿六屋企，佢就送咗張貼紙想我靜靜噉坐喺度等阿魚。
eng: When we got to Aa-Six's house, she gave me a sticker wanting me to sit quietly and wait for Aa-Fish.

text: 跟住見到阿大，佢送咗粒扣俾我，原來係粒糖。
eng: Then we saw Aa-Big, she gave me a button, which turned out to be candy.

text: 我返到屋企將全部嘢都放喺個盒度。
eng: I got home and put everything in a box.

text: 最後，我送咗一粒心型石頭俾阿魚。
eng: Finally, I gave a heart-shaped stone to Aa-Fish.

text: 《小蜜蜂與大笨象》
eng: "The Little Bee and the Elephant"

text: 有一日，大笨象阿細見到一隻蜜蜂喺度喊緊，阿細問佢做咩事。
eng: One day, the elephant Aa-Small saw a bee crying, and Aa-Small asked her what's the matter.

text: 小蜜蜂：「我叫阿大，我係第一次出嚟呢度玩，唔知點返屋企，好唔開心啊。
eng: The little bee: "My name is Aa-Big, I am playing here for the first time, I don't know how to go home, I am very unhappy.

text: 你送我返屋企好唔好啊？」
eng: Can you bring me home?"

text: 阿細話：「冇問題啊。你屋企喺邊度？我送你返去吖。」
eng: Aa-Small said: "No problem. Where is your home? I'll bring you back."

text: 然後，阿細送咗阿大去樹上面，問：「你行入去望一望，睇下呢個係咪你屋企吖？」
eng: Then, Aa-Small brought Aa-Big to the top of a tree, and asked: "You go insinde and take a look, see if this is your house?"

text: 突然有隻雀仔飛咗過嚟，想食咗阿大，阿大大叫：「唔係啊，呢度係雀仔屋企啊！」
eng: Suddenly a bird flew over and wanted to eat Aa-Big, and Aa-Big shouted: "No, this is the bird's house!"

text: 跟住，阿細又送咗阿大去一個好黑嘅洞穴度。
eng: Then, Aa-Small also sent Aa-Big to a very dark cave.

text: 佢問：「呢個係唔係你屋企？」
eng: He asked, "Is this your home?"

text: 突然，有好多蝙蝠飛咗過嚟，阿大好驚噉飛走。
eng: Suddenly, a lot of bats flew over, and Aa-Big flew away in fear.

text: 跟住講：「唔係啊，呢度係蝙蝠嘅屋企啊！我哋不如去其他地方睇睇。」
eng: Then she said, "No, this is the bats' home! We better go somewhere else to look.”

text: 之後佢哋去咗最後一個地方，阿細問：「噉呢度係唔係你屋企啊？」
eng: Then they went to the last place, and Aa-Small asked, "So, is this your home?"

text: 阿大好開心話：「係喇，呢度係我屋企！」
eng: Aa-Big was happy and said, "Yes, this is my home!"

text: 阿大好開心，對住阿細講：「多謝你送我返屋企啊。」
eng: Aa-Big was so happy that she said to Aa-Small, "Thank you for bringing me home."

text: 阿大而家識返屋企喇。佢成日出去揾阿細玩。
eng: Aa-Big now knows how to go home. She always goes out to find Aa-Small to play.

text: 老鼠仔去冒險
eng: Little Mouse goes on an adventure

text: 老鼠仔第一次嚟到人類屋企，好多嘢都係第一次見。
eng: Little Mouse comes to a human home for the first time, and there are many things to see for the first time.

text: 「我叫老鼠仔，喺屋企好悶喇，所以我偷走出嚟玩。
eng: "I'm called Little Mouse, at home I'm bored, so I ran off from home to play.

text: 點解啲公仔咁高嘅？佢做咩喺到大叫，又跳嚟跳去呢？我唔明啊。」
eng: Why are these dolls so tall? What are they screaming about, and jumping around? I don't understand."

text: 爸爸見到老鼠仔好驚，而媽媽就想捉住隻老鼠仔。
eng: Dad is scared when he sees Little Mouse, and Mom then wants to catch Little Mouse.

text: 「點解又多兩個公仔，佢哋都唔同樣嘅。
eng: "Why are there two more dolls, they are all different.

text: 啊！做咩有一個公仔想追我㗎，救命啊！」
eng: Ah! Why is there a doll trying to chase me, help!"

text: 突然有隻貓仔出現喺老鼠仔面前。佢想捉老鼠仔。
eng: Suddenly a kitten appeared in front of Little Mouse. He wants to catch Little Mouse.

text: 「啊！呢個喵喵叫嘅公仔係咩嚟㗎？
eng: "Ah! Where did this meowing doll come from?

text: 點解我會對佢特別驚嘅？
eng: Why am I so afraid of him?

text: 我要跑快啲啊，爸爸，救命啊。」
eng: I must run faster. Daddy, help."

text: 媽媽諗住拎個掃把可以捉到老鼠仔，原來老鼠仔已經唔喺原來嗰度，去咗媽媽後面。
eng: Mom is thinking about taking the broom to catch Little Mouse, turns out Little Mouse is no longer where it was, and went behind Mom.

text: 「我喺你後面啊。呢個公仔好傻啊，好好笑啊。」
eng: "I'm behind you. This doll is so silly, it's so funny."

text: 老鼠仔覺得有啲攰，所以坐咗喺婆婆度。
eng: Little Mouse felt a little tired, so he sat in Grandma's place.

text: 婆婆即刻驚到拎報紙亂打。
eng: Grandma was immediately afraid so she grabbed the newspaper and randomly hit around.

text: 老鼠仔好驚噉跳走咗。
eng: Little Mouse jumped away in fear.

text: 全部人都喺度揾老鼠仔去咗邊度。
eng: Everyone was looking for where Little Mouse went.

text: 爸爸係屋企入面最驚老鼠仔嘅人。
eng: Dad was the most afraid of Little Mouse in the family.

text: 佢哋到依家都仲未揾到老鼠仔。
eng: They still haven't found Little Mouse until now.

text: 「點解呢個公仔見到我唔驚嘅，好似好鍾意我噉㖭。」
eng: "Why does this doll looks at me without fear, it seems to like me."

text: 「佢跟住我走。我行去左面，佢又去左面，點解呢個公仔咁搞笑嘅。」
eng: "He is following me. I go left, and he also goes left, why is this doll so funny."

text: 突然，老鼠屋企人出晒嚟揾老鼠仔。
eng: Suddenly, Little Mouse's family came out looking for Little Mouse.

text: 啲人類見到，全部驚到走晒。
eng: The humans saw them, and all ran away in fear.

text: 老鼠仔爸爸鬧咗老鼠仔一餐，但係佢都仲係好想再嚟玩多一次啊。
eng: Little Mouse's father scolded Little Mouse, but he also still wants to back and play one more time.

text: 《月亮與帽》
eng: "Moon and Cap"

text: 今日，我又同爸爸、媽媽、哥哥同細妹一齊去公園玩。
eng: Today, I went to the park again with my father, mother, older brother and little sister.

text: 爸爸送咗個好靚嘅太陽眼鏡畀哥哥，媽媽送咗頂藍色嘅帽畀我，細妹有佢鍾意嘅嘢食。
eng: Dad gave my brother some beautiful sunglasses, Mom gave me a blue cap, and my sister got something that she liked to eat.

text: 突然一陣大風吹咗過嚟，吹走咗我頂新帽。
eng: Suddenly, a gust of wind blew in, and blew away my new hat.

text: 我頂新帽飛咗去大樹上面，我試咗好多次都攞唔返落嚟。
eng: My new hat flew onto a big tree, I tried many times but couldn't get it down.

text: 我喺度喊。「唔要啊，我要我頂帽啊。」
eng: There, I started crying. "No, I want my hat."

text: 我唔開心到冇食到嘢。
eng: I was so unhappy that I didn't eat anything.

text: 嗰晚我望住天空，突然月亮哥哥過咗嚟。
eng: That night I was staring at the sky, when suddenly Brother Moon came over.

text: 佢睇到我頂帽卡住咗喺棵大樹度。
eng: He saw my hat being stuck in the big tree.

text: 佢試咗一試戴我頂新帽，然後笑笑口噉講：「你有冇見過月亮試新嘢？」
eng: He tried wearing my new hat, then smiled and said, "Have you ever seen the moon try something new?"

text: 我都笑住噉講：「冇啊！」
eng: I also smiled and said, "No!"

text: 到第二日，媽媽送咗一頂新嘅帽畀我。
eng: The next day, my mother gave me a new hat.

text: 媽媽話：「呢個係月亮哥哥送畀你㗎，記得要多謝佢啊。你今晚同佢講啦！」
eng: Mom said, "This was given to you by Brother Moon, remember to thank him. Tell him tonight!"

text: 到夜晚，我同月亮一齊好開心噉戴住我哋頂新嘅帽。
eng: In the evening, I and the moon, together we happily wore our new hats.

text: 我哋嗰晚過得好開心。
eng: We had a great time that night.

text: 「今日咁熱，我都係用月亮哥哥送畀我頂新帽啦。唔知太陽哥哥佢使唔使用呢？」
eng: "It's so hot today, I'd better use the new hat that Brother Moon gave me. I wonder if Brother Sun needs to use it?"

text: 「我有好多頂唔同嘅帽，你哋覺得我今日揀邊頂好呢？」
eng: "I have many different hats, which one do you think I choose today?"

text: 神秘的魔法石
eng: Mysterious Magic Stone

text: 「我係阿魚，我好鍾意睇阿哥寫字，寫得好靚。」
eng: "I am Aa-Fish, I like to watch my brother write, and he writes beautifully."

text: 有一日，阿哥出咗街，所以阿魚就靜雞雞噉拎阿哥支筆嚟寫字。
eng: One day, Older Brother went out, so Aa-Fish quietly took Older Brother's pen to write.

text: 阿魚揾到好多嘢，咩都有，有間尺啦、紙啦同釘書機啦。
eng: Aa-Fish found a lot of things, everything, including a ruler, paper and stapler.

text: 阿魚揾到一個特別嘅石頭，原來呢個石頭係有魔法㗎。
eng: Aa-Fish found a special stone, turns out that this stone is magical.

text: 突然，石頭吸咗支鐵棒過嚟。
eng: Suddenly, the stone drew an iron rod over.

text: 「啊！唔知佢吸唔吸到其他嘢呢？等我試下先。」
eng: "Ah! I wonder if it can attract anything else? Let me try."

text: 當佢拎住魔法石頭行埋去釘書機嗰陣，釘書機突然走埋嚟，阿魚嚇親。
eng: As she took the magic stone up to the stapler, the stapler suddenly came closer, Aa-Fish was frightened.

text: 當佢拎魔法石頭去吸貓仔，貓仔冇理佢。
eng: When she took the magic stone up to the kitten, the kitten didn't react.

text: 「點解吸唔到嘅？」
eng: "Why can't you attract it?"

text: 當佢試下吸住鐵嘅間尺時，間尺企咗起身。
eng: When she tried to attract the iron ruler, the ruler stood up.

text: 阿魚好開心，想再試其他嘢。
eng: Aa-Fish was so happy and wanted to try again with other things.

text: 當佢吸椰子嗰陣，又唔得喇。
eng: When she attracted the coconut, it didn't work again.

text: 阿魚好想知點解會噉。
eng: Aa-Fish really wanted to know why this was happening.

text: 突然，「叮」一聲，原來阿哥返咗屋企。
eng: Suddenly, there was a "ding", it turned out that Older Brother had returned home.

text: 阿魚驚到跳咗起身、整跌晒啲嘢。
eng: Aa-Fish jumped up in fear, and dropped everything.

text: 阿魚好唔開心，阿哥最鍾意嗰支筆跌咗喺床下，佢要諗辦法執返起佢。
eng: Aa-Fish was very unhappy, her brother's favorite pen was dropped under the bed, and she had to find a way to retrieve it.

text: 佢想用間尺攞支筆返嚟，點知推得仲遠。
eng: She wanted to use a ruler to take the pen back, but unexpectedly she pushed it even further.

text: 「叮」，呢次唔係又有人返到屋企，而係阿魚有辦法喇！
eng: "Ding", this time it's not someone back home again, but Aa-Fish has a way!

text: 佢用魔法石頭吸住間尺，再等魔法石頭吸住支筆。
eng: She stuck the magic stone on the ruler, and then waited for the magic stone to attract the pen.

text: 得咗！終於得咗喇！
eng: Got it! Finally got it!

text: 阿魚要等阿哥未注意嗰陣，將啲嘢放返好。
eng: Aa-Fish had to wait for her brother not paying attention, then put the things back.

text: 阿哥一返到嚟，淨係見到有個椰子。
eng: When Older Brother came back, he only saw that there was a coconut.

text: 阿魚仲係好想知，嗰個魔法石頭係咩嚟，你哋知唔知係咩嚟啊？
eng: Aa-Fish still wonders what that magic stone is; do you guys know what it is?

text: 等你捉到我先啦！
eng: I wait until you catch me first!

text: 「大家好啊！我係二筒。佢係我嘅主人，叫三萬。
eng: "Hello everyone! I'm Cookies. He is my master, called Treeman [30,000].

text: 佢成日都叫我同佢玩，但係我都係唔睬佢。
eng: He always asks me to play with him, but I ignore him.

text: 我好眼瞓啊，瞓一陣先。」
eng: I'm very sleepy, I sleep a while first."

text: 「佢叫我坐喺度，噉我都聽佢講，坐喺度。」
eng: "He tells me to sit here, so I will listen to him and sit here."

text: 係啊！二筒坐咗喺度啊，一陣囉。
eng: Yes! Cookie sat here for a while.

text: 跟住佢又去咗邊啊？
eng: And then where did he go?

text: 唉⋯⋯「想捉我？好難啊。我跳，又想嚟多次？我又跳！」
eng: Sigh... "You want to get me? Very difficult. I jump, you want to come another time? I jump again!"

text: 三萬想捉住二筒。二筒亂跑，跳嚟跳去。
eng: Treeman wants to catch Cookies. Cookies run around, jumps around.

text: 「捉我唔到哩？等我靜雞雞行出去先。」
eng: "Can't catch me? Let me quietly go out first."

text: 二筒行緊嗰陣，佢心入面講：「你睇我唔到，你睇我唔到⋯⋯」
eng: When Cookies left, he said in his heart: "You can't see me, you can't see me ... "

text: 三萬見到二筒喇，佢行過去想捉住二筒，二筒好快噉跑走咗。
eng: Treeman looked at Cookies, he walked over and tried to catch Cookies, and Cookies quickly ran away.

text: 跑跑下，二筒見到有樣嘢好搞笑，玩咗一粒鐘。
eng: Running down, Cookies saw something very funny and played for an hour.

text: 跟住二筒真係跑咗出去，然後仲見到隻蝸牛。
eng: Then Cookies actually ran out, and then he saw a snail.

text: 二筒好鍾意同人比賽，想睇下同蝸牛邊個行得快啲。
eng: Cookies really likes to compete with people, he wants to see with the snail who walks faster.

text: 「你行快啲啦，等你等到想瞓喇。」
eng: "Go faster, waiting for you makes me want to sleep."

text: 二筒又見到隻雞，佢哋諗住玩跳舞比賽。
eng: Cookies also saw a chicken, and they were going to play a dance competition.

text: 你哋睇到二筒笑得噉開心，就知佢贏咗喇。
eng: When you see Cookies smiling so happily, you know he won.

text: 三萬見到二筒返咗嚟、瞓咗喺度。
eng: Treeman saw Cookies come back and sleep right here.

text: 三萬諗住去同二筒玩。
eng: Treeman is ready to play with Cookies.

text: 點知⋯⋯「你想同我玩啊？等你捉到我先啦！」
eng: Who would have thought... "Do you want to play with me? I wait until you catch me first!"

text: 好想做，唔想做
eng: Want to do it, don't want to do it

text: 「我有兩個哥哥，叫阿大同阿二。
eng: "I have two older brothers, named Aa-Big and Aa-Two.

text: 我最細，我叫阿三。
eng: I am the youngest, I'm called Aa-Three.

text: 又到朝早喇，佢哋係時候起身喇！」
eng: It's morning again, it's time for them to get up!"

text: 呢度係阿大張床。阿大點都唔肯起身。
eng: Here is Aa-Big's bed. Aa-Big refuses to get up.

text: 「又嚟喇，佢又唔想起身喇。
eng: "Here it is again, he again doesn't want to get up yet.

text: 日日朝早都係噉，佢好多嘢都唔想去做。」
eng: Everyday in the morning it's like that, and he also doesn't want to do a lot of things."

text: 「等我同你哋講下佢唔想做咩啦！
eng: "Let me tell you what he doesn't want to do!

text: 佢唔想刷牙啦，佢唔想沖涼啦，佢早餐都唔想食。唉！」
eng: He doesn't want to brush his teeth, he doesn't want to take a shower, he doesn't want to eat breakfast. Sigh!"

text: 「佢最唔鍾意嘅係去學校。
eng: "His least favorite thing is going to school.

text: 我諗佢最鍾意嘅應該係瞓喺度，咩都唔使做。唉！」
eng: I think his favorite thing should be to sleep here and not have to do anything. Sigh!"

text: 等我哋嚟睇下阿二今日有咩做先。
eng: Let's take a look at what Aa-Two has to do today.

text: 「今日阿二好開心噉出門口。應該有好嘢玩。
eng: "Today Aa-Two went out happily today. There must be something fun to do.

text: 啊！阿二今日去咗睇動物啊，咩動物都有，有鴨仔，豬仔，
eng: Ah! Today Aa-Two went to see animals, all kinds of animals; ducklings, piglets,

text: 同有雀仔啦，有好多好多隻動物，睇到都覺得開心。」
eng: and also birds, there are many, many animals; seeing them makes you feel happy."

text: 「等我嚟講下阿二先，同阿大唔一樣，阿二好鍾意去學校，好鍾意刷牙，
eng: "Let me tell you about Aa-Two, he is unlike Aa-Big, Aa-Two likes to go to school, and brush his teeth,

text: 好鍾意食早餐，阿大唔食早餐，佢食晒佢嗰份，佢話唔好浪費食物。」
eng: he likes to have breakfast, Aa-Big doesn't eat breakfast, but he has hast eaten his entire portion, he says he doesn't want to waste any food."

text: 「到我講下自己喇！我好細個，去唔到學校，我自己出咗去公園玩啊！
eng: "I also tell you about myself! I'm very young, don't go to school yet, so I went out to the park by myself!

text: 佢哋兩個幾點返屋企啊？好想佢哋陪我玩啊！」
eng: What time do the two get home? I really want them to accompany me playing!"

text: 過嚟一齊食蛋糕啦！
eng: Come here and eat cake together!

text: 今日，阿大自己整咗一個蛋糕，佢好想同屋企人一齊食。
eng: Today, Aa-Big made a cake by himself, and he would love to eat it with his family.

text: 一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八，個蛋糕分做八份，睇落去好好食。
eng: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, the cake is divided into eight portions, which is delicious to look at.

text: 婆婆返到屋企喇！佢好鍾意食蛋糕，返到嚟見到有蛋糕喺度，拎咗一份嚟食。
eng: Grandma came home! She likes to eat cake, and when she came back and saw that there was cake here, she took a piece to eat.

text: 公公喺房睇緊書，跟住出嚟見到有蛋糕，佢都拎咗一份返房，一路睇書，一路食。
eng: Grandpa was reading in the room, and then he came out and saw that there was a cake, so he also took a piece back to the room, then read and ate at the same time.

text: 媽媽都返咗屋企，佢見到有一份蛋糕，蛋糕上面寫住「畀媽媽」，噉佢知道係阿大留畀佢食嘅，佢好開心噉慢慢食。
eng: When Mom returned home, she saw a piece cake, on the cake it was written "For Mom", then and she knew that Aa-Big has kept a piece for her to eat, and she ate it happily and slowly.

text: 爸爸睇緊電視，阿大拎咗一份蛋糕畀佢，阿大都想一齊睇電視，佢要拎一份蛋糕畀下一個人。
eng: Dad was watching TV, and Aa-Big took a piece of cake for him; Aa-Big also wanted to watch TV together, but he needed to take a piece of cake to the next person.

text: 阿大下一個要拎畀嘅係姨姨，姨姨做緊嘢，都係唔好嘈佢喇。
eng: The next person that Aa-Big needs to serve is auntie, auntie is working, so better not bother her.

text: 下一個梗係要留一份畀叔叔啦，佢喺出面做緊嘢，噉放喺呢度等佢一陣食。
eng: Of course, the next one should be left for my uncle, he is working outside, so leave it here and wait for him to eat later.

text: 梗係要拎畀細妹啦，細妹打完籃球，一定好肚餓，拎一份留畀佢食。
eng: Of course, he has to take one to his little sister, when she has finished playing basketball, she must be very hungry, so he takes a piece to keep for her to eat.

text: 啊！阿大唔記得咗，原來自己都未食，好彩仲有一份。
eng: Oh! Aa-Big forgot, turns out he himself has not eaten yet, but luckily he still has one piece.

text: 大家都食得好開心，真係第一次食到咁好味嘅蛋糕。
eng: Everyone ate so happily; it really was the first time they had ever tasted such a delicious cake.

text: 阿大同細妹都準備開餐一齊食喇！
eng: Aa-Big and his little sister also prepare to start a meal that they can eat together!

text: 識講嘢嘅狗仔！
eng: Talking doggy!

text: 「我哋屋企有阿爸，阿媽，阿大同埋我，我叫狗仔。」
eng: "At our home there are Dad, Mom, Aa-Big, and me, my name is Doggy."

text: 今日，狗仔食咗神奇嘅一嚿肉，知道自己可以同阿大講嘢。
eng: Today, Doggy ate a magical piece of meat, and now he can talk to Aa-Big.

text: 阿大都嚇咗一跳，但得阿大聽到狗仔講咩，其他人聽唔明。
eng: Aa-Big was startled, but only Aa-Big could understand what Doggy was saying, others could not understand him.

text: 狗仔同阿大去咗公園玩。
eng: Doggy and Aa-Big went to the park to play.

text: 狗仔：「阿大瞓覺，噉我企喺呢度，唔畀其他人嘈佢。喂！貓仔，阿大要瞓覺，你唔好入嚟。」
eng: Doggy: "Aa-Big is sleeping, so I will stand here, and not let anyone disturb him. Hey! Kitty, Aa-Big needs to sleep, don't come in."

text: 阿大：「狗仔，你真係識講嘢啊！我好開心啊！噉我哋一齊返學校，一齊玩。」
eng: Aa-Big: "Doggy, you really can talk! I'm so happy! So let's go to school together, and play together."

text: 狗仔：「嗯，我都想！」
eng: Doggy: "Yes, I also want that!"

text: 阿大、狗仔同其他朋友一齊比賽。
eng: Aa-Big, Doggy, and other friends compete with each other.

text: 阿大：「狗仔過嚟。」
eng: Aa-Big: "Doggy come here."

text: 狗仔：「知道，嚟緊。」
eng: Doggy: "Okay, coming."

text: 阿媽鬧緊阿大同狗仔。
eng: Mom is scolding Aa-Big and Doggy.

text: 阿大：「狗仔，我哋又畀人鬧喇，唉。」
eng: Aa-Big: "Doggy, we are being scolded again, alas."

text: 狗仔：「唔緊要，我同你一齊。」
eng: Doggy: "It's okay, I'm with you."

text: 有一班雀仔喺度嘈住阿媽做嘢。
eng: There are some birds distracting Mom from work.

text: 阿大：「狗仔，去趕走佢哋。」
eng: Aa-Big: "Doggy, go and scare them away."

text: 阿大：「狗仔，我哋一齊玩啦！」
eng: Aa-Big: "Doggy, let's play together!"

text: 狗仔：「好啊！最鍾意同阿大一齊玩。」
eng: Doggy: "Okay! I like to play with Aa-Big the most."

text: 狗仔：「阿大，有人嚟咗啊，去開門。」
eng: Doggy: "Aa-Big, someone has come, go and open the door."

text: 阿大：「噉你都聽到？係喎，有人喎，係小魚送嘢畀我。」
eng: Aa-Big: "So, have you heard it too? Right, there is someone, it's Little Fish who sent me something."

text: 阿大：「你睇下，小三嚟咗啊！」
eng: Aa-Big: "Look at that, Little Three has come!"

text: 狗仔：「我好鍾意同小三一齊玩。好想一齊開心噉玩落去。」
eng: Doggy: "I so like to play with Little Three. I really want to have fun and play together forever."

text: 「我唔見咗嘢啊！佢走咗去邊啊？你哋見唔見到啊？」
eng: "I've lost it! Where did it go? Do you see it?"

text: 「我係小草，我喺度搵緊一樣嘢，你哋見到嘅話同返我講吖。」
eng: "I'm Charles, I'm here looking for something, and if you see it, tell me."

text: 「係唔係細妹拎走咗？又冇喎。
eng: "Did my younger sister take it away? Also not.

text: 係喎，我今日有玩玩具，可能喺玩具箱。」
eng: Yes, today I played with my toys, maybe it's in the toy box."

text: 小草喊住噉講：「唔喺呢度，又唔喺我個袋度。
eng: Charles cried and said, "It's not here, also not in my bag.

text: 你去咗邊啊？我搵咗你成日喇，出嚟啦！」
eng: Where did you go? I've been looking for you all day, come out!"

text: 「冇可能㗎！我要搵多次，搵多次玩具箱。
eng: "Impossible! I need to look again, look again in the toy box.

text: 喺唔喺書下面啊？都係冇啊！」
eng: Is it under the book? Also not there!"

text: 小草喺度行嚟行去，都係搵唔到。
eng: Charles went here and there, but still couldn't find it.

text: 小草嘅婆婆喺公園搵到一樣嘢，係一個搖搖。
eng: Charles' grandma found something at the park, it was a yo-yo.

text: 婆婆拎住個搖搖開始玩，佢識好多花式。
eng: His grandma held the yo-yo and started to play, she knew a lot of fancy movements.

text: 婆婆一返到屋企，小草見到佢就跑去抱住婆婆。
eng: Once his grandma returned home, Charles saw her and ran to give his grandma a hug.

text: 小草一路想搵嘅係搖搖，而婆婆幫佢拎咗返嚟。
eng: What Charles wanted to find was his yo-yo, and his grandma helped him get it back.

text: 婆婆：「小草，你係咪好鍾意呢個搖搖？我想玩一陣啊。」
eng: Grandma: "Charles, do you like this yo-yo? I want to play a bit."

text: 小草好開心搵返個搖搖，所以都想同婆婆一齊玩。
eng: Charles was so happy to have his yo-yo back, so he also wanted to play together with his grandma.

text: 婆婆玩到唔肯停，小草望住婆婆，扁晒嘴噉，唉！
eng: But when grandma played didn't want to stop, Charles looked at his grandma, his mouth in a frown, alas!

text: 「我好想玩啊，我都未玩過！」
eng: "I really want to play, I haven't played with it yet!"

text: 我大個仔喇！
eng: I'm a big boy!

text: 「我叫小智，我五歲㗎喇，你哋唔好睇小我，我識做好多嘢㗎。你哋唔信我，我做俾你睇。」
eng: "My name is Archie, I'm five years old, you better not underestimate me, I know how to do a lot of things. If you don't believe me, I'll show you."

text: 小智行咗去樓梯口，慢慢噉爬上樓梯。
eng: Archie walked to the staircase, and slowly climbed the stairs.

text: 「你睇，我叻唔叻，我得咗喇！」
eng: "Look, am I good, I did it!"

text: 小智爬到上最高喇。
eng: Archie climbed to the very top.

text: 「你睇我幾叻。我唔識落去啊。下面好高啊，我好驚啊！」
eng: "You see I'm so good. I don't know how to go down. It goes so far down, I'm scared!"

text: 小智想俾人知佢大個仔，佢又去爬上張櫈度。
eng: Because Archie wanted people to know that he's a big boy, and he also climbed onto a chair.

text: 「我要俾人知我唔係細路仔喇。」
eng: "I want people to known that I am not a little boy."

text: 小智最後都爬到上去，但係一爬到上去，佢又開始驚喇。
eng: Archie climbed to the very top, but as soon as he got there, he began to be afraid again.

text: 「點解咁高嘅？我好想落去啊！有冇人幫下我！」
eng: "Why is it so high? I want to go down! Can someone help me!"

text: 小智好驚啊，佢要爬上去張枱度，想有人見到佢。
eng: Archie is so scared, he needs to climb onto the table, he wants someone to see him.

text: 小智再望一望下面。
eng: Archie looked down again.

text: 小智喺度喊住噉講：「好驚啊，好高啊，我好想返落去啊！有冇人嚟幫我啊？」
eng: Archie cried and said, "I'm so scared, it's so high, I want to go down! Is anyone coming to help me?"

text: 爸爸聽到小智喺度喊，跟住行咗過嚟。
eng: Dad heard Archie crying, and then walked over.

text: 爸爸：「小智，你大個仔喇，你可以自己爬返落嚟㗎。你做到㗎！」
eng: Dad: "Archie, when you're a big boy, you can climb back down on your own. You can do it!"

text: 小智：「知道！我會試下。」
eng: Archie: "I know! I will try."

text: 小智好驚，佢唔會喊，佢大個仔。
eng: Archie was scared, but he didn't cry, he's a big boy.

text: 小智慢慢噉爬落嚟。小智落到嚟喇！佢做到喇！
eng: Archie slowly climbed down. Archie got down! He did it!

text: 小智好開心噉講：「我覺得自己真係大個仔喇！」
eng: Archie said happily, "I think I'm really a big boy!"

text: 我嘅老友！
eng: My buddy!

text: 「大家好！我有好多朋友，你哋又多唔多朋友？噉我嚟介紹下佢哋先！」
eng: "Hello everyone! I have a lot of friends, do you also have a lot of friends? Then I'll introduce them first!"

text: 「一開始梗係要介紹我啲大朋友啦，佢哋係小明同小智，我好鍾意同佢哋一齊打波㗎。」
eng: "Of course, I have to introduce my big friends first, they are Siu Ming and Archie, and I really like to play ball with them."

text: 「我都有一啲朋友細過我嘅，佢哋好鍾意同我玩，我哋鍾意一齊喺公園玩，每次玩都玩成三粒鐘。」
eng: "I also have a friend who is younger than me, they like to play with me, we like to play together in the park, each time we play for about three hours."

text: 「我都有一啲大少少嘅朋友，我鍾意同佢哋坐喺櫈度傾計。」
eng: "I also have some a little bit older friends, I like to sit and talk with them."

text: 「我有一個細佬，佢叫阿杰，佢未識講嘢。
eng: "I have a younger brother, his name is Jerry, and he can't speak yet.

text: 佢係我朋友，我好鍾意望住佢瞓喺度，佢起身之後我又同佢玩。」
eng: He's my friend, I love watching him sleep, and after he wakes up I also play with him."

text: 「我仲有一啲朋友有尾㗎，佢哋係我啲動物朋友：有狗仔啦，有貓仔啦，同其他動物。」
eng: "I also have some friends who have tails, they are my animal friends: there are puppies, kittens, and other animals."

text: 「我有一啲朋友，其他人見到好驚，但係我唔驚，我好鍾意佢哋。有蛇仔，有毛毛蟲。」
eng: "I have some friends of whom others are afraid, but I'm not afraid, I like them very much. There are snakes and caterpillars."

text: 「我有一啲朋友，又識飛，又識游水：有魚仔，有雀仔。」
eng: "I have some friends who can fly and swim: there are fish and birds."

text: 「我好鍾意讀書同返學校㗎，咩嘢書我都鍾意，所以書都係我嘅朋友。」
eng: "I like reading and going to school, I like all kinds of books, so books are also my friends."

text: 「我有一個好朋友，你哋估唔估到係邊個啊？」
eng: "I have one good friend, can you guess who it is?"

text: 「嗰個係我阿媽，佢係我最最最好嘅朋友。」
eng: "That's my mom, she's my very very best friend."

text: 「我有一個成日陪我嘅朋友，佢成日都出現喺我身邊，你哋估唔估到係邊個？」
eng: "I have one friend who is always with me, he always shows up where I am, can you guess who it is?"

text: 邊個可以幫我出書啊？
eng: Who can help me make a book?

text: 大家好啊，我叫阿細，我係一個好鍾意睇書嘅學生。
eng: Hello everyone, my name is Aa-Small, I am a student who likes to read.

text: 今日，喺公園嘅時候，我好想睇一本書。
eng: Today, while in the park, I would love to read a book.

text: 我冇書，冇得睇書，所以我想自己出一本書。
eng: Because I don't have a book, I can't read a book, so I want to make a book myself.

text: 我開始自己出書，爸爸媽媽佢哋都幫我出書。
eng: I started making my own books, and my parents helped me with them.

text: 然後我先去畫圖，爸爸幫我油顏色，爸爸講：「阿細，你寫得好啊。」
eng: Then I first drew pictures, and my dad helped me coloring, he said, "Aa-Small, you write well."

text: 然後我開心噉答：「多謝爸爸！」
eng: Then I happily replied: "Thank you Dad!"

text: 我要油顏色嘅時候，媽媽幫我剪開張紙。
eng: When I wanted to paint, my mother helped me cut out a piece of paper.

text: 媽媽講：「阿細，你好叻啊！」
eng: Mom said, "Aa-Small, you're so smart!"

text: 我笑住答媽媽：「梗係啦！多謝媽媽！」
eng: I smiled and replied to Mom, "Of course! Thank you Mom!"

text: 到我剪開張紙嘅時候，嫲嫲行咗過嚟，佢諗住嚟幫我貼圖。
eng: When I cut the paper, Grandma came over, and she wanted to help me paste the pictures.

text: 嫲嫲講：「阿細，你剪得好！」
eng: Grandma said, "Aa-Small, you cut so well!"

text: 我笑住講：「梗係啦！好易啫，多謝嫲嫲！」
eng: I smiled and said, "Of course! It's easy! Thank you Grandma!"

text: 我貼圖嘅時候爺爺幫我寫，爺爺話：「阿細好叻女啊！」
eng: When I pasted the pictures, Grandpa helped me write; Grandpa said: "Aa-Small is a very smart girl!"

text: 我跟住答：「唔係啊爺爺，係有你哋幫我，我先做到！」
eng: I then replied: "No, Grandpa, it's because of your help that I could do it!"

text: 我寫書嘅時候哥哥幫我將啲紙釘埋一齊。
eng: When I was writing the book, my older brother helped me staple the paper together.

text: 哥哥笑住話：「我細妹大個女喇。」
eng: Brother smiled and said, "My little sister is a big girl."

text: 我講：「好嘢，哥哥都話我做得好。」
eng: I said, "Well, my brother says I'm doing well."

text: 佢哋好開心幫我出書，本書係我哋一齊出嘅。
eng: They were so happy to help me make the book; it's a book that we made together.

text: 好開心啊，我有一本書喇，我哋一齊睇書啦。
eng: I'm so happy, I have a book, let's read it together.

text: 係喎！唔記得幫本書改名，你哋有冇好主意啊？
eng: Yes! I forgot to give this book a name, do you have a good idea?

text: 我隻狗仔係唔同啲嘅！
eng: My puppy is different!

text: 「我叫小明啊！佢係我隻狗仔，佢叫旺財。
eng: "My name is Siu Ming! He is my puppy, his name is Lucky.

text: 我隻狗仔同其他狗仔有啲唔同。
eng: My puppy is a little different from other puppies.

text: 你哋知唔知點解啊？大家睇落去咪知點解囉！」
eng: Do you know why? If you all read on, you will know why!"

text: 「吖！我唔記得講下我嘅好同學，佢叫小剛。
eng: "Oh! I forgot talking about my good classmate, his name is Siu Gong.

text: 我哋成日一齊去學校。
eng: We always go to school together.

text: 我哋好鍾意一齊玩，我哋一齊打波，一齊去街，一齊温書，佢係我嘅好朋友。
eng: We love to play together, we play ball together, we go out together, we study together, he is a good friend of mine.

text: 「旺財有一隻貓仔，佢叫富貴。
eng: "Lucky has a kitten, his name is Richie.

text: 隻貓仔又同其他貓仔有啲唔同，佢個樣好惡。
eng: The kitten is also a little different from other kittens, his face is very fierce.

text: 我見到佢嗰陣，我都好驚。」
eng: When I saw him, I was so scared."

text: 今日天氣好，又冇落雨。
eng: Today the weather is good, and there is no rain.

text: 小明去咗公園度玩，佢見到小剛喺度好大聲噉嘈。
eng: Siu Ming went to play in the park, he saw Siu Gong making a loud noise there.

text: 「你睇下！佢又喺度嬲喇！又唔知邊個激嬲咗佢呢？」
eng: "Look! He is here and angry again! And I don't know what made him angry?"

text: 「佢係噉喺度叫，我好想知邊個激嬲咗佢，我行上去睇下咩問題先。」
eng: "He keeps yelling there, I really want to know who made him angry, I'll go up and see what's the problem."

text: 「吓！係佢激嬲咗富貴啊。」
eng: "What? It's him who made Richie angry."

text: 旺財應該等咗好耐等人嚟幫佢，我咁啱行過幫咗佢。
eng: Lucky must have waited for a long time for someone to help him, and I happened to come and help him.

text: 「原來係旺財激嬲咗富貴，旺財一見到我走過嚟，佢就跳咗上嚟我嗰度。」
eng: "Turns out it was Lucy who made Richie angry, and as soon as Lucky saw me coming over, he jumped up to me."

text: 「應該係貓仔驚狗仔，但係我嘅旺財係驚貓仔。」
eng: "It should be that kittens are afraid of puppies, but Richie is afraid of kittens."

text: 屋企大危機
eng: The big crisis at home

text: 「終於返到屋企喇，坐車坐到頭都暈埋」阿大大聲噉講。
eng: "Finally back home, I got dizzy in the car," Ah Da said loudly.

text: 「快啲入屋，好肚餓啊！」家姐冇晒力噉講。
eng: "Hurry up and get in the door, I'm so hungry!" said my sister with no strength at all.

text: 媽咪笑住講：「知道喇，我依家去煮飯俾你哋食啦，你哋有冇話想食咩啊？」
eng: Mom smiled and said, "Got it, I'm going to cook for you now, did you say what you want to eat?"

text: 阿大答：「咩都可以，我要食好多好多，煮多啲。」
eng: Ah Da replied: "Anything, I want to eat a lot, cook more."

text: 媽咪問：「你哋食唔食得晒㗎？」
eng: Mom asked, "Did you eat enough?"

text: 家姐答：「食唔晒咪掉咗佢囉。」
eng: My sister replied, "I lost him if I couldn't finish eating."

text: 阿爸有少少嬲噉話：「你哋唔可以噉諗㗎，我哋唔可以浪……」
eng: Dad said a little angrily: "You can't think like that, we can't wave..."

text: 阿爸都未講完，媽咪就開咗門，一開門，有陣味傳咗出嚟。
eng: Before Dad finished speaking, Mom opened the door, and as soon as the door was opened, a smell came out.

text: 媽咪笑住問：「發生咩事呀？好臭呀，就嚟俾佢臭暈，係唔係有人放屁？」
eng: Mom smiled and asked, "What happened? It stinks, just give him a stink, is someone fart?"

text: 大家都搖頭，似係喺屋企入面傳出嚟。媽咪先發現件事有啲嚴重。
eng: Everyone shook their heads, as if it was coming out of the house. Mom just realized that something was a little serious.

text: 阿爸好緊張噉話：「大家快幫手揾，睇下發生咩事。」
eng: Dad said nervously, "Let's help find it and see what happens."

text: 媽咪去咗睡房揾，不過冇發現，阿大就入咗廁所揾，都係冇。
eng: Mom went to the bedroom to look for it, but I didn't find it, so Ah Da went into the toilet to look for it, but there was still none.

text: 家姐就去咗飯廳揾，越揾，家姐個肚就越響，因為佢真係好肚餓。
eng: My sister went to the cafeteria to look for it, and the more I looked for it, the louder my sister's stomach became, because he was really hungry.

text: 阿爸就入咗廚房，咩都發現唔到，佢開始有啲擔心。
eng: Dad went into the kitchen and found nothing, and he started to worry a little.

text: 突然，阿爸大叫一聲：「喺雪櫃，陣味喺嗰度傳出嚟㗎。
eng: Suddenly, Dad exclaimed, "In the refrigerator, the smell is coming out there."

text: 阿媽就話：「噉快啲打開雪櫃望下。」阿媽就去咗開雪櫃。
eng: Mom said, "Hurry up and open the refrigerator and look down." Mom went to open the refrigerator.

text: 阿媽一打開道雪櫃門，即刻想暈，想叫大家唔好過嚟，但係阿大同家姐已經跑咗過嚟。
eng: As soon as Mom opened the refrigerator door, she immediately wanted to faint and wanted to tell everyone not to come, but Ah Da and her sister had already run over.

text: 阿大大叫：「救命呀！我哋係咪俾臭味怪獸攻擊呀？好臭啊！」
eng: Ah Da shouted: "Help, are we attacked by stinky monsters? It stinks!"

text: 阿爸望真少少，原來係雪櫃冇插到電，搞到啲食物冇雪住，所以全部變壞晒。
eng: Dad really looked a little, it turned out that the refrigerator was not plugged in, and the food was not snowing, so it all went bad.

text: 阿大話：「唔緊要啦，煮熟咗都可以食嘅，我好肚餓，我好想食蛋呀！」
eng: A lie: "It's okay, you can eat it cooked, I'm hungry, I want to eat eggs!"

text: 阿爸即刻話：「梗係唔得，食物壞咗就唔食得，食咗好容易病㗎。」
eng: Dad immediately said: "Of course not, if the food is broken, you won't eat it, it's easy to get sick if you eat it."

text: 突然有一隻雞蛋跌咗落地下，又多一陣臭味。阿大驚到跑走咗。
eng: Suddenly an egg is lost and falls to the ground, and there is another stink. Ah Da ran away in shock.

text: 阿爸好唔開心噉講咗一句：「噉我哋掉晒佢喇，唉。」
eng: Dad said unhappily, "So we'll throw him all, alas."

text: 阿大好奇噉問：「阿爸，做咩咁唔開心嘅？
eng: Curious asked, "Dad, why are you so unhappy?"

text: 食物，我成日食唔晒啲嘢食，都掉晒㗎喇，更何況仲要係壞咗嘅嘢食，反正我哋有錢，可以再買」。
eng: Food, I often can't finish eating, it's all lost, not to mention it's still bad and eaten, anyway, I have money, I can buy it again."

text: 阿爸搖搖頭講：「係，我哋係有錢可以買食物，但我哋都唔可以浪費食物。
eng: Dad shook his head and said, "Yes, we have money to buy food, but we can't waste food either."

text: 你知唔知依個世界其實仲有好多人係冇嘢食㗎？你哋已經好幸福㗎喇。
eng: Did you know that there are still many people in this world who don't have much to eat?

text: 每一樣食物都係得來不易，所以我哋要更加應該珍惜。
eng: Every food is hard-won, so we should cherish it even more.

text: 阿大同家姐聽完都點點頭：「我明白喇。」
eng: Sister Ah Datong nodded after listening: "I see."

text: 家姐講:「阿爸，不如我哋將多餘而我哋又食唔晒嘅食物捐俾食物銀行吖，又唔使浪費食物，又可以幫到有需要嘅人。」
eng: My sister said, "Dad, it's better for me to donate the excess food that I can't eat enough to the food bank, so that I don't have to waste food, and I can help people in need."

text: 阿爸好開心噉點點頭。
eng: Dad nodded happily.

text: 一年一次剪頭髮
eng: That annual haircut

text: 有一個地方，係人同動物都可以一齊和平生活嘅。
eng: there is a place where people and animals can live together in peace.

text: 呢度有個有錢人叫阿達，每年嘅一月一號係佢要剪頭髮嘅日子，今日終於到喇。
eng: There is a rich man named Ada here, and the first of January every year is the day he will cut his hair, and today has finally arrived.

text: 當佢想出門口，佢老婆叫住佢：「唔准去，依家疫情咁嚴重，唔准出。其實你想剪都冇人幫到你。」
eng: When he wanted to go out, his wife called him: "Don't go, now the epidemic is so serious, don't go out." In fact, if you want to cut it, no one will help you.

text: 阿達好嬲噉講：「我一定要剪，依個係我一直嘅習慣嚟。」
eng: Ada said very lovingly, "I have to cut it, because I am not used to it." "

text: 突然，佢記得好似好多舖頭都冇開門做生意。
eng: Suddenly, he remembers like many shops were not open for business.

text: 過咗咁耐，一定開返晒。佢行咗出門口，真係好多舖頭都冇開門。
eng: After so long, it must have been overturned. He walked out the door, and really many shops were not open.

text: 佢好忟憎噉講：「我就唔信剪唔到，我揾阿明，上年都係揾佢！」
eng: He hated to say this: "I don't believe that I can't cut it, I picked Amin, I still looked for him last year!"

text: 佢就打電話畀阿明，「阿明，幫幫手，剪個頭，同上年一樣就得㗎喇！」
eng: He called Amin, "Amin, help, cut your head, just like last year!"

text: 阿明細細聲噉講：「老友，唔係唔想幫你，依家疫情咁得人驚。」
eng: Amin whispered: "Dude, it's not that I don't want to help you, the epidemic is so scary now."

text: 妹妹就同爸爸講：「不如，等我哋幫你剪喇！」
eng: My sister said to my father, "Let's cut it for you!"

text: 阿達諗一諗，都好，畀佢哋試吓都好。
eng: Ada thinks about it, it's all good, let them try it.

text: 好耐都冇試過假期一家大細喺屋企一齊過喇。
eng: Haven't tried holidays for a long time, and the family spent it together at home.

text: 佢哋幫阿達設計咗幾個髮型，問佢鍾意邊個。
eng: They helped Ada design a few hairstyles and asked him who he liked.

text: 最後連佢老婆都幫埋手，佢老婆剪緊嗰陣一路喺度諗一陣要去買風扇，唔小心幫佢剪咗一個風扇頭。
eng: In the end, even his wife helped, and his wife was thinking about buying a fan for a while while cutting, and accidentally cut a fan head for him.

text: 阿達突然大叫一聲，佢好似諗到一樣嘢。
eng: Ada suddenly exclaimed, as if he had thought of something.

text: 佢跑咗出門口，伯伯見到佢都驚咗一下，佢仲記得要保持一定嘅社交距離先係啱，所以停咗喺度，唔行咁前。
eng: He ran out the door, and his uncle was scared when he saw him, and he remembered that it was right to maintain some social distancing, so he stopped here and didn't go so far.

text: 而阿達醒起自己冇戴口罩，又跑返屋企拎口罩。
eng: And Ada remembered that she was not wearing a mask and ran home to get it.

text: 全部人都望住阿達，睇下發生咩事。
eng: Everyone stared at Ada to see what was going on.

text: 阿達大聲噉講：「大家聽住喇，我有件事想同大家講！」
eng: Ada said loudly: "Listen, I have something I want to tell you!"

text: 「依家疫情咁嚴重，我哋唔應該咁自私，唔可以只係諗自己，為咗你自己同身邊嘅人，出街記得戴口罩，大家要保持一米嘅社交距離。」
eng: "Now that the epidemic is so serious, we should not be so selfish, we can't just think about ourselves, for yourself and the people around you, remember to wear a mask when you go out, and everyone should maintain a social distance of one meter."

text: 阿達繼續講「因為疫情好多人都冇咗工作，生活上都出現困難，所以我身為社會一分子，我自願捐出我一半身家，幫助一啲有需要嘅人。」
eng: Ada continued, "Because of the epidemic, many people have no jobs and have difficulties in life, so as a member of society, I voluntarily donate half of my property to help people in need.

text: 當阿達講完之後，好多人都舉起手大叫：「太好喇！終於有人嚟幫我哋喇！」，有啲仲喊咗出嚟。
eng: When Ada finished speaking, many people raised their hands and shouted, "Great!

text: 大家都開心到又唱歌，又跳舞。
eng: Everyone sang and danced with joy.

text: 但係一位唱歌嘅伯伯好似太開心喇，唔記得戴口罩。
eng: But a singing uncle seemed so happy that he forgot to wear a mask.

text: 阿達做嘅事傳播咗出去，好多傳媒都開始關注佢，同走嚟睇下發生咩事，令到更多人都開始關注疫情。
eng: What Ada did spread, and many media began to pay attention to him, and ran to see what happened, so that more people began to pay attention to the epidemic.

text: 阿達不停噉送啲防疫用品畀有需要嘅人，都有好多市民自願幫手。
eng: Ada keeps sending epidemic prevention supplies to people in need, and many citizens volunteer to help.

text: 阿達老婆日日都希望可以疫情快啲好返。
eng: Ada's wife hopes to recover quickly from the epidemic every day.

text: 而阿達為咗令自己記得身為社會一分子嘅責任，所以佢決定疫情唔好返，就唔剪頭髮。
eng: In order to remember his responsibility as a member of society, Ada decided not to cut his hair because of the epidemic.

text: 我係一名工程師
eng: I am an engineer

text: 我叫阿樂，我細細個就有一個夢想，係想成為一個工程師，但係好難實現到。
eng: My name is Ale, and I had a dream when I was a child to become an engineer, but it was difficult to achieve.

text: 你哋可能會講只係工程師，認真啲讀書咪得囉。
eng: You might say you're just engineers, just read carefully.

text: 吖！仲有一樣嘢未講，我係一個女仔……
eng: Ah! One more thing not to say, I'm a girl ... ...

text: 我想整嘅嘢有好多，多到你哋都唔信。
eng: I think there's a lot of stuff that you don't believe.

text: 我好想起一條好長好長嘅公路，可以畀我踩住單車，由地球踩去月球。
eng: I was reminded of a long, long highway that would allow me to pedal my bike from Earth to the moon.

text: 我好早就想去月球睇下，睇下月亮係咪有隻兔仔喺度，可以帶一個月餅當手信，我諗佢應該會鍾意食。
eng: I wanted to go to the moon for a long time to see if there was a little rabbit here on the moon and could bring a mooncake as a gift, I think he would like to eat it.

text: 但係班上嘅男同學聽到我想做工程師，佢係噉笑我，指住我話：
eng: But when the male student in the class heard that I wanted to be an engineer, he laughed at me and pointed at me and said:

text: 「你一個女仔，仲想做工程師，點會夠我哋男仔嚟，我夢想都係做工程師，你都係喺寫字樓返工啦。」
eng: "You are a girl, you still want to be an engineer, how can you be enough for us boys, I dream of being an engineer, you still work in the office building."

text: 我好想整一架火箭出嚟，可以飛嚟飛去，好想睇下其他地方，好想知有冇一個地方係男女平等嘅呢？
eng: I would love to have a whole rocket out and fly around, really want to see other places, wonder if there is a place where men and women are equal?

text: 其實，我喺學校嘅科學考試年年都係全班第一名，嗰個男仔次次都係唔合格，但係個個都讚佢叻，有理想，但係我就⋯⋯點解會有咁大唔同？
eng: In fact, my science exam at school was the first in the class every year, and the boy failed every time, but everyone praised him for being smart and idealistic, but I ... Why is there such a big difference?

text: 吖！我仲有個地方想去呀！
eng: Ya! I still have a place I want to go!

text: 我好想去睇海嘅世界，聽人講有好多魚、海星同海草。
eng: I would love to see the world of the sea, and I heard that there are a lot of fish, starfish and seaweed.

text: 因為我唔識游水，如果我整到一部潛水艇就好喇！
eng: Since I can't swim, if only I got a whole submarine!

text: 噉我就可以去睇下唔同嘅嘢。
eng: Then I can go and see something different.

text: 有時，我唔係好明白，點解連屋企人都唔支持我。
eng: Sometimes, I don't quite understand why even my family doesn't support me.

text: 成日都係嗰句：「女仔做咩工程師，做寫字樓唔好咩？」
eng: All day long, it's a joke: "What are girls doing as engineers, is it bad to be an office building?"

text: 但係我都有自己鍾意同想做嘅嘢㗎。
eng: But I also have things I like and want to do.

text: 有一日，科學老師叫我落堂嚟揾佢，佢問咗我一個問題，如果你係一個工程師，你會想整咩嘢呀？
eng: One day, my science teacher called me to come to him after class, and he asked me a question, if you were an engineer, what would you want to do?

text: 我細細聲噉問：「我都可以做到工程師咩？」
eng: When I was a kid, I asked loudly, "Can I be an engineer too?"

text: 佢好肯定噉答：「可以呀！」
eng: He replied affirmatively, "Yes!"

text: 我再問：「但係我係女仔喎！」
eng: I asked again, "But I'm a girl!"

text: 佢再答：「噉又點？」
eng: He replied, "So what?"

text: 聽到佢噉講，我開始慢慢講我嘅理想。
eng: Hearing him say this, I began to slowly talk about my ideals.

text: 我見老師好留心聽我講，我繼續講「我仲想整一個機械人，佢可以幫媽媽煮飯，又可以幫爸爸做嘢，又可以教細佬做功課。」
eng: I saw that the teacher listened attentively, and I continued, "I also want a robot that can help my mother cook, help my father cook, and teach my brother to do homework. 」

text: 最好梗係可以捉到電腦上嘅壞人，唔准佢哋偷嘢。
eng: It is best to catch the bad guys on the computer and not allow them to steal.

text: 捉到佢之後，我要同佢講，偷嘢係唔啱㗎！
eng: After I catch him, I'm going to tell him that it's not right to steal!

text: 唉，而家地球都病咗，我都好想發明一啲嘢可以救下佢。
eng: Alas, now that the earth is sick, I would also like to invent something to save him.

text: 因為地球係我哋嘅屋企，好似我哋嘅屋企人噉。
eng: Because the earth is our home, just like our family.

text: 最後，我好想可以有一對翼，噉我就可以每日嚟同老師打招呼喇。
eng: Finally, I would love to have a pair of wings so I can come and say hello to the teacher every day.

text: 老師嗰日靜靜噉聽我講我嘅夢想，都鼓勵我要加油。
eng: The teacher quietly listened to me that day and encouraged me to cheer.

text: 自從嗰日之後，我更加認真讀書，而屋企人都開始明白我。
eng: Since that day, I have studied more seriously, and my family has begun to understand me.

text: 阿樂而家望住一本日記笑住講：「而家睇返之前細個寫嘅日記都幾搞笑。
eng: Le now stared at a diary and said with a smile: "Now look at the diary I wrote when I was a child, which is quite funny.

text: 我最後都自我介紹，我叫阿樂，我而家係一個工程師，大家有事都可以揾我幫手㗎。」
eng: I finally introduced myself, my name is Le, I am now an engineer, everyone can ask me for help. 」

text: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？
eng: Are we the same? Or are we different?
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 歡迎大家嚟到動物之城，呢度好似有一對母女喺度傾偈，不如我哋聽下佢哋講緊啲咩吖。
eng: Welcome to Animal City, where there seems to be a mother and daughter chatting here, so let's listen to what they have to say.
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 「阿儀，我最後講多次，唔准再同蛇仔玩。」
eng: "Yi, I said many times in the end, you are not allowed to play with the snake son again. 」
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 阿儀問：「點解喎？我同佢係好朋友嚟㗎。」
eng: Yi asked, "Why? I came with him as a good friend."
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 媽咪答：「因為佢同我哋唔同，唔係同一種族，佢會對你不利㗎，你會受傷㗎。」
eng: Mom replied, "Because he is different from us, not of the same race, he will be bad for you, and you will be hurt."
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 阿儀繼續講：「但係…」
eng: Yi continued, "But..."
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 媽咪開始嬲嬲地講：「唔使再但係喇，聽阿媽講就得喇。快啲返學喇。」
eng: Mom began to say angrily, "No more but, just listen to mom." It's almost time for school. 」
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 阿儀細細聲噉講：「哦…」
eng: Yi whispered, "Oh..."
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 阿儀喺度諗：點解一定要分得咁清，我同蛇仔做朋友又有咩問題。我真係唔明媽咪點解唔俾。
eng: Yi was thinking: Why do I have to be so clear, and what is the problem with me being friends with the snake son. I really don't understand why my mother didn't let me.
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 點知，喺另一個屋企，有兩隻動物喺度鬧交。
eng: Who knows, in another home, two animals quarrel here.
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 屋企傳出咗一把聲音：「蛇仔，唔准你再同阿儀玩。佢唔值得同你做朋友，聽到未？」
eng: A voice came from the house: "Snake son, you are not allowed to play with Yi again." He doesn't deserve to be friends with you, do you hear?"
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 蛇仔大聲講：「我…唔…制。」
eng: The serpent son exclaimed, "I... No... System. 」
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 爸爸鬧：「唔准唔聽話！」
eng: Dad scolded: "Don't disobey!"
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 跟住就打落去蛇仔塊面度。
eng: Then he hit the snake child in the noodles.
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 跟住就拎咗書包，跑咗出去。
eng: Then he took his bag and ran out.
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 蛇仔一路喊，一路諗：點解啲大人都唔諗下小朋友感受嘅？阿儀都係動物，點解我哋唔可以做朋友喎！」
eng: While crying, the snake son thought: Why don't adults want children to feel?
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 喺學校，阿儀見到蛇仔眼紅紅就問佢發生咩事。
eng: At school, Yi saw the snake boy's red eyes and asked him what had happened.
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 阿儀：「蛇仔，你做咩喊呀？我有冇嘢可以幫到你呀？」
eng: Yi: "Snake son, why are you crying, is there anything I can do to help you?"
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 蛇仔：「阿儀，我哋有咩唔同？點解我爸爸唔准我哋做朋友嘅？」
eng: Snake Son: "Yi, what's different between us, why doesn't my father allow me to be friends?"
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 阿儀：「唉！我媽咪都係噉講」
eng: Yi: "Oh, that's what my mother said."
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 突然，阿儀好似諗到啲嘢。「蛇仔，不如我哋畫下我哋有咩唔同，有咩係一樣吖。」
eng: Suddenly, Yi seemed to think of these things. "Snake son, let's draw what is different about us, what is the same."
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 蛇仔笑住講：「好喎，黃色圈圈係代表你，藍色圈圈係代表我，綠色係我哋一樣嘅地方。」
eng: The snake son smiled and said, "Well, the yellow circle represents you, the blue circle represents me, and the green circle is the same place as us."
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 佢哋開始不停諗佢哋有咩唔同，有咩係相同嘅地方。
eng: They start to think about what is different about them, what is the same.
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 蛇仔話：「吖，我諗到喇，我身體好長，但係你就好細粒。」
eng: The serpent son said, "Oh, I thought about it, I have a long body, but you are very small. 」
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 蛇仔有啲唔開心噉講：「點解，我諗唔到我哋有咩相似嘅，我哋係咪真係唔適合做朋友呀…」
eng: The snake son said a little unhappy: "Why, I didn't expect us to have any similarities, are we really not suitable for being friends..."
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 阿儀話：「唔好咁灰心啦，我哋一定揾到嘅，放心。」
eng: Yi said, "Don't be so discouraged, we will definitely find it, rest assured."
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 佢哋一直望住張紙，一路喺度諗，但係都係冇答案。
eng: They kept staring at the piece of paper, thinking, but there was still no answer.
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 突然，佢哋聽到有啲腳步聲，好似行緊埋嚟。
eng: Suddenly, they heard a little footsteps, as if approaching.
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 原來係大象老師，佢開口問：「你哋個樣做咩咁煩惱嘅？」
eng: It turned out to be the elephant teacher, and he asked, "Why are you so troubled?"
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 阿儀：「我好想知我同蛇仔有咩相似嘅地方。」
eng: Yi: "I'm curious to know what is the similarity between me and the snake son. 」
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 大象老師微笑咗一下，跟住話：「好簡單，我問你哋一個問題，你哋最想同邊個一齊玩吖？」
eng: The elephant teacher smiled and said, "It's very simple, let me ask you a question, who would you most like to play with?"
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 阿儀同蛇仔即刻指住對方。
eng: Yi and the snake son immediately pointed at each other.
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 跟住老師又問：「你哋唔開心會揾邊個傾心事吖？」
eng: Then the teacher asked, "Who are you going to talk to if you're not happy?"
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 同樣地，大家都係指住對方。
eng: In the same way, everyone is pointing at each other.
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 老師再講：「其實大家做朋友，係唔需要介意對方係咩種族，咩膚色，講咩語言㗎。
eng: The teacher said, "Actually, when you are friends, you don't need to mind what race, color, or language the other person speaks."
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 其實大家只要交個心出嚟同對方做朋友，噉大家就自然成為好朋友㗎喇。」
eng: In fact, as long as everyone makes friends with each other, then everyone will naturally become good friends. 」
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 阿儀同蛇仔聽完老師噉講之後，大家攬住對方，跟住一齊話：「我哋係好朋友呀！」
eng: After Yi and the snake son heard the teacher say this, they hugged each other, and then said together, "We are good friends!"
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 其實每個人都係特別嘅，會同其他人有相同或者唔同嘅地方，我哋唔可以因為對方嘅少少唔同，就認為對方係唔適合同自己做朋友，大家知道嘛？
eng: In fact, everyone is special, will have the same or different places with other people, we can't think that the other party is not suitable to be friends with ourselves because of a little difference in each other, you know?
bookTitle: 我哋係一樣？定係唔一樣？

text: 犀利婆婆
eng: Awesome mother-in-law

text: 婆婆買咗青青最鍾意食嘅炒栗子，青青好開心，仲同婆婆一齊食咗幾粒。
eng: mother-in-law bought Qingqing's favorite fried chestnuts, Qingqing was so happy, and she ate a few grains with her mother-in-law.

text: 之後佢哋一齊去揾巴婆婆同青青嘅好朋友——巴仔飲茶。
eng: After that, they went together to drink tea with Ba Po and Qingqing's good friend, Ba Zai.

text: 巴婆婆一家係喺印度嚟嘅，佢哋一家都好香㗎，唔知係用咩香水呢？
eng: Granny Ba's family is from India, they are very fragrant, I don't know what perfume they use?

text: 青青好好奇，不過佢次次都唔記得問。
eng: Qingqing was very curious, but he forgot to ask every time.

text: 晏晝，青青同婆婆返到屋企，諗住繼續食炒栗子，點知碟上面嘅栗子冇晒啊！
eng: In the afternoon, Qingqing and her mother-in-law returned home, ready to continue eating fried chestnuts, how do you know that there are no chestnuts on the plate at all!

text: 究竟係邊個食晒啲栗子？
eng: Who ate some chestnuts?

text: 「唔通係狗仔小旺做嘅？」
eng: "Could it be made by the dog Xiaowang?"

text: 青青估。小旺最鍾意食食食，一定係佢！
eng: Qingqing estimated. Xiao Wang's favorite food must be him!

text: 「但係，如果係小旺食咗嘅話，實會搞到一地都係栗子殼㗎喎？」婆婆話。
eng: "But if Xiao Wang eats it, he will definitely get chestnut shells?" said the mother-in-law.

text: 「係公公？但係公公冇晒牙㗎啦喎⋯⋯係狸貓仔？」青青估。
eng: "It's my father-in-law, but my father-in-law is completely toothless..., is it a tanuki kitten?" Qingqing thought.

text: 狸貓仔係巴仔喺天台揾到嘅小動物，巴仔同佢做咗好朋友，不過狸貓仔好鍾意偷廚房啲嘢食。
eng: The tanuki kitten is a small animal that Ba Zai found on the rooftop, and Ba Zai became good friends with him, but the tanuki kitten likes to steal kitchen things to eat.

text: 但係啲栗子咁多，狸貓仔咁細隻，又點偷得晒？
eng: But there are so many chestnuts, and the tanuki kitten is so small, how can you steal it?

text: 究竟係邊個食咗啲栗子呢？
eng: Who ate some chestnuts?

text: 「我有辦法！」婆婆突然講：「我哋可以整三個陷阱嚟捉賊！」
eng: "I have a way!" The mother-in-law suddenly said, "We can make three traps to catch thieves!"

text: 「不過，首先我哋要有多啲栗子嚟做陷阱喎。」
eng: "But first, we need to make a little more chestnuts to make traps."

text: 婆婆帶青青入廚房。
eng: Mother-in-law takes Qingqing into the kitchen.

text: 「乜啲栗子唔係食晒喇咩？」青青問。
eng: "Didn't you eat chestnuts?" asked Qingqing.

text: 「我靜雞雞收起咗一啲栗子，本來諗住今晚肚餓食嘅。」
eng: "I quietly put away some chestnuts, I expected to be hungry tonight."

text: 青青聽到之後，對眼即刻發晒光，口水都流埋！
eng: When Qingqing heard this, her eyes immediately lit up, and her saliva flowed!

text: 婆婆帶住青青，喺廚房、大廳同公公張梳化度，用籃、紙箱、膠桶同相機做咗三個陷阱，希望可以揾到係邊個食咗啲栗子。
eng: The mother-in-law took Qingqing and made three traps with baskets, cardboard boxes, plastic buckets and cameras in the kitchen, hall, and father-in-law's sofa, hoping to find out who ate some chestnuts.

text: 幾個鐘後，青青突然叫住噉走去揾婆婆：「啲栗子唔見晒啊！」
eng: A few hours later, Qingqing suddenly ran to her mother-in-law with a shout: "The chestnut is gone!"

text: 婆婆跟住青青行出大廳，喺籃入面見唔到狸貓仔，紙箱下面見唔到小旺，相機都冇出相紙，但係啲栗子就唔見晒。
eng: The mother-in-law followed Qingqing out of the hall, and she couldn't see the tanuki kitten in the basket, Xiaowang couldn't be seen under the cardboard box, and the camera didn't come out of the photo paper, but the chestnut was gone.

text: 究竟係邊個食晒啲栗子啊？婆婆諗咗一陣。
eng: Who ate some chestnuts?" the mother-in-law thought for a while.

text: 突然，婆婆指住青青：「啊！我知啦！係你！」
eng: Suddenly, the mother-in-law pointed at Qingqing: "Ah, I know, it's you!"

text: 青青開始心虛，唔敢正眼望婆婆……
eng: Qingqing began to feel weak, and did not dare to look at her mother-in-law squarely...

text: 「呢啲陷阱淨係得你知點整，一定係你搞掂晒啲陷阱，再食晒啲栗子！」
eng: "These traps just have to know how to do it, you must have completed some traps and ate some chestnuts!"

text: 「呀……因為啲栗子實在太好食，我忍唔住就……」青青細細聲講。
eng: "... Because these chestnuts are so delicious, I can't help but ... ... Qingqing whispered.

text: 婆婆摸咗下青青個頭，笑住話：
eng: Mother-in-law touched Qingqing's head and said with a smile:

text: 「想食咪同我講囉！不過栗子食太多對腸胃唔好，不如我哋將剩低嘅栗子分畀巴婆婆，等佢哋都試吓香港嘅街頭小食吖？」
eng: "Don't tell me if you want to eat! But eating too many chestnuts is not good for the stomach, why don't we give the rest of the chestnuts to Grandma Ba, so that they can also try to scare Hong Kong's street food?"

text: 「好啊！噉不如請埋巴仔食煨蕃薯、燒賣同魚蛋吖？」青青答。
eng: "Okay! Why don't you invite Ba Zi to eat stewed sweet potatoes, roasted and fish eggs?"

text: 等到婆婆同青青出返大廳，點知......檯上面嘅栗子又唔見咗！
eng: Wait until the mother-in-law and Qingqing come out of the hall, how do you know ... The chestnuts on the stage are gone again!

eng: "㗩㗩㗩 ... ... At this time, there was a sound of eating in the room ... ...

text: 紙船的秘密
eng: The Secret of Paper Boats

text: 新年之後嘅第一個節日到喇！
eng: The first festival after the New Year has arrived!

text: 唔少人屋企都準備咗花燈同湯圓，而小明同大鼻就準備咗紙船慶祝。
eng: Many people prepared lanterns and rice balls, and Xiaoming and Big Nose prepared paper boats to celebrate.

text: 佢哋喺河邊放紙船，睇住紙船喺水上面浮下浮下。
eng: They put paper boats by the river and watch them float up and down the water.

text: 「點解紙船可以浮喺水度嘅？」小明問。「係咪因為我有頭髮呢？」
eng: "Why can paper boats float?" asked Bob. "Is it because I have hair?"

text: 大鼻都唔知紙船點解識浮。
eng: Big Nose doesn't know why the paper boat floats.

text: 不過小明知道一定唔關頭髮事，佢摸住自己嘅光頭噉諗。佢哋決定返去問公公。
eng: But Bob knows that it must be none of his hair, he touches his bald head and thinks so. They decided to go back and ask their father-in-law.

text: 「公公，點解紙船識浮嘅？」小明問。
eng: "Father-in-law, why did the paper boat float?" asked Bob.

text: 平時乜都識嘅公公俾小明問到𢯎晒頭。
eng: The father-in-law, who usually understands everything, was asked by Xiaoming to shave his head completely.

text: 佢決定帶小明同大鼻去揾花姨姨。
eng: He decided to take Xiaoming and Big Nose to Aunt Hua.

text: 花姨姨係公公個女，又係科學老師，一定會知點解。
eng: Aunt Hua is the daughter of her father-in-law and a science teacher, so she will definitely know why.

text: 「爸爸。」花姨姨見到公公，就放低手上本書。
eng: "Dad. When Aunt Hua saw her father-in-law, she put down the book in her hand.

text: 「花花，你知唔知點解紙船識浮？」
eng: "Hua Hua, do you know why the paper boat floats?"

text: 花姨姨見到小明同大鼻個好奇樣，就知道條問題一定係呢兩個小朋友問嘅。
eng: Aunt Hua saw Xiaoming and Big Nose looking curious, and knew that this question must be asked by these two children.

text: 佢笑笑口，請公公入房坐，又叫小明同大鼻出去拎一桶水同一個盤返嚟。
eng: He smiled, asked his father-in-law to come into the room and sit, and asked Xiaoming and Big Nose to go out and get a bucket of water and a plate back.

text: 等咗冇幾耐，小明同大鼻就好辛苦噉搬咗一大桶水入嚟。
eng: Not long after waiting, Xiaoming and Big Nose worked hard to bring in a large bucket of water.

text: 花姨姨將準備好嘅蘋果同匙羹放喺檯面，跟住叫大鼻將啲水倒落個盤度。
eng: Aunt Hua puts the prepared apples and spoons on the countertop, and then asks Big Nose to pour the water onto a plate.

text: 「爸爸，你試下將個蘋果放落水度，再輕輕撳佢落去。」
eng: "Dad, try putting the apple in the water and gently pressing him down." "

text: 花姨姨同公公講。公公將蘋果放落水，再用尾指推佢落去。
eng: Aunt Hua and father-in-law said. The father-in-law put the apple into the water and pushed him down with his little finger.

text: 哎呀！好多水倒咗出嚟啊！公公一鬆手，粒蘋果就浮返上水面。
eng: Oops! A lot of water poured out! As soon as the father-in-law let go, an apple floated to the surface.

text: 「小明，呢度有幾多水倒咗出嚟啊？」花姨姨問。
eng: "Xiaoming, how much water has been poured out here?" asked Aunt Hua.

text: 小明望望檯面，又望望地下嘅水，話：「應該有一杯水。」
eng: Xiao Ming looked at the table, and at the water on the ground, and said, "There should be a glass of water."

text: 「冇錯。」花姨姨點頭，繼續講：「蘋果放落水之後，有一杯左右嘅水倒咗出嚟，而蘋果就浮緊。」
eng: "That's right. Aunt Hua nodded and continued: "After the apple fell into the water, a cup or so of water was poured out, and the apple was floating.

text: 花姨姨望下桶水，又問：「大鼻，你可唔可以幫我倒滿個盤？」
eng: Aunt Hua looked down at the bucket of water and asked, "Big nose, can you help me fill a plate?"

text: 「今次你哋試下放匙羹。」
eng: "This time, you can try to put a spoon." "

text: 小明一放匙羹落水，匙羹就即刻沉落水底，得少少水倒咗出嚟。
eng: As soon as Bob puts the spoon into the water, the spoon immediately sinks to the bottom of the water, and a little water is poured out.

text: 「你哋見到啦，蘋果放落水嗰陣，推咗好多水出嚟，然後佢就浮咗起身。」
eng: "You see, when the apple fell into the water, it pushed a lot of water out, and then he floated.

text: 「即係同瀉出嚟嘅水有關？」大鼻問。
eng: "Is it related to the water that spills out?" asked Big Nose.

text: 「冇錯，如果將瀉出嚟嘅水同蘋果一齊磅重，就會發現蘋果比推出去嘅水更加輕，即係話蘋果將重過自己重量嘅水推咗出去，所以佢就浮到。」
eng: "That's right, if you weigh the water that spills out together with the apple, you will find that the apple is lighter than the water that is pushed out, that is, the apple pushes out the water that is heavier than its own weight, so he floats."

text: 「但係匙羹推出去嘅水少咁多，即係話……」公公話。
eng: "But the spoon pushes out so much less water, that is..."

text: 「即係話匙羹推出去啲水仲輕過佢自己嘅重量，所以佢就沉喇！」
eng: "That is, the spoon pushed out of the water is lighter than his own, so he sank!"

text: 「噉海上面啲船呢？佢哋重過匙羹咁多，點解又浮到？」小明問。
eng: "What about the ships on the Earth Sea, they weigh so much more than spoons, why do they float again?" asked Bob.

text: 「就好似蘋果噉，海上面嘅船大到可以將重過自己嘅水推出去。
eng: "Like apples, boats on the sea are big enough to push out water heavier than themselves."

text: 而且海洋嘅水多好多㗎！噉佢咪可以浮囉！」
eng: And the ocean has a lot more water, then he can float!"

text: 「原來係噉，我明白啦！」小明話。
eng: "So that's it, I see!" said Bob.

text: 「噉我哋可以出去放紙船未啊？」大鼻已經好心急要去玩喇。
eng: "Can we go out and put paper boats?" Big Nose is already very anxious to play.

text: 「可以，不過玩完記得帶走啲紙船，如果唔係會整污糟條河㗎！」
eng: "Yes, but remember to take the paper boat with you, if it doesn't stain the river!"

text: 花姨姨分咗啲顏色紙畀佢哋。
eng: Aunt Hua gave them colored paper.

text: 「係咪唔記得收返啲船呢？」公公拎咗幾隻白色紙船出嚟——係佢哋今朝放嘅紙船呀！
eng: "Did you forget to take back the boat?" Father-in-law took a few white paper boats out - they put paper boats this morning!

text: 小明同大鼻笑咗笑，就同公公一齊出去放紙船啦！
eng: Xiaoming and Big Nose smiled, and went out with his father-in-law to put paper boats!

text: 畀個密碼嚟睇下
eng: Give a password to see

text: 今日心怡同媽媽出街買嘢，行過一條街，聽到有個叔叔喺度叫賣。
eng: Today Xinyi and her mother went shopping on the street, walked through a street, and heard an uncle shouting here.

text: 「埋嚟睇，埋嚟揀呀！想要配鎖匙嘅都可以過嚟呀，唔同嘅鎖匙公仔我都有，好靚㗎！」
eng: "Come and see, come and choose, if you want to match the key, you can also come over, I also have different key dolls, very beautiful!"

text: 心怡聽到，就拉住媽媽去到叔叔面前，好緊張噉講：
eng: Xinyi heard it, so she pulled her mother to her uncle and said nervously:

text: 「媽媽，可唔可以配一條畀我呀，我已經大個女喇，識得自己保管㗎喇。」
eng: "Mom, can you match one to me, I have grown up as a girl, I know how to keep it myself."

text: 媽媽笑住講：「好啦，配啦，真係冇你辦法。」
eng: Mom smiled and said, "Well, yes, you can't help it."

text: 心怡好開心噉同叔叔講：「叔叔，我想配一條鎖匙，要黃色嘅。」
eng: Xin Yi happily said to her uncle: "Uncle, I want a key, and I want a yellow one." "

text: 叔叔心諗：其實我啱啱先二十歲，應該叫我哥哥先啱……不過唔緊要啦，都唔係第一次畀人噉叫我……
eng: Uncle thought to himself: Actually, I am just twenty years old, I should call my brother just ... But it doesn't matter, it's not the first time I've been called like that ... ...

text: 之後佢答：「冇問題，一陣就搞掂。你睇下呢條啱唔啱你？」
eng: After which he replied: "No problem, it'll be done in a moment." Do you see if this is right for you?"

text: 心怡即刻答：「啱呀啱呀，黃色好靚呀！」
eng: Xinyi immediately replied: "Oh, oh, yellow is so beautiful!"

text: 喺叔叔整緊鎖匙嘅時候，佢部收音機播出一單新聞：
eng: When my uncle was working on the key, his radio broadcast a single news:

text: 「本港近日發生一宗網上騙案，有位先生畀人呃咗好多錢……」
eng: "There was an online fraud case in Hong Kong recently, and a gentleman was cheated out of a lot of money..."

text: 過咗十分鐘，心怡終於拎到新鎖匙返屋企喇！
eng: After ten minutes, Xinyi finally went home with the new key!

text: 佢哋行到屋企門口，先發現原來大門冇閂到！
eng: They walked to the door and found that the door was not closed!

text: 佢哋即刻入屋睇睇，好彩冇唔見嘢。
eng: They immediately entered the door to take a look, fortunately they were not gone.

text: 媽媽坐低慢慢同心怡講：「鎖好門好緊要㗎，條屋企鎖匙你都要小心收好，唔好畀其他人呀！」
eng: Mom sat down and slowly said to Xinyi: "It's very important to lock the door, you should also put away the house keys carefully, don't let others!"

text: 心怡答：「知道喇，我會好好收好佢㗎喇。」
eng: Xinyi replied: "Got it, I will put him away well."

text: 媽媽繼續講：「除咗屋企鎖匙，仲有好多私人嘢你都要收好呀，好似錢、日記，仲有電子密碼……」
eng: Mom continued: "In addition to the keys at home, there are many personal things you also have to keep away, such as money, diaries, and electronic passwords..."

text: 心怡笑住講：「媽媽，我大個女㗎喇，我先冇咁唔小心，我會保管好佢哋。」
eng: Xinyi smiled and said: "Mom, I'm a girl who grew up, I'm not so careless, I'll keep them."

text: 媽媽開咗屋企部電腦，問：「真係咁叻？噉你講下你係點保管啲密碼嘅？」
eng: Mom turned on a computer at home and asked, "So how do you keep some passwords?"

text: 心怡開始講：「簡單啦，上堂老師有講過，我哋用電腦嗰陣，有好多嘢要注意……」
eng: Xinyi began to say: "Simple, the teacher in class has said that when we use the computer, there are many things to pay attention to..."

text: 「好似入密碼嗰陣，要睇下隔籬有冇人，唔好畀人見到。」
eng: "Like when entering the password, we must see if there is anyone next door and don't let people see."

text: 「而且我部電話仲有設定到鎖機密碼，我係咪好叻呀？」
eng: "And my phone still has a lock code, am I smart?"

text: 「係喇係喇，最叻係你喇。最緊要記得：唔好亂畀個密碼其他人，因為你唔知佢哋會用嚟做咩壞事。」媽媽語重心長噉講。
eng: "Yes, yes, the best is you." The most important thing to remember: don't mess around with other people, because you don't know what they'll do with it. Mom said seriously.

text: 心怡話：「我知道喇，媽媽！」
eng: Xinyi: "I know, Mom!"

text: 媽媽問：「你今日好似好聽話噉噃？」
eng: Mom asked, "You seem to be very obedient today?"

text: 心怡有啲唔開心噉講：「冇，因為前幾日我個好朋友阿細打機嗰陣，佢畀咗個遊戲帳號密碼人，跟住就畀人偷咗個帳號喇……
eng: Xinyi said unhappily: "No, because a few days ago my good friend Ah Xiao played an electric array, he gave a game account password person, and then someone stole an account...

text: 我聽完之後都好驚，我以後會小心保管自己嘅嘢㗎喇！」
eng: I was so scared after listening to it, I will carefully keep myself in the future!"

text: 唔知你部電腦同手機有幾多個密碼？你哋又有冇好好管理佢哋呢？
eng: I don't know how many passwords your computer and mobile phone have?

text: 我哋之間嘅秘密
eng: The secret between us

text: 大家見唔見到我呀？
eng: Don't you see me?

text: 我係坐最後排睇緊書嗰個男仔，我叫阿茶。
eng: I am the boy sitting in the last row reading a book, my name is Acha.

text: 傳緊紙仔嗰個係我好朋友阿海，睇嚟今日我哋又有秘密行動喇！
eng: In the paper son, that is my good friend Ahai, it seems that today we have another secret operation!

text: 同學仔一個傳一個。我心諗：「傳快啲啦，好想知佢寫咗啲咩畀我呀！」
eng: Classmates pass on one by one. I thought to myself, "Hurry up, I'd love to know what he wrote to me!"

text: 有人掂咗下我隻手，然後畀咗張紙仔我。
eng: Someone got my hand and gave me a piece of paper.

text: 我一睇，上面寫住：一陣我哋喺飯堂後面等。
eng: When I looked at it, it said: We'll wait behind the canteen in a moment.

text: 我望一望阿海，睇嚟又有好嘢玩喇。
eng: I looked at Ahai, and it seemed that there was something good to play with again.

text: （後來我哋至知道，原來同學仔傳紙仔嗰陣已經睇到晒上面寫乜，仲諗緊一陣靜靜雞跟埋去睇我哋有咩玩……）
eng: (Later, we learned that the son of the original classmate had seen what was written on it at that time, and was still thinking about secretly following to see what we had to play ... ）

text: 終於落堂喇！阿海拎住個藍色盒仔出咗去，我跟住佢出去。
eng: Ah Hai went out with a small blue box, and I followed him out.

text: 我哋一去到飯堂後面，阿海就開咗個盒同我講：「殊……睇下，係你最鍾意食嘅薯波呀！」
eng: As soon as we arrived at the back of the cafeteria, Ah Hai opened a box and said to me, "Shu... Look, is it your favorite potato ball!"

text: 「多謝阿海，噉我唔客氣喇！」我即刻伸手諗住開餐……
eng: "Thank you Ah Hai, then you're welcome!" I immediately reached out and prepared to open the meal...

text: 「我哋都唔客氣喇！」成班同學突然喺後面走晒出嚟。
eng: "You're all welcome!" the class suddenly walked out from behind.

text: 「乜咁多人呀……好啦，噉就一人一粒……」阿海話口未完，大家已經忍唔住口喇！
eng: "What so many people ... Well, then one per person... Ah Hai's words are not finished, and everyone can't help but speak!

text: 佢哋食完一粒又一粒，啲薯波話咁快就冇晒，淨低我同阿海對住個吉盒……
eng: After they ate one after another, these potato balls quickly disappeared, and Ah Hai and I faced a ji box ...

text: 第二日，阿海又拎咗一盒薯波返學。呢次阿海決定用第二個方法傳話。
eng: The next day, Ah Hai took another box of potato balls to school. This time, Ahai decided to use the second method to pass the message.

text: 佢用一條紙綁住一支筆，再喺上面寫字，然後叫隔籬嘅同學傳畀我。
eng: He tied a pen with a piece of paper, wrote on it, and asked a classmate next door to pass it on to me.

text: 嗰個同學諗住呢次又有好嘢食喇，點知一睇，紙上面啲字全部都睇唔明！唯有傳畀下個同學睇。
eng: That classmate estimated that he had something good to eat this time, how did he know that when he looked at it, he couldn't understand all the words on the paper!

text: 點知其他同學都一樣睇唔明紙上面啲字！就係噉，條紙傳到去我手上。
eng: Who knew that the other students couldn't read the words on the paper! That's it, the strip of paper passed to my hand.

text: 我望到阿海對住我舉起支筆，就即時明晒！
eng: I saw Ah Hai holding up a pen at me and immediately understood!

text: 我學佢拎起支筆，將條紙綁住支筆，啲字就出現返喇：一陣食飯我哋去音樂室等。
eng: I learned him to pick up a pen, tie the paper to the pen, and the words would come back: Let's eat later, we'll go to the music room and wait.

text: 而家我同阿海終於可以兩個人靜靜哋食薯波喇！
eng: Now Ah Hai and I can finally eat potato balls quietly for two people!

text: 好多時，朋友之間嘅一個眼神、一個動作，係局內人先會明白嘅！
eng: Many times, a look or action between friends is understood only by insiders!

text: 唔知你同朋友係咪都係噉嘅呢？
eng: I wonder if you and your friends are like this?

text: 懶叔叔
eng: Lazy uncle

text: 「鈴鈴！」美美同信信即刻跑去門口開門。
eng: "Bell!" Mimi and Nobu immediately ran to the door to open the door.

text: 「係叔叔呀！」兩個人一齊撲上去攬住叔叔。
eng: "Is it uncle!" the two pounced on their uncle together.

text: 叔叔成日都帶好多禮物送畀兩個小朋友，美美同信信都好鍾意叔叔。
eng: My uncle brings a lot of gifts to the two children all day, and Mimi and Nobu like my uncle very much.

text: 但叔叔有樣嘢唔好，就係懶。佢成日坐喺梳化睇書、睇電視、瞓覺，乜都唔做。
eng: But uncle has one bad thing, that is, laziness. He was always sitting on the couch reading, watching TV, sleeping and doing nothing.

text: 呢日媽媽忍唔住問叔叔：「你到底坐夠未？」
eng: On this day, my mother couldn't help but ask my uncle: "Have you sat enough?"

text: 叔叔望一望媽媽，笑笑口噉話：「差唔多啦。聽日我就要上山下海同睇老虎喇。」
eng: The uncle looked at his mother and said with a smile: "Almost." Tomorrow I'm going to go up and down to the sea and see the tigers. 」

text: 「講笑你就識！」媽媽都冇佢咁好氣。
eng: "Just kidding, you understand!" Mom wasn't as angry as him.

text: 第二日，叔叔一個人坐喺梳化上自言自語：「嘩！好靚呀！喂！咪埋嚟呀！」
eng: The next day, my uncle sat alone on the sofa and said to himself, "Wow!

text: 美美同信信聽到，就去睇下發生咩事。
eng: When Meimei and Shinshin heard it, they went to see what happened.

text: 原來叔叔戴咗副好大嘅黑色眼鏡。
eng: It turned out that my uncle wore a pair of large black glasses.

text: 美美拍拍叔叔，問：「呢副係咩眼鏡嚟㗎？」
eng: Meimei patted her uncle and asked, "What kind of glasses are these?"

text: 叔叔就除低眼鏡畀美美試戴。
eng: My uncle took off his glasses and tried them on for Meimei.

text: 眼鏡好黑，美美咩都睇唔到。然後叔叔撳咗一個掣……
eng: The glasses were dark and Meimei couldn't see anything. Then the uncle pressed a button ... ...

text: 哇！美美入咗海底世界呀！下面有魚，左邊有龜，右邊仲有……
eng: Wow! Meimei entered the underwater world! There are fish below, there is on the left, and there is ...

text: 「啊！」美美大叫咗聲，係好大嘅鯊魚！
eng: "Ah!" exclaimed Mimi, a big shark!

text: 「我又要睇！我又要睇！」喺美美隔籬嘅信信都想試下副眼鏡。
eng: "I want to see it again! I want to see it again!" Shinshin, who was next door to Meimei, also wanted to try on a pair of glasses.

text: 「好，到你戴。」叔叔幫信信戴好眼鏡，又撳咗個掣。
eng: "Okay, until you wear it." Uncle helped Shinshin put on his glasses and pressed another button.

text: 「嘩，係鹿同馬騮！仲有天鵝喺度飛……」
eng: "Wow, it's deer and monkeys, and swans flying here ...

text: 信信睇到嘅係一片樹林，耳邊仲傳嚟好多雀仔聲。
eng: Shinshin saw a forest of trees, and there were many birds in his ears.

text: 「叔叔救命！有老虎呀！」信信突然大嗌。
eng: "Uncle help, there are tigers!" Xinxin suddenly cursed.

text: 「嗯……」信信除低眼鏡諗咗陣，就話：「但我都係鍾意真實世界多啲。」
eng: "Hmm..." Shinshin took off his glasses and thought about it, so he said, "But I still like the real world."

text: 「吓？點解呀？」叔叔問。
eng: "Scared? why?" asked my uncle.

text: 「我哋不如出去摘香蕉啦！當造呀！」信信拉住叔叔出門。
eng: "We might as well go out and pick bananas, it's the season!" Shinshin dragged his uncle out.

text: 「我又要食香蕉！」美美跟住追出去。
eng: "I'm going to eat bananas again!" Mimi chased out.

text: 就係噉，叔叔最愛嘅梳化今日終於都變成「空櫈」喇。
eng: That's it, my uncle's favorite sofa has finally become "empty" today.

text: 春日飛燕
eng: Spring Flying Swallow

text: 元朗有一座好大嘅山，山下就係夏兒屋企。
eng: There is a big mountain in Yuen Long, and under the mountain is Xia Er's house.

text: 夏兒住喺一條好細嘅村，每間屋都淨係得兩層高，好多人都搬晒去市區住喇。
eng: Xia'er lives in a very small village, each house is only two stories high, and many people have moved to the city.

text: 夏兒一家係少數會留喺呢條村嘅人，除咗佢哋，仲有啲公公婆婆喺度住。
eng: Xia'er's family is one of the few people who will stay in this village, and in addition to them, there are some in-laws and mothers-in-law who live here.

text: 今日，媽媽帶夏兒同細佬一齊行山，佢哋喺山上見到好多唔同嘅花草樹木，仲有野豬一家喺水邊散步。
eng: Today, my mother took Xia'er and her brother to climb the mountain together, and they saw many different flowers and trees on the mountain, as well as a wild boar family walking by the water.

text: 嘩！有馬騮喺樹上飛嚟飛去！佢哋嘅手臂好長啊！
eng: Wow! There are monkeys flying around the trees! Their arms are so long!

text: 「媽媽！你過嚟睇下！」夏兒話。
eng: "Mom, come and take a look!" said Xia'er.

text: 媽媽話：「咦，係隻燕子喎！」
eng: Mom said, "Hey, it's a swallow!"

text: 媽媽見夏兒好想救隻雀仔，就畀佢帶隻雀仔返去。
eng: Seeing that Xia'er really wanted to save a bird, her mother brought him a bird back.

text: 夏兒將隻燕子放喺一個摸上手好舒服嘅紫色袋入面，又拎咗幾粒果子畀佢食。
eng: Xia Er put the swallow in a purple bag that was comfortable to the touch, and took a few more fruits for him to eat.

text: 跟住媽媽帶佢哋去揾大伯伯，大伯伯養咗好多雀仔，佢應該知道點樣救燕子。
eng: Then the mother took them to the eldest uncle, who had a lot of birds, and he should know how to save the swallows.

text: 大伯伯一路執藥入布袋，一路話：
eng: While grabbing the medicine into the cloth bag, the eldest uncle said:

text: 「通常燕子都係一家人一齊飛，呢隻蕩失路嘅小燕子，可能要到出年先可以見返屋企人喇！」
eng: "Usually swallows fly together as a family, and this little swallow that has lost its way may not see its family until next year!"

text: 「點解要等到出年咁耐？」夏兒問。
eng: "Why wait so long until next year?" asked Xia'er.

text: 「因為冬天就到喇！冬天呢，地下冇晒果子同蟲仔，燕子冇嘢食，就要飛去暖啲嘅地方揾食。」大伯伯話。
eng: "Because winter is coming, there are no fruits and insects on the ground at all, and the swallows have nothing to eat, so they have to fly to warm places to find food." Uncle Da said.

text: 「即係要等到出年春天，佢先可以揾返屋企人？」夏兒問。
eng: "Is it until next spring that he can't find his family?" asked Xia'er.

text: 「係啊！所以呢段時間，隻燕子就靠晒你喇！」大伯伯講完，就將袋住紗布同藥嘅布袋畀咗夏兒。
eng: "Yes, so during this time, this swallow depends on you!" After the uncle finished speaking, he gave Xia Er the bag containing gauze and medicine.

text: 就係噉，今年冬天，夏兒做咗「燕子媽媽」，幫手睇燕子，仲揾埋媽媽幫手整張好細、但好厚嘅被仔畀燕子保暖。
eng: That's it, this winter, Xia'er made a "swallow mother" to help watch the swallows, and also asked her mother to help keep the swallows warm by the whole very small, but very thick by the child.

text: 就喺媽媽好緊張噉整被嘅時候，夏兒問：「媽媽！燕子嘅屋企人出年先返嚟，噉佢咪好驚囉？」
eng: Just when her mother was nervous, Xia Er asked, "Mom, Yanzi's family will not come back next year, so he is so scared?"

text: 媽媽話：「雖然燕子會好驚，但佢知道屋企人一定會返嚟揾佢，所以唔會唔開心嘅。」
eng: Mom said, "Although Swallow will be scared, he knows that his family will definitely come back to him, so he will not be unhappy."

text: 「就好似喺外地忙於工作嘅爸爸、同埋我嘅好朋友小花，佢哋一年會返嚟一次，所以我都唔會唔開心噉樣？」
eng: "Just like my dad who is busy with work and my good friend Xiaohua, they will come back once a year, so I won't be unhappy like this?"

text: 媽媽摸住夏兒頭髮，話：「冇錯，因為佢哋知道呢度先係屋企，佢哋一定會返嚟。」
eng: Mom touched Xia'er's hair and said, "That's right, because they know this is home first, and they will definitely come back."

text: 話咁快就到春天喇！爸爸同小花都返咗嚟，仲同夏兒一齊行山。
eng: Dad and Little Flower are back and climbing the mountain with Xia'er.

text: 雖然夏兒條村已經冇乜人住，但夏兒相信啲村民都係同佢一樣，覺得：
eng: Although Xia Er Tiao Village is no longer inhabited, the villagers that Xia Er believes are still the same as him, feeling:

text: 「始終都係返返去最熟悉嘅屋企、喺最愛嘅家人身邊，先最開心自在！」
eng: "It's always the happiest time to go back to the family you know best, and to be by your favorite family!"

text: 小雲同小吉
eng: Xiaoyun and Xiaoji

text: 小雲同小吉係一對好朋友。
eng: Xiaoyun and Xiaoji are good friends.

text: 小雲係一個好要面嘅女仔，而小吉就內向啲，佢鍾意跟住小雲，小雲做咩，小吉都會跟住做。
eng: Xiao Yun is a very faceless girl, and Xiao Ji is introverted, he likes to follow Xiao Yun, what Xiao Yun does, Xiao Ji will also follow.

text: 今日，小吉嚟小雲屋企，小雲一開門就聽到小吉笑到見牙唔見眼噉話：
eng: Today, Xiao Ji came to Xiao Yun's house, and as soon as Xiao Yun opened the door, he heard Xiao Ji laugh so hard that he couldn't see his teeth and said this:

text: 「聽日係母親節，你睇下我準備咗咩禮物畀媽媽？」
eng: "Tomorrow is Mother's Day, see what gifts I have prepared for my mother?"

text: 正當小雲都想拎佢份禮物出嚟嗰陣，小吉拎咗一條頸巾出嚟。
eng: Just when Xiao Yun also wanted to give him a gift, Xiao Ji came out with a scarf.

text: 小吉笑住問：「係咪好靚呀？係我自己織㗎！」
eng: Xiao Ji smiled and asked, "Isn't it so beautiful?

text: 小雲即刻收返埋自己份禮物，心入面有啲驚訝：又真係幾靚喎！
eng: Xiao Yun immediately hid his gift, and was a little surprised in his heart: It's really beautiful!

text: 跟住就好嬲噉走咗。
eng: Then he left angrily.

text: 留低小雲一個人喺屋入面。
eng: Leaving Xiao Yun alone in the house.

text: 第二日，小雲起身返學，行到一半，發覺唔記得拎手錶，即刻跑返去拎，仲因為噉而遲到。
eng: The next day, Xiaoyun got up to go to school, walked halfway, realized that he forgot to take his watch, and immediately ran back to get it, and was late because of this.

text: 返到學校，小吉一見到小雲就擰歪面。
eng: Back at school, Xiao Ji turned his face crooked when he saw Xiao Yun.

text: 小雲心諗：我就睇你一陣會唔會嚟揾我食飯。
eng: Xiao Yun thought to himself: I'll see if you will come to me for dinner in a while.

text: 終於食飯喇，但係小吉揾咗其他同學一齊食。
eng: Finally ate, but Xiaoji found other classmates to eat with.

text: 小雲望住隻手錶，有啲眼濕濕：「你有八個鐘冇同我講嘢喇！仲要嬲到幾時啊？」
eng: Xiao Yun looked at a watch, a little tearful: "You haven't told me for eight minutes!

text: 放學喇，小雲期待小吉揾佢一齊返屋企嘅畫面都係冇出現。
eng: After school, the picture of Xiaoyun expecting Xiaoji to find him to go home with him still did not appear.

text: 小雲一個人返到屋企，睇住隻手錶，好冇心機：「唉！又話過嚟一齊玩嘅？我哋有一二個鐘冇傾偈喇！」
eng: Xiao Yun came home alone, looked at a watch, and was not in the mood: "Oh, how about playing together? I haven't talked for an hour or two!"

text: 過咗一陣，小雲開始諗：「我係咪過份咗呢？係咪應該道歉？面子真係咁緊要咩？」
eng: After a while, Xiao Yun began to think, "Am I going too far? Should I apologize? Is face really that important?"

text: 呢個時候，小雲突然諗起啲嘢！佢即刻揾咗條木梯想出去，但係唔夠力拎。
eng: At this time, Xiao Yun suddenly remembered these things! He immediately found a wooden ladder and wanted to go out, but he didn't have enough strength to take it.

text: 咁啱佢細佬喺後面，佢就叫細佬：「細佬，過嚟幫家姐搬條梯出去，返嚟請你食蛋糕！」
eng: Then behind his brother, he called his brother: "Brother, come and help my sister move a ladder out, come back and invite you to eat cake!"

text: 細佬流晒口水話：「收到！」
eng: The younger brother drooled and said, "Received!"

text: 細佬問：「家姐，我哋要去邊呀？」
eng: The younger brother asked, "Sister, where are we going?"

text: 小雲話：「如果冇估錯，佢一定係去咗嗰度！跟我嚟！」
eng: Xiao Yun said, "If you guessed correctly, he must be going there!

text: 佢哋嚟到一個公園，見到小吉坐咗喺樹上面。
eng: They came to a park and saw Xiaoji sitting on top of a tree.

text: 小雲記得佢哋次次有咩唔開心都會嚟呢度。
eng: Xiao Yun remembered that they would come here every time they were unhappy.

text: 小雲喺樹下面叫咗小吉幾次，小吉都冇理佢。
eng: Xiao Yun called Xiao Ji several times under the tree, but Xiao Ji ignored him.

text: 小雲決定先爬上隔籬棵樹。
eng: Xiao Yun decided to climb the tree next door.

text: 佢爬嗰時有一下差啲甩手，小吉見到好緊張，好彩有小雲細佬喺後面捉住佢至冇事。
eng: He almost got rid of his hand when he climbed, Xiao Ji saw that he was very nervous, but fortunately Xiao Yun's younger brother caught him behind and was fine.

text: 終於嚟到樹上面，小雲同細佬將條梯嘅另一邊擺去小吉嗰度。
eng: Finally coming to the tree, Xiao Yun and his brother swung the other side of the rope to Xiao Ji.

text: 小雲大叫：「小吉，我有嘢想同你講，你等我，我依家行過嚟……」
eng: Xiao Yun shouted: "Xiao Ji, I have something I want to tell you, you wait for me, I will come over now..."

text: 小吉即刻話：「傻嘅咩！唔好呀！」
eng: Xiao Ji immediately said, "Silly!

text: 但係小雲已經慢慢行緊過去喇！
eng: But Xiao Yun has gone well!

text: 有驚無險，小雲終於同小吉坐返埋一齊喇！
eng: There is no danger, Xiao Yun finally sat back with Xiao Ji!

text: 小吉唔知好嬲定笑好：「你係咪傻㗎！」
eng: Xiao Ji didn't know whether to be angry or laugh: "Are you stupid!"

text: 小雲話：「我知你一定會捉實條梯嘅！同埋琴日對唔住呀……其實你條頸巾好靚，不過因為……」
eng: Xiao Yun said, "I know you'll be sure to grab a ladder! I'm sorry for yesterday... Actually, your scarf is beautiful, but because..."

text: 未等佢講完，小吉突然問：「咦！你戴緊嗰隻……」
eng: Before he could finish, Xiao Ji suddenly asked, "Hey, you're wearing that..."

text: 小雲畀咗佢隻手錶小吉睇，小吉有啲感動：「估唔到你仲戴住我幾年前送畀你嘅手錶……」
eng: Xiao Yun gave him only watch Xiao Ji to see, and Xiao Ji was a little moved: "I can't imagine that you are still wearing the watch I gave you a few years ago..."

text: 「錶上面有嚿『雲』，更重要嘅係，入面有我同你嘅合照呀嘛……」
eng: "There's a 'cloud' on the watch, and more importantly, there's a photo of me and you..."

text: 小雲同小吉就係噉你一句我一句，和好返喇！
eng: Xiao Yun and Xiao Ji are like this, you say a word to me, and the reconciliation is back!

text: 海底世界
eng: Underwater World

text: 今日天氣好好，藍天白雲，好適合出海！
eng: The weather is very good today, the sky is blue and white, it is very suitable for going to the sea!

text: 我同教練由西貢搭船出發，準備去潛水！
eng: My instructor and I set off from Saigon to take a boat and prepare to go diving!

text: 我最鍾意睇關於海嘅書，覺得海底世界一定好靚，所以一直都想試下潛水。
eng: I like to read books about the sea the most, and I think the underwater world must be very beautiful, so I have always wanted to try diving.

text: 今次終於有機會喇，我好緊張！
eng: I finally had a chance this time, and I was nervous!

text: 聽講海入面啲魚好靚，所以我帶埋部防水相機，諗住影多啲靚相。
eng: I heard that the fish in the sea are beautiful, so I brought a waterproof camera and wanted to take more beautiful photos.

text: 教練好仔細噉幫我檢查蛙鞋、面罩、氧氣筒等裝備，確保全部冇問題之後，就可以準備落水喇！
eng: The instructor carefully helped me check the fins, mask, oxygen cylinder and other equipment to make sure that everything was okay, and then I was ready to fall into the water!

text: 佢話喺水入面大家都講唔到嘢，所以一定要跟住佢，唔好游咁遠。
eng: He said that no one can say anything in the water, so be sure to follow him and don't swim so far.

text: 教練數三聲之後，我哋就一齊跳落水。
eng: After the coach counts three times, we jump into the water together.

text: 落水冇幾耐，我哋就見到好多魚仔。
eng: Not long after falling into the water, we saw a lot of small fish.

text: 佢哋一條跟住一條噉游，全部都好可愛！
eng: They swim one after the other, all so cute!

text: 我哋越游越深，見到越嚟越多魚。
eng: We swam deeper and saw more and more fish.

text: 佢哋五顏六色，真係好靚！
eng: They are colorful and really beautiful!

text: 不過佢哋有太多種類，我都唔知佢哋叫咩名。
eng: But there are so many varieties of them, I don't know what their names are.

text: 呢度除咗魚多，仲有好多珊瑚。
eng: In addition to the fish, there are also a lot of corals.

text: 而且啲珊瑚就好似魚嘅屋企噉，好多魚仔都匿埋喺度。
eng: And these corals are like the home of fish, and many small fish hide here.

text: 我記得睇啲書話過，魚仔會揀同自己顏色一樣嘅珊瑚匿埋，呢啲就叫保護色。
eng: I remember reading these books that said that small fish would choose corals of the same color as themselves to hide, and these are called protective colors.

text: 不過，如果我哋慢慢睇真啲，其實都可以揾到佢哋。
eng: However, if we look at the real point slowly, we can actually find them.

text: 但係望還望，記得要同啲魚仔保持距離。
eng: But look back, remember to keep your distance from these little fish.

text: 咁多魚之中，我最鍾意嘅就係橙白色嘅小丑魚。
eng: Of all these fish, my favorite is the orange-white clownfish.

text: 以前我睇電視見到佢哋，已經覺得好靚！
eng: I used to watch TV and saw them, and I already thought they were beautiful!

text: 今次我好好彩，可以親眼見到幾條小丑魚，所以即刻幫佢哋影相。
eng: This time I was lucky enough to see a few clownfish with my own eyes, so I immediately took pictures of them.

text: 啱啱影完相，我就見到有條大魚食緊啲細魚！
eng: Just after taking the photo, I saw a big fish eating some small fish!

text: 再睇多一陣，先知道大魚唔係想食細魚，而係細魚幫緊大魚洗牙！
eng: After looking at it for a while, I realized that the big fish did not want to eat small fish, but the small fish was helping the big fish clean their teeth!

text: 原來魚同人一樣，都會互相幫助。
eng: It turns out that fish, like people, will help each other.

text: 我哋繼續游，見到更多嘅魚同珊瑚。
eng: We continued swimming and saw more fish and coral.

text: 突然，有隻八爪魚喺珊瑚中間彈出嚟！
eng: Suddenly, an octopus pops up in the middle of the coral!

text: 原來，佢係伏匿匿高手，成日匿埋嚇人一跳。
eng: It turns out that he is a master of concealment, always hiding and scary.

text: 時間差唔多，我哋開始游返上船。
eng: At about the same time, we started swimming back to the boat.

text: 期間，我哋又見到一隻海龜。
eng: During this time, we saw another turtle.

text: 佢喺度望嚟望去，唔知揾緊啲咩呢？
eng: He looked around here, not knowing what he was looking for?

text: 突然，一條好大嘅魔鬼魚好似飛機噉喺我頭上飛快游過。
eng: Suddenly, a big manta fish swam over my head like an airplane.

text: 我即刻影多張相，之後就跟住教練游返上水面。
eng: I immediately took more photos and then followed the instructor back to the upper water.

text: 原來海入面有好多好特別嘅魚，潛水真係好好玩啊！
eng: There are a lot of special fish in the sea, and diving is really fun!

text: 我好想快啲再潛水，去睇多啲唔同嘅海洋生物！
eng: I would love to dive again quickly to see more different marine life!

text: 數學？難我唔到啦！
eng: Math? Difficult for me!

text: 家姐好專心噉做緊功課。突然，門「碰」一聲打開！
eng: Sister is very attentive to her homework. Suddenly, the door "touched" and opened!

text: 「家姐，好悶呀！我唔做功課喇，數學都冇用嘅，我想出去玩呀！」
eng: "Sister, it's very stuffy! I don't do my homework, math is useless, I want to go out and play!"

text: 阿佑大發脾氣。
eng: Ayou loses his temper.

text: 「唔可以唔做功課㗎！而且數學其實好有用，到你大個就會明㗎喇。」
