eng: Fung finally said, "My mom is sick."

text: 「哦……噉冇辦法啦，你照顧好伯母……波幾時都有得打，但媽媽就淨係得一個……」
eng: "Oh... then there's no way around it, you take care of your auntie... You can play ball at any time, but there's only one mom..."

text: 跟住佢哋就收咗線。
eng: Then they ended the call.

text: 其實阿風比任何人都想去比賽……
eng: In fact, more than anyone Fung wants to go to the game...

text: 阿風望一望細妹，有少少苦笑噉講：「呢次到我哋幫手準備今晚嘅團年飯喇！」
eng: Fung looked at his little sister and said with a forced smile: "This time, we will help prepare tonight's Lunar New Year dinner!"

text: 阿風開雪櫃，見到媽媽已經一早準備好晒食材，心都定啲。
eng: Fung opened the fridge, and saw that his mom had already prepared all the ingredients earlier, and he felt calmer.

text: 但阿風見到一個個大大小小嘅煲就嚇咗一跳：咁多個煲，係咪各有唔同用法㗎？
eng: But when Fung saw all the big and small pots he was shocked: There are so many pots, do they all have different uses?

text: 佢望一望牀上嘅媽媽，細細聲同自己打氣：「唔理喇！由細到大睇媽媽整過咁多次，你一定做到嘅，阿風！」
eng: He glanced at his mom on the bed and whispered to himself, "Ignore it! Since I was a child I've seen mom do it so many times. You must be able to do it, Fung!"

text: 揀咗啲啱用嘅煲之後，依家要處理食材。
eng: After choosing the right pots, it's now time to process the ingredients.

text: 細妹寫低食材同份量，阿風就跟住放落煲……
eng: Little sister wrote down the ingredients and quantities, and Fung put them in the pot...

text: 「叮噹、叮噹！」媽媽聽到門鐘聲，就即刻起身去開門，門外面已經嚟咗好多親戚喇！
eng: "Ding-dong, Ding-dong!" When mom heard the doorbell, she immediately got up and went to open the door. Outside the door many relatives had already come!

text: 媽媽唯有坦白話：「唔好意思呀！我仲未……」
eng: Mom had no choice but to confess, "I'm sorry! I still haven't..."

text: 「好香呀！辛苦你準備咁多嘢食喇！」
eng: "It smells so good! Thank you for preparing so much food!"

text: 啲親戚聞得飯香嚟，都唔理得媽媽想講咩喇！
eng: The relatives can smell the food, but they don't care what mom wants to say!

text: 媽媽見到阿風同細妹煮嘅飯，即刻跑過去攬住佢哋，同親戚講：「辛苦我兩個仔女先啱，呢餐係佢哋整㗎！」
eng: When mom saw the rice cooked by Fung and his little sister, she immediately ran over and hugged them. She told her relatives, "Thanks to the hard work of my two children! This meal is made by them!"

text: 阿風有啲唔好意思，細細聲話：「唔辛苦，我哋大個仔大個女喇嘛！」
eng: Fung was a bit embarrassed, and whispered: "It wasn't hard work, we are all grown up now!"

text: 阿風突然覺得，幫到媽媽手嘅話，打少一場波，其實都冇咩嘢吖！
eng: Fung suddenly realized, if he can help his mother, then playing one less game, actually doesn't matter!

text: 我愛睇書！
eng: I love to read books!

text: 「阿欣，夠鐘沖涼喇！」
eng: "Yan, it's time to take a shower!"

text: 「阿欣，快啲食飯！」
eng: "Yan, eat quickly!"

text: 「阿欣，再唔返學就趕唔切喇！」
eng: "Yan, if you don't go to school, you won't be in time!"

text: 「阿欣，巴士到咗喇！」
eng: "Yan, the bus has arrived!"

text: 「阿欣，做晒功課未啊？」
eng: "Yan, have you done your homework yet?"

text: 阿欣成日都唔應媽媽，呢次都一樣。
eng: Yan always doesn't answer her mother, and this time it's the same.

text: 媽媽行出廳，淨係見到阿欣嘅功課放咗喺枱，佢自己就唔見人。
eng: When Mom walked out of the living room, she only saw Yan's homework on the table, but she didn't see anyone.

text: 「阿欣去咗邊度呢？」
eng: "Where did Yan go?"

text: 媽媽心入面問。
eng: Mom asked in her heart.

text: 不過，諗諗下，媽媽估到阿欣去咗邊喇……
eng: However, thinking about it, Mom guessed where Yan had gone...

text: 媽媽入去阿欣間房，果然見到佢又喺牀上睇書。
eng: Mom went into Yan's room and saw her reading on the bed again.

text: 阿欣之前成日都匿喺牀上睇書，所以呢次一定又係睇書睇到唔記得做功課啦！
eng: Yan used to always hide in bed and read books, so this time while reading she must have forgotten to do her homework!

text: 阿欣最鍾意睇書，每日都不斷睇書。
eng: Yan loves reading the most, every day she keeps reading.

text: 喺屋企、學校、公園都會不停睇書。
eng: At home, at school, in the park, non-stop reading books.

text: 每次睇書嘅時候，佢都會好專心，聽唔到媽媽叫佢。
eng: Every time she reads a book, she is so focused that she can't hear her mom calling her.

text: 阿欣睇完一本又一本，佢希望睇晒世界上所有嘅書！
eng: Yan has read one book after another, she hopes to read all the books in the world!

text: 之前，有同學問阿欣點解咁鍾意睇書？打機仲好啦！
eng: Before, a classmate asked Yan why she likes reading so much. Playing video games is even better!

text: 阿欣話因為睇書好開心！
eng: Yan said it's because reading books makes her happy!

text: 睇書可以睇到好多好靚嘅公仔，又可以學到好多字。
eng: Reading books lets you see many beautiful dolls, and learn many words.

text: 啲字有好多唔同意思，唔同字又會組成唔同句子，而句子組成嘅故事就係書！
eng: The words have many different meanings, different words make up different sentences, and the sentences make up the story that is the book!

text: 睇書可以睇到好多故事，好似去咗另一個世界噉！
eng: Reading books can make you read so many stories, it's like going to another world!

text: 不過有一日，阿欣終於發現一個睇書大問題——就係學校圖書館入面所有嘅書，都已經俾佢睇晒喇！
eng: But one day, Yan finally discovered a big problem with reading books - that was, all the books in the school library, they already had been read by her!

text: 佢好想再睇多啲書，佢係噉揾、係噉揾，想睇下仲有冇書係佢未睇嘅……
eng: She really wanted to read more books, she was searching and searching, trying to see if there were any books she hadn't read yet...

text: 揾嚟揾去，佢都唔見有新書。阿欣好唔開心，忍唔住喊咗出嚟。
eng: Looking around, she didn't see any new books. Yan was very unhappy and couldn't help crying.

text: 喊喊下，佢岳高頭，突然發現書櫃最上幾層仲有好多書！
eng: Crying, she raised her head and suddenly found that there were still many books on the top rows of the bookcase!

text: 啲書全部都放得好高，所以佢之前都冇為意到。
eng: The books were all placed so high that she hadn't noticed them before.

text: 嗰度啲書都係佢未睇過嘅，佢即刻開心返晒！
eng: The books there were all some she had not read yet, and immediately she was happy!

text: 但而家問題係佢唔夠高拎嗰度啲書。
eng: But now the problem was that she isn't tall enough to take the books there.

text: 阿欣諗：我要點先可以拎到上面啲書呢？
eng: Yan thought: What can I do to get the books above?

text: 喺呢個時候，阿欣見到阿明同阿文入咗圖書館。
eng: At this moment, Yan saw Ming and Man enter the library.

text: 佢諗起以前同媽媽玩騎膊馬，就即刻叫佢哋嚟幫手！
eng: She remembered that she used to play shoulder-riding with her mom, and immediately asked them to come and help!

text: 阿文抱起阿明，阿明抱起阿欣，一個抱一個噉，阿欣就嚟拎到上面啲書喇……
eng: Man picked up Ming, Ming picked up Yan, one by one, Yan was about to get the books above...

text: 「哎吔！」阿文好快就冇力抬佢哋，佢同阿明都跌咗落地！
eng: "Oh!" Man soon lost the strength to lift them, and both she and Ming fell to the ground!

text: 好彩阿欣及時捉住書櫃邊，冇跌到落去，但都仲係好驚險！
eng: Fortunately, Yan caught the edge of the bookcase in time and didn't fall down, but she was still very scared!

text: 「小心啊！」突然，好高好高嘅高老師出現，佢捉住阿欣，將佢放返落地。
eng: "Be careful!" Suddenly, very tall Teacher Miss Ko appeared, she grabbed Yan, and lowered her back to the ground.

text: 「你冇事吖嘛？你頭先做咩上到咁高啊？」高老師問阿欣。
eng: "Are you okay? Why did you get so high just now?" Miss Ko asked Yan.

text: 阿欣指住上面啲書，話好想拎嗰啲書睇。
eng: Yan pointed to the books above, and said she wanted to pick them up and read them.

text: 然後，高老師二話不説就又抱起阿欣，阿欣好開心噉拎咗好多書落嚟。
eng: Then, without saying a word, Miss Ko picked up Yan again, and Yan happily took down many books.

text: 之後，阿欣滿手係書噉問高老師點解可以生得咁高。
eng: After that, Yan with her hands full of books asked Miss Ko how she could grow so tall.

text: 高老師話佢以前都唔高，係後尾佢食多咗飯，飲多咗水，做多咗運動，先變到而家咁高咋！
eng: Miss Ko said that she was not tall before; it was only later that she ate more rice, drank more water, and exercised more, which made her get as tall as she is now!

text: 不過阿欣好似冇聽到高老師講嘢，因為佢又開始好專心噉睇書喇！
eng: However, Yan didn't seem to hear Miss Ko, because again she had begun to very intently read a book!

text: 你算吧啦！我同你已經再冇結果。
eng: You do the math! I have no results with you.

text: 咁多年嘅心心愛愛而家已經了結咗。
eng: All these years of beloved love are now over.

text: 如果！你唔係做到噉樣過晒火。
eng: If! You didn't go overboard like this.

text: 你今日或者已經會，叫我做老婆。
eng: You may already be able to call me a wife today.

text: 你要私人時間玩遊戲機我唔會阻住你。
eng: You want private time to play game consoles, I won't get in your way.

text: 你同朋友飲酒飲天光我喺屋企等你。
eng: You drink with your friends, drink daylight, I'm waiting for you at home.

text: 我嘅生日幾月幾號唔提你都記唔起。
eng: You can't remember the month and day of my birthday without mentioning it.

text: 你話嗰晚約咗人睇波我都冇話唔畀。
eng: You said that I had an appointment to watch the game that night, and I didn't say no.

text: 我收埋所有感覺做一個識講唔緊要嘅女仔。
eng: I hide all the feelings to be a girl who can say it's okay.

text: 跟住你有兩餐一宿我已經心甘命抵。
eng: I have two meals and one night with you, and I am already willing.

text: 我都唔知點解我會揀同你一齊。
eng: I don't know why I chose to stay with you.

text: 不過我真係有諗過會同你一生一世。
eng: But I really thought I'd be with you for the rest of my life.

text: 其實我會感覺你，已經薄情如斯。
eng: Actually, I will feel that you are already in thin love.

text: 其實我又感覺我自己，孤苦無依。
eng: Actually, I feel like myself, lonely.

text: 其實我希望唔記得，喊咗幾多次。
eng: Actually, I wish I forgot, how many times I cried.

text: 其實我繼續畀機會你，再試一試。
eng: Actually, I will continue to give you the opportunity to try again.

text: 我差唔多已經唔記得我跟咗你幾年。
eng: I've pretty much forgotten that I've been with you for a few years.

text: 跟你咁多年有幾多夜晚失咗幾多眠。
eng: How many nights you've lost sleep over the years.

text: 失眠想打畀你傾計換嚟幾多個唔方便。
eng: Insomnia wants to call you to talk about how many inconveniences in exchange.

text: 咁多個唔方便愛嚟回應全部滄海同桑田。
eng: So many inconvenient loves to respond to all the vicissitudes of the sea and Kuwata.

text: 上個月二十九日，下午四點三十分。
eng: 29th of the previous month, 4:30 p.m.

text: 有人話喺火車站見到你攬女你話你自己一個人。
eng: Some people say that when they see you holding your daughter at the train station, you say that you are alone.

text: 我同你一齊咁耐都仲未分到邊一句係真。
eng: I've been with you for so long and haven't found a single sentence true.

text: 每日差唔多嘅大話同埋每日揾我笨。
eng: Lies almost every day and stupid me every day.

text: 我希望你話嗰個女仔只係你公司女同事。
eng: I want you to say that the girl is just a female colleague in your company.

text: 希望你親口同我講你哋食飯都除二。
eng: I hope you tell me in person that you will eat in two.

text: 原來你可以由頭到尾都只係當冇呢件事。
eng: It turns out that you can just start to finish when there is no such thing.

text: 呢個人其實已經唔再值得我鍾意。
eng: This person is no longer worthy of my liking.

text: 我已經好攰同你再冇感覺一切到此為止。
eng: I'm tired and don't feel like it's all over here.

text: 以後你有你嘅生活，我乜嘢都唔知。
eng: Later you have your life, I don't know anything.

text: 唔好揾我唔好搞我機會唔再畀多次。
eng: Don't look for me, don't mess with me, don't give me a chance, no more times.

text: 今日我決定做嘢話一就一話二就二。
eng: Today I decided to do things, say one, say two.

text: 唔怕夜晚黑
eng: Not afraid of the night

text: 我怕夜晚黑。
eng: I'm afraid at night.

text: 當四圍變得又靜、又黑鼆鼆嘅時候，就可能會有怪物出現嚟對付我。
eng: When the surroundings become quiet and dark, there may be monsters that will appear against me.

text: 有媽咪喺旁邊，我先可以瞓得着。
eng: With my mother by my side, I can sleep.

text: 但係媽咪嚟緊夜晚要返醫院做嘢。
eng: But Mom will have to go back to the hospital at night.

text: 佢特登申請放一日假，同我去長洲玩。
eng: He deliberately applied for a day off to go to Cheung Chau with me.

text: 媽咪帶我去到一個有好多石頭嘅地方，我哋踩住幾嚿大石行落地底。
eng: My mother took me to a place where there were many rocks, and we stepped on a few large rocks and landed on the ground.

text: 嗰度有一個窿，裏面好黑，比夜晚更加黑。
eng: There was a hole there, and it was dark inside, even darker than at night.

text: 我拉住媽咪唔想行入去，佢話：
eng: I grabbed my mom and didn't want to go inside, and she said:

text: 「有陽光喺你後面，又有我行喺前面，唔使怕㗎。」
eng: "There is sunshine behind you, and I walk in front, don't be afraid."

text: 窿入面好靜，我聽到自己個心跳得好快，就捉實媽咪繼續向前行。
eng: The cave was quiet, and I heard my heart beat fast, so I grabbed my mother and kept walking.

text: 冇幾耐，前面變得好光。
eng: It didn't take long for the front to get very bright.

text: 媽咪話我哋已經嚟到窿嘅另一邊，爬上去就係出口。
eng: Mom said we had come to the other side of the hole and climbed up to the exit.

text: 佢又話，呢個窿叫做「張保仔洞」。
eng: He also said that this hole is called "Zhang Baozai Cave".

text: 夜晚準備上船嘅時候，媽咪叫我𩓥高頭望下。
eng: When I was about to get on the boat in the evening, my mother told me to look up.

text: 天空上面佈滿星星，我問：「點解平時冇咁多星星嘅？」
eng: The sky was covered with stars, and I asked, "Why aren't there so many stars?"

text: 媽咪話：「因為香港夜晚有太多燈着住，燈光掩蓋咗星星嘅微光，即係人哋講嘅光污染。
eng: Mom said: "Because there are too many lights living in Hong Kong at night, the lights cover up the shimmer of the stars, which is what others call light pollution.

text: 呢度係離島，冇呢個問題。」
eng: Here are outlying islands, there is no such problem. 」

text: 我第一次覺得夜晚黑係咁靚。
eng: For the first time, I thought it was so beautiful at night.

text: 之後，媽咪夜晚唔喺度，婆婆嚟睇住我。
eng: After that, my mother was away at night, and my mother-in-law came to watch me.

text: 我眼光光，婆婆問我做咩事唔肯瞓覺。
eng: I watched as my mother-in-law asked me what I did not sleep.

text: 我話我怕黑，冇媽咪陪住會瞓唔着。
eng: I said I was afraid of the dark and couldn't sleep without my mother.

text: 婆婆指住窗邊，話：「你數下附近有幾多盞開住嘅燈？」
eng: The mother-in-law pointed to the window, "Do you count how many lights are on nearby?"

text: 一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八⋯⋯我數唔曬，有好多盞燈着住呀！
eng: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight... I can't count, there are so many lamps living!

text: 「出面有幾多盞燈開住，就有幾多個人同你一樣未瞓覺。
eng: "As many lights are on outside, there are as many people who haven't slept like you."

text: 黑鼆鼆嗰陣，喺你身邊一定仲有光，即使可能好微弱⋯⋯」
eng: There must still be light around you, even if it may be faint..."

text: 「好似星星噉？」
eng: "Like the stars?"

text: 「好聰明呀。除咗星星，呢度仲有好多人陪住你，包括返緊工嘅媽咪。
eng: "How clever. In addition to the stars, there are many people here to accompany you, including moms at work.

text: 時間會過渡，黑鼆鼆之後，朝早點都會嚟，周圍又會光返晒。所以——」
eng: The time will pass, and after the black simmer, the morning will come, and the surrounding light will turn again. So--"

text: 所以，夜晚黑一啲都唔可怕！
eng: So, the night is not scary at all!

text: 心足
eng: Heart-footed

text: 夏天，最好梗係喺屋企開住冷氣睇電視啦！
eng: summer, of course, it is better to watch TV with the air conditioner on at home!

text: 依家好熱呀，阿孝除晒衫等自己涼啲。
eng: It's very hot now, Ah Xiao took off his clothes to cool himself.

text: 佢望出窗，有一班人喺出面搞咗幾個月都唔知搞緊咩，又搬沙，又搬水噉。
eng: He looked out the window, and there was a group of people who had been outside for months and did not know what they were doing, moving sand and moving like water.

text: 阿孝跑去問媽媽：「依家咁熱，出面啲工人咁辛苦喺度整緊咩呀？」
eng: Hyo ran to his mother and asked, "It's so hot now, what are the workers working so hard outside?"

text: 媽媽放低個炭燙斗，話：「今晚你就知！好喇，好去食嘢，啲嘢凍晒喇。」
eng: Mom put down a charcoal iron, "You'll know tonight! Okay, good to eat, these things are all cold."

text: 阿孝心諗：吓，依家三十幾度，屋企又冇冷氣，我驚啲嘢熱都嚟唔切啦！
eng: Xiao Xin thought: Scared, now it's more than thirty degrees, and there is no air conditioning at home, I'm afraid it's too late to get hot!

text: 阿孝食完嘢就一支箭噉跑咗出去，佢今日約咗阿怡一齊玩。
eng: Xiao ran out like an arrow after eating, and he asked Yi Yi to play with him today.

text: 佢同阿怡玩咗冇耐，阿怡就出晒汗喇。
eng: He didn't play with Yi for a long time, and Yi sweated.

text: 阿怡話：「阿孝，不如今日嚟我屋企玩啦！」
eng: Yi: "Ah Xiao, it's better to play at my house today!"

text: 阿孝話好。阿孝都係第一次去阿怡屋企，佢一入屋就坐低開電視。
eng: Filial piety said yes. Xiao also went to Yi's house for the first time, and as soon as he entered the door, he sat down and turned on the TV.

text: 阿孝睇到眼都唔眨，心諗：如果我屋企都有電視就好喇！
eng: Takashi didn't blink when he saw it, and thought: If only my house also had a TV!

text: 見天氣咁熱，阿怡開咗冷氣。
eng: Seeing that the weather was so hot, Yi turned on the air conditioner.

text: 謊言
eng: Lie

text: 夜晚，小成挨住媽媽一齊睇天上嘅星星。

eng: Mom asked Xiao Cheng: "So do you think Xiao Xin is right or wrong now?"

text: 「嗯……噉就啱多啲、又錯少少啦！
eng: "Hmm... That's just a little bit more and a little bit wrong!

text: 「你哋好叻喎，識得將個骷髏骨砌返好。」
eng: "You guys are smart, you know how to get the skulls back."

text: 老師神神秘秘噉笑咗一笑。
eng: The teacher smiled mysteriously.

text: 「對唔住啊，我哋唔係有心整跌佢㗎……」
eng: "I'm sorry, we didn't mean to take him down..."

text: 阿心講講下發現有啲唔對路——
eng: Something is wrong when I talk about it.

text: 「點解老師你知我哋整跌咗個骷髏骨嘅？」
eng: "Why do you know that I have a skull?"

text: 阿家企咗起身。
eng: Ah Jia stood up.

text: 你哋又估唔估到點解老師會知呢？
eng: And guess why the teacher would know?

text: 講故人
eng: Storyteller

text: 從前有一個好大、好靚嘅地方。呢度有好多人，個個人都好唔同。
eng: Once upon a time there was a big, beautiful place. There are a lot of people here, and everyone is very different.

text: 阿欣就係住喺呢度，佢最鍾意聽故仔，特別係同呢個地方有關嘅故仔。
eng: Ashin lives here, and he loves to listen to stories, especially those related to this place.

text: 不過，呢度嘅人都好忙。有人忙住返工揾錢，有人忙住温書，有人忙住吃喝玩樂。
eng: People here are busy, though. Some people are busy going to work to make money, some people are busy reading books, and some people are busy eating, drinking, and having fun.

text: 阿欣試過叫媽媽、爸爸、同學、老師講故仔畀佢聽。
eng: Ashin once asked his mother, father, classmates, and teachers to tell him stories.

text: 不過，佢哋全部都話唔得閒，仲叫返阿欣有時間不如去温書做功課。
eng: However, they all said that they were not available, and they called back Ah Xin to go to Wen Shu to do his homework when he had time.

text: 直到有一日，佢遇上一個姐姐。呢個姐姐好靚，笑得好甜，仲有一把靚聲。
eng: Until one day, he meets a sister. This sister is beautiful, has a sweet smile, and has a beautiful voice.

text: 阿欣問佢可唔可以講故仔畀佢聽，姐姐笑住話可以，仲問返阿欣想聽咩故仔。
eng: Ashin asks if he can tell him a story, and his sister laughs and says yes, and asks Ashin what story he wants to hear.

text: 阿欣就話咩故仔都想聽。
eng: Ashin wants to hear any story.

text: 跟住佢哋坐低，一個講故，一個聽故。
eng: Then they sit down, one telling a story, the other listening.

text: 講完幾個故仔之後，本身喺隔籬玩緊嘅小朋友見到阿欣好開心噉聽故仔，覺得好好奇，就走晒埋嚟一齊聽……
eng: After telling a few stories, the children who were playing next door saw Ah Xin listening to the stories happily and felt very curious, so they all ran over to listen to them ... ...

text: 姐姐講完一個又一個故仔，埋嚟聽佢講故仔嘅人越嚟越多。
eng: After my sister told one story after another, more and more people came to listen to him tell the story.

text: 原來佢講嘅故仔全部都同佢哋住緊嘅地方有關——雖然佢哋住咗喺度好耐，佢哋唔知嘅事都仲有好多——好彩有姐姐，佢哋先可以發現同重拾返呢啲大大小小嘅軼事。
eng: It turns out that all the stories he tells are related to the place where they live—although they have lived there for a long time, and there are still many things they don't know—and thanks to their sister, they can discover and rediscover these anecdotes, big and small.

text: 之後，阿欣同其他小朋友日日都嚟聽姐姐講故仔。
eng: After that, Ashin and other children came to listen to her sister's story every day.

text: 去到後來，佢哋唔止聽故，仲學埋點樣講故！
eng: Later, they not only listened, but also learned how to tell stories!

text: 大家講故嘅時候都會加唔同嘢，所以個個講嘅故仔都唔同。
eng: Everyone adds different things when telling stories, so everyone tells different stories.

text: 一傳十，十傳百，好快連啲大人都聽到佢哋嘅故仔。
eng: One pass ten, ten pass a hundred, and soon even a little adult hears their story.

text: 啲大人而家先知原來喺佢哋忙緊嘅時候，喺小朋友中間已經興起咗講故聽故嘅潮流！
eng: Some adults now realize that when they are busy, there is a trend of storytelling and listening to stories among children!

text: 冇幾耐，佢哋都好似啲小朋友噉，開始聽更多人嘅故仔，仲同其他人講自己嘅故仔……
eng: Before long, like some children, they began to listen to more people's stories and tell their own stories to others ... ...

text: 漸漸噉，呢個地方啲人放慢手上嘅工作，花多咗時間停低聽故講故。個個人都開心咗好多。
eng: Gradually, people in this place slow down their work and spend more time stopping to listen to stories and tell stories. Everyone was a lot happier.

text: 但係市長就唔係咁開心喇——因為佢覺得啲人做嘢慢咗！
eng: But the mayor was not so happy - because he felt that people were doing things slowly!

text: 佢即刻叫晒啲高官嚟開會。
eng: He immediately called some senior officials to a meeting.

text: 佢哋諗咗好耐，都諗唔明點解啲人做嘢會慢咗咁多。
eng: They thought about it for a long time and couldn't figure out why people were doing things so much slower.

text: 過咗好耐之後，佢哋終於諗通，原因係阿欣同姐姐搞到大家掛住聽故講故而冇心做嘢！
eng: After a long time, they finally figured it out, because Ashin and his sister made everyone miss listening to stories and tell stories and were not in the mood to work!

text: 佢哋叫咗阿欣同姐姐嚟問話。
eng: They called Ashin and her sister to come and ask questions.

text: 「你哋點解要講咁多故仔，搞到啲人掛住聽故仔唔做嘢？」市長問。
eng: "Why are you telling so many stories that people miss listening to them and not working?" the mayor asked.

text: 阿欣見到呢度啲人全部都好嬲噉望住佢，就好驚噉捉住姐姐隻手，細細聲話：
eng: Seeing that all the people here were staring at him angrily, Ashin grabbed his sister's hand in fear and whispered:

text: 「我哋只不過講返自己喺呢個地方嘅成長經歷……」
eng: "We just talk about our own upbringing in this place ... ...

text: 姐姐接住話：「大家都將自己嘅故事講出嚟，先會知道呢個地方發生過咩事，然後更加鍾意呢個地方。
eng: My sister continued: "Everyone tells their own stories to know what happened in this place, and then they like this place more."

text: 市長咁想知道大家點解咁鍾意講故仔，不如試下出街聽下大家嘅故仔？
eng: The mayor wants to know why everyone likes to tell stories so much, why don't you try to go to the street and listen to everyone's stories?

text: 話唔定你聽完，都會想講下自己嘅故仔，做個講故人呢？」
eng: Maybe after you listen, you will also want to tell your own story and be a storyteller?"

text: 一個月後，市長又叫阿欣同姐姐嚟。
eng: A month later, the mayor called Ah Xin and his sister again.

text: 不過呢次唔係問話，而係要佢哋聽市長講故仔呀！
eng: But this time it was not a question, but a story for them to listen to the mayor!

text: 動物全書機
eng: Animal Book Machine

text: 「哥哥你睇下我畫咗啲咩？」阿思拎咗一幅畫出嚟。
eng: "Brother, do you want to see my painting?" Ah-Si took out a painting.

text: 「好叻喎，呢隻咪係老虎？我都有啲唔記得咗佢咩樣喇！話晒都絕咗種一百年……」
eng: "That's great. Is this a tiger? I also forgot what they look like! After all, it's been extinct for a hundred years..."

text: 「好彩啲人喺二三零零年發明咗一部『動物全書機』，將動物嘅相入落部機，就可以睇返動物嘅紀錄片。」
eng: "Fortunately, in 2300 someone invented an 'animal book machine'; by inserting photos of animals into the machine, you can watch documentaries of animals."

text: 喺部機開緊嘅時候，哥哥幫幅畫影咗張相。
eng: While the machine was running, Brother took a picture of the painting.

text: 佢一將張相入落部機，隻老虎即刻出咗嚟。
eng: As soon as he put the picture into the machine, the tiger came out immediately.

text: 哥哥搖下頭：「唉，以前啲人好鍾意買賣虎皮，所以佢哋至會絕種，仲有好多動物都係噉……」
eng: Brother shook his head: "Sigh, in the past people liked to trade tiger skins, so they went extinct, and there are still a lot of animals like this..."

text: 呢個時候阿思見到佢兩個朋友——阿貓同阿寶行過，佢就叫佢哋過嚟一齊玩。
eng: At this time, Ah-Si saw her two friends, Ah-Cat and Ah-Bo, walking by, and she asked them to come and play together.

text: 佢哋都想睇下史前動物，諗都唔諗就過咗嚟。
eng: They also wanted to see prehistoric animals, and without thinking twice they came over.

text: 「呢條係『一角鯨』，佢住嘅地方好凍㗎，好似二百年前就冇晒喇……」
eng: "This is a 'narwhal', he lives in very cold places, it seems like it disappeared two hundred years ago..."

text: 阿寶又換張相，繼續講：「呢隻係猩猩，唔好睇佢好似好傻噉，其實佢好醒㗎！依家全世界得返一隻咋。」
eng: Ah-Bo changed the picture again, and continued, "This is a chimpanzee, don't look at him like he's stupid, he's actually very smart! Now in the whole world there's only one left."

text: 「佢同馬騮仔好似樣呀。」阿思笑住講。
eng: "He looks a lot like Little Monkey," Ah-Si said with a smile.

text: 「到我喇！」「我嚟先㗎，到我至啱！」「我最細個，應該係我先！」佢哋個個都想入相落部機度。
eng: "My turn!" "I'll come first, it's my turn!" "I'm the youngest, it should be me first!" They all wanted to put photos into the machine.

text: 喺佢哋仲爭緊嘅時候，哥哥靜雞雞入咗張相落去。
eng: While they were still arguing, Older Brother quietly inserted a picture.

text: 有隻動物出咗嚟，個個都唔知佢係咩——又似馬，又似鹿噉。
eng: An animal came out and everyone didn't know what it was -- it looked like a horse and it looked like a deer.

text: 「呢次到我喇！」阿寶未講完就入咗張相落去。
eng: "It's my turn this time!" Before Ah-Bo had finished speaking, he inserted a photo.

text: 「又係你——」一隻藍色腳嘅雀仔出咗嚟。
eng: "It's you again--" A blue-footed bird came out.

text: 「呢隻我識喎，老師噚日有講過，係『藍腳鰹鳥』。佢哋追女仔嗰陣係會跳舞㗎！」阿思笑住話。
eng: "I know this one, the teacher said it yesterday, it's a 'blue-footed booby'. They dance when they chase girls!" Ah-Si said with a smile.

text: 突然，畫面又轉咗隻新動物。
eng: Suddenly, the screen switches to a new animal.

text: 阿貓話：「我知呢隻叫『奇異鳥』，佢好懶㗎，日日瞓廿個鐘。不過依家再見唔到佢哋喇，冇晒喇！」
eng: Ah-Cat said, "I know this one is called 'kiwi.' He's lazy, every day it sleeps 20 hours. But now we can't see them anymore, they're gone!"

text: 「就嚟天黑喇，我哋睇埋最後一隻好返屋企喇——」哥哥同佢哋講。
eng: "It's getting dark, let's look at a last one then go home--" Older Brother said to them.

text: 「呢次又輪到我喇！」阿寶指住自己。
eng: "It's my turn again this time!" Ah-Bo pointed to himself.

text: 新動物「𠽌」一聲就出咗嚟——
eng: The new animal came out with a [slurp] sound -

text: 世界各地每分每秒都有動物瀕臨絕種，唔想啲咁可愛嘅動物消失，你哋會做啲咩嚟保護佢哋呢？
eng: All over the world every minute and every second there are animals close to extinction; if you don't want such cute animals to disappear, what will you do to protect them?

text: 一齊嚟幫阿才手
eng: Let's help Ah Cai hand

text: 阿才係一個地盤工人。
eng: Ah Cai is a site worker.

text: 呢三十年嚟，阿才喺香港起過好多好出名嘅高樓大廈，有中銀大廈、國際金融中心、環球貿易廣場同埋維港文化匯等等。
eng: In the past 30 years, Ah Cai has built many famous high-rise buildings in Hong Kong, including the Bank of China Tower, the International Finance Centre, the International Commerce Centre and the Victoria Harbour Cultural Exchange.

text: 平時做嘢嗰陣，阿才需要喺竹棚上面擒高擒低——
eng: When doing things usually, Ah Cai needs to climb up and down on the bamboo shed -

text: 佢唔怕高，喺竹棚上面四圍走都冇問題，因為佢細細個都係噉樣喺樹上面玩。
eng: He is not afraid of heights, and it is no problem to walk around on the bamboo shed, because he used to play on the tree like this when he was a child.

text: 阿才好記得大樹帶畀佢嘅安全感。
eng: Ah Cai remembers the sense of security that the tree gives him.

text: 佢細細個住喺上水嗰陣，屋企門口前面有樖好高好大嘅荔枝樹，阿才同住隔籬屋嘅朋友會靜靜噉喺樖樹下面，一齊望住個天傾偈，或者合埋眼好舒服噉瞓晏覺。
eng: When he lived in Sheung Shui when he was a child, there was a tall lychee tree in front of his house, and Ah Cai's friends who lived next door would quietly under a tree, staring at the sky and chatting together, maybe closing their eyes and taking a nap comfortably.

text: 佢哋有時會挨住樖樹坐低，聽下身邊啲雀仔同昆蟲嘅叫聲；
eng: They sometimes sit next to a tree and listen to the calls of birds and insects around them;

text: 樹上嘅荔枝熟咗，阿才就會同朋友爬上去摘甜甜酸酸嘅果實嚟食。
eng: When the lychees on the tree are ripe, Ah Cai and his friends will climb up to pick sweet and sour fruits to eat.

text: 喺大樹下生活，日子過得好快。
eng: Living under a big tree, the days go by quickly.

text: 過咗冇幾年，阿才舉高隻手就摘到荔枝，唔使再爬樹。
eng: After a few years, Ah Cai was able to pick lychees with his raised hand and no longer have to climb trees.

text: 阿才大個之後，搬咗去巿區生活，屋企四圍再冇啲可以畀佢遮陰休息嘅樹。
eng: When Ah Cai grew up, he moved to the city and there were no trees around his house that could give him shade and rest.

text: 唔使返工嘅時候，阿才會一個人去野外地方，揾返以前嗰種放鬆嘅感覺。
eng: When he doesn't have to go to work, Ah will go to the wild place alone and find the relaxed feeling he used to have.

text: 佢會去濕地公園睇雀仔，或者上山睇唔同種類嘅昆蟲。
eng: He would go to the wetland park to see the birds and maybe go up the mountain to see different species of insects.

text: 阿才又喺大埔租咗一塊田，用嚟種菜種花，有收成嗰陣就會分啲畀朋友。
eng: Ah Tsai rented another plot of land in Tai Po to grow vegetables and flowers, and when the harvest was completed, he would give it to his friends.

text: 阿才起過好多棟建築物，不過佢最想起嘅係樹林——可以畀香港人抖氣嘅一大片樹林。
eng: Ah Cai has built many buildings, but what he thinks of most is the woods, a large forest that can make Hong Kong people shake.

text: 阿才想要一個色彩繽紛嘅樹林，有綠色葉嘅樹、黃色葉嘅樹、橙色葉嘅樹，同埋紅色葉嘅樹。
eng: Ah Cai wants a colorful wood, trees with green leaves, trees with yellow leaves, trees with orange leaves, and trees with red leaves.

text: 樹林可以吸引好多種類嘅雀仔同昆蟲嚟生活，唔同嘅人都會過嚟休息。
eng: The woods can attract many species of birds and insects to live, and different people will come to rest.

text: 阿才已經揾好咗一個地方種樹，嚟緊佢需要一啲鍾意大自然嘅朋友嚟幫手。
eng: Ah Cai has already found a place to plant trees, and then he needs a little friend who likes nature to help.

text: 你哋想唔想一齊去野外玩下呀？
eng: Do you want to go out into the wild together?

text: 咖啡、奶茶同鴛鴦
eng: Coffee, milk tea and mandarin duck

text: 今日係星期日，爹哋、媽咪帶咗我去茶餐廳一齊食晏。
eng: Today is Sunday, and my father and mother took me to the tea restaurant for lunch.

text: 爹哋舉起手，同侍應哥哥講：「唔該，我要一個常餐、一杯凍鴛鴦。」
eng: Dad raised his hand and said to the waiter brother, "Thank you, I want a regular meal and a cup of cold mandarin duck."

text: 我問爹哋：「『凍鴛鴦』係咩嚟？」
eng: I asked my father, "What is 'cold mandarin duck'?"

text: 爹哋話：「鴛鴦即係咖啡加奶茶，係一般茶餐廳常見嘅嘢飲。」
eng: Dad: "Mandarin duck is coffee and milk tea, which is a common drink in general tea restaurants."

text: 我問：「噉點解唔係叫做咖茶，或者奶啡，而係鴛鴦呢？」
eng: I asked, "Why isn't it called coffee tea, or milk coffee, but mandarin ducks?"

text: 爹哋話：「鴛鴦本身係一種生活喺水上嘅鳥類。
eng: Dad said, "Mandarin ducks themselves are birds that live on water."

text: 佢哋有個特別嘅地方，就係男仔同女仔個樣完全唔同，男嘅五顏六色，女嘅灰灰暗暗，睇落去冇挐冇掕，但係佢哋又會成日一雙一對噉生活。
eng: They have a special place, that is, boys and girls look completely different, men are colorful, women are gray and dark, there is no shackle or no shackles, but they will often live like a pair in pairs.

text: 就好似咖啡同奶茶，佢哋顏色、味道完全唔同，但係加埋一齊就會變成好好味嘅嘢飲。
eng: Just like coffee and milk tea, they are completely different in color and taste, but together they become delicious drinks.

text: 有啲人仲話，鴛鴦係香港人發明嘅嘢飲嚟！」
eng: Some people also say that the Mandarin duck was invented by Hong Kong people!"

text: 我話：「我明白啦。噉我同坐隔籬位嘅同學都係鴛鴦！」
eng: I said, "I see." My classmate and I are all Mandarin ducks sitting next door!"

text: 我見到媽咪喺度偷笑。佢細細聲噉問我：「你隔籬個同學係點樣㗎？」
eng: I saw my mother snickering here. When he was a child, he asked me, "How are the classmates next to you?"

text: 我話：「佢係今個學期轉校過嚟嘅插班生。
eng: I said, "He's a transfer student this semester."

text: 佢頭髮攣攣哋，五官同我哋好唔同，膚色都同我哋大部份同學唔一樣，好似外國人。」
eng: His hair is curved, his facial features are very different from ours, and his skin color is different from most of our classmates, like foreigners.

text: 「雖然我哋兩個嘅外表好唔同，但我哋每日喺學校都會一齊好開心噉上堂、一齊放小息、一齊玩。
eng: "Although we are very different in appearance, we have fun together, take breaks and play together every day at school."

text: 好多老師見到我哋兩個，都話我哋係『孖公仔』。
eng: Many teachers saw us both and said we were "twins".

text: 但係我而家可以話返畀老師知，我哋唔係孖公仔，我哋仲係一杯鴛鴦！」
eng: But I can now say back to the teacher that we are not twins, we are still a cup of Mandarin ducks!"

text: 媽咪聽到我噉講，就嗌侍應哥哥過嚟，點咗一杯熱「兒童鴛鴦」。
eng: When my mother heard me say this, she called the waiter's brother to come over, how to drink a cup of hot "children's mandarin ducks".

text: 媽咪又話：「鴛鴦本身有咖啡因，唔啱小朋友飲。但係兒童鴛鴦就冇嘅。
eng: Mom said: "Mandarin ducks themselves have caffeine and are not drunk by children." But child asymmetry does not.

text: 下次約埋你隔籬位同學一齊嚟茶餐廳食嘢，等我請佢飲杯兒童鴛鴦啦！」
eng: Next time I meet with a classmate next to you to eat at the tea restaurant, let me invite him to have a cup of children's mandarin ducks!"

text: 生果有核
eng: Fruit has a kernel

text: 阿加同小玲好鍾意揾多多玩。
eng: Aga and Xiaoling like to find more to play.

text: 多多係一隻看管森林嘅牧羊犬，佢每次見到阿加同小玲，都會帶佢哋四圍睇下。
eng: Duoduo is a shepherd dog who watches over the forest, and every time he sees Aja and Xiaoling, he shows them around.

text: 住打鼓嶺嘅東東，一啲都唔怕凍——佢有個暖身秘訣，就係大聲唱歌。
eng: Dongdong, who lives in Da Guling, is not afraid of the cold at all - he has a warm-up secret, which is to sing loudly.

text: 星期一朝早，氣温得返五度，東東掖高衫袖，大聲噉唱：「讓——我——閃——耀——」
eng: On Monday morning, when the temperature was only five degrees, Dongdong raised his sleeves and sang loudly: "Jean--I--Shine--Shine--"

text: 當時嘅佢冇為意到有人喺自己後面。
eng: At that time, he did not realize that someone was behind him.

text: 第二日放學，班長跟住東東行。
eng: After school the next day, the class leader continued east.

text: 東東唔耐煩，就問：「你做咩成隻吊靴鬼噉跟住我尾啫？」
eng: Dongdong was impatient, so he asked, "Why did you follow me with a hanging boot to the end?"

text: 點知班長話：「你咪就係琴日喺草地唱歌嗰個人？首歌唔應該噉唱㗎。」
eng: Who knew that the class leader said, "Aren't you the same person who sang in the grass yesterday? 」

text: 東東以為班長想笑佢，嚇到面都青埋。
eng: Dongdong thought that the squad leader wanted to laugh at him, and his face turned blue with fright.

text: 班長好認真噉話：「你唱得咁好聽，一個人喺草地唱真係好大嘥，應該要企出嚟唱俾多啲人聽！」
eng: The squad leader said very seriously: "You sing so well, it's really wasteful to sing alone in the grass, you should stand up and sing to many people!"

text: 「吓？」東東𢲷晒頭：「我未試過喺人哋面前唱完一首歌㗎噃——」
eng: Dongdong shaved his head: "I haven't tried to finish a song in front of others--"

text: 班長話：「你琴日咪試咗囉。唔信嘅話，聽我唱返你首飲歌：『讓——我——閃——耀——』⋯⋯」
eng: The squad leader said, "Don't try it yesterday." If you don't believe me, listen to me sing back your drinking song: "Let's - I - shine - shine --"

text: 東東截住班長，話：「咪再笑我啦！
eng: Dongdong intercepted the squad leader, "Stop laughing at me!"

text: 其實我之前都試過一個人企喺台上唱歌㗎，但係⋯⋯
eng: Actually, I used to stand on stage alone and sing before, but...

text: 「我望住台上嗰盞好掁眼嘅大光燈，就開始係噉標汗，仲緊張到成身震晒，入唔到個拍子……」
eng: "I stared at the big light on the stage, and I started sweating like this, and I was so nervous that my whole body shook, and I couldn't enter a beat..."

text: 班長拍晒心口話：「噉我畀暗號你，提你幾時入，咪解決到囉！」
eng: The squad leader patted his chest and said, "Then I will give you a secret message and mention when you will enter, and it will be solved!"

text: 東東諗咗一陣，覺得要畀個機會自己改變，就報名參加校慶表演。
eng: Dongdong thought for a while, felt that he had to give a chance to change himself, so he signed up for the school celebration performance.

text: 星期六、日，東東特登留喺屋企，對住空氣、幻想前面有好多觀眾噉唱歌。
eng: On Saturdays and Sundays, Dongdong deliberately stayed at home, singing like this to the air and fantasizing that there were many spectators in front of him.

text: 佢唱得越嚟越大聲，仲借咗班長屋企隻羊嚟練習上台表演。
eng: He sang louder and louder, and borrowed the sheep from the class leader's house to practice performing on stage.

text: 唱完之後，東東同隻羊講：「如果你想繼續聽我唱歌，就講啲嘢啦。」
eng: After singing, Dongdong and the sheep said, "If you want to continue listening to me sing, just say it."

text: 隻羊一路含住棵草，一路話：「咩。」
eng: The sheep held a grass in his mouth and said, "What. 」

text: 校慶到喇，啲老師、家長都擁晒去台前。
eng: When the school celebration arrived, these teachers and parents rushed to the front of the stage.

text: 東東冇諗過會有咁多人嚟，佢企喺台上面，個心開始緊張。
eng: Dongdong didn't expect so many people to come, he stood on the stage, and his heart began to get nervous.

text: 嗰盞熟口熟面嘅大光燈突然着咗，仲射住東東企緊嗰個位。
eng: The familiar headlight suddenly pierced, still shining at the position of Dongdong Station.

text: 「咩。」東東聽到上面有聲，就𩓥高頭——原來班長擒咗上樹！
eng: "What. When Dongdong heard the sound above, he raised his head - it turned out that the squad leader grabbed the tree!

text: 佢口噏噏噉打暗號：天空海闊任鳥飛，小小天地跳飛機⋯⋯一二三，到你！
eng: He said nonsense: the sky and the sea are wide for birds to fly, and the small world jumps the plane ... One, two, three, to you!

text: 東東即刻深吸一口氣，然後大聲唱：
eng: Dongdong immediately took a deep breath, and then sang loudly:

text: 讓我閃耀，讓我閃耀，讓我發出光輝將個世界照——
eng: Let me shine, let me shine, let me shine a world -

text: 能令整個世上添歡笑，如同亮光世上照——
eng: It can add laughter to the whole world, like a light in the world.

text: 東東唱歌嘅時候，成個人閃閃發亮，閃亮到所有觀眾都入晒迷，耳邊淨係聽到佢把聲，眼中淨係望到佢一個……
eng: When Dongdong sang, the whole person shone brightly, so bright that all the audience was fascinated, only his voice was heard in his ears, and only one ...

text: 大藝術家
eng: Great artist

text: 阿女又上台攞獎喇。佢打扮得好靚，喺台上講緊得獎感受。

text: 佢啲朋友仔坐喺我隔籬幫佢影相，有個仲話陣間要同佢一齊打卡。
eng: His friend sat next to me to take pictures of him, and one of them said that he wanted to check in with him.

text: 有邊個估到依家企喺台上嗰個靚女，細個嗰陣係一嚿忟薑嚟嘅呢？
eng: Who would have guessed that the beautiful woman standing on the stage now came from a piece of ginger when she was a child?

text: 我仲記得佢九歲生日嗰日，我專登請假、踩單車去接佢放學，點知佢一望到我就鼓埋泡腮，忟忟憎憎噉。
eng: I still remember his ninth birthday, I specially asked for leave and rode a bicycle to pick him up from school, how did I know that he puffed out his cheeks when he saw me, and he hated it.

text: 嗰陣我指住天空同阿女講：
eng: At that time, I pointed to the sky and said to my daughter:

text: 「你睇下，太陽伯伯知道你今日生日，特登幫天空變到咁藍嚟氹你開心！睇下個天空幾靚？」
eng: "Look, Uncle Sun knows your birthday today, and deliberately helped the sky turn so blue to make you happy!

text: 阿女聽完，竟然對住天空大鬧：
eng: After listening to it, my daughter actually made a fuss about the sky:

text: 真係唔知阿女發生咩事咁嬲爆爆！
eng: I don't know what happened to my daughter so angry!

text: 好彩我嗰日早有準備，拎咗佢最鍾意食嘅茶點出嚟。
eng: Fortunately, I was prepared that day and took out his favorite refreshment.

text: 我問：「係咪有人蝦我個女呀？」
eng: I asked, "Is someone bullying my daughter?"

text: 阿女見到有嘢食，心情至好返少少。
eng: When my daughter sees that she is eating, her mood is a little better.

text: 佢皺起眉頭話：「冇人蝦我。」
eng: He frowned and said, "No one bullied me."

text: 「係今日默書，我明明温得好熟，但係之後睇返本書，先知自己倒轉咗啲字嚟寫。
eng: "It is today's silent book, I am obviously very familiar with it, but when I read this book later, the prophet himself wrote some words in reverse."

text: 點解我寫極都寫唔啱隻字？」
eng: Why can't I write a word correctly?"

text: 我話：「噉返學唔係淨係得默書嘅——不如我哋試下其他嘢？」
eng: I said, "Isn't it just silent to go to school this way - why don't I try something else?"

text: 阿女話：「你唔怕我成績差，讀書唔成咩？
eng: Daughter: "Aren't you afraid that I will have poor grades and will not be able to study?"

text: 爺爺話過，想我讀好啲書，第時可以揸筆揾食。」
eng: Grandpa said, if I want to read a good book, I can smoke a pen to find food in the future.

text: 我聽完得啖笑，就隨手拎起啲顏色筆，話：
eng: I laughed after hearing this, so I picked up the color pen casually and said:

text: 「傻妹，係揸都揸呢啲筆先啦。」
eng: "Little girl, it's a pen." "

text: 阿女一開始就揀咗佢最鍾意嘅紅色。
eng: The daughter chose his favorite red at the beginning.

text: 佢話：「今日數學堂，老師教咗我哋咩叫立方體……」
eng: He said: "In today's math class, the teacher taught us what a cube is ... "

text: 佢一路講，一路用畫筆畫咗個好四正嘅長方體出嚟。
eng: He said as he drew a good cuboid with a brush.

text: 佢冇用間尺，徒手就畫到好直嘅線。
eng: He drew straight lines with his bare hands without a ruler.

text: 佢話要跟彩虹顏色嘅次序嚟畫，所以第二支就揀咗橙色。
eng: He said that he wanted to draw in the order of the rainbow colors, so the second one chose orange.

text: 「老師問我哋，有冇圓形球體嘅例子。
eng: "The teacher asked us if there were any examples of round spheres.

text: 我即刻舉手，話平時食開嘅橙就係啦！」
eng: I immediately raised my hand and kept saying that the orange I usually eat is it!"

text: 佢又畫一個圓形，喺上面點咗好多密密麻麻嘅細點，好似一個真嘅橙！
eng: He drew another circle, and dotted a lot of densely packed dots on it, like a real orange!

text: 畫到最後，阿女揀咗紫色。
eng: At the end of the painting, the daughter chose purple.

text: 佢話：「老師叫我哋用啲想像力，將頭先講過嘅例子串做一個故事，用嚟交堂課。
eng: She said, "The teacher told us to use some imagination and string together the examples we just said into a story for the lesson.

text: 我畫咗一個長方形嘅窗，有隻雀仔喺出面飛入嚟，偷偷哋擔走個橙。」
eng: I drew a rectangular window with a bird flying in outside, sneaking an orange away.

text: 我見阿女揸住畫筆，有返晒心機，就鼓勵佢繼續諗多啲故事，再畫出嚟。
eng: I saw that my daughter grabbed the brush and had already turned her mind, so I encouraged him to continue to think about more stories and draw again.

text: 阿女話：「我仲諗到好多同動物有關嘅故事，例如青蛙、老鼠、貓狗嗰啲。
eng: The daughter said: "I also think of many stories about animals, such as frogs, mice, cats and dogs.

text: 我諗住等到放假就一次過畫晒佢哋出嚟……
eng: I'm going to wait until the holidays to draw them all at once...

text: 係喎，爸爸，我可唔可以要一份生日禮物呀？」
eng: yes, Dad, can I ask for a birthday present?"

text: 我梗係話好。阿女開心到彈起：「好嘢！我想要一本畫簿啊！」
eng: Of course I said yes. My daughter bounced up happily: "Okay, I want a picture book!"

text: 我冇諗到，當日我隨手拎起畫筆遞畀阿女，會換嚟依家屋企一個又一個獎座！
eng: I didn't expect that I picked up the brush that day and handed it to my daughter, which would be exchanged for one trophy after another at home!

text: 其實個個小朋友都係一粒原石，只要肯用心發掘、打磨，佢哋每一個都可以發光發亮！
eng: In fact, every child is a rough stone, as long as they are willing to dig and polish carefully, each of them can shine!

text: 點解?
eng: Why?

text: 對於足球，佢有好多個「點解」：
eng: For football, he has many "whys":

text: 點解踢波唔准用手？點解足球個波咁大嘅？
eng: Why are you not allowed to use your hands to kick a ball? Why is the chest of a football so big?

text: 而佢最想知嘅係，點解嚟親足球場踢波嘅都係男仔嘅？
eng: And what he wants to know most is, why are all the boys who come to the football stadium to play?

text: 佢發現自己仍然好想揾到答案，不過唔知可以向咩人發問。
eng: He found that he still wanted to find answers, but didn't know who to ask.

text: 喺呢個時候，佢問自己：「點解我有咁多點解嘅呢？」
eng: At this point, he asked himself, "Why do I have so much?"

text: 可惜，佢發現自己都唔識答。
eng: Unfortunately, he found that he would not answer either.

text: 後來，佢揾到個將啲「點解」表達出嚟嘅方法－就係畫畫！
eng: Later, he found a way to express the "why" - that is, to draw!

text: 佢唔知點解足球場只有男仔踢波，又唔知點解冇女仔肯同佢一齊踢波，所以佢就畫咗一幅男仔女仔一齊踢波嘅畫；
eng: He didn't know why only boys played in the football field, and he didn't know why no girls wanted to play with him, so he drew a picture of boys and girls playing together;

text: 佢唔知點解朋友仔淨係温書，唔同佢一齊玩，所以就畫咗幅佢同朋友一齊玩嘅畫。
eng: He didn't know why his friend just read books and didn't play with him, so he drew a picture of him playing with his friends.

text: 漸漸地，佢畫咗好多畫。
eng: Gradually, he painted a lot.

text: 之後，有唔少人睇到佢嘅畫。有人問佢：「點解男仔女仔一齊踢波嘅？」
eng: After that, many people saw his paintings. He was asked, "Why do boys and girls play together?"

text: 「點解咁多幅畫都係你喺度玩嘅？」「點解你畫咁多畫？」
eng: "Why are you playing with so many paintings here?" "Why do you paint so many paintings?"

text: 雖然佢唔識答晒每一條問題，但係對佢哋問嘅「點解」都非常好奇。
eng: Although he didn't know how to answer every question, he was very curious about the "why" they asked.

text: 佢明白到，世界上仲有好多未知嘅事物，佢依然有好多「點解」。
eng: He realized that there are still many unknowns in the world, and he still has many "whys".

text: 同之前唔同嘅係，佢唔再因為怕人哋唔識答，而唔敢問「點解」。
eng: Unlike before, he no longer dares to ask "why" for fear that others will not answer.

text: 於是，佢又開始向好多人問「點解」，例如成日上堂問老師。
eng: So he started asking many people "why\

text: 差唔多每堂課，佢都會舉手發問，學校入面每個老師都俾佢問過「點解」。

text: 如果老師解答到佢嘅問題，佢就會好開心，覺得自己又學到一樣嘢。
eng: If the teacher answers his question, he will be happy and feel that he has learned something again.

text: 唔知係咪受到佢影響，佢啲朋友仔都開始會喺堂上踴躍問「點解」，佢好開心。
eng: I don't know if it was influenced by him, but his friends also began to ask "why" in the hall, and he was so happy.

eng: I wonder what they'll give?

text: 不過，我知道媽咪會送啲咩畀我做生日禮物－就係我一直都好想要嘅寵物！
eng: But I knew my mom would give me something for my birthday—the pet I've always wanted!

text: 我好鍾意動物，唔知媽咪會送咩寵物畀我呢？
eng: I love animals, I don't know what pets my mother will give me?

text: 如果係大笨象就好囉，噉我就可以騎象返學。
eng: If it's an elephant, then I can ride an elephant to school.

text: 聽同學講，住屯門嘅人會騎牛返學返工，我都想試下。
eng: I heard from my classmates that people in Tuen Mun can ride bulls to work, and I want to give it a try.

text: 不過，我唔係住屯門，又冇養牛，所以未有機會。
eng: However, I am not from Tuen Mun and I do not raise cattle, so I have no chance.

text: 但如果媽咪送隻大笨象畀我，我就可以騎象返學喇！
eng: But if my mother sends me an elephant, I can ride an elephant to school!

text: 同學仔見到，一定好羡慕我！
eng: When my classmates see it, they must be very envious of me!

text: 但係，大笨象好似行得好慢嗰喎，會唔會令我遲到呢？
eng: However, elephants seem to walk very slowly, so will it make me late?

text: 遲到嘅話，我會畀老師罰……
eng: If I am late, I will be punished by the teacher ... ...

text: 噉不如騎犀牛啦！
eng: Why not ride a rhinoceros!

text: 犀牛跑得快，肯定唔怕會遲到。
eng: Rhinos run fast and are certainly not afraid of being late.

text: 但係佢嘅身體好似坦克車咁硬，跑起上嚟可能會撞爛好多嘢，會連累媽咪要賠錢……
eng: But his body is as hard as a tank car, and he may crash a lot of things when running, and will affect his mother to lose money ...

text: 我諗，犀牛都係唔好。
eng: I thought, rhinos still don't want to.

text: 況且我屋企又唔夠大，大笨象同犀牛都唔可以住喺度。
eng: Besides, my house wasn't big enough for elephants and rhinos to live in.

text: 睇嚟媽咪唔會送大笨象或者犀牛畀我㗎喇……
eng: It seems that my mother will not send me elephants or rhinos ...

text: 噉會唔會係鱷魚呢？
eng: Could this be a crocodile?

text: 但係，佢好似要住喺多水嘅地方，噉會唔會霸住沖涼房呢？
eng: However, it seems that he is going to live in a place with a lot of water, so will he occupy the bathing room?

text: 噉樣嘅話，我同屋企人都沖唔到涼，好唔乾淨喎。
eng: In this case, my family and I can't take a shower, it's very unclean.

text: 我諗，鱷魚都係唔好喇。
eng: I thought, crocodiles still don't want it.

text: 要睇鱷魚嘅話，都係去濕地公園揾貝貝啦！
eng: If you want to see crocodiles, go to the wetland park to find Babe!

text: 唔通係箭豬?
eng: Could it be porcupines?

text: 佢又細隻，又唔使霸住浴室。
eng: He's small and doesn't have to take up the bathroom.

text: 不過，佢身上啲箭好似仙人掌噉，會拮到人好痛。
eng: However, a little arrow on his body is like a cactus, and it will hurt a lot.

text: 萬一我唔小心掂到佢，可能會畀佢拮傷，好危險。
eng: In case I accidentally touch him, it may cause him to be punctured, which is dangerous.

text: 我諗，箭豬都係唔適合做寵物。
eng: I think porcupines are still not suitable as pets.

text: 點都好，希望媽咪唔好送臭鼬鼠畀我啦——因為佢哋真係好臭啊！
eng: Anyway, I hope my mother doesn't send me skunks – because they really stink!

text: 不過，媽咪都好怕臭味，所以佢應該唔會送臭鼬鼠嘅！
eng: However, Mom is also afraid of stink, so he probably won't send skunks!

text: 仲有我最驚嘅獅子！
eng: And the lion I fear the most!

text: 雖然佢哋有個好型嘅花名－「萬獸之王」，不過佢哋好兇猛，我唔敢行近佢哋。
eng: Although they have a good nickname - "King of All Beasts\

text: 而且，獅子係肉食性動物，萬一我唔記得餵飽佢哋，後果好難想像......
eng: Moreover, lions are carnivores, in case I don't remember feeding them, the consequences are hard to imagine ...

text: 題外話：雖然我唔敢接近獅子，不過就好鍾意行獅子山。
eng: Off-topic: Although I dare not approach lions, I like to walk Lion Rock.

text: 噉唔通係蛇?我記得媽咪話過，隻寵物會成日抱住我——
eng: Is this a snake? I remember my mother saying that this pet would always hold me.

text: 蛇就係會成日圍住啲嘢，好似抱住佢哋噉。
eng: Snakes just surround these things all day as if holding them.

text: 但係，我怕條蛇會圍得太大力，圍到我抖唔到氣……
eng: However, I am afraid that this snake will surround me so hard that I can't breathe ...

text: 數嚟數去，好似咩動物都唔啱我。
eng: Count and count, like any animal is not right for me.

text: 究竟，媽咪會送咩動物畀我呢？
eng: What animal will my mother give me?

text: 「汪－汪－汪－」咦！呢啲吠聲，唔通我嘅寵物係……
eng: "Woof-woof-woof-woof-" These barks, is my pet ...

text: 係狗仔！係一隻好可愛嘅黑白斑點狗啊！
eng: It's a puppy! It's a cute black and white Dalmatian dog!

text: 雖然佢唔可以送我返學，但佢可以陪我一齊玩！
eng: Although he can't send me to school, he can play with me!

text: 而且佢細細隻，可以住喺我屋企。
eng: And he is so delicate that he can live in my house.

text: 仲有，佢唔會傷害我！
eng: Also, he won't hurt me!

text: 媽咪話佢叫皮皮，叫我以後要多啲同皮皮一齊玩。
eng: Mom said his name was Pippi and told me to play with Pippi more in the future.

text: 就係噉，我日日同皮皮一齊走嚟走去，每一日都好開心。我愛皮皮！
eng: That's it, I walk around with Pippi every day, and I'm so happy every day. I love Pippi!

text: 流浪狗
eng: Stray dogs

text: 「走開啦！你好污糟呀！」
eng: "Go away, you're dirty!"

text: 「阿仔快啲走，唔好俾呢隻污糟嘢行埋嚟！」
eng: "Son go quickly, don't let this dirty beast come over!"

text: 「走呀！走呀！我叫你走呀！唔好行埋嚟呀！」
eng: "Go, go! I told you to go! Don't come here!"

text: 全部人都好嫌棄噉避開一隻好污糟嘅狗仔。
eng: Everyone hated avoiding a very dirty puppy like this.

text: 「點解佢哋好似唔鍾意我噉嘅？我只係想揾佢哋幫下手……」
eng: "Why don't they seem to like me like this? I just want to ask them for help...

text: 狗仔好攰噉瞓喺垃圾堆上面，一路望住外面，好似等緊人噉，個肚仔一路喺度叫。
eng: The puppy sleeps tiredly on top of the garbage heap, staring out, like waiting for someone, and the belly son barks here.

text: 我係一隻狗仔，我好鍾意同阿檸一齊玩㗎！
eng: I'm a puppy and I love playing with Ah Ming!

text: 記得一個月前我仲係半歲，嗰陣我住喺一個好細嘅籠入面，籠外人來人往，仲成日聽到啲人講咩「歡迎光臨」。
eng: I remember a month ago when I was half a year old, I lived in a very small cage, and there were many people outside the cage, and I often heard people say "welcome".

text: 最後唔知做咗啲咩，阿檸就帶咗我返佢屋企喇！
eng: In the end, I didn't know what to do, and Ah Ming took me back to his house!

text: 阿檸好鍾意同我玩㗎，佢仲成日都叫我畀隻手佢，但「手」即係咩呀？
eng: Ah Ming likes to play with me, and he tells me to give him a hand all day, but what is "hand"?

text: 佢係咪諗住請我食嘢？好呀，好呀！我就坐喺度等佢畀嘢我食。
eng: Okay, okay! I'm going to sit here and wait for him to give me something to eat.

text: 有時佢又會將啲樹枝拋到好遠，到底想點呢？
eng: Sometimes he throws these branches far away, what does he think?

text: 唔明呀！跟住佢好似有啲嬲嬲哋噉。
eng: I don't understand! I seem to be a little angry and angry with him.

text: 兩個星期之後，阿檸已經好少理我喇。
eng: Two weeks later, Ah Ming had paid little attention to me.

text: 有時我揾佢玩，佢會好大聲鬧我，我肚餓都唔敢出聲，我好驚佢鬧我。
eng: Sometimes when I play with him, he will scold me loudly, I am too hungry to speak, I am so afraid that he will scold me.

text: 突然有一日，阿檸爸爸開車帶我哋出去玩。
eng: Suddenly, one day, Ah Ming's father drove us out to play.

text: 坐車嗰陣，好似聽到阿檸爸爸話：「買咗兩個星期就唔要嗱？」
eng: When I was in the car, I seemed to hear Father Ning: "Don't snort after buying it for two weeks?"

text: 我唔知佢講緊咩，但我好開心呀！好耐冇出過去喇！
eng: I don't know what he's talking about, but I'm so happy!

text: 嗰日落好大雨，阿檸拖住我去到一個垃圾堆，叫我喺度等佢。我乖乖哋喺度等……
eng: It was raining so hard that day that Ah Ming led me to a garbage dump and told me to wait for him here. I'm waiting here ... ...

text: 我由朝等到晚，都仲未見到阿檸返嚟。我又凍又肚餓。
eng: I waited until late and didn't see Ah Ming come back. I was cold and hungry.

text: 一日一日噉過去，喺呢段日子，我肚餓就揾下垃圾堆有冇嘢食，覺得眼瞓就喺垃圾堆度瞓。
eng: Day by day, during this time, when I was hungry, I looked for something to eat in the garbage heap, and when I felt sleepy, I slept in the garbage heap.

text: 到咗今日，我終於驚覺阿檸可能係蕩失路，就想揾人幫手揾佢——佢依家一個人一定好驚㗎喇！
eng: Today, I finally realized that Ah Ming might have lost his way, so I wanted to find someone to help find him - he must be so scared by himself now!

text: 但我辛苦咗大半日，都係無功而還。
eng: But I worked hard for most of the day, but I also paid it back to no avail.

text: 正當我諗住返埋去垃圾堆度唞下，一陣腳步聲由遠至近，最後停咗喺我後面。
eng: Just as I was about to go back to the garbage heap to rest, after a while footsteps came from far to near, and finally stopped behind me.

text: 我以為係阿檸，即刻轉頭一望——原來唔係……係另一個男仔。
eng: I thought it was Ah Ming, and immediately looked back - it turned out to be not... It's another boy.

text: 佢望咗我好耐，跟住就走埋嚟。
eng: He looked at me for a long time, and then he came over.

text: 嗰時我好驚佢會好似其他人噉打我，所以我即刻縮返去後面。
eng: I was so afraid that he would hit me like everyone else, so I immediately retracted back.

text: 佢停咗喺度，打開書包，拎咗一包腸仔出嚟，好似想叫我一齊食。
eng: He stopped here, opened his bag, and came out with a packet of sausages, as if he wanted to ask me to eat it together.

text: 我真係太肚餓喇，忍唔住行上前食咗一啖，見佢冇鬧我，我就繼續食埋佢。
eng: I was really hungry and couldn't help but step forward to take a bite, and seeing that he didn't scold me, I continued to eat him.

text: 佢笑住同我講：「仲要唔要呀？」
eng: He smiled and said to me, "Do you want it?"

text: 我點點頭，佢又拎多一條俾我食。
eng: I nodded, and he brought me another one to eat.

text: 跟住佢每日都會畀嘢我食，又同我一齊玩……
eng: Follow him every day will be eaten by me, and play with me ...

text: 大家好！我係阿明，係個小學生。
eng: I'm Amin, and I'm a schoolboy.

text: 我喺上星期開始見到街上有隻流浪狗仔周圍走，佢肚餓就喺垃圾堆揾嘢食，有時唔小心掂到啲路人仲會俾人鬧、俾人打。
eng: Last week, I started to see a stray puppy walking around on the street, hungry in the garbage heap looking for something to eat, and sometimes accidentally touching some passers-by and being scolded and beaten.

text: 見到佢噉，我唔忍心，於是用晒啲零用錢嚟買腸仔俾佢食，得閒又嚟同佢玩。
eng: I couldn't bear to see him, so I ran out of pocket money to buy sausages for him to eat, and played with him when I had time.

text: 就係噉過咗一星期。我決定帶隻狗仔返屋企。
eng: That's how a week passed. I decided to bring a puppy home.

text: 雖然我好驚媽媽會鬧我，但見到佢咁慘，我唔忍心。
eng: Although I was so afraid that my mother would scold me, I couldn't bear to see him so miserable.

text: 媽媽一見到隻狗，就大聲問我：「隻狗仔喺邊度拎返嚟㗎？」
eng: As soon as my mother saw a dog, she asked me loudly, "Where can I get the puppy back?"

text: 我細細聲答：「我啱啱喺街執嘅……我……我哋可唔可以養佢呀？」
eng: I whispered to the answer: I just picked up on the street ... ... I...... Can we raise him?"

text: 媽媽見到隻狗仔成身都係傷，好嚴肅噉同我講：「你想養佢？你做到以下兩樣嘢，我就畀你養。」
eng: My mother saw that the puppy was covered in injuries all over and said to me very seriously: Do you want to raise him? 」

text: 「第一，你要日日同佢玩，同佢沖涼，餵佢食嘢……」
eng: "First, you have to play with him every day, bathe with him, feed him..."

text: 我點點頭……唔經唔覺，我已經養咗呢隻流浪狗（佢依家叫「阿旺」）三年喇，我哋一直都玩得好開心。
eng: I nodded... Before I knew it, I had been raising this stray dog (his name is now "Awang") for three years, and I had fun all the time.

text: 我到依家都仲好記得媽媽講嘅第二個要求：
eng: I still remember my mother's second request:

text: 「你可能有好多朋友，但你要記住，佢只係得你呢一個朋友，所以你唔准抌低佢，唔理佢。」
eng: "You may have a lot of friends, but remember that he's just your friend, so you don't bend him or leave him alone."

text: 當時我好大力噉點咗一下頭。
eng: I nodded vigorously at the time.

text: 想養寵物諗一諗養佢一世唔准抌
eng: If you want to have a pet, think about raising him for a lifetime, you are not allowed to nag

text: 演唱會
eng: Concert

text: 「阿哥⋯⋯幫下手啦⋯⋯」「唔得呀，你揾其他人幫手啦。」
eng: "Brother ... help ..." "No, you can find someone else to help." 」

text: 阿妹入咗嚟我間房，求我幫手買演唱會飛。「阿哥啊～唔係噉都托我手㬹下話？」
eng: A-mei came into my room and begged me to help buy concert tickets. "Brother~ Isn't it all entrusted to me?"

text: 今次佢哋去到紅館連開四日演唱會喎，聽朝賣飛一定全香港爭崩頭。
eng: This time, they went to the Red Hall to hold a four-day concert, and tomorrow morning the ticket sales will definitely collapse in Hong Kong.

text: 「都話人哋係叫『東京四十六』，係當今日本最紅嘅女子組合——」
eng: "It is said that people are called 'Tokyo Forty-Six', and they are the most popular girl group in Japan today--"

text: 今年動漫節竟然請到佢哋十個成員嚟表演，我等咗佢哋嚟香港好耐喇！
eng: This year's Comic-Con actually invited ten of their members to perform, and I have been waiting for them to come to Hong Kong for a long time!

text: 「我二十歲，班女仔仲細過我！」
eng: "I'm twenty years old, and the girl in the class is younger than me!"

text: 「至少我冇日日對住你讚佢哋有幾靚女囉！」
eng: "At least I don't praise them every day for how beautiful they are!"

text: 「但係你日日沖涼都唱佢哋啲歌呢，勁難聽囉！」
eng: "But you sing his songs every day in the bath, it's hard to hear!"

text: 「哎吖，畀返啲面嚟好喎！話晒都係你大佬……」
eng: After all, it's still your brother ...

text: 「吓？我先唔得閒睬你囉！」
eng: "Scared, I don't have time to pay attention to you!"

text: 「唔得閒就出返去喇，唔好企喺度——」
eng: "Go back when you don't have time, don't stand here--"

text: 「一係你借錢畀我買黃牛嘞！」
eng: "Either you lend me money to buy a scalper!"

text: 「你黐咗線呀？黃牛閒閒哋都炒到五千蚊啊！你幫人補習賺好多錢咩？」
eng: "Do you stick the thread? Scalper is fried to 5,000 yuan! Do you make a lot of money helping people tutor?"

text: 「所以咪問你借囉！」
eng: "So don't ask you borrowed it!"

text: 「你都傻嘅！我做侍應咋，你估我人工好高呀？」
eng: I'm just a waiter, you guess my salary is high?"

text: 「噉你又買部咁貴嘅電腦？」阿妹一手指住我部新電腦。
eng: "So you bought such an expensive computer?" my sister pointed to a new computer.

text: 「喂，我用自己錢買有咩問題？」
eng: "Hey, what's wrong with me buying it with my own money?"

text: 「冇～但係你用咗我個學生優惠呢——」
eng: "No~ but you used my student discount-"

text: 阿妹隨即又一手指住我牆上嘅東京四十六海報：
eng: My sister then pointed to the Tokyo Forty-Six poster on my wall:

text: 「仲有呢啲海報，唔知之前係邊個問我點樣喺日本網站訂貨嘅呢嗬？」
eng: "And the poster, I don't know who asked me how to order this strand on the Japanese website before?"

text: 阿妹讀書叻過我好多，仲要喺大學主修緊日文，我每次有日文睇唔明都係揾佢求救……
eng: My sister is much smarter than me, and I have to major in Japanese in college, and every time I can't understand Japanese, I still ask him for help ...

text: 「我記得，係我吖嘛，得未？」
eng: "I remember, I was the one who said, okay?"

text: 「得～噉即係聽朝你幫唔幫手啫～？」阿妹嘅語氣真係話變就變。
eng: "Gotta ~that's to listen to you to help or not~?" The younger sister's tone really changed.

text: 明明我內心仲想駁佢，有我幫手都唔一定搶到飛——
eng: Obviously, I still want to refute him in my heart, and I may not be able to grab the ticket with my help--

text: 「好嘢～幾時都話我大佬係全世界最好嘅大佬！」
eng: "Okay~ I always say that my brother is the best brother in the world!"

text: 但係對住呢個牙尖嘴利嘅阿妹，我真係冇晒乎……
eng: But to this sharp-toothed A-mei, I really don't care ...

text: 塞車
eng: Traffic jam

text: 我住屯門，不過唔近西鐵站，而係喺碼頭嗰邊。
eng: I live in Tuen Mun, but not near the West Rail Station, but on the pier.

text: 屯門對我嚟講算係幾方便，設施齊全，有幾個大型商場畀人行街買嘢之餘，仲有唔少公園同遊樂場，啱晒一家大細。
eng: Tuen Mun is quite convenient for me, with complete facilities, several large shopping malls for people to shop for things, as well as many parks and playgrounds, which is completely suitable for the family.

text: 呢度仲有好多單車徑，我有時都會沿住屯門河踩單車。
eng: There are a lot of cycling trails and I sometimes cycle along the Tuen Mun River.

text: 行遠少少又有海灘同郊野公園，可以約埋一班朋友去游水行山。
eng: A little further away there are beaches and country parks, you can meet a group of friends to go swimming and climbing.

text: 前排仲有套戲係用屯門做背景，拍到我屋企周圍嘅風景好靚——其實我都幾鍾意屯門。
eng: There is also a set of scenes in the front row that use Tuen Mun as the background, and the scenery around my house is beautiful - in fact, I also like Tuen Mun.

text: 話說我啱啱開始喺一間廣告公司做平面設計師，平時主要喺辦公室畫圖，不過間唔中都要陪老細見客，聽對方意見。
eng: I started working as a graphic designer in an advertising agency, and I usually mainly draw in the office, but from time to time I also accompany my boss to meet customers and listen to each other's opinions.
