text: 「媽媽，我仲未想瞓住呀！」
eng: "Mom, I don't want to fall asleep yet!"

text: 我見到個鐘長針指住六，短針指住九同十中間，即係九點半啫，我仲想繼續玩飛行棋呀——
eng: I saw the long hand pointing to six, the short needle pointing to the middle of nine and ten, it was half past nine, and I wanted to continue playing flying chess --

text: 「聽日去迪士尼樂園再玩過啦！」
eng: "I'll go to Disneyland tomorrow!"

text: 話口未完，媽媽就入房拉咗我去廁所刷牙……
eng: The words were not finished, and my mother went into the room and pulled me to the toilet to brush my teeth ...

text: 明明放學嗰陣個鐘仲係指住四，點解眨下眼就九點半？
eng: Obviously the clock at school time is still pointing to four, why blink the eyes are nine thirty?

text: 時間，你去咗邊呀？
eng: Time, where did you go?

text: 不過聽日去迪士尼，一定好好玩，我要快啲瞓覺！
eng: But going to Disney tomorrow, it must be fun, I have to hurry up!

text: 「樂樂，好起身啦！媽媽蒸咗你最鍾意食嘅燒賣做早餐呀！」
eng: "Lele, it's getting better! Mom steamed your favorite roast for breakfast!"

text: 我捽眼望望個鐘，又係九點半，兩支指針睇落好似冇郁過，但其實個天已經光晒。
eng: I raised my eyes to look back and forth at the clock, it was half past nine, and the 2,000 yuan hands didn't seem to have moved, but in fact, the sky was completely light.

text: 我望住個鐘，望到頭都側埋，覺得時間呢樣嘢真係好神奇。
eng: I stared at a clock, looked sideways, and thought that time was really magical.

text: 媽媽好似知我諗咩噉望住我笑：
eng: Mom looked at me and smiled as if she knew what I was thinking:

text: 「傻豬，支時針係行完一圈走返原點，但係喺現實世界已經過咗十二個鐘——所以而家已經係朝早九點半喇！
eng: "Silly pig, the hour hand is walking back to square one after a lap, but twelve hours have passed in the real world - so it's already half past nine in the morning!

text: 仲唔快啲起身刷牙食早餐！」
eng: Don't hurry up and brush your teeth for breakfast!"

text: 時針走一圈就過咗十二個鐘？
eng: Time and where did you go?

text: 時間，你去咗邊呀？
eng: Time, where did you go?

text: 搭車去迪士尼嗰陣，我打醒十二分精神望住我隻錶——我要𥄫實支時針唔畀佢走得咁快，等我可以玩耐啲！
eng: When I took the car to Disney, I woke up and looked at my watch -- I'm going to press the hour hand to keep him from running so fast so I can play longer!

text: 我望呀望，望呀望——好慢呀，佢好似冇郁過噉！
eng: I look and look, look and look - very slowly, he seems to have not moved!

text: 望下望下，我覺得眼皮越嚟越重，最後一片漆黑……
eng: Looking down, I feel that my eyelids are getting heavier and heavier, and the last piece of darkness ...

text: 到我再擘大眼嗰陣，支時針已經唔經唔覺行咗一大步！
eng: By the time I open my eyes again, the hour hand has taken a big step unconsciously!

text: 時間，你去咗邊呀？
eng: Time, where have you been?

text: 「仲望手錶？我哋到咗喇，快啲去玩啦！」媽媽又催我喇。
eng: "Still looking at the watch? We're here, let's go play!" my mother urged me again.

text: 反而媽媽比我勤力，佢望錶：「咦，乜兩點嗱，我哋食啲嘢先繼續玩啦。」
eng: On the contrary, my mother worked harder than me, and he looked at the watch: "Hey, what two o'clock, I ate and continued to play."

text: 吓？！！！乜時間過得咁快嘅！
eng: What time flies so fast?!!!

text: 「媽媽，點解時間會過得咁快，佢去咗邊？佢係咪俾鐘錶啲指針妖怪食咗？」
eng: "Mom, why does time pass so quickly, where did he go, was he eaten by the clock and clock pointer monster?"

text: 我忍唔住一輪嘴將我嘅煩惱同猜測話晒畀媽媽聽……
eng: I couldn't help but pout my worries and guesses to my mother after all... ...

text: 媽媽聽完先係呆一呆，然後笑到見牙唔見眼：「嘩哈哈哈，傻豬，你諗咗去邊呀？
eng: Mom was stunned after listening to it, and then smiled so much that she couldn't see her teeth: "Whahahaha, silly pig, where do you want to go?"

text: 鐘錶係我哋用嚟睇時間嘅工具嚟，有啲唔準嘅，會行得快咗或慢咗。
eng: Clocks are the tools we use to see the time, a little inaccurate, will go faster or slower.

text: 但真正嘅時間係一分一秒噉流逝，唔會話走得快咗或慢咗。
eng: But the real time is a minute and a second, not to say running faster or slower.

text: 時間過得快或慢，係人嘅主觀感覺嚟。」
eng: Time flies quickly or slowly, it is a subjective feeling of the person.

text: 媽媽停咗停，稍為收起笑容再開口：
eng: Mom stopped, put away her smile a little and spoke again:

text: 「不過有樣嘢你講得啱，就係時間係一去不復返嘅，挽留唔到亦揾唔返——
eng: "But there is one thing you say, that is, time is gone forever, and we can't keep it and can't get it back-

text: 我哋唯一可以做嘅，就係好好珍惜當下，唔好虛度光陰。」
eng: The only thing we can do is to cherish the present moment and don't waste time."

text: 我似明非明噉望住媽媽，佢就話：
eng: I stared at my mother like Ming Feiming, and he said:

text: 「就好似我哋今日嚟到迪士尼，你會希望點樣度過喺呢度嘅時間？」
eng: "Just like we come to Disney today, how would you like to spend your time here?"

text: 「我希望同媽媽開開心心噉過！」
eng: "I want to have fun with my mother!"

text: 我諗都唔諗就脫口而出。
eng: I blurted out without thinking.

text: 媽媽語帶安慰噉話：「係哩？但係你掛住睇手錶嘅話，就會錯過晒啲美好時光㗎喇！」
eng: Mom said comfortingly, "Yes, but if you miss looking at your watch, you'll miss some good times!"

text: 「噉……冇咩事我都係返去繼續玩喇！」
eng: "... I'll go back and play if there's nothing to do!"

text: 我一支箭噉跑走——天底下竟然有咁正嘅時光，我當然要好好把握啦，嘻嘻！
eng: I ran away with an arrow - there is such a great time under the sky, of course I have to take advantage of it, hee-hee!

text: 豬仔藏寶圖
eng: Piggy's Treasure Map

text: 自從豬仔輸咗上一屆大胃王比賽之後，佢就變到冇晒心機，做咩都好似冇乜力噉，連佢嘅好朋友羊仔約佢去食嘢都唔想去。
eng: Ever since Piglet lost the last Big Stomach King competition, he has become completely unhappy, acting as if he has no power, not even wanting to go if his good friend Lamb asked him to eat.

text: 有一日，豬媽叫豬仔去地下室攞箱唔要嘅廢紙出嚟等佢拎去回收。
eng: One day, Mother Pig asked Piglet to go to the basement to get boxes of unwanted waste paper and wait for him to take it for recycling.

text: 箱入面咩都有——除咗以前啲信、帳單同宣傳單張，竟然仲收埋咗張藏寶圖！
eng: The box has everything - except for the previous letters, bills and promotional leaflets, there are even treasure maps!

text: 藏寶圖上面仲有一行好細嘅字，應該係藏寶圖作者個名嚟，但係因為放得太耐，啲字已經甩晒色睇唔清楚。
eng: There is also a very small line of words on the treasure map, which should be the name of the author of the treasure map, but because it has been left for too long, these words have faded and cannot be seen clearly.

text: 豬仔好好奇：到底呢張藏寶圖係邊個畫嘅呢？收埋嘅又係啲咩寶藏嚟呢？
eng: Piglet was curious: Who drew this treasure map, and what treasure was hidden?

text: 雖然豬仔心裏面充滿疑惑，不過佢都照樣收返佢入紙箱，交畀豬媽拎去回收。
eng: Although the piglet was full of doubts, he still took it back, put it into a cardboard box, and gave it to the pig mother to recycle.

text: 到咗夜晚，豬仔個心開始囉囉攣。
eng: At night, Piglet's heart began to stir.

text: 張藏寶圖一直喺佢腦海盤旋，搞到佢失眠不特只，第二日返學仲差啲遲到。
eng: Zhang's treasure map kept circling in his mind, causing him to lose sleep, and he was almost late for school the next day.

text: 羊仔見到豬仔嘅黑眼圈，就問佢：「豬仔你對眼搞咩？」
eng: The lamb saw the dark circles under the pig's eyes and asked him, "What are you doing to the eyes, little pig?"

text: 豬仔就答：「係噉嘅，我喺屋企地下室揾到張藏寶圖，唔知邊個留低嘅——」
eng: Piglet replied, "Well, I found a treasure map in the basement of my house, and I don't know who left it--."

text: 「藏寶圖？所以你漏夜去尋寶呀？」羊仔聽完即刻興奮到雙眼發光。
eng: "So you went on a treasure hunt overnight?" Lamb's eyes lit up with excitement as soon as he heard this.

text: 「冇呀……」豬仔就冇羊仔咁好興致，淨係回咗句：「算啦，我咩都唔想做……」
eng: "No..." The little pig was not as interested as the lamb, but just replied: "Forget it, I don't want to do anything..."

text: 羊仔鼓勵佢：「你唔好咁冇心機啦，最多我陪你去喇！」
eng: The lamb encouraged him: "Don't be so unhappy, at most I'll accompany you!"

text: 豬仔聽到之後，覺得好感動，好感激羊仔喺佢比賽失意嘅時候鼓勵佢振作，於是決定去尋寶——
eng: When Piggy heard this, he felt very touched and grateful to Lamb for encouraging him to cheer up when he was disappointed in the game, so he decided to go treasure hunting.

text: 之但係張藏寶圖已經俾佢抌返入紙箱，豬媽可能今日就會拎去回收，於是佢哋兩個一放學就跑返屋企想拎返，可惜左揾右揾都揾唔返個紙箱！
eng: But Zhang Treasure Map has been picked back into the cardboard box by him, and the pig mother may take it for recycling today, so the two of them ran home as soon as school to get it back, but unfortunately they couldn't find a cardboard box left and right!

text: 羊仔拍一拍豬仔膊頭安慰佢：「唔好咁容易就放棄啦，我哋都仲未見到個箱，證明仲有機會！」
eng: The lamb patted the piglet on the shoulder to comfort him: "Don't give up so easily, we haven't seen a box yet, prove that there is still a chance!"

text: 豬仔諗諗下，覺得好似有啲道理，都好欣賞羊仔嗰種樂觀態度，於是重新提起精神，同羊仔繼續翻箱倒籠噉揾……
eng: Little Pig thought about it, felt that it seemed to make some sense, and appreciated the optimistic attitude of the lamb, so he regained his spirit and continued to rummage through the boxes and cages with the lamb...

text: 喺佢哋鍥而不捨嘅努力下，佢哋終於揾到個箱，張藏寶圖仲喺入面！佢哋終於可以出發尋寶喇！
eng: With their perseverance, they finally found a chest, and the treasure map was still inside! They can finally set off on a treasure hunt!

text: 豬仔同羊仔順住藏寶圖嘅指示，穿過幾條街，去到一個公園。
eng: The piglet and lamb follow the treasure map's instructions and cross a few streets to a park.

text: 呢個公園係豬爸爸成日帶豬仔嚟玩嘅地方。
eng: This park is where Papa Pig always brings the piglets to play.

text: 佢哋根據藏寶顯示嘅位置，喺公園草地度不停噉掘，結果真係俾佢哋揾到一個寶盒！
eng: They kept digging in the park meadows based on the location of the treasure cache, and it turned out that they really found a treasure box!

text: 佢哋即刻開心到攬埋一舊，然後小心翼翼噉打開個盒——然後豬仔呆咗。
eng: They immediately embraced a piece with joy, then carefully opened the box - and then the piglet stayed.

text: 羊仔見到豬仔嘅反應，好心急噉問：「裏面放咗啲咩呀？」
eng: Seeing the piglet's reaction, the lamb asked anxiously, "What's in it?"

text: 豬仔慢慢喺寶盒入面拎咗一對手套同一張相出嚟。
eng: Piggy slowly took a pair of gloves in the treasure box and came out with the same photo.

text: 相中人係豬爸爸，睇返張相嘅日期，係豬爸爸第一次參加搶包山比賽影嘅。
eng: The person in the photo is Father Pig, and looking at the date of this photo, it was taken by Father Pig for the first time in the Bag Grabbing Mountain Competition.

text: 豬仔記得豬爸爸同佢講過，佢輸咗嗰場比賽，但係點解相入面嘅佢笑得咁開心嘅？
eng: Piggy remembers Papa Pig telling him that he lost the game, but why is he smiling so happily in the photo?

text: 豬仔反轉張相，背面寫住「跌低係為咗學習點樣企返起身。」
eng: A photo of the piglet inverted, with the words "Fall to learn how to get back up."

text: 豬仔呢個時候先醒起，豬爸爸雖然輸咗嗰次比賽，但係佢冇被打沉，之後仲不停練習同參賽，而家已經係豬村出晒名嘅「包山王」！
eng: Little Pig only remembered at this time that although Pig Papa lost that competition, he was not sunk, and then he kept practicing and competing, and now he is Pig Village's famous "King of Baoshan"!

text: 豬仔拎張相畀羊仔睇，話：「原來張藏寶圖係爸爸㗎！
eng: The piglet showed the lamb a photo, "It turns out that the treasure map is Daddy!"

text: 相信嗰次嘅失敗經歷對爸爸嚟講係好珍貴嘅回憶，所以佢先珍而重之噉收埋呢張相……」
eng: I believe that the failure experience is a precious memory for my father, so he treasured and hid this photo..."

text: 豬仔喺呢一刻終於明白，原來失敗並唔可怕，最重要係學識接受失敗，從中學習；
eng: At this moment, the piglet finally understood that failure is not terrible, the most important thing is to learn to accept failure and learn from it;

text: 失敗亦唔需要一個人面對，因為人身邊總會有啲好似羊仔噉嘅好朋友陪住你。
eng: Failure also does not need to be faced alone, because others will always be around a good friend like a lamb to accompany you.

text: 經過今次之後，豬仔唔再自暴自棄，仲決定好好準備下一屆大胃王比賽添！
eng: After this time, Piglet no longer gave up on himself, and decided to prepare for the next Big Stomach King Competition!

text: 飲茶
eng: Drinking tea

text: 我爸爸係一個廚師——準確啲講，係點心師傅。
eng: my dad is a chef – a dim sum chef to be exact.

text: 我哋一家住公屋，佢就係喺屋邨商場入面嗰間酒樓返工，我未出世佢已經喺嗰度做，到而家計計埋埋都有廿幾年囉。
eng: Our family lives in a public house, he works in the restaurant in the low-cost housing mall, he has been doing it there before I was born, and it has been twenty years now.

text: 小學嗰陣我讀上午校，媽媽成日帶我放學去酒樓飲下午茶，順便探爸爸班，
eng: When I was in elementary school, I was in morning school, and my mother always took me to the restaurant for afternoon tea after school, and visited my father's class by the way,

text: 去到連酒樓經理都認得我哋一家（佢仲好鍾意請我食糖添）。
eng: Even the restaurant manager recognized our family (he also liked to invite me to eat candy and rice).

text: 不過兩三點始終係酒樓嘅黃金時段，有好多人幫襯，
eng: But two or three o'clock is always the prime time of the restaurant, and there are many people visiting,

text: 所以爸爸多數都係喺廚房忙到踢晒腳，唔會次次得閒出嚟見我哋，而我哋都習慣晒。
eng: So Dad is mostly busy in the kitchen, and he won't come out to see us every time, and we are all used to it.

text: 通常媽媽會帶我坐埋一邊嘅卡位，然後問我想食啲咩點心。
eng: Usually my mother would take me to the booth on the side and ask me what I wanted to eat.

text: 嘩，我想食嘅嘢就多喇：燒賣啦、蝦餃啦、腸粉啦，牛肉球啦——呢啲係例牌要嗌嘅——
eng: Wow, I want to eat more: roasted sales, shrimp dumplings, sausage flour, beef balls - this is always called --

text: 之後再加一籠奶黃包或者叉燒包；朝早上完體育堂嘅話，仲會要多個珍珠雞添！
eng: add a basket of custard buns or char siu buns; if you go to the sports hall in the morning, you will ask for multiple guinea fowl additions!

text: 「叫咁多，你食唔食得晒㗎？」
eng: "Call so much, do you eat enough?"

text: 「係爸爸整嘅就食得晒！」
eng: "Daddy makes it, eat!"

text: 講係噉講，一個細路女食得幾多，所以我差唔多次次都食淨，
eng: Say so, how much a little girl eats, so I eat almost every time,

text: 跟住就會俾媽媽話我「嘥嘢」、「爸爸整點心好辛苦」、「要珍惜食物」……最後佢一定會同經理講：
eng: Then my mother would say that I was "wasting things\

text: 「唔好意思呀，又要打包喇！」
eng: "Sorry, I have to pack again!"

text: 中學之後我就好少陪媽媽去爸爸嗰度飲茶喇。
eng: After middle school, I rarely accompanied my mother to my father's for tea.

text: 直到大學搬咗入宿舍，識咗班新朋友，至意外發現原來大家都好鍾意飲茶——
eng: Until the university moved into the dormitory, met new friends in the class, and unexpectedly found that everyone liked to drink tea -

text: 次次大家落堂諗唔到去邊度食，就一定會有人提議：「去酒樓飲茶啦！」
eng: Every time everyone didn't think of where to eat after class, someone would suggest: "Go to the restaurant to drink tea!"

text: 我一直覺得一大班廿零歲嘅後生仔去飲茶係一件好神奇嘅事：
eng: I have always felt that it is a very amazing thing for a large group of twenty-and-nine-year-old young people to drink tea:

text: 明明爸爸嗰度淨係得一大班阿伯阿婆幫襯！
eng: obviously my father is only a large group of uncles and grandmothers patronizing!

text: 大學酒樓嘅餐牌豐富過啲屋邨酒樓嘅好多（當然價錢都高好多），
eng: The menu of the university restaurant is rich, there are many low-cost rental restaurants (of course, the price is much higher),

text: 粥粉麵飯嘅選擇都有唔少，仲有啲我細個冇食過嘅點心，尤其係桂花糕同咖啡糕呢類嘅甜品。
eng: there are many choices of porridge flour and noodle rice, and I didn't eat dim sum when I was a child, especially desserts such as osmanthus cake and coffee cake.

text: 人大咗之後，我嘅胃口反而細咗。
eng: When I get older, my appetite is smaller.

text: 而家我飲茶通常只會嗌一兩籠燒賣，然後陪大家食下炒飯。
eng: Now I drink tea and usually only shout one or two baskets of roasted rice, and then accompany everyone to eat fried rice.

text: 另外一個轉變係，我而家真係好鍾意「飲茶」，特別係普洱茶，
eng: Another change is that I really like "drinking tea" now, especially Pu'er tea,

text: 嗰陣苦味細個唔識欣賞，大個就覺得別有一番風味……
eng: At that time, I didn't know how to appreciate bitter taste when I was a child, and I felt that it had a special flavor when I grew up ... ...

text: 兩個月前我嚟到倫敦，開始我嘅留學生活。
eng: I came to London two months ago to start my study abroad life.

text: 老實講，有時都會幾掛住香港，
eng: To be honest, sometimes I miss Hong Kong,

text: 不過好彩我識到幾個香港同學，可以一齊傾下偈、食下飯，等大家唔使咁思鄉。
eng: but fortunately, I know a few Hong Kong classmates, and I can chat and eat together, so that everyone does not have to be so homesick.

text: 我哋有幾次仲試過約埋一齊去附近嘅港式酒樓飲茶食點心添！
eng: We have met together a few times to go to a nearby Hong Kong-style restaurant for tea and dim sum Tim!

text: 不過喺英國食香港嘢，味道真係差一截，有時仲有陣唔新鮮嘅怪味……
eng: But eating Hong Kong in the UK, the taste is really poor, and sometimes there is a strange smell that is not fresh...

text: 去過咁多間酒樓，始終都係爸爸整嘅嘢最好食！
eng: I have been to so many restaurants, and it is always my father who cooks the best food!

text: 父「子」
eng: Father "Son"

text: 禮拜六，朝早六點半，我起身去廁所。
eng: Saturday, at six-thirty in the morning, I get up to go to the bathroom.

text: 行過客廳，老豆已經起咗身，開住電視，坐喺梳化睇新聞。
eng: Walking through the living room, my father has already got up, turned on the TV, and sat on the sofa to watch the news.

text: 「早晨啊阿仔。」佢喺機場做維修，日日返十幾個鐘頭。
eng: "Good morning, son." He did maintenance at the airport and returned for more than a dozen hours a day.

text: 照計呢個時間，佢應該已經出咗門返工。「……早晨。」
eng: By this time, he should have gone to work. 「...... Good day. "

text: 去完廁所，諗住返房繼續瞓：我頭先打機打到四點先瞓。
eng: After going to the toilet, I am ready to go back to the house to continue sleeping: I just called the electric call until four o'clock to sleep.

text: 「阿仔呀？」「做咩？」「不如陪老豆去食個早餐？」吓，咁突然？
eng: "Son?" "What for?" "Why don't you go to breakfast with your father?"

text: 「你唔係要返工咩？」「我今日請咗假。」
eng: "Aren't you going to work?" "I'm taking a leave of absence today."

text: 老豆係工作狂，責任心好重，我未見過佢請假。
eng: My father is a workaholic and very responsible, and I haven't seen him take a leave of absence yet.

text: 「你想食嘅話都得嘅……」我當去食宵夜。
eng: "You can eat whatever you want ... ... I'm going to eat late-night snacks."

text: 刷好牙，洗完面，換埋衫，先至六點十。
eng: Brush your teeth, wash your face, change your clothes, it's only six ten.

text: 「你諗住去邊間？」「冇所謂啊，你揀？」
eng: "Where are you going?" "It doesn't matter, you choose?"

text: 於是我帶咗老豆去街口嗰間茶餐廳，夠近，而且得佢開咁早。
eng: So I took my father to the tea restaurant at the entrance of the street, close enough, and only he opened so early.

text: 一坐低，老豆就遞咗個餐牌畀我：「睇下想食啲咩？」
eng: As soon as I sat down, my father handed me a menu: "See what you want to eat?"

text: 「我諗好咗㗎喇。」「咁快？」
eng: "I'm done." "So soon?"

text: 「我成日嚟，記得晒有咩食。」「哦，係呀……好好食㗎？」「唔差。」
eng: "I often chant and remember what to eat." "Oh, yes ... It's delicious?" "It's not bad. "

text: 我嗌咗一碗沙嗲牛肉麵，飲凍檸水；佢嗌咗一碗腿蛋通，飲凍奶茶。
eng: I shouted a bowl of satay beef noodles and drank frozen lemonade; he called a bowl of leg egg and drank frozen milk tea.

text: 佢好似好鍾意飲奶茶，屋企擺咗一包包奶茶粉，我每朝起身都會見到垃圾桶有一包。
eng: He seems to like milk tea very much, and there are packets of milk tea powder at home, and I see a packet in the trash can every morning.

text: 「伙記，加多份西多士吖！」「你好肚餓？」
eng: "Employee, add more Western toast!" "Are you so hungry?"

text: 「唔係呀，我驚你唔夠飽吖嘛。」「我一碗麵夠㗎喇。」
eng: "No, I'm afraid you're not full." "I have enough noodles."

text: 「欸，多士可以兩份食嘅啫！」
eng: "Huh, you can eat toast in two!"

text: 啲嘢食好快到，然後我哋都食得好專心，一句偈都冇傾，氣氛有啲尷尬。
eng: The toast arrived quickly, and then we all ate very attentively, without saying a word, and the atmosphere was awkward.

text: 最後係老豆第一個出聲：「你真係夠飽？」
eng: Finally, the father was the first to say, "Are you really full?"

text: 佢已經切好份西多士，留咗半份畀我，但我始終都冇掂過份多士。
eng: He had already cut a portion of Western Toast and kept half of it for me, but I never made a toast.

text: 「哦……噉我食埋佢啦。」印象中佢好似好憎人食淨嘢。
eng: "Oh... Then I ate him. He had the impression that he hated people eating clean.

text: 「呢度啲嘢食真係唔錯，唔怪之得你——」「埋單囉？」
eng: "The food here is so good, no wonder you-" "Checkout?"

text: 我打斷咗老豆，佢亦窒咗窒：「吓！而家先七點八，好早咋喎！不如陪老豆踩返轉單車哩？」
eng: I interrupted my father, and he also complained: "Scared! It's only seven eight, it's very early! Why don't you accompany my father on a slalom bike?"

text: 我平時成日約人踩單車，屋企都擺咗架幾貴嘅單車。
eng: I usually ask someone to ride a bicycle, and I have a very expensive bicycle at home.

text: 「啱啱至食飽，唔踩喇。」「噉……一係去公園散步？」
eng: "Just eaten, don't step on." "So... Or go for a walk in the park?"

text: 「我真係有啲攰，想返屋企瞓覺。」
eng: "I'm a little tired and want to go home and sleep." "

text: 老豆冇再講啲咩，就攞咗張單去埋。
eng: Didn't my father say anything more, so he took a slip and went.

text: 返到屋企，我直接返房攤上牀，望住天花板——嗰陣啱啱好八點。
eng: When I got home, I went straight back to the stall and stared at the ceiling—it was exactly eight o'clock.

text: 老豆成朝都好古怪。
eng: Father Cheng Dynasty is also eccentric.

text: 定係佢份人不嬲都係噉，只係我見得佢太少，唔了解佢？
eng: Or is he always like this, but I have seen him too little and don't know him?

text: 「父」子
eng: "Father" Son

text: 阿仔今朝帶我去一間我未去過嘅茶餐廳。
eng: Son took me this morning to a tea restaurant that I haven't been to yet.

text: 我拎起餐牌：「睇下想食啲咩？」
eng: I picked up the menu: "See what you want to eat?"

text: 「我諗好咗㗎喇。」「咁快？」「我成日嚟，記得晒有咩食。」
eng: "I want to do it." "So soon?" "I often chant, remember what to eat."

text: 「哦，係呀……好好食㗎？」「唔差。」
eng: "Oh yes ... ... It's delicious?" "It's not bad. "

text: 原來佢成日嚟食，我都係呢刻先知。
eng: It turns out that he eats a lot, and I am also a prophet at this moment.

text: 我四十一歲，喺機場做維修，一星期要返六日，朝七晚七。
eng: I am forty-one years old, doing maintenance at the airport, and I have to go back six days a week, seven to seven.

text: 我廿二歲就學人結婚，廿四歲仲做埋老豆。
eng: I got married when I was twenty-two and became a father at twenty-four.

text: 我亦都唔識做人老豆：我每日有十幾個鐘唔喺屋企，好少時間同阿仔相處。
eng: I also don't become a father: I am not at home for more than ten hours a day, and I rarely spend time with my son.

text: 我阿媽有時睇唔過眼，就接個孫返自己屋企，親手煮飯佢食。
eng: My mother sometimes can't tolerate it, so she takes her grandson back to her house and cooks for him to eat.

text: 依家諗落，我真係好耐冇試過噉樣同佢一齊坐低食餐飯，仲要係早餐。
eng: Now that I think about it, I really haven't tried to sit down with him like this for a meal, or breakfast.

text: 但佢只係嗌咗碗公仔麵，噉夠飽咩？
eng: But he just called a bowl of instant noodles, is it so full?

text: 一個牛高馬大嘅後生仔，照計胃口點都會大過我呢個阿叔啩？
eng: A young man with a high cow and a big horse, how can his appetite be greater than my uncle, right?

text: 「伙記，加多份西多士吖！」「你好肚餓呀？」
eng: "Staff, add more servings of Western Toast!" "Are you so hungry?"

text: 「唔係呀，我驚你唔夠飽吖嘛。」「我一碗麵夠㗎喇。」
eng: "No, I'm afraid you're not full." "I have enough noodles."

text: 「欸，多士可以兩份食嘅啫！」
eng: "Huh, you can eat two portions of toast!"

text: 我將西多士切開兩邊，食咗半份；但係另外嗰半份阿仔由始至終都冇掂過。
eng: I cut the western toast on both sides and ate half of it, but the other half of the toast was never made by my son.

text: 唔通佢真係咁細食？「……噉我食埋佢啦。」
eng: Is he really that snacky? ... Then I ate him.

text: 我一路食，一路發覺我唔知點開口同佢傾偈，結果我哋七點坐低，搭半過啲就已經食完埋單。
eng: As I ate, I realized that I didn't know how to talk to him, so I sat down at seven o'clock, and I had already eaten and paid for it halfway through.

text: 我見仲咁早，咪撩佢踩單車——我見佢擺咗架都幾貴嘅單車喺屋企，佢應該好鍾意踩單車——點知佢話攰，想返屋企瞓覺。
eng: I see it's still so early, don't provoke him to ride a bike - I saw that he put a rather expensive bike at home, he should like cycling - how do you know that he said he was tired and wanted to go home to sleep.

text: 返到屋企，佢粒聲冇出就入房閂門。
eng: When he got home, he entered the room and closed the door without a word.

text: 望住呢個畫面，我都唔知仲可以做咩，最後唯有拎我自己架二手單車落樓，一個人由大埔踩去沙田。
eng: Looking at this picture, I didn't know what else to do, and in the end I had to take my own second-hand bicycle downstairs and pedal alone from Tai Po to Shatin.

text: 阿仔今朝問過我做咩今日唔使返工，我話我請咗假，不過我冇講點解——
eng: My son asked me this morning why I didn't have to go to work today, and I said I took a leave of absence, but I didn't say why—

text: 但遺憾嘅係，我最後探佢唔成——因為佢老婆凌晨五點打畀我，話佢已經走咗。
eng: But unfortunately, I couldn't visit him in the end - because his wife called me at five o'clock in the morning and said that he had left."

text: 聽到呢個消息，我個腦一片空白，完全唔知可以做咩……
eng: When I heard this, my brain went blank, and I didn't know what I could do...

text: 最後我諗到嘅，就係想同你好好哋食返餐飯……」
eng: The last thing I thought of was to have a good meal with you..."

text: 選班長
eng: Choosing a class leader

text: 今日，王老師叫我哋選班長。
eng: Today, Teacher Wang asked us to choose a class leader.

text: 王老師係我哋嘅班主任，都係學校嘅新老師。
eng: Teacher Wang is our homeroom teacher and the new teacher of the school.

text: 我覺得同其他老師相比，王老師好特別——佢講嘢好温柔，好好人又成日笑。
eng: I think compared to other teachers, Mr. Wang is very special - he speaks softly, is very nice and laughs a lot.

text: 而且，佢選班長嘅方式都好唔同。
eng: Moreover, he chose the class leader in a very different way.

text: 以前，老師都會喺開學之後就即刻揀班長。
eng: In the past, teachers would also choose class leaders immediately after school started.

text: 老師通常會按照上個學期同學嘅成績，揀成績最好嘅同學做班長。
eng: The teacher usually selects the student with the best grade as the class leader according to the results of the students in the previous semester.

text: 不過，而家我哋已經開咗學一個月，王老師先話要選班長。
eng: However, now that we have started school for a month, Teacher Wang said that she would choose a class leader.

text: 王老師話，想大家相處一段時間，互相了解之後先選。
eng: Teacher Wang said that I want everyone to get along for a while and get to know each other before choosing.

text: 而且，班長唔係由王老師揀，而係由班上同學一人一票選出。
eng: Moreover, the class president is not chosen by Teacher Wang, but by one vote of the classmates.

text: 王老師話，班長係班嘅代表，除咗負責幫老師維持課堂秩序，仲要幫助同服務同學。
eng: Teacher Wang said that the class leader is the representative of the class, in addition to helping the teacher maintain order in the class, but also helping and serving the classmates.

text: 例如，幫手點名、派午飯、收功課，如果有同學唔舒服就要陪佢去休息室。
eng: For example, help with roll call, send lunch, collect homework, and accompany a classmate to the break room if he is not feeling well.

text: 因為班長嘅職責多，所以班長會得到一個優點獎勵。
eng: Because the squad leader has many responsibilities, the squad leader will receive a merit reward.

text: 之後，王老師就叫想做班長嘅同學舉手。
eng: After that, Teacher Wang asked the students who wanted to be class leaders to raise their hands.

text: 「我要做！」好快就有兩個同學舉手，佢哋分別係小明同家家。
eng: "I'm going to do it!" Soon two classmates raised their hands, they were Bob and Jiajia.

text: 其實佢哋喺之前嘅學期都俾老師揀過做班長，之不過同學仔唔鍾意佢哋。
eng: In fact, they have all been chosen by the teacher to be the class president in the previous semester, but the classmates do not like them.

text: 小明成績好好，但除咗讀書之外，其他嘢乜都唔會理。
eng: Bob has good grades, but doesn't pay attention to anything other than reading.

text: 每逢小息，佢都掛住做功課同温書，好少同其他同學玩同傾計。
eng: Every time he takes a break, he misses doing homework and studying warmly, and rarely plays peace talks with other classmates.

text: 放學之後，佢就即刻去補習，唔會參加課外活動。
eng: Immediately after school, he goes to tutoring and does not participate in extracurricular activities.

text: 有一次，有同學喺佢面前跌低，跌到隻腳損晒，但係身為班長嘅小明竟然唔扶佢起身，仲話要去温書唔得閒照顧佢。
eng: Once, a classmate fell in front of him and broke his foot, but Xiaoming, who was the class leader, did not help him get up, and said that he was going to Wen Shu and had no time to take care of him.

text: 自此之後，同學都覺得小明淨係掛住温書唔理人。
eng: Since then, the classmates have felt that Xiaoming only wants to read Wen Shu and ignore others.

text: 至於家家，佢成日請同學食嘢。
eng: As for the family, he always invited his classmates to eat.

text: 家家每日都帶好多零食返嚟，派畀同學食。
eng: The family brings a lot of snacks back every day and distributes them to classmates.

text: 佢話如果收咗佢嘅零食，就要同佢做朋友，聽晒佢話。
eng: He said that if he accepted his snacks, he would be friends with him and listen to him.

text: 有次放學突然落大雨，家家冇帶遮，就同一位經常收佢零食嘅同學講：「你成日食我送啲嘢，今次輪到你幫我喇！」
eng: Once it suddenly rained heavily after school, and the family did not bring an umbrella, so I said to a classmate who often collected snacks from him: "You often eat and I give away, this time it is your turn to help me!"

text: 之後一手拎咗人哋把遮走，留低個同學喺學校等雨停。
eng: After that, he took the umbrella and left, leaving a classmate to wait for the rain to stop.

text: 後嚟家家做咗班長，就成日向同學講：「我係班長，老師要我維持課堂秩序，你哋要聽我話！」
eng: Later, when he became a class leader, he often said to his classmates: "I am the class leader, the teacher wants me to maintain order in the class, you must listen to me!"

text: 於是，佢不停叫同學幫佢拎嘢，又叫人代佢擦黑板同清潔課室。
eng: So he kept asking his classmates to help him get it, and asked someone to clean the blackboard and clean the classroom on his behalf.

text: 曾經有位同學，覺得佢冇盡班長責任而唔聽佢命令，家家就喺收功課嘅時候，專登收埋佢份功課，然後向老師講大話，話佢唔肯交功課，要老師罰佢。
eng: There was once a classmate who felt that he had not fulfilled his responsibilities as a class leader and did not listen to his orders, so when the family was collecting his homework, he specially hid his homework, and then lied to the teacher, saying that he refused to hand in his homework and asked the teacher to punish him.

text: 王老師問佢哋點解想做班長。小明話：「因為做班長可以拎優點，拎到優點，我嘅成績排名就會更高！」
eng: Teacher Wang asks them why they want to be class presidents. Xiao Ming: "Because being a class leader can take advantages, and with advantages, my grades will rank higher!"

text: 而家家就話：「做班長好勁，可以令同學聽晒自己話！」
eng: Now the family says: "It's very good to be a class leader, you can let the students listen to themselves!"

text: 王老師聽完之後就擰擰頭，再問大家仲有冇人想做班長。
eng: Teacher Wang shook his head after listening to it, and asked everyone if anyone wanted to be the class leader.

text: 同學仔你眼望我眼，大家都唔講嘢。
eng: Classmates, you look me in the eye, and everyone does not speak.

text: 喺呢個時候，我舉起手——不過我唔係話自己想做班長，而係想推薦心兒做班長。
eng: At this time, I raised my hand - but I didn't say that I wanted to be the class leader, but I wanted to recommend Xin'er to be the class leader.

text: 心兒雖然成績唔算好好，又唔會成日請同學食嘢，不過佢好鍾意幫人。
eng: Although Xin'er does not have very good grades and does not invite his classmates to eat all day, he likes to help others.

text: 俾家家拎咗把遮嘅同學，最後亦因為心兒借把遮畀佢，佢先唔使等到冇雨先走。
eng: The classmate who took an umbrella from the family in the family, and in the end, because Xin'er lent him the umbrella, he didn't have to wait until there was no rain to leave first.

text: 最後嗰位俾家家誣衊佢冇做功課嘅同學，都因為心兒見到家家收埋佢份功課，先唔使俾老師罰……
eng: In the end, the classmate who was slandered by his family for not doing his homework, and because he saw his family hiding his homework, he didn't have to let the teacher punish ... ...

text: 點解我會知咁多？因為呢三個受到幫助嘅同學，全部都係我！
eng: Why do I know so much? Because these three students who were helped are all me!

text: 老師聽完我嘅建議，就問心兒想唔想做班長。
eng: After listening to my advice, the teacher asked if he wanted to be the class president.

text: 「如果可以幫到大家嘅話，我願意！」
eng: "If I can help everyone, I do!"

text: 心兒一講完呢句，班上即刻掌聲雷動。睇嚟受過心兒幫助嘅人唔只我一個。
eng: As soon as Xin'er finished saying this, the class immediately applauded. It seems that I am not the only one who has been helped by my heart.

text: 最後，老師叫大家投票。
eng: Finally, the teacher asks everyone to vote.

text: 結果幾乎全班都投心兒一票，佢就成為咗我哋嘅班長喇！
eng: As a result, almost the whole class voted for it, and he became our class president!

text: 我相信，佢一定會係個好班長！
eng: I believe that he will be a good class leader!

text: 盤古開天闢地・女媧造人
eng: Pangu opened the world and Nuwa created people
bookTitle: 盤古開天闢地・女媧造人

text: 「呢個世界係點嚟㗎，呢個地球又係點嚟㗎？」
eng: "How is the world, and how is this earth?"
bookTitle: 盤古開天闢地・女媧造人

text: 趁而家得閒，仲有十五分鐘先落堂，我用少少時間同大家解釋下啦。」
eng: While I have time now, there are still fifteen minutes before class ends, so I will explain it to you in a little time. 」
bookTitle: 盤古開天闢地・女媧造人

text: 仲未有地球，仲未有宇宙嘅時候，世界就好似雞蛋蛋白咁混濁，
eng: When there was no earth, no universe, the world was like egg protein cloudy,
bookTitle: 盤古開天闢地・女媧造人

text: 而且咩都冇，除咗喺呢個空間中間瞓咗嘅一個巨人之外——佢叫做盤古。」
eng: And nothing, except for a giant who slept in the middle of this space - his name was Pangu. 」
bookTitle: 盤古開天闢地・女媧造人

text: 我好心急噉追問：「之後呢？呢個巨人會做啲咩㗎？」
eng: I was anxious to ask, "What will this giant do?"
bookTitle: 盤古開天闢地・女媧造人

text: 佢有一把好巨型嘅斧頭，佢用力一揮，輕嘅物質就開始慢慢上升，形成空氣；
eng: He has a very large axe, and with a strong swing, the light substance begins to slowly rise, forming air;
bookTitle: 盤古開天闢地・女媧造人

text: 然後就話：「我知喇！就好似爸爸你成日同媽媽道歉一樣！
eng: Then he said, "I know, just like dad you always apologize to mom!

text: 如果你唔知自己做錯啲咩，媽媽就會繼續嬲你！」
eng: If you don't know what you're doing wrong, your mother will continue to be angry with you!"

text: 爸爸好尷尬噉回應：「細聲少少，細聲少少……」
eng: Dad responded embarrassedly: "A little quieter, a little quieter..."

text: 第二日，艾迦聽從爸爸嘅建議再去揾波特道歉，表明自己嘅誠意。
eng: The next day, Iga followed her father's advice and went to Potter to apologize and show her sincerity.

text: 而波特聽到之後都即刻冇再嬲，仲非常唔好意思噉承認自己尋日對艾迦太惡。
eng: And Potter didn't get angry immediately after hearing this, and was very embarrassed to admit that he was too bad for Iga yesterday.

text: 經過呢件事之後，佢哋兩個比起初識嗰陣更老友，仲重建咗一個更堅固嘅水壩添！
eng: After this incident, the two of them are older friends than they were when they first met, and they have built a stronger dam!

text: 塞翁失馬，焉知非福
eng: Sai Weng Lost His Horse, how do you know if that's not a blessing (in disguise)?

text: 從前，有位老人家住喺好遠嘅地方，人人都叫佢做塞翁。
eng: Once upon a time, there was an old man who lived far away, and everyone called him Sai Weng.

text: 塞翁性格樂觀，為人處世嘅方法與眾不同。
eng: Sai Weng had an optimistic personality and a different approach to the world.

text: 有一日，塞翁屋企隻老馬唔知點解，放牧嗰陣蕩失路，唔見咗。
eng: One day, an old horse of Sai Weng's family, for some reason, lost its way while grazing and disappeared.

text: 過咗好多日，佢哋都係揾唔返隻馬。
eng: After many days, they still couldn't find the horse.

text: 鄰居知道咗呢個消息之後，都覺得好可惜，一齊去到塞翁屋企安慰佢。
eng: When the neighbors learned the news, they all felt a pity and went to Sai Weng's house together to comfort him.

text: 不過塞翁覺得無乜所謂，唔見咗隻馬啫，無乜大不了。
eng: But Sai Weng felt that it didn't bother him. Losing a horse wasn't a big deal.

text: 佢反而安慰大家：「我唔見咗隻馬，當然係一件壞事，但話唔定會帶嚟好結果呢？」
eng: Instead, he comforted everyone: "Of course, it is a bad thing that I've lost a horse, but it may happen that it will bring good results."

text: 鄰居聽到塞翁嘅説話，都覺得好笑。
eng: The neighbors were all amused by what Sai Weng had said.

text: 隻馬唔見咗，明明係一件壞事，但係塞翁就覺得係一件好事，好明顯係安慰自己，所以大家都無將塞翁嘅説話當真。
eng: Losing the horse was obviously a bad thing, but Sai Weng felt that it was a good thing. Obviously it was to comfort himself, so no one took his words seriously.

text: 過咗幾個月，嗰隻蕩失路嘅老馬竟然跑返嚟，仲帶埋另一隻馬！
eng: A few months later, the old horse who had lost his way actually returned with another horse!

text: 於是，鄰居又一齊嚟向塞翁道賀，仲讚佢唔見馬嗰陣好有遠見。
eng: So the neighbors came together to congratulate Sai Weng and praised him for his foresight when he lost his horse.

text: 不過今次塞翁反而好憂心：「唉，我無啦啦多咗隻馬，當然係一件好事，但係話唔定佢會帶嚟壞結果呢？」
eng: But this time Sai Weng was very worried, "Oh, I've gained a horse out of the blue. Of course, it's a good thing, but who knows if it will bring bad results."

text: 鄰居聽到塞翁嘅説話，都覺得奇怪，多咗隻馬，可以係咩壞事呢？
eng: When the neighbors heard what Sai Weng said, they all felt strange. What bad things could gaining a horse bring?

text: 塞翁屋企無啦啦多咗隻馬，佢個仔非常開心，於是成日騎住隻馬周圍走。
eng: Sai Weng's family had gained a horse out of the blue. His son was very happy, so he rode around on the horse all day long.

text: 終於有一日，個仔得意忘形，竟然喺馬背上面跌咗落嚟，仲跌傷咗一隻腳，自此行唔到路。
eng: Eventually, one day, his son got carried away and fell off the horse, breaking a leg, and could no longer walk.

text: 善良嘅鄰居知道之後，即刻過嚟塞翁屋企慰問。
eng: When the kind neighbors found out about this, they immediately came to the Sai Weng's house to offer condolences.

text: 不過，塞翁都係講同一句説話：
eng: Still, Sai Weng said the same thing:

text: 「我個仔跌斷隻腳，當然係一件壞事，但之後話唔定會帶嚟好結果呢？」
eng: "My son having broken a leg is of course a bad thing, but there's a chance that it may bring good results in the future."

text: 鄰居聽到塞翁嘅説話，都覺得佢亂咁講嘢。
eng: When the neighbors heard what Sai Weng said, they all thought he was talking nonsense.

text: 大家都唔明白，佢個仔跌斷咗隻腳，點會係好事呢？
eng: They all didn't understand how his son having broken a leg could be a good thing.

text: 呢個故事已經流傳咗千幾二千年，為嘅係要話畀我哋知，人世間嘅好事同壞事唔係絕對嘅——
eng: This story has been passed down for a thousand to two thousand years. The purpose is to tell us:

text: 有啲時候，壞事會帶嚟好嘅結果，而好事都會帶嚟壞嘅結果。
eng: Good things and bad things in the world are not absolute—sometimes bad things will bring good results, and good things will bring bad results.

text: 凡事要睇兩面，唔好只著眼於一時嘅得失。
eng: Look at both sides of everything; don't focus only on temporary gains and losses.

text: 江郎才盡・夢筆生花
eng: Jiang Yan has exhausted his talents. From the pen came marvelous works.

text: 喺好耐好耐之前，中國出咗一位文學家，佢叫做江淹。
eng: A long, long time ago, from China came a literary scholar, his name was Jiang Yan.

text: 江淹細個嘅生活好慘，因為佢自細爸爸就過咗身，於是佢同佢媽媽相依為命。
eng: Jiang Yan's childhood life was very tragic. At a young age, his father passed away, and so he and his mother had only each other to depend on.

text: 喺咁艱苦嘅環境之下，江淹依然好畀心機讀書。
eng: Even under such difficult circumstances, Jiang Yan still put all he could into his studies.

text: 佢長大之後，成為咗一位好出名嘅文學家，佢寫嘅詩詞歌賦尤為出色。
eng: After he grew up, he became a very famous literary scholar, and he wrote poems and songs with outstanding talent.

text: 因為佢太有才華，大家都叫佢做江郎。
eng: Because he was so talented, everyone called him Master Jiang.

text: 冇幾耐，江淹做咗大官。
eng: Not long after, Jiang Yan became a high-ranking official.

text: 因為做官賺好多錢，所以佢就冇再畀心機讀書。
eng: Because he made a lot of money as an official, he didn't study hard anymore.

text: 到佢老嗰陣，佢嘅文章唔單止冇進步，仲越寫越差。
eng: By the time he was old, his writings not only did not improve, but even worsened and worsened over time.

text: 做唔到活到老學到老啫，影響真係咁大？
eng: He didn't continue to learn while he lived his years, was there really that big of an impact?

text: 有啲人話，有一日江淹搭船渡河，喺船上瞓覺嗰陣，夢見一位古代嘅文學家，叫做張景陽。
eng: Some say one day, Jiang Yan was crossing the river on a boat. When he fell asleep on the boat, he saw in his dreams an ancient literary scholar called Zhang Jingyang.

text: 張景陽話：「我之前借咗一匹好靚嘅布畀你，而家係時候還返畀我喇。」
eng: Zhang Jingyang said, "I lent a very beautiful cloth to you in the past, now it is time to return it back to me."

text: 江淹摸一摸自己心口，真係有一匹靚布，於是就還返畀張景陽。
eng: Jiang Yan felt around his chest, there really was a beautiful cloth. So, he returned it to Zhang Jingyang.

text: 江淹夢醒之後，佢嘅文筆就開始每況愈下喇。
eng: After Jiang Yan awoke from his dream, his writing began to get worse and worse.

text: 又有另一啲人話，有一日江淹喺個涼亭入面瞓著咗。
eng: Some others say that one day Jiang Yan fell asleep in a pavilion.

text: 佢發咗一個夢，夢見另一位古代嘅文學家，叫做郭璞。
eng: He fell into a dream, where he saw another ancient literary scholar named Guo Pu.

text: 郭璞同佢講：「好耐之前我借咗一枝有五隻顏色嘅筆畀你，你借咗好多年，而家係時候還返畀我啦。」
eng: Guo Pu said to him: "A long time ago, I lent you a five-color pen, you've borrowed it for many years, now it's time to return it back to me."

text: 江淹摸一摸心口，真係有支好靚嘅五色筆，於是就還返畀郭璞。
eng: Jiang Yan felt around his chest, there really was a beautiful five-color pen. So, he returned it to Guo Pu.

text: 江淹夢醒之後，就再寫唔出好嘅詩詞歌賦喇。
eng: After Jiang Yan awoke from his dream, he could no longer write good poems or songs.

text: 因為呢兩個傳說，大家都話江郎嘅才華已經用曬，於是就有「江郎才盡」呢個成語。
eng: Because of these two legends, everybody says that Jiang Yan's talent had been exhausted already, so now there exists the idiom: "Jiang Yan has exhausted his talents."

text: 聽完江淹嘅故事，係咪覺得好慘呢？
eng: After having listened to Jiang Yan's story, don't you feel that it was tragic?

text: 不如我哋聽返啲開心嘅故事？
eng: How about we go back to listening to some happy stories instead?

text: 喺好耐好耐之前，又有另一位好出名嘅詩人，佢叫做李白。
eng: A long, long time ago, from China came another famous poet, his name was Li Bai.

text: 李白細個嗰陣，讀書唔勤力，成日偷懶。
eng: When Li Bai was a child, he didn't work hard in his studies, always slacking off.

text: 有一日，李白路過一條小溪，小溪旁邊有一位老太太。
eng: One day, Li Bai passed by a little stream, beside the little stream was an old lady.

text: 呢位老太太揸住一條好粗嘅鐵柱喺度磨。
eng: The old lady was holding a very thick iron pillar, grinding it.

text: 李白覺得好奇怪，就問老太太做緊乜。
eng: Li Bai thought that this was very strange, and asked the old lady what she was doing.

text: 老太太話：「我想將條鐵柱磨成一枝針。」
eng: The old lady said: "I want to grind the iron pillar into a needle."

text: 聽完之後，李白好感動：如果連一條咁粗嘅鐵柱都可以磨成針，只要努力，天下間冇嘢係做唔到！
eng: After listening, Li Bai felt very moved: If even such a thick iron pillar can be worn down to a needle, as long as you work hard, there will be nothing in the world that you won't be able to do.

text: 於是李白就好努力畀心機讀書，最終成為出色嘅大詩人。
eng: So, Li Bai studied hard and became an outstanding poet.

text: 當時有一個傳說，話李白細個嗰陣，發咗一個夢。
eng: At that time, there was a legend that said that when Li Bai was a child, he had a dream.

text: 佢夢見自己用嘅筆，筆頭上面居然生出一朵花，之後佢就成為出色嘅大詩人。
eng: In his dream, he was using a pen. To his surprise, from the tip of the pen came out a flower. Afterwards, he became an outstanding, great poet.

text: 呢個故事就係「夢筆生花」成語嘅由來。
eng: This story is where the idiom: "From the pen came beautiful works" comes from.

text: 唔知呢啲傳說係真定係假嘅呢？
eng: I don't know if these legends are real or fake.

text: 你哋又有冇試過發關於「筆」嘅夢？
eng: Have you ever tried to dream about a pen?

text: 不過，江淹同李白之所以成功，都係離唔開佢哋嘅努力。
eng: Regardless, the success of Jiang Yan and Li Bai is inseparable from their hard work.

text: 所以，各位小朋友，你哋唔好諗住因為唔想做功課，就同爸爸媽媽講，話你發夢俾人攞走咗支筆，「江朗才盡」呀！
eng: So, children, don't think that just because you don't want to do your homework, that you can just tell your parents that you dreamt of your pen being taken away, and say that your writing talents are no more!

text: 一飯千金
eng: A meal is worth a thousand taels of gold.

text: 喺二千幾年前，中國古代有一位好勁嘅將軍，佢叫做韓信。佢嘅本領天下第一，無人能及。
eng: Over two thousand years ago, there was a great general in ancient China whose name was Han Xin. His skills ranked the top in the world, with no one else can compare.

text: 而家我要講佢細個受人照顧，大個報恩嘅故事。
eng: Now I want to tell the story of him being cared for when he was little and grew up to repay his kindness.

text: 有一日，佢去咗河邊釣魚，諗住食魚充飢。喺呢個時候，佢見到一位洗衫嘅婆婆。
eng: One day, he went to the river for fishing, he wanted to eat some fish to feed his hunger. At this time, he saw an old lady who was doing laundry.

text: 婆婆見到韓信個肚餓到扁晒，就餵佢食飯，一連幾十日都係噉，直到婆婆洗晒啲衫。
eng: The old lady saw that Han Xin was hungry, so she fed him for dozens of days, until she had washed all clothes.

text: 韓信好感動，佢同婆婆講：「你咁照顧我，將來我一定會好好報答你。」
eng: Han Xin was very touched, and he said to the old lady, "You take care of me so much, I will definitely repay you well in the future."

text: 婆婆就話：「我請你食飯，係因為我見你可憐。我唔需要你報答我，我只需要你努力做人。」
eng: Then the old lady said, "I treated you a dinner, because I saw that you were pitiful. I don't need you to repay me, I just need you to work hard to be the best of yourself."

text: 韓信覺得好慚愧。從此，韓信認真閱讀兵書，練習武藝，決心要做一個有用嘅人。
eng: Han Xin felt ashamed. From then on, Han Xin carefully read the book of soldiers, practiced martial arts, and determined to be a useful person.

text: 過咗一排，韓信遇到一位蝦蝦霸霸嘅少爺。
eng: After a while, Han Xin met a young master who loved bullying the others.

text: 之後韓信真係瓹佢褲襠底。周圍睇熱鬧嘅人都笑佢細膽。
eng: After that, Han Xin really crawled under his pants. People everywhere laughed at his timidity.

text: 後來，韓信做咗劉邦嘅將軍。當時劉邦只係一個小王，冇能力統一天下。
eng: Later, Han Xin became Liu Bang's general. At that time, Liu Bang was just a small king and did not have the ability to unify the world.

text: 劉邦又覺得韓信好普通，所以只係畀佢做個小將軍。
eng: Liu Bang also felt that Han Xin was very ordinary, so he just assigned him as a small general.

text: 於是有一晚，韓信決定離開劉邦。丞相蕭何知道之後，就即刻騎馬追韓信返嚟。
eng: One night, Han Xin decided to leave Liu Bang. After Prime Minister Xiao He found out, he immediately rode back after Han Xin.

text: 劉邦知道就好嬲：「逃走嘅將軍有幾十個，點解你偏偏要追韓信？」
eng: Liu Bang was very angry when he knew it, "There are dozens of generals who have escaped, why do you want to chase Han Xin?"

text: 蕭何話：「如果你甘心做一個小王，你可以唔要韓信；但如果你要一統天下，冇韓信你就做唔到！」
eng: Xiao He said,"If you are willing to be a little king, you can do it without Han Xin; but if you want to dominate the world, you can't do it without Han Xin!"

text: 劉邦知道錯在自己，於是封咗韓信做大將軍。最終，喺韓信嘅幫助下，劉邦成功統一天下。
eng: Liu Bang knew that he was at fault, so he promoted Han Xin as the great general. In the end, with the help of Han Xin, Liu Bang successfully unified the world.

text: 韓信功成之後，始終冇忘記當初幫佢嘅婆婆。
eng: After Han Xin's success, he did not forget the old lady who helped him earlier.

text: 佢返鄉下揾返嗰位婆婆，畀咗一千兩黃金佢──呢個就係成語「一飯千金」嘅由來。
eng: He returned to the countryside to visit the old lady and give her 1,000 taels of gold—hence the origin of the idiom "a meal of 1,000 gold."

text: 當然，韓信都冇忘記當初想害佢嗰位少爺。
eng: Of course, Han Xin did not forget the young master who wanted to harm him earlier.

text: 嗰位少爺見返韓信，知道人哋做咗大將軍，嚇到手震腳震，咩都講唔到。
eng: When the young master saw Han Xin, he knew that he had become a great general, and his hands and feet trembled with fright, and he couldn't say anything.

text: 點知韓信竟然話：「雖然你當眾羞辱過我，但亦因為噉，我至識得忍辱負重，仲成就咗今日嘅我。
eng: Who knew that Han Xin actually said, "Although you have humiliated me in public, but because of this I know how to endure humiliation and bear the pressure, which makes me become who I am today.

text: 所以我唔會報仇，仲會以德報怨，畀個官你做。」
eng: So I will not take revenge, but will repay the grievance with virtue and give you an official position."

text: 韓信一生人入面，影響佢最大嘅有三個人，分別係婆婆、少爺，同埋蕭何。
eng: In Han Xin's life, there were three people who had the greatest influence on him, namely the old lady, the young master, and Xiao He.

text: 如果你係韓信？你又會點報答佢哋？
eng: If you were Han Xin, how would you repay them?

text: 杞人憂天・杯弓蛇影
eng: Cup Bow Snake Shadow

text: 喺好耐好耐之前，有一個國家，叫做杞國。
eng: A long, long time ago, there was a country called the country of Qi.

text: 杞國有一個人，佢好細膽，仲成日亂諗嘢。
eng: There is a man in the country who is very timid and often thinks about things.

text: 有一日，佢忽然間諗到，如果天空冧落嚟，點算好？
eng: One day, he suddenly thought, what if the sky fell?

text: 佢驚到瞓唔着。
eng: He was so scared that he couldn't sleep.

text: 之後，佢忽然又諗到，如果大地冧咗落去，點算好？
eng: Then he suddenly thought, what if the earth goes down?

text: 佢驚到食唔落飯。
eng: He was so afraid that he couldn't eat.

text: 佢好幾個月食唔安，瞓唔落，搞到個人瘦咗好多，親戚朋友見到都好擔心。
eng: He was restless for months, couldn't sleep, lost a lot of weight, and his relatives and friends were worried when they saw it.

text: 之後有一位智者去咗揾呢個杞國人，同佢講：「天空係由空氣所組成，呢個世界到處都有空氣。人類要生存，日日都要呼吸。
eng: Then a wise man went to the man and said to him, "The sky is made of air, and there is air everywhere in this world." For humans to survive, they have to breathe every day.

text: 人類日日喺空氣之中活動，唔係一件好平常嘅事咩？你使乜驚個天會冧落嚟？」
eng: Isn't it a common thing for human beings to move in the air every day, why are you afraid that the heavens will fall?"

text: 杞國人聽咗之後，覺得好有道理，稍為安心咗少少。
eng: After listening to it, the people of Qiguo felt very reasonable and slightly relieved.

text: 但係佢又即刻諗到另一個問題。佢問：「噉天上面嘅太陽、月亮、星星，佢哋唔會跌落嚟咩？」
eng: But he immediately thought of another question. He asked, "So that the sun, the moon, and the stars in the sky will not fall?"

text: 智者答：「計我話，天上面嘅太陽、月亮、星星，呢啲通通都係氣體，氣體又點會跌落嚟呢？」
eng: The wise man replied: "In my opinion, the sun, the moon, and the stars above the sky are all gases, and how can the gas fall?"

text: 佢話：「噉我都安心啲。」
eng: He said: "Then I will also be at ease."

text: 但係佢又即刻擔心其他嘢：「如果大地冧咗落去，噉又點算好？」
eng: But he immediately worries about something else: "What if the earth goes down?"

text: 智者話：「大地基本係由泥土所組成，呢個世界周圍都係泥土。人類要生活，日日都要行路。
eng: The wise man said, "The earth is basically made of dirt, and the world is full of dirt." Human beings have to live and walk every day.

text: 人類日日喺泥土上面活動，唔係一件好平常嘅事咩？你使乜驚個地會冧落去？」
eng: Isn't it a common thing for humans to move on the dirt every day, why are you afraid that you will like it?"

text: 智者答完之後，佢先明白自己嘅擔心實在係多餘，即刻開心到笑出嚟！
eng: After the wise man answered, he realized that his worries were superfluous, and immediately laughed with joy!

text: 之後佢有返胃口食嘢，夜晚瞓覺都冇再失眠。
eng: After that, he had returned to his appetite to eat, and he did not lose sleep at night.

text: 當中有位客人特別細膽，見到杯入面有一條蛇，就好驚，唔敢飲。
eng: One of the guests was very timid and saw a snake in the cup, so he was so scared that he did not dare to drink it.

text: 但係主人家特登準備咗咁多靚酒佳餚，咁有誠意，客人唔敢唔飲呢杯酒，於是就唂一聲吞咗杯酒落肚。
eng: But the host deliberately prepared so many beautiful wines and delicacies, so sincere, the guests did not dare not drink this wine, so they swallowed a glass of wine.

text: 客人返到自己屋企，當日就覺得肚好痛，又食唔落飯。
eng: When the guest returns home, he feels a pain in his stomach that day and can't eat.

text: 主人家見佢病咗，就去探佢，睇下佢做咩病咗。
eng: When the host saw that he was sick, he went to visit him to see what he was doing sick.

text: 客人喊住話：「我食你餐飯嗰陣，有條蛇入咗我個杯，但係我有理冇理一啖飲晒杯酒！
eng: The guest cried and said, "When I ate your meal, a snake entered my cup, but I ignored it and drank a glass of wine!

text: 主人家安慰咗佢一陣，就返到自己屋企。
eng: The host comforted him for a while and returned home.

text: 佢諗咗好耐：自己住咗咁耐，都未見過有蛇，冇理由有條蛇走入去杯酒度㗎？
eng: He thought for a long time: he has lived for so long, he has never seen a snake, there is no reason for a snake to run into a glass of wine?

text: 之後佢抬頭一望，見到自己收藏嘅弓——佢突然明白晒！
eng: After he looked up and saw his collection of bows - he suddenly understood!

text: 客人杯酒入面條蛇，其實係把弓嘅倒影。
eng: The snake in the guest's glass of wine is actually a reflection of the bow.

text: 主人家即刻同客人講返件事，客人聽到，即刻就病好喇，仲可以落牀食飯添！
eng: The host will tell the guest about the matter immediately, the guest hears it, and he will be well immediately, and he can also eat again!

text: 所以小朋友，唔好成日自己嚇自己，話唔定你而家驚緊嘅嘢，大個咗就發現其實一啲都唔恐怖呢！
eng: So children, don't scare yourself all day, maybe you are afraid now, and when you grow up, you will find that it is not scary at all!

text: 曹沖稱象
eng: Cao Chong Weighs an Elephant

text: 從前，有一位丞相，佢叫做曹操。佢有幾個仔，個個都好有成就。
eng: Once upon a time, there was a grand minister named Cao Cao. He had a few sons, each being very accomplished.

text: 大仔叫曹丕，後嚟做咗皇帝；又有一個細仔，叫做曹植，係著名嘅文學家。
eng: The eldest son was called Cao Pi, who later became emperor, and another younger son, Cao Zhi, who was a famous literary scholar.

text: 佢哋嘅故事出名到人盡皆知。但係其實曹操仲有一個細仔，大家又知唔知呢？
eng: Their stories are so famous that they've become common knowledge. But in fact, Cao Cao has a younger son too, did you all know that?

text: 曹操呢個細仔，叫做曹沖，佢自細就聰明過人。
eng: Cao Cao's youngest son, called Cao Chong, was more bright than others since he was little.

text: 佢五六歲嗰陣，已經識得諗方法解決一啲連大人都解決唔到嘅難題。
eng: When he was five or six years old, he already knew how to think of ways to solve problems not even adults could solve.

text: 有一次，有人送咗一隻好靚嘅山雞畀曹操。
eng: Once, someone gave Cao Cao a very beautiful pheasant.

text: 呢隻山雞啲羽毛好靚，五顏六色，曹操想睇呢隻山雞跳舞，於是係噉逗隻山雞，但係隻山雞一直都唔睬佢。
eng: This pheasant's feathers were beautiful and colorful, Cao Cao wanted to see the pheasant dance, so he teased and poked the pheasant, but the pheasant never paid any attention to him.

text: 呢個時候，細仔曹沖就話：「好簡單啫，等我嚟啦。」
eng: At this time, the youngest son Cao Chong said: "It's very simple! Let me do it."

text: 曹沖放咗一塊銅鏡喺隻山雞面前，山雞見到銅鏡入面有隻好靚嘅山雞。
eng: Cao Chong put a copper mirror in front of the pheasant. The pheasant saw a very beautiful pheasant in the copper mirror.

text: 山雞為咗同佢鬥靚，就開始跳舞，點知鏡入面嘅山雞跟住一齊跳。
eng: In order to compete to be the most beautiful, the pheasant began to dance, but little did it know that the pheasant in the mirror would follow in his dancing.

text: 最尾，山雞跳咗好耐都唔停，因為佢要等鏡入面嗰隻停，佢先肯停。
eng: In the end, the pheasant danced for a long time without stopping because only when the pheasant in the mirror stopped would it be willing to stop.

text: 從此，大家都覺得曹沖真係一位神童。後嚟，又有人送咗一隻大笨象畀曹操。
eng: Since then, everybody thought that Cao Chong was really a child prodigy. Later on, someone gave an elephant to Cao Cao.

text: 曹操佢哋個個都冇見過大笨象，佢見淨係象腿都已經有一條柱咁粗，覺得大笨象真係好大隻。
eng: Cao Cao and everyone else had never seen an elephant, and he even saw that the elephant's legs were already as thick as a pillar, so he thought that the elephant was indeed very large.

text: 佢喺度諗：唔知呢隻大笨象有幾重呢？
eng: Here he thought: How heavy is this elephant?

text: 於是佢就問大臣，睇下有冇方法可以量度呢隻大笨象嘅重量。
eng: So, he asked the minister to see if there was any way to measure the weight of this elephant.

text: 有一位大臣話：「大笨象又大隻又重，要做一個超級巨型嘅稱，先可以量到佢嘅重量。」
eng: One minister said: "Elephants are large and heavy, it would take a super giant scale in order to measure its weight."

text: 曹操笑住答：「噉個稱咪仲大過間屋？邊有可能做到呀？」
eng: Cao Cao smiled and replied, "Wouldn't that mean that such a scale would have to be larger than a house? How would that be possible?"

text: 另一位大臣話：「大笨象係生嘅，就算造到咁大個稱，大笨象都未必肯乖乖企上去。
eng: Another minister said: "Elephants are alive, even if one could make such a large scale, the elephant may not even necessarily be willing to stand on it obediently."

text: 呢個時候，有個細路走出嚟，原來係曹沖。
eng: At this time, a child ran out, turning out to be Cao Chong.

text: 佢話：「要量隻大笨象有幾重，好簡單啫，等我話畀你哋知點做啦。
eng: He said: "Measuring an elephant's weight is so simple, let me tell you all how to do it.

text: 首先準備一隻木船，放隻大笨象上去。大笨象咁重，水位一定好深。
eng: First, prepare a wooden boat and put the elephant onto it. Since the elephant is so heavy, its level on the water must be very deep down.

text: 揾到個水位之後，再派人喺船上刻一個記號。」
eng: After finding the water level, send someone to carve a marking of it on the boat."

text: 呢個時候，好多大臣都仲未明白曹沖想點。佢哋問：「噉之後點做呀？」
eng: At this time, many ministers still had not understood what Cao Chong wanted to do. They asked, "Then, what would we do after that?"

text: 曹沖接住講：「之後就拉返隻大笨象出嚟，再逐啲逐啲放木頭上去，直到隻船去返之前嘅水位先好停。
eng: Cao Chong continued: "Then, pull the elephant back out and then load logs on the boat little by little, until the boat sinks back down to that water level.

text: 最後攞返啲木頭出嚟，分開磅下幾重，加埋咪知隻大笨象幾重囉。」
eng: Finally, take back the logs and weigh them. Add them all up and that'll be how heavy the elephant is!"

text: 一眾大臣依家先恍然大悟！佢哋好慚愧，因為佢哋做大人嘅，都唔及一個五六歲嘅細路聰明。
eng: The crowd of ministers have only now suddenly realized! They were very ashamed because they weren't even as smart as a five, six-year-old child.

text: 自古英雄出少年，所以做大人嘅，千祈咪睇小細路！
eng: Since ancient times, heroes have been emerging as youngsters. So, as an adult, absolutely do not underestimate children!

text: 做細嘅，都唔好睇小自己——有時細路仔睇嘢，比大人仲要透徹呀！
eng: As kids, don't underestimate yourselves- sometimes kids see things more clearly than adults!

text: 田忌賽馬
eng: Tian Ji Betting on Horse racing

text: 二千幾年前嘅中國，有一個齊國，國王齊威王好鍾意賽馬，佢成日同佢嘅大臣田忌比賽，而田忌次次都輸，點解呢？
eng: Over two thousand years ago in China, there was a state of Qi, and King Qi Wei liked horse racing. He always competed with his minister Tian Ji, and Tian Ji lost every time. Why?

text: 原來佢哋會將自己嘅馬分成三等，分別係上等馬、中等馬，同埋下等馬，然後舉行三場比賽。
eng: It turned out that they would divide their horses into three classes, the upper class, the middle horse, and the lower class, and then hold three races.

text: 而齊威王嘅上等馬，次次都跑得快過田忌嘅上等馬少少，中等馬同下等馬都一樣，所以田忌每次都輸。
eng: And King Qi Wei's upper-class horse ran a little faster than Tian Ji's upper-class horse every time, and the same was true for middle-class horses and lower-class horses, so Tian Ji lost every time.

text: 為咗唔好失咗個氣勢，田忌次次都落重注，於是佢次次都輸好多錢。
eng: In order not to lose momentum, Tian Ji made heavy bets every time, so he lost a lot of money.

text: 有一日，田忌遇到一位好聰明嘅將軍，佢叫做孫臏。
eng: One day, Tian Ji met a very clever army general named Sun Bin.

text: 孫臏話：「田忌，你唔使驚，我有一個方法，包你次次賽馬都贏，等你唔使輸錢之餘，仲次次都會贏錢。」
eng: Sun Bin said: "Tian Ji, don't be afraid, I have a method, you will win every horse race, and you will win money every time."

text: 田忌唔明白，佢問孫臏：「你係咪想揾人訓練我啲馬？」
eng: Tian Ji didn't understand, so he asked Sun Bin, "Are you trying to find someone to train my horse?"

text: 孫臏答：「完全唔使訓練你啲馬。」
eng: Sun Bin replied, "You don't have to train your horse at all."

text: 田忌又問：「噉你係咪想換走我啲馬？」
eng: Tian Ji asked again, "Then do you want to change my horse?"

text: 孫臏答：「一樣唔使，乜馬都唔使換。」
eng: Sun Bin replied, "No need, no need to change any horse."

text: 田忌好驚噉話：「乜都唔做，咪又係輸！」
eng: Tian Ji was so afraid that he said, "Do nothing, don't lose again!"

text: 孫臏好有自信噉答：「信我啦，跟住我做，一定會贏！」
eng: Sun Bin replied confidently: "Trust me, follow me, you will definitely win!"

text: 冇幾耐，又到咗賽馬日。齊威王非常之有自信，佢望住田忌話：「呢次我又嚟贏晒你啲錢喇！」
eng: Not long after, it was Racing Day again. King Qi Wei was very confident, and he looked at Tian Ji and said: "This time I will win your money again!"

text: 田忌好驚，唔知點算，而孫臏就自信十足噉企喺田忌隔籬。
eng: Tian Ji was so scared that he didn't know what to do, but Sun Bin stood next to Tian Ji confidently.

text: 第一場比賽開始喇！孫臏派咗田忌嘅下等馬，去對戰齊威王嘅上等馬。
eng: The first game began! Sun Bin sent Tian Ji's lower-class horse to fight against King Qiwei's upper-class horse.

text: 第一場比賽仍然係輸，田忌驚到面都青埋，但係孫臏依然好有自信。
eng: The first game was lost, Tian Ji was so scared that his face turned blue, but Sun Bin was still very confident.

text: 之後喺第二場比賽，孫臏派田忌嘅上等馬，去對戰齊威王嘅中等馬。
eng: Later in the second race, Sun Bin sent Tian Ji's upper-class horse to fight against King Qi Wei's middle-class horse.

text: 雖然田忌嘅上等馬贏唔到齊威王嘅上等馬，但係要贏佢嘅中等馬，真係一啲難度都冇——田忌終於贏咗第一場比賽！
eng: Although Tian Ji's upper-class horse could not win against King Qi Wei's upper-class horse, it is really not difficult to win his middle-class horse - Tian Ji finally won the first race!

text: 最後係第三場比賽，孫臏派田忌嘅中等馬，去對戰齊威王嘅下等馬。諗都唔使諗，田忌又贏多場。
eng: Finally, in the third game, Sun Bin sent Tian Ji's middle-class horse to fight against King Qi Wei's lower-class horse. Needless to guess, Tian Ji won a game again.

text: 三場比賽，田忌贏咗兩場，輸咗一場：三盤兩勝，田忌終於贏咗齊威王！
eng: Out of the three matches, Tian Ji won two and lost one. Two wins in three rounds, Tian Ji finally won King Qi Wei!

text: 同樣都係呢啲馬，用原本嘅方法，田忌就會輸；但係調一調出場次序，田忌就贏。
eng: Similarly using the original method with the same horses, Tian Ji would lose, but once he adjusted the order of horses, Tian Ji would will.

text: 孫臏係咪好聰明呢？呢個故事話畀我哋聽，力敵唔得嘅時候，就要智取！
eng: Isn't Sun Bin very smart? This story tells us that when you can't fight against it, you have to outsmart it!

text: 淥麵
eng: Noodles

text: 「又搞咗成日……」我望咗望手機，又試搞到凌晨，已經係兩點幾。
eng: "Another whole day..." I looked at my phone, and tried to get it until the early hours of the morning, it was already two o'clock.

text: 出到公司門口，咁啱有架的士，我嗱嗱聲截車返屋企。
eng: Out of the door of the company, there is such a chance that there is a taxi, I quickly stopped the car and went home.

text: 我租咗九龍城嘅一間劏房。
eng: I rented a subdivided room in Kowloon City.

text: 我本身同父母一齊住元朗，但揾到依家份工之後，就搬咗出嚟住。
eng: I live with my parents in Yuen Long, but after finding my current job, I moved out.

text: 揀九龍城，係因為方便返工：我依家喺九龍灣做緊一間電視台嘅助導。
eng: I chose Kowloon City because of the convenience of going to work: I am currently working as a TV assistant in Kowloon Bay.

text: 「助導」全名係助理導演，即係導演嘅助手，但實際上只係一個打雜：
eng: The full name of the "assistant director" is an assistant director, that is, the director's assistant, but in fact it is just a miscellaneous job:

text: 拍節目嗰陣，現場所有嘅嘢都關我事，導演、演員、攝影師……
eng: When filming a show, all the noise on the scene is my business, the director, actors, photographers ... ...

text: 所有人問嘅問題，我冚唪唥都要識答。
eng: Everyone asks questions, and I have to be able to answer them all.

text: 我連大家每日食邊間餐廳嘅乜嘢飯盒都要顧埋一份。
eng: I even have to take care of what box lunch from which restaurant everyone eats every day.

text: 我間劏房喺一棟舊樓嘅七樓，租金唔貴，對我嘅經濟負擔唔算大。
eng: My subdivided room is on the seventh floor of an old building, the rent is not expensive, and the financial burden on me is not large.

text: 而且好彩嗰度有𨋢，唔使我行樓梯。
eng: And it's good that there is an elevator there, so I don't have to take the stairs.

text: 不過凌晨一個人返屋企都有少少恐怖，所以我全程都會戴耳機聽歌。
eng: But it's a little scary to go home alone in the early hours of the morning, so I wear headphones to listen to songs the whole time.

text: 今晚我返到屋企都已經三點零，入門口嗰下個肚響咗一響。「唉，肚餓添……」
eng: When I got home tonight, it was already three thirty, and the next stomach rang at the door. "Oh, I'm hungry again..."

text: 做電視台嘅人個個都食無定時，我上一餐係夜晚八點，求求其其食咗盒燒鴨飯。
eng: Everyone who works as a TV station eats irregularly, and my last meal was at eight o'clock in the evening, and I casually ate a box of roast duck rice.

text: 我打開櫥櫃，入面放咗十幾包公仔麵，全部都係辣味。
eng: I opened the cupboard and there were more than a dozen packs of instant noodles inside, all spicy.

text: 我好少煮飯食，屋企連電飯煲都冇，淨係得一個電磁爐同一個電熱水壺。
eng: I rarely cook, I don't even have a rice cooker at home, just an induction cooker and an electric kettle.

text: 平時我肚餓都係淥麵食就算，但當我返完十幾個鐘頭工：「唔想淥麵……好麻煩。」
eng: Usually I'm hungry and even if I braised pasta, but when I finished working for more than ten hours: "I don't want to braised noodles... It's troublesome.

text: 於是我閂返櫃門，開另一個櫃桶，拎咗杯辣味杯麵出嚟放上枱——
eng: So I closed the door, opened another drawer, took a cup of spicy cup noodles and put it on the table -

text: 我屋企除咗一包包公仔麵之外，就淨返一杯杯杯麵。
eng: In addition to a bag of instant noodles, there are only cups of noodles left in my house.

text: 我開住電熱水壺就撻上牀（我張牀就喺正我張枱隔籬）。
eng: I stole it with the electric kettle on (I'm right next to my desk).

text: 「叮！」啲水一煲滾，我就爬起身坐近張枱，搣開杯麵個蓋，斟啲滾水落去。「計時三分鐘……」
eng: "Ding!" As soon as the water boiled, I got up and sat close to the table, pinched the lid of the cup noodles, and poured boiling water down. "Three minutes..."

text: 我開着手機，揾返我最鍾意嗰首日文歌出嚟播，首歌唱完啱啱好三分鐘，於是我再攤返上牀聽住等。
eng: I turned on my phone and retrieved my favorite Japanese song, which was sung for exactly three minutes, so I spread it back and listened.

text: 佢第一句歌詞就係：「你淥緊杯麵，你斟緊滾水落去……」「吖！吖！吖！」
eng: His first lyrics were: "You're wiping the noodles, you're pouring boiling water ... ... "Whoops! Wow! Wow!"

text: 窗口出面有一樖好高嘅樹，夏天朝早一定有雀仔喺上面叫，仲要叫得好難聽。
eng: There is a tall tree outside the window, and there must be birds chirping on it in the summer morning, and it must be so ugly.

text: 「嘈夠未啊……使唔使朝朝七點都準時嘈醒我——」七點？
eng: "Is there enough noise ... ... Do you want to wake me up every morning at seven o'clock—"Seven o'clock?

text: 我即時爬起身，捽一捽眼，望一望出面——個天已經光晒。「大鑊……」
eng: I get up immediately, raise my eyes, and look out - the sky is already light. "Trouble..."

text: 我杯杯麵已經浸咗幾個鐘，杯身摸落仲有少少暖，但啲麵已經浸到腍晒，成擗漿糊噉好核突……
eng: My cup of noodles has been soaked for a few hours, and the cup body is still a little warm, but the noodles have been soaked to the point of stroking, and it is very disgusting to become a paste ... ... ...

text: 「……都係落樓下買個早餐食算啦……」
eng: "... ... Let's go downstairs and buy breakfast ... ..."

text: 望夫石
eng: Amah Rock, the Husband-Watching Stone.

text: 我呢個學期參加咗大學一個同留學生做朋友嘅計劃，負責帶佢哋遊覽香港同埋認識香港文化。
eng: This semester, I participated in a university program to make friends with international students, where I was in charge of taking them around Hong Kong and having them learn about Hong Kong culture.

text: 唔知邊度嚟？我都唔知啊！
eng: Do you not know where it is? Well, I don't know either!

text: 聽到嗰下真係呆咗，唔識畀反應，心諗：乜嘢「阿媽石」啊？
eng: After hearing that, I was really dumbfounded. I didn't know how to react and thought to myself: What is "A-mah Rock"? [A-ma is a term for mother]

text: 望夫石係喺沙田獅子山郊野公園入面，近大圍嗰邊。
eng: Amah Rock was in the Lion Rock Country Park in Sha Tin, near Tai Wai.

text: 而廣東話之所以會叫佢做「望夫石」，就同一個傳說有關：
eng: And the reason why Amah Rock is called "The Husband-Watching Stone" in Cantonese is related to a legend:

text: 相傳好耐好耐以前，有一家三口住喺沙田；當時嘅香港人大多數仲係漁民。
eng: Legend has it that a long, long time ago, a family of three lived in Shatin; most people in Hong Kong at that time were still fishermen.

text: 有一日，爸爸出海捕魚之後就冇再返屋企，瀨低咗媽媽同佢哋啱啱出世嘅仔。
eng: One day, father didn't come home after going fishing, leaving her mother and their newborn child behind.

text: 媽媽好擔心自己老公嘅安危，於是每日都孭住囝囝上獅子山望海，盼望老公安全返嚟。
eng: The mother was very worried about her husband's safety, so she carried her son to Lion Mountain every day to look at the sea, hoping that her husband would return safely.

text: 而兩母子嘅身體就變咗做石頭，永遠留喺獅子山上面。
eng: The bodies of the mother and son became stones and remained on Lion Mountain forever.

text: 從此，呢嚿石就叫做「望夫石」：盼「望」老公（即係「夫」）返嚟嘅「石」頭。
eng: Since then, this stone has been called "The Husband-Watching Stone".

text: 點都好啦，搞掂！揾咗路線，知道點去，又揾埋個名嘅來源，可以講下故仔。
eng: Anyways, we've done it! We've found the route and how to get there, and even the origins of the name, now you will be able to tell this little story.

text: 跟住要諗嘅就係去到有咩做……大佬啊！
eng: The next thing to think about is what to do when you get there, man.

text: 望夫石真係一嚿石嚟㗎咋，除咗同佢影相，真係冇嘢好做呀！
eng: Amah Rock is really just a stone, besides taking pictures with it, there really isn't much to do!

text: 都仲可以喺山上俯瞰埋沙田嘅景色嘅……
eng: There is also a view of Sha Tin from the hill ...

text: 希望班美國學生上到去之後唔會失望啦。
eng: I hope that the group of American students won't be disappointed after getting there.

text: 神童孔融
eng: Prodigy Kong Rong

text: 好耐以前有一個神童，佢叫做孔融。
eng: A long time ago there was a child prodigy called Kong Rong.

text: 佢細細個就好孝順。
eng: He was filial as a child.

text: 孔融嘅兄弟入面，孔融排行第六，係全家最細。
eng: Among Kong Rong's brothers, Kong Rong ranks sixth, the youngest in the family.

text: 孔融四歲嗰陣，發生咗一個小故事。
eng: When Kong Rong was four years old, a little story happened.

text: 話說次次孔融同佢哥哥食梨，佢都專登揀細嘅嚟食，將大嘅留畀幾位哥哥。
eng: It is said that every time Kong Rong and his brother eat pears, he also specially chooses the small ones to eat, leaving the big ones for several older brothers.

text: 大家都覺得好奇怪，正常人都鍾意食大嘅梨，大嘅梨又甜又多汁，有乜理由要揀細嘅嚟食呢？
eng: Everyone thinks it's strange, normal people like to eat big pears, big pears are sweet and juicy, what is the reason to choose small pears?

text: 家族入面嘅大人一齊問孔融：「孔融呀，點解次次食梨，你唔揀大嘅嚟食，偏偏要揀最細嘅呢？」
eng: The adults in the family asked Kong Rong together: "Kong Rong, why do you not choose the big one to eat every time you eat pears, but choose the smallest?"

text: 孔融話：「因為我係細仔，按道理嚟講，我係應該揀細嘅嚟食。」
eng: Kong Rong said: "Because I am the youngest son, it stands to reason that I should choose the little one to eat. 」

text: 佢哋聽到孔融噉答，都忍唔住一齊讚孔融孝順。
eng: When they heard Kong Rong answer like this, they couldn't help but praise Kong Rong for his filial piety together.

text: 又有一次，京城嚟咗一位好出名嘅大官，佢叫做李元禮。
eng: Another time, a very famous official came to the capital, he was called Li Yuanli.

text: 佢從來唔見陌生人，如果唔係佢親戚，或者名人，係冇可能見到李元禮。
eng: He never saw strangers, and if it weren't for his relatives, perhaps celebrities, it would be impossible to see Li Yuanli.

text: 孔融唔識得李元禮，又唔係佢親戚，亦唔係啲咩好出名嘅人，但係孔融又想見下佢喎。
eng: Kong Rong didn't know Li Yuanli, he wasn't his relative, and he wasn't a very famous person, but Kong Rong wanted to see him.

text: 噉點算好呢？神童不愧係神童，孔融諗到一個計仔。
eng: So what to do? The prodigy is worthy of being a prodigy, Kong Rong thought of a way.

text: 佢去到李元禮屋企，同守門口嘅人講：「我係李元禮嘅親戚。」
eng: He went to Li Yuanli's house and said to the person guarding the door: "I am Li Yuanli's relative. 」

text: 於是守門口嘅人就放咗佢入去。
eng: So the man guarding the door let him in.

text: 孔融見到李元禮之後，李元禮覺得好奇怪，佢話：
eng: After Kong Rong saw Li Yuanli, Li Yuanli felt very strange, and he said:

text: 「我從來未見過你喎，點解你話你係我親戚呢？」
eng: "I've never seen you, so why do you say you're my relative?"

text: 孔融就話：「我嘅祖先曾經做過你祖先嘅學生，所以我哋世世代代都有交情。」
eng: Kong Rong said: "My ancestor used to be your ancestor's student, so we have been friends for generations. 」

text: 李元禮覺得更加奇怪，佢心諗：我嘅祖先做過佢祖先嘅老師？
eng: Li Yuanli felt even more strange, and he thought to himself: My ancestor was his ancestor's teacher?

text: 點解我從來都冇聽過？孔融繼續講：
eng: Why have I never heard of it?

text: 「我嘅祖先係孔子，你嘅祖先係老子，孔子曾經問過老子問題，所以孔子做過老子嘅學生。
eng: Kong Rong continued: "My ancestor was Confucius, your ancestor was Lao Tzu, Confucius once asked Lao Tzu questions, so Confucius was Lao Tzu's student.

text: 我哋世世代代都有交情呀。」
eng: We've had friends for generations. 」

text: 在座咁多位客人，包括李元禮，全部都覺得孔融好聰明。
eng: All the guests present, including Li Yuanli, all felt that Kong Rong was very smart.

text: 當時有另一位大官在場，佢叫陳煒。
eng: At that time, another senior official was present, his name was Chen Wei.

text: 陳煒對住孔融講：「你真係好聰明，不過細個聰明嘅人，大個都未必有成就。」
eng: Chen Wei said to Kong Rong: "You are really smart, but when you were a child, you were smart, and you may not have achieved anything when you grow up. 」

text: 孔融即刻串返佢：「噉你細個一定好聰明喇。」
eng: Kong Rong immediately flipped him: "Then you must have been very smart when you were a child." 」

text: 李元禮聽到孔融嘅回答，笑到出唔到聲！
eng: When Li Yuanli heard Kong Rong's answer, he couldn't laugh!

text: 笑完之後，李元禮話孔融大個之後，一定會又出名又有成就。
eng: After laughing, Li Yuanli said that Kong Rong will definitely be famous and successful when he grows up.

text: 果然，孔融大個之後，成為咗一位好出色嘅文學家，仲做埋大官添！
eng: Sure enough, when Kong Rong grew up, he became an excellent literary scholar and also became a great official!

text: 東方朔傳奇
eng: Dongfang Shuo Legend

text: 好耐好耐之前，有一個好聰明博學嘅人，佢叫做東方朔。
eng: A long, long time ago, there was a very intelligent and erudite man named Dongfang Shuo.

text: 佢唔單止聰明，仲好識搞笑。
eng: He's not only smart, he's also funny.

text: 皇帝好鍾意佢，當佢係搞笑藝人，就好似小丑噉。
eng: The emperor liked him very much, and when he was a funny entertainer, he was like a clown.

text: 東方朔講嘅嘢雖然好好笑，唔可以完全當真，但係説話背後又幾有道理。
eng: Although what Dongfang Shuo said is very funny and cannot be completely taken seriously, there is quite a reason behind the argument.

text: 皇帝從來未見過咁唔知醜嘅人，所以就畀咗個小官佢做，可惜做呢種小官係見唔到皇帝。
eng: The emperor has never seen such a shameless person, so he gave a small official to him to do, but it is a pity that to do this kind of small official is not to see the emperor.

text: 區區一個小官當然滿足唔到東方朔，於是佢諗咗一個計仔。
eng: Of course, a small official can't satisfy Dongfang Shuo, so he wants to find a way.

text: 當時皇帝手下有一班養馬嘅官，佢哋全部都係侏儒。
eng: At that time there was a group of horse breeders under the emperor, and all of them were gnomes.

text: 班侏儒一聽到呢度，個個都驚到喊晒口。
eng: As soon as the class dwarf heard this, everyone cried with fear.

text: 有一日，皇帝經過，啲侏儒即刻跪晒喺地下，不停向佢道歉。
eng: One day, the emperor passed by, and some gnomes immediately knelt on the ground and kept apologizing to him.

text: 皇帝覺得奇怪，就問咩事。
eng: The emperor felt strange and asked something.

text: 皇帝知道東方朔份人向來鬼馬，呢條屎橋一定係佢諗出嚟，於是命人叫東方朔過嚟，當面問佢咩事。
eng: The emperor knows that Dongfang Shuo has always been a slippery person, and this bad idea must have been thought up by him, so he ordered someone to call Dongfang Shuo over and ask him what happened in person.

text: 東方朔一聽到可以見皇帝，就好開心雀躍，因為佢嘅計仔終於得逞喇！
eng: When Dongfang Shuo heard that he could see the emperor, he was so happy, because his solution finally succeeded!

text: 皇帝見到東方朔，就問佢：「點解你要嚇啲侏儒呀？」
eng: When the emperor saw Dongfang Shuo, he asked him: "Why do you want to scare the dwarf?"

text: 東方朔話：「侏儒得三尺高，人工有二百四十蚊；我成九尺高，人工都係得二百四十蚊。
eng: Dongfang Shuo: "The dwarf is only three feet tall and the salary is two hundred and forty yuan; I am nine feet tall, and the salary is still only two hundred and forty yuan."

text: 侏儒啲嘢食多到食唔晒，我就成日餓住個肚。
eng: The dwarf eats too much to eat, and I am often hungry.

text: 如果皇上覺得我講嘢係啱聽嘅，就畀個大官我做；
eng: If the emperor thinks that I am listening to me, give me a high official to do it;

text: 如果覺得唔啱聽，你不如炒咗我啦，費事浪費食物。」
eng: If you don't feel like it, you might as well fire me, too lazy to waste food.

text: 皇帝見佢搞笑得嚟又有口才，就索性畀咗個大官佢做——東方朔終於可以成日見到皇帝喇！
eng: The emperor saw that he was funny and eloquent, so he simply gave a senior official him to do - Dongfang Shuo can finally see the emperor often!

text: 過咗好耐。有一日，皇帝送咗好多肉畀大臣食，東方朔都有份。
eng: It's been a long time. One day, the emperor sent a lot of meat to the ministers to eat, and Dongfang Shuo also had a share.

text: 但係唔知點解，負責切肉嘅官員等極都未到。
eng: But I don't know why, the official in charge of cutting meat did not wait.

text: 嗰日仲要係「三伏日」，即係全年最熱嘅一日，大家都熱到出晒汗。
eng: It was still the "Three Volts Day\

text: 最後東方朔等唔切，就擅自切咗一忽肉帶返屋企。
eng: In the end, Dongfang Shuo was too late, so he cut a piece of meat without permission and took it home.

text: 皇帝知道之後好嬲，佢叫東方朔過嚟自我檢討一下。
eng: The emperor was very angry when he found out, and he asked Dongfang Shuo to review it himself.

text: 東方朔碌一碌對眼，唱咗首歌：「東方朔呀東方朔。你唔等個官嚟到就切肉，係幾咁無禮。
eng: Dongfang Shuo looked at his eyes and sang a song: "Dongfang Shuo, Dongfang Shuo." How rude it is for you to cut meat without waiting for an official to come.

text: 你切嘅肉係留畀自己太太食，係幾咁愛錫老婆。」
eng: The meat you cut is reserved for your wife to eat, how much you love your wife. "

text: 皇帝聽完之後，忍唔住哈哈大笑。
eng: After hearing this, the emperor couldn't help but laugh.

text: 皇帝話：「我叫你自我批評，點知變咗自己讚自己。」
eng: Emperor: "I call you self-criticism, how do you know that you have changed yourself and praised yourself."

text: 於是原諒咗佢。
eng: So forgave him.

text: 皇帝見東方朔咁有急才，就送咗好多酒同肉畀東方朔，等佢同太太一齊享用。
eng: The emperor saw that Dongfang Shuo was so anxious, so he sent a lot of wine and meat to Dongfang Shuo and let him enjoy it with his wife.

text: 大禹治水
eng: Dayu Tames the Waters

text: 唔知大家又知唔知，中國古代都有大洪水嘅傳說呢？
eng: But did you know that ancient China also had legends of a great flood?

text: 喺好耐好耐以前，有一場大洪水，周圍都水浸。
eng: A long, long time ago, a big flood came and flooded everything.

text: 抬頭望去，四周圍都睇唔到陸地，搞到有人要住喺樹上面，有人要住喺山窿入面。
eng: There was no land in any direction as far as the eye could see. It was so bad that some people had to live in trees, and others had to live in caves.

text: 仲要水入面都係咬人嘅蛇同龍，大家都唔知點算。
eng: What's more, there were biting snakes and dragons in the water. No one knew what to do.

text: 呢個時候，皇帝派咗個人去治理洪水。
eng: At this time, the emperor sent someone to go control the flood.

text: 呢個人見到周圍都俾水浸到睇唔見陸地，就起咗好多圍牆，諗住阻住啲洪水。
eng: When this person saw that everywhere was so badly flooded that the land was gone from sight, he built many walls to block the floodwaters.

text: 不過啲洪水太勁，沖冧晒啲圍牆。
eng: But the floods were so strong that they washed the walls down.

text: 皇帝好嬲，嬲到將佢流放咗去一個叫羽山嘅地方。
eng: The emperor was so angry that he exiled the person to a place called Yu Shan.

text: 大禹長大之後，皇帝就命令佢繼承佢爸爸未完成嘅任務。
eng: When Dayu grew up, the emperor commanded that he should inherit his father's unfinished mission.

text: 於是佢下定決心，一定要平息呢場超級大洪水！
eng: So he was determined that he was going to quell this extremely large flood!

text: 大禹首先去調查洪水係咩一回事。
eng: Dayu first went to investigate what sort of thing this flood was.

text: 佢爬上一座又一座高山，視察洪水有幾勁，同埋佢係點樣流動。
eng: He climbed mountain after mountain to see how strong the flood was and how it flowed.

text: 爬咗無數咁多座高山後，大禹終於知道要點樣平息呢場洪水——
eng: After climbing countless high mountains, Dayu finally knew how to quell the flood —

text: 佢爸爸係靠起圍牆去防止洪水漫延，但失敗咗，所以大禹決定用疏導嘅方法去平息洪水。
eng: his father had built walls to prevent the flood from spreading, but since that failed, Dayu decided to use diversion to quell the flood.

text: 中國一共有九條最主要嘅河流，大禹決定先從呢九條河流入手。
eng: There are nine major rivers in China, and Dayu decided to start with these nine rivers.

text: 佢掘走九條河流旁邊啲泥沙，河水開始流入支流。
eng: He dug away the silt from beside the nine rivers, and the river water began to flow into tributaries.

text: 大禹繼續掘，一直掘到東面嘅大海。
eng: Dayu continued digging all the way until he reached the ocean in the east.

text: 最後九條河流嘅水都流咗入東面嘅大海。
eng: Ultimately, the water of the nine rivers all flowed into the ocean in the east.

text: 大功告成之後，終於見返陸地喇！
eng: After this enormous success, the land was finally visible again!

text: 大禹仲趕走埋啲咬人嘅蛇同龍。
eng: Dayu even drove out the biting snakes and dragons.

text: 大家終於有地起屋耕田，有得食有得住喇！
eng: Everyone finally had land for houses and farming. They had something to eat and somewhere to live!

text: 大禹用咗十年去平息呢場大洪水。
eng: Dayu spent ten years quelling the flood.

text: 皇帝為咗感謝大禹嘅努力付出，最後仲讓咗個帝位畀佢。
eng: In the end, the emperor actually gave the throne to Dayu to thank him for all of his hard work.

text: 嘉欣嘅飯盒
eng: Jiaxin's box lunch

text: 「鈴、鈴、鈴！」又到午餐時間喇！每個小朋友都拎飯盒出嚟，放喺枱上面。
eng: "Bell, bell, bell!" It's lunch time again! Each child takes a box lunch out and puts it on the table.

text: 每個飯盒都有唔同嘅顏色，唔同嘅圖案，又紅又綠，又有花花又有熊仔，一齊放喺枱上面，七彩繽紛，真係好靚啊。
eng: Each box lunch has a different color, different pattern, red and green, flowers and bear children, placed on the table together, colorful, really beautiful.

text: 咦？當大家都開開心心準備食飯嘅時候，最細粒嘅嘉欣反而郁都唔郁，仲嬲爆爆噉望住自己個飯盒。
eng: When everyone was happily preparing to eat, the youngest Jiaxin didn't move, and stared angrily at his boxed lunch.

text: 究竟點解呢？唔通佢唔肚餓？定係啱啱同朋友鬧交，所以冇胃口？
eng: Isn't he hungry, or has he just quarreled with a friend and has no appetite?

text: 嘉欣乸住塊面，嘴都扁埋噉，慢慢用食指撂起個飯盒蓋，極速𥊙咗裏面一眼——
eng: Jiaxin's mother held a piece of noodles, her mouth seemed to be flat, slowly picked up a box lunch lid with her index finger, and quickly glanced inside.

text: 「又係呢啲！」嘉欣大嗌。「咩事？咩事？」
eng: "Again!" Jiaxin cursed. "What? What?"

text: 周圍嘅同學聽到，即刻走晒過嚟，七嘴八舌噉一齊關心嘉欣發生咩事：
eng: When the surrounding classmates heard this, they all ran over immediately, and they all cared about what happened to Jiaxin like seven mouths and eight tongues:

text: 「嘉欣，你做咩大嗌啊？嚇到我個心而家都仲卜卜噉跳！」
eng: "Jiaxin, why are you cursing, it scares my heart to beat now!"

text: 「係唔係有咩唔開心啊？」
eng: "Isn't there something unhappy?"

text: 「係唔係見到小強？我幫你捉住佢！」
eng: "Did you see Xiaoqiang, I'll help you catch him!"

text: 嘉欣係噉擰頭，話：「唔係啊、唔係啊。你哋睇下！」
eng: Jiaxin shook her head and said, "No, no. Take a look!"

text: 講完就打開個飯盒。大家異口同聲噉嘩咗一下。
eng: After that, open a box lunch. Everyone wowed in unison.

text: 原來飯盒入面有半條香噴噴嘅蒸魚，上面淋咗好多鮮味嘅蒸魚豉油，一直流到去粒粒分明嘅白飯上面，
eng: It turned out that there was half a fragrant steamed fish in the bento, drizzled with a lot of umami steamed fish soy sauce, and it flowed all the way to the clear grains of white rice,

text: 隔籬仲有幾條青翠嘅白烚菜心，真係睇到人流晒口水。
eng: There are also a few green white cabbage hearts next to it, and I really see people drooling.

text: 再睇真啲，飯盒隔籬仲有一細盒飯後小食，入面有個蛋撻仔同兩粒脹卜卜嘅燒賣仔。
eng: Looking at the real point, next to the box lunch, there is also a small snack after the meal, which has an egg tart son and two swollen roasted children.

text: 「嘉欣你就好啦，午餐咁豐富！」成班同學都好羨慕。
eng: "Jiaxin, you are good, the lunch is so rich!" the whole class was envious.

text: 「有咩好喎！我阿爸成日煮埋呢啲普通嘢，成日都食㗎啦，太悶喇！
eng: My dad cooked all day and ate it all day, it was so stuffy!

text: 我都想好似你哋噉，食下日本便當，食下印度咖哩，食下印尼炒飯……」
eng: I also want to be like you, eat Japanese curry, eat Indian curry, eat Indonesian fried rice..."
