text: 佢聽見就笑住話：「我睇過一部小說，主角有件隱形斗篷，去到邊都可以神不知鬼不覺，睇嚟你係想要呢件嘢喎。」
eng: When he heard it, he smiled and said, "I read a novel in which the protagonist has an invisibility cloak that can be unnoticed anywhere, it seems that you want this one."

text: 佢又摸下我個頭：「你唔使唔開心喎，最多我下次讓下你囉。
eng: He touched my head again: "You don't have to be unhappy, at most I'll let you go next time."

text: 「隱形斗篷？竟然有啲咁勁嘅嘢？」
eng: "The cloak of invisibility? is it a little that powerful?"

text: 我即刻兩眼放光：「我先唔使你讓我！我哋要堂堂正正公平競爭。
eng: My eyes immediately lit up: "I don't need you to let me!

text: 你等我揾到件隱形斗篷返嚟，你就知味道！」
eng: You know the taste when I find an invisibility cloak and come back!"

text: 想揾資料要點做？梗係去圖書館啦！
eng: Want to find information to do? Of course go to the library!

text: 第二日一早，我就跑去圖書館揾一大堆關於衫嘅書，啲書疊起上嚟仲高過我。
eng: The next morning, I ran to the library to find a bunch of books on clothes, stacked higher than me.

text: 我每拎一本書，都要伸到隻手好長，對腳又要趷到好高，仲辛苦過行山。
eng: Every time I take a book, I have to reach a long hand, and my feet are very high, which is harder than climbing a mountain.

text: 不過嘻嘻，有咁多書，我就唔信揾唔到傳說中嘅隱形斗篷！
eng: But hee, with so many books, I don't believe I can't find the legendary invisibility cloak!

text: 揭完一頁又一頁，原來衫褲鞋襪嘅世界好大，淨係物料，都已經十隻手指數唔晒！
eng: After uncovering page after page, it turns out that the world of clothes, shoes and socks is very large, and the materials alone are already counted by ten hands!

text: 毛冷啦，尼龍啦，棉啦，羊毛啦……剩係我而家身上着嘅，都已經三四種。
eng: Wool bar, nylon bar, cotton bar, wool bar ... ... It's just that I'm wearing three or four of them now.

text: 再望一望周圍睇書嘅人啲衫，研究下係咩質地——有啲分到，有啲分唔到。
eng: Look at the clothes of people reading everywhere and study what texture it is - a little divided, a little indistinguishable.

text: 真係好好玩啊！
eng: It's really fun!

text: 毛鬙鬙嘅叫毛冷，冬天嗰陣，媽媽會將佢親手織嘅冷帽同冷手套畀我戴。
eng: In winter, my mother would wear the cold hat and thread gloves that she had knitted by herself.

text: 我戴上去就暖笠笠，畀風吹到都唔覺凍。
eng: I put it on very warm, and I don't feel cold when blown by the wind.

text: 好似膠嘅係防水尼龍，落雨着嘅雨褸就係用佢造。
eng: Like glue is waterproof nylon, and the raincoat worn in the rain is made of him.

text: 我着佢喺身就唔怕落雨，雨水打落雨褸只會跣走。
eng: I wear him without fear of rain, and the coat will only slip away when the rain hits.

text: 滑到跣手、超好摸嘅係絲綢，媽媽珍而重之掛喺衣櫃嘅旗袍，就係用棗紅色嘅絲綢造。
eng: The silk that slips to the skier and is super easy to touch is silk, and the cheongsam that my mother cherishes and hangs in the wardrobe is made of jujube-red silk.

text: 哥哥結婚嗰日，媽媽就係着呢件旗袍，高貴又優雅，人人都話好睇。
eng: On the day of my brother's wedding, my mother wore this cheongsam, which was noble and elegant, and everyone said it looked good.

text: 硬繃繃嘅係牛仔布，隻色好似天空咁藍咁靚。
eng: Hard and taut is denim, only the color is as blue as the sky.

text: 爸爸有條十幾年嘅牛仔褲，着上身型格又舒服，而且好襟着。
eng: Dad has jeans for more than ten years, which are handsome and comfortable to wear, and very slack.

text: 「各位讀者請注意，圖書館將於五分鐘後停止服務……」
eng: "Dear readers, please note that the library will be out of service in five minutes..."

text: 係圖書館嘅關館廣播，原來已經咁夜嗱！
eng: It was the library closing announcement, it turned out to be so late!

text: 我嗱嗱聲執好啲嘢，跑返屋企。
eng: I quickly packed up and ran home.

text: 返到屋企，表姐問我揾到隱形斗篷未。
eng: When I got home, my cousin asked me if I had found the invisibility cloak.

text: 「暫時未，不過我揾到更加好玩嘅嘢！」
eng: "Not yet, but I found something more fun!"

text: 我諗咗諗，又話：「你都唔好咁快放心住，雖然衣着嘅世界好大，但我遲早都會揾到隱形斗篷嚟贏你！」
eng: I thought about it and said, "Don't worry so quickly, although the world of clothing is big, sooner or later I will find the invisibility cloak to win you!"

text: 我周圍跑，周圍跳，又伸手穿過自己身體！哈哈哈，實在太搞笑，太好玩喇！
eng: I ran everywhere, jumped everywhere, and reached through my body!

text: 我笑下笑下就笑醒，醒咗都仲繼續攣弓蝦米噉笑。摺緊衫嘅媽媽走嚟問我咩事咁開心。
eng: I laughed and woke up, and when I woke up, I continued to laugh like a shrimp bending my bow. My mother, who was folding clothes, came up to me and asked me what was so happy.

text: 「哈哈哈，我隱形咗啊！」
eng: "Hahaha, I'm invisible!"

text: 改造漁村
eng: Transforming fishing villages

text: 所有城市都由小村落開始，一步一步慢慢發展成今時今日繁華嘅大都會。
eng: All cities started as small villages and gradually developed into the bustling metropolis they are today.

text: 好多好多年前，有一條小漁村，入面住咗一班醒目又勤力嘅人。
eng: Many, many years ago, there was a small fishing village where a group of striking and hard-working people lived.

text: 家輝同家寶兩兄妹就係其中一份子。
eng: Jia Fai and Jiabao brothers and sisters are one of them.

text: 佢哋屋企雖然唔係有錢，但係一家樂也融融，好捱得，生活過得幾好。
eng: Although their family is not rich, the family is happy, very close, and lives well.

text: 媽媽話：「種瓜得瓜，種豆得豆。大家只要肯努力，就會有收穫。」
eng: Mom said, "Grow melons to get melons, and plant beans to get beans." As long as everyone is willing to work hard, they will reap the rewards. 」

text: 爸爸話：「一家人開開心心就夠喇。」
eng: Dad said, "It's enough for the family to be happy. 」

text: 家輝話：「仲有狸貓先生！」
eng: Ka Fai: "And Mr. Tanuki!"

text: 原來家輝上年去郊野公園玩嘅時候，認識咗狸貓先生，之後佢每個月都會去探狸貓。
eng: It turned out that when Jia Fai went to play in the country park last year, he met Mr. Tanuki, and since then he has visited Tanuki every month.

text: 生活有屋企人，有狸貓先生，一家都好滿足。
eng: Life has a family, there is Mr. Tanuki, and the family is very satisfied.

text: 有一日，有個陌生嘅叔叔嚟到漁村。
eng: One day, a strange uncle came to the fishing village.

text: 佢笑騎騎噉同村長講：「呢條漁村真係好，條條魚都鮮嫩肥美，村民又勤力！
eng: He laughed and rode to the village chief: "This fishing village is so good, every fish is tender and fatty, and the villagers are working hard!"

text: 我想喺度起工廠，等大家可以賺多啲錢！」
eng: I want to build a factory here so that everyone can make a lot of money!"

text: 村長覺得幾好，於是搞咗個投票大會。
eng: The village chief thought it was good, so he held a voting meeting.

text: 每個村民都有一票，少數服從多數，最後大家同意起工廠。
eng: Each villager had one vote, the minority obeyed the majority, and finally everyone agreed to start the factory.

text: 過咗冇幾耐，工廠起好喇！
eng: Not long after, the factory was built!

text: 爸爸決定唔再捉魚，改去工廠返工。
eng: Dad decided to stop catching fish and go to work in the factory instead.

text: 爸爸話：「每個月收入多咗，間唔中可以買零食畀家輝同家寶！」
eng: Dad said, "I earn a lot every month, and I can buy snacks for Jia Fai and Jia Bao from time to time!"

text: 工廠起完一間又一間，塞滿成條村。
eng: Factories were built one after another, filling the entire village.

text: 村長心諗：「冇晒地起工廠，點算呢？呀！斬晒啲樹，噉咪有地囉！」
eng: The village chief thought to himself, "What if there is no land to build a factory?

text: 村長一聲下令，村民落手落腳斬晒啲大樹。
eng: The village chief gave an order, and the villagers personally cut down some large trees.

text: 冇幾耐，新嘅工廠又起好喇！
eng: Not long after, the new factory was built again!

text: 爸爸話：「其實冇大樹都冇咩問題吖。」
eng: Dad said, "Actually, there is no problem without big trees."

text: 家輝問媽媽：「唔知狸貓先生間屋而家點呢？」
eng: Jia Fai asked his mother, "I wonder if Mr. Tanuki's house is ordered now?"

text: 狸貓先生住喺樹窿入面，冇咗樹，佢好可能要露宿街頭。
eng: Mr. Tanuki lives in a tree hole, and without the tree, he is likely to sleep on the streets.

text: 媽媽好擔心，同家輝講：「我哋去探下狸貓先生，睇下佢而家咩環境啦！」
eng: My mother was worried, and said to Jiahui, "I'll go visit Mr. Tanuki and see how he is now!"

text: 於是家輝家寶一家出發去狸貓先生住嘅郊野公園。
eng: So the family set off to Mr. Tanuki to live in a country park.

text: 瘦猛猛嘅狸貓先生見到家輝嚟咗，就喺最後一樖大樹後面行出嚟。
eng: Mr. Tanuki saw Jiahui coming, and walked out behind the last big tree.

text: 佢攬住家輝，眼濕濕話：「家輝！我聽日要搬喇！其他狸貓已經搬得七七八八，我唔走唔得喇……」
eng: He hugged Jiahui and burst into tears: "Jiahui, I'm moving tomorrow! The other tanukis have already moved, I can't leave anymore..."

text: 爸爸好傷心，好後悔當初支持啲村民斬晒啲樹起工廠。
eng: Dad was very sad and regretted supporting some villagers to set up factories.

text: 「有冇辦法變返以前噉樣？我唔要工廠，可唔可以畀返大樹我？」家輝好急切噉問。
eng: I don't want the factory, can you give me back the tree?" asked Ka Fai eagerly.

text: 爸爸有啲為難噉講：「種樹並唔係一朝一夕嘅事——」
eng: Dad said with some embarrassment: "Planting trees is not something that happens overnight--"

text: 「有……有！」狸貓先生有啲口窒窒噉插口：「有一個方法！
eng: "Yes... Yes!" Mr. Tanuki stammered a little, "There is a way!

text: 後山有條魔法蟲蟲，聽講只要對住佢誠心許願，願望就會成真。」
eng: There is a magic insect in the back mountain, and I heard that as long as you sincerely make a wish to him, the wish will come true. 」

text: 家輝同家寶嗱嗱臨去後山！幾經辛苦，佢哋終於揾到魔法蟲蟲。
eng: After several hard work, they finally found the magic worm.

text: 佢哋望住蟲蟲許願：「魔法蟲蟲，請你幫我哋將漁村變返以前噉，好多大樹吖！」
eng: They looked at the insects and made a wish: "Magic insects, please help me turn the fishing village back to the way it used to be, a lot of big trees!"

text: 蟲蟲冇反應。家輝再大聲許願：「請你幫我哋條村生返好多大樹吖！」
eng: The bugs didn't respond. Jia Fai made another loud wish: "Please help me get back a lot of big trees in the village!"

text: 蟲蟲仲係冇反應。家輝擰轉頭，想揾狸貓先生，至發現佢根本冇跟嚟後山！
eng: The bugs still didn't respond. Jiahui turned his head and wanted to find Mr. Tanuki, only to find that he didn't follow Houshan at all!

text: 「狸貓先生已經起行去新嘅屋企喇。佢唔想你傷心，所以冇同你講再見……」
eng: "Mr. Tanuki has already got up and gone to his new home. He didn't want you to be sad, so he didn't say goodbye to you .................."

text: 原來根本冇魔法蟲蟲，發生過嘅事係冇得從頭嚟過。
eng: It turned out that there were no magic insects at all, and what happened was not from scratch.

text: 小漁村一步一步變成今日嘅城市，村民越嚟越多，狸貓越嚟越少。
eng: Step by step, the small fishing village has become the city it is today, with more and more villagers and fewer and fewer tanukis.

text: 而家家輝一諗起狸貓先生，就會同朋友講：
eng: Now when Jia Fai thinks of Mr. Tanuki, he will say to his friends:

text: 「我以前有個朋友係狸貓！好得意㗎！」
eng: "I used to have a friend who was a tanuki!

text: 朋友聽完都會笑佢：「傻的嗎？人又點同狸貓做朋友呀？」
eng: Friends would laugh at him after hearing this: "Stupid, how can people be friends with tanukis?"

text: 法蒂瑪同月亮
eng: Fatima and the Moon

text: 佢真係好鍾意呢個小生命，係咁可愛，咁柔軟，又咁靚。
eng: He really likes this little life, it is so cute, so soft, and so beautiful.

text: 喺世界地圖入面，佢連一點微塵嘅位置都冇。
eng: On the map of the world, he doesn't even have the location of a speck of dust.

text: 呢座島就好似廣闊海洋中嘅一塊碎片仔，方圓幾百米，除咗海水、海龜同魚，就咩都冇。
eng: The island is like a child of debris in the vast ocean, with a radius of several hundred meters, and there is nothing but seawater, turtles, and fish.

text: 佢細到一班細路仔邊跑邊玩，只要半日就可以繞島一圈；
eng: He is so small that a group of children can run and play at the same time, and they can go around the island in half a day;

text: 一隻啱啱起身嘅海龜晨運噉游，一粒鐘就可以繞一圈。
eng: A sea turtle that has just woken up in the morning exercises swim like this, and a bell can go around in a circle.

text: 呢座島就係咁細。
eng: The island is just that small.

text: 尋日佢先發現一朵完全未見過嘅植物，日頭會打開晒啲葉，夜晚就好似蝦米噉捲成一團；
eng: Yesterday he had only discovered a plant that he had never seen before, which would open some leaves during the day and roll up like a shrimp at night;

text: 今日佢就喺沙灘揾到一個好靚嘅大貝殼，喺陽光之下會閃出七彩光芒，就好似有條彩虹靜雞雞匿咗喺入面噉。
eng: Today he found a beautiful large shell on the beach, which would shine in the sun, as if a rainbow had crept into it.

text: 大海係幾咁神秘，入面又有幾咁多得意嘅事！
eng: How mysterious the sea is, and what lovely things are inside!

text: 「月亮、月亮，我幾時先可以去大海睇下呀？」
eng: "Moon, moon, when can I go to the sea?"

text: 「等你大個啲，明白大海有好嘅一面、亦有衰嘅一面嗰陣。」
eng: "When you grow up, you understand that there is a good side to the sea and a bad side."

text: 月亮每次都噉答。
eng: The moon replied every time.

text: 「究竟幾時先係大個啲呢？去到媽媽條腰咁高？
eng: "When is it going to grow up?

text: 定係夠力拎得起一隻大螺？而且大海咁好，又點可能會係衰？」
eng: Or can you afford a big snail, and the sea is so good, how can it be bad?"

text: 游到成條魚噉，連哥哥都冇佢游得咁好。
eng: Swims like a fish, even his brother doesn't swim as well as him.

text: 佢以前一直覺得島仔係全世界最靚嘅，點知原來海底世界仲要靚十萬倍！
eng: He had always thought that the island was the most beautiful in the world, but how did he know that the underwater world was 100,000 times more beautiful!

text: 橙色嘅珊瑚、黑白相間嘅熱帶魚、奇形怪狀嘅石頭、成個人咁大嘅海龜……
eng: Orange corals, black and white tropical fish, strangely shaped rocks, turtles the size of a whole person...

text: 每一樣嘢都好新奇。
eng: Everything is new.

text: 有一晚佢帶埋防水電筒去到海邊，想靜雞雞去游水。
eng: One night he took a waterproof flashlight to the beach and wanted to go for a swim quietly.

text: 因為佢實在太想知道夜晚嘅海底係點喇！
eng: Because he really wants to know what is going on at night at the bottom of the sea!

text: 究竟啲魚係唔係去晒瞓覺？海龜又會唔會反肚瞓？
eng: Are these fish going to sleep? Are turtles going to sleep?

text: 得啲植物孤零零噉順水擺動，粒聲唔出，可能都已經瞓咗。
eng: Only a few plants swayed alone along the water, without a sound, probably asleep.

text: 突然，佢覺得有啲唔對路。佢覺得水流嘅感覺唔同咗。
eng: Suddenly, he felt that something was wrong. He felt that the water felt different.

text: 原來出面落緊大雨，又吹緊大風，所以海入面先有咁多暗流。
eng: It turned out that it was raining heavily outside and the wind was blowing, so there were so many undercurrents in the sea.

text: 之後先抬起頭去揾啱啱救起自己嘅光——原來係月亮。
eng: After that, I first looked up and looked for the light that had just saved me - it turned out to be the moon.

text: 「大海充滿智慧同寶藏，不過同時都暗藏好多危險。」
eng: "The sea is full of wisdom and treasures, but it also hides many dangers."

text: 月亮繼續講：「微風可以令你涼爽，不過一旦變得暴烈，可以摧毀你嘅家園。
eng: The moon continued: "A breeze can keep you cool, but when it becomes violent, it can destroy your home.

text: 喺黑夜散步，會令你覺得平靜，不過亦可能會不知不覺噉帶你去咗懸崖邊。
eng: Walking in the dark will make you feel calm, but it may also take you to the edge of a cliff before you know it.

text: 樹木畀咗好多資源我哋，不過當佢跌落嚟嗰陣，可能會奪去你嘅生命。
eng: Trees give us a lot of resources, but when they fall, they can take your life.

text: 「多謝你啊月亮，我以後唔會再咁自大㗎喇。」
eng: "Thank you, Moon, I won't be so arrogant again."

text: 月亮微笑，月光柔柔噉照落暴雨下嘅大海。
eng: The moon smiles, and the moonlight softly shines on the sea under the rainstorm.

text: 大海仍然好安靜，就好似咩事都冇發生過。
eng: The sea is still quiet, like nothing has happened.

text: 「噉就乖喇。按照大自然法則，我係唔可以干涉你哋嘅事。
eng: "That's good. According to the laws of nature, I cannot interfere in your affairs.

text: 佢唔想冇咗月亮，佢唔想冇咗呢個咁重要嘅朋友。
eng: He didn't want to lose the moon, he didn't want to lose such an important friend.

text: 「即使你再聽唔到我把聲，見唔到我個樣，我嘅月光、我嘅顏色仍然會喺天上面陪住你。
eng: "Even if you can't hear my voice or see my appearance, my moonlight and my color will still be with you in the sky.

text: 我亦會一直喺月球嘅另一面望住你，所以你唔使傷心㗎……」
eng: I'll always be watching you from the other side of the moon, so you don't have to be sad..."

text: 佢面上嘅月光已經消失，而天空個月亮，就只剩返一個散發住淺黃色光嘅空殼，唔識講嘢，亦冇温柔嘅目光。
eng: The moonlight on his face had vanished, and the sky was moonlit, leaving only an empty shell with a pale yellow light, unable to speak, nor to look tenderly.

text: 會唔會係自己唔小心浸親，又咁好彩飄返去岸邊，就幻想係月亮救咗自己？
eng: Could it be that I accidentally soaked in it, and I was so lucky to float back to the shore, and I imagined that the moon saved me?

text: 佢唔肯定。佢淨係知每晚感受到月光輕撫嘅時候，內心都出奇地温暖，就好似有一個人喺遠處祝福緊自己……
eng: He wasn't sure. All he knew was that when he felt the moonlight caressing him every night, his heart was surprisingly warm, like a person blessing himself from afar...

text: 后羿射日・嫦娥奔月
eng: Houyi shooting at the suns, Chang'e running to the moon

text: 傳説話呢個世界本身唔止一個太陽。
eng: Legend has it that the world originally had more than one sun.

text: 你哋估下有幾多個？
eng: Guess how many there were?

text: 兩個？三個？唔係！係十個太陽！
eng: Two? Three? No! There were ten suns!

text: 大家唔使驚，嗰陣十個太陽都好乖。
eng: Don't worry! The ten suns were all very well-behaved at that time.

text: 喺好遙遠嘅東方，有一個温泉，叫做湯谷，係十個太陽休息同沖涼嘅地方。
eng: In the Far East, there was a hot spring called Hot Spring Valley. This was where the ten suns rest and bathe.

text: 温泉隔籬有一棵樹，叫做扶桑。
eng: Next to the hot spring was a tree called Fusang.

text: 呢十個太陽攰嘅時候，就會輪流飛上樹枝上面休息。
eng: When these ten suns were tired, they would take turns flying up the branches to rest.

text: 到第二日天光，就到另一個太陽出動。
eng: By daylight the next day, it was time for another sun to set out.

text: 十個太陽好有規律噉輪更，所以一直以嚟都相安無事。
eng: The ten suns worked in regular shifts, so they had always been at peace with each other.

text: 忽然間有一日，呢十個太陽好想一齊出去玩，噉就大鑊喇！
eng: Suddenly, one day, these ten suns really wanted to hang out together, which created a big problem.

text: 十個太陽同時出現喺天空，地面變到好熱好熱。
eng: Ten suns appeared in the sky at the same time, and the ground became very hot.

text: 呢個時候，有一位射箭好叻嘅勇士，佢叫做后羿。
eng: At that time, there was a warrior who was very good at archery, and his name was Houyi.

text: 於是皇帝送咗一把紅色嘅弓畀后羿，呢把弓要全世界最大力嘅人先拉得開；
eng: As a result, the emperor gave a red bow to Houyi as a gift. This bow could only be drawn open by the strongest person in the world.

text: 后羿望向天空，佢見到十個太陽好開心噉玩緊，但係大地上面嘅人類實在太辛苦喇。
eng: Hou Yi looked at the sky and saw the ten suns playing happily, but the humans on the earth were suffering terribly.

text: 呢個就係點解天空得一個太陽嘅故事。
eng: This is the story of why there is only one sun in the sky.

text: 后羿立咗大功，佢身邊嘅人應該好戥佢開心啦？事實唔係。
eng: Hou Yi had accomplished a great achievement, and the people around him should feel very happy for him, right?

text: 后羿有位好靚嘅太太，叫做嫦娥。
eng: That wasn't the case. Houyi had a very beautiful wife named Chang'e.

text: 后羿成日出差，唔喺屋企。
eng: Houyi was away on official duty and wasn't home all the time.

text: 嫦娥覺得好悶，又好寂寞，於是佢就想離開后羿。
eng: Chang'e felt very bored and lonely, so she wanted to leave Houyi.

text: 有一日，嫦娥趁后羿出差唔喺度，乘機偷咗啲藥。
eng: One day, Chang'e took the opportunity of Houyi's being out on official duty and stole the medicine.

text: 然後等咗好多日，后羿仲未返屋企。
eng: Then she waited for many days, and Houyi still had not returned home yet.

text: 漫長嘅夜晚，嫦娥真係頂唔順喇！
eng: Chang'e really couldn't stand it anymore on such a long night!

text: 佢望住天上面嘅月亮，決心離開后羿！
eng: She looked up at the moon in the sky and decided to leave Houyi!

text: 冇耐，佢就慢慢飄起，飄下飄下就飛咗上月亮。
eng: Shortly after, she started to float upwards and eventually floated to the moon.

text: 當然，嫦娥有帶埋佢隻寵物玉兔一齊飛。
eng: Of course, Chang'e had brought her pet Jade Rabbit to fly with her.

text: 飛上月亮之後，嫦娥起咗座宮殿畀自己同玉兔住，呢個宮殿叫做廣寒宮。
eng: After flying to the moon, Chang'e built a palace for herself and Jade Rabbit to live in. This palace is called Guanghan Palace.

text: 所以有人話，當我哋望向月亮嗰陣，會見到有隻兔仔喺度整藥。
eng: Therefore some people say that when we look at the moon, we see a little rabbit there making medicine.

text: 講返嫦娥。嫦娥實在太長命，佢發覺喺月亮仲悶過喺地球，
eng: Back to Chang'e. Chang'e is too long-lived. She found that the moon is more boring than the earth.

text: 所以每到夜晚，我哋都會見到嫦娥望住我哋，因為佢好掛住佢嘅親人朋友......
eng: So every night, we will all see her staring at us because she misses her family and friends ...

text: 古宅心慌慌
eng: Ancient House Panicked

text: 傳說某個地方有一間古老大屋，大屋入面有隻專食細路嘅惡鬼。
eng: Legend has it that somewhere there is an old house with a demon who eats children.

text: 某日，有三個細路喺大屋出面打板球。
eng: One day, three children were playing cricket outside the house.

text: 「哎吔！個波呀！」家豪一唔小心，將個波打咗入大屋嘅花園。
eng: "Ouch, that ball!" Jia Hao accidentally hit the ball into the garden of the big house.

text: 美怡想入去執返個波，但家豪嗌住佢。
eng: Mei Yi wants to go in and retrieve a ball, but Jia Hao calls out to him.

text: 「唔好呀！你冇聽過咩？間屋入面有鬼，專食小朋友㗎！」
eng: "No, haven't you heard, there are ghosts in the house, eat children!"

text: 家豪指住間屋，驚驚青青噉講。
eng: Jiahao pointed to the house, afraid that Qingqing would say so.

text: 美怡唔係好信，但都停咗喺度冇再入去。
eng: Mei Yi didn't believe it, but they all stopped here and didn't go in again.

text: 「噉而家點算好呀？」可盈問。
eng: "What should I do now?" asked Keying.

text: 「不如我哋問下郵差叔叔吖？佢好似每個禮拜都會去送信，姿勢好純熟，手腳好迅速……」家豪建議。
eng: "Why don't we ask Uncle Postman, he seems to deliver letters every week, his posture is very skillful, his hands and feet are very fast..."

text: 於是，可盈去咗揾郵差叔叔。
eng: So, Keying went to find Uncle Postman.

text: 「叔叔，請問……請問……街口間古老大屋係咪真係有鬼？
eng: "Uncle, may I ask ... Excuse me...... Is there really a ghost in the old house at the entrance of the street?

text: 我哋想入去執返個波，但聽講入面有隻鬼，好鍾意食小朋友……」
eng: We wanted to go in and retrieve a ball, but I heard that there was a ghost inside, and we like to eat children..."

text: 郵差笑咗笑，細細聲同可盈講︰「其實，屋入面個住客，係鍾意食小朋友……整嘅蛋糕。」
eng: The postman smiled and whispered to Keying: "Actually, the tenants in the house like to eat children... Whole cake.

text: 佢講完再笑一笑，就踩單車走咗……
eng: After he said it, he smiled again and rode away...

text: 可盈返嚟將同一番説話講畀家豪同美怡聽，三個人都各有諗法。
eng: Keying came back and told Jiahao and Meiyi the same words, and the three of them had their own ideas.

text: 「我哋好唔好整個蛋糕送入去？」美怡問。
eng: "Shall we deliver the whole cake?" asked Mei Yi.

text: 「郵差叔叔會唔會呃我哋，想我哋俾鬼食？」家豪好認真噉講。
eng: "Will Uncle Postman lie to us and think that we will be eaten by ghosts?" said Jiahao seriously.

text: 「如果……如果……佢蛋糕又食……小朋友又食，噉點算好？不如……唔好要個波啦？」可盈想喊。
eng: "What if... If...... He cakes and eats ... What should the child do if he eats again? Don't want a ball?" Ke Ying wanted to cry.

text: 「但個波係我嘅生日禮物嚟……不如噉，我哋沓正中午十二點去，爸爸講過中午陽氣最盛，啲鬼怪法力會最弱！」美怡大膽提議。
eng: "But that ball was my birthday present to ... ... It's better like this, let's go at twelve o'clock on the hour, Dad said that the sun is the strongest at noon, and a little ghost mana will be the weakest!"

text: 「先旨聲明，就算你哋唔敢去，我都會照去！」佢補充。
eng: "Statement, even if you don't dare to go, I will go!" he added.

text: 「去咪去，有咩好驚喎。呢個世界邊有鬼㗎！可盈你嚟唔嚟？你唔係驚呀？」家豪大大聲講，似係為自己壯膽。
eng: "Go don't go, what is there to be afraid of." Aren't you afraid?" said Jia Hao loudly, as if to bolster himself.

text: 「你哋去……我就去……」可盈細細聲噉講。
eng: "You guys go ... ... I'll go ... .

text: 就係噉，佢哋真係一齊整咗個蛋糕，約定禮拜六中午十二點，去古老大屋，探險！
eng: That's it, they really made a cake together, agreed to go to the old house at twelve noon on Saturday, and explore!

text: 話咁快嚟到禮拜六。
eng: Saturday soon.

text: 「叮噹。」佢哋嚟到大屋門口，撳咗一下鐘。
eng: "Jingle Bell." They came to the door of the house and rang the bell.

text: 「叮噹。」都係冇人應門。
eng: "Jingle Bell." Still no one answered.

text: 「叮噹。」突然，大門打開，開門嘅係一個老婆婆。
eng: "Jingle Bell." Suddenly, the door opened, and it was an old woman who opened it.

text: 家豪嚇到褪後一步，可盈就匿喺家豪身後。
eng: Jiahao was so frightened that he took a step back, and Keying hid behind Jiahao.

text: 「婆婆，我哋整咗個蛋糕畀你呀！」美怡講完後，婆婆望住佢哋。
eng: "Mother-in-law, we have made a cake for you!" After Mei Yi finished speaking, her mother-in-law stared at them.

text: 美怡再講多次，婆婆先識得「咦咿哦哦」噉問佢哋嚟做乜。
eng: Mei Yi said it many times before her mother-in-law knew how to ask them what they were doing here.

text: 呢個時候，佢哋先發現婆婆隻耳仔撞聾，唔係好聽到嘢……
eng: At this time, they found that the mother-in-law only had a deaf ear and did not hear very much ... ...

text: 婆婆見佢哋咁有心整咗個蛋糕過嚟，就請佢哋入屋。
eng: The mother-in-law saw that they had such a heart to make a cake, so she invited them to enter the door.

text: 啲小朋友知道婆婆隻耳仔唔好，就特登講得慢啲大聲啲，話想攞返個板球。
eng: The child knows that the mother-in-law has bad ears, so he deliberately speaks slowly and loudly, saying that he wants to get back a cricket ball.

text: 原來婆婆係一個好友善嘅人，只係聽嘢唔太清楚，所以好少出街，亦好少同啲街坊傾偈。
eng: It turns out that the mother-in-law is a very friendly person, but she doesn't hear things very clearly, so she rarely goes out on the street and rarely chats with some neighbors.

text: 啲大人見婆婆噉，以為婆婆唔鍾意俾人騷擾，就作個故仔話間屋有鬼，等啲小朋友唔好去打擾佢。
eng: These adults see their mother-in-law and think that their mother-in-law does not like to be harassed, so they make a story that there are ghosts in the house, and wait for children not to disturb him.

text: 美怡佢哋同婆婆傾咗好耐偈，仲一齊食埋蛋糕先走。
eng: Meiyi, they talked with their mother-in-law for a long time, and they ate cake together and left first.

text: 婆婆仲話歡迎佢哋得閒過嚟再玩過添。
eng: The mother-in-law also said that they are welcome to come and play again when they are free.

text: 之後，逢親佢哋打咗咩板球、羽毛球、乒乓球、排球或者足球入屋，婆婆都會執返畀佢哋。
eng: Later, whenever they play cricket, badminton, table tennis, volleyball or football, the mother-in-law will also pick them up.

text: 然後每個禮拜六中午十二點，佢哋都會帶住蛋糕去古老大屋，探婆婆！
eng: Then every Saturday at twelve o'clock at noon, they would take the cake to the old house and visit the mother-in-law!

text: 老鼠仔班班
eng: Mouse son class class

text: 班班係一隻住喺樹林入面嘅老鼠仔，屋企有媽咪，仲有十七個兄弟姊妹。
eng: Banban is a rat child who lives in the woods, has a mother at home, and seventeen siblings.

text: 佢好犀利㗎，成日橫衝直撞，天不怕地不怕。
eng: He is very powerful, always on the rampage, and he is not afraid of the sky.

text: 直到有一次，班班喺附近農場中咗陷阱，差啲甩唔到身，佢先開始識驚，唔敢四圍去農場度揾粟米食。
eng: It wasn't until once, when Ban Ban fell into a trap on a nearby farm and almost couldn't get out, that he began to be afraid to go around the farm to find corn food.

text: 但冇嘢食個肚仔又會餓……
eng: But it's okay to eat a little belly and get hungry ... ...

text: 佢問媽咪點算好，媽咪問返佢轉頭︰「你最叻係咩先？」
eng: He asked his mother what to do, and her mother asked him back: "What is your best cow?"

text: 「挖地洞！我最叻就係挖地洞！」
eng: My smartest is to dig a hole!"

text: 於是，佢每日就帶住太陽眼鏡、望遠鏡、放大鏡，仲有藥水膠布去挖地洞，想出去睇下其他地方有冇好嘢食。
eng: So he went to dig holes every day with sunglasses, binoculars, magnifying glasses, and potion tape, wanting to go out and see if there was anything good to eat elsewhere.

text: 班班挖呀挖，挖呀挖，挖到唔知自己去咗邊，就諗住伸個頭出去睇下。
eng: Ban Ban dug and dug, dug and dug, dug until he didn't know where he went, and was ready to stick out and see.

text: 估唔到頭一伸，就嚇咗一大跳！
eng: I didn't expect that as soon as my head was extended, I was shocked!

text: 「喂，老鼠仔，你邊度嚟㗎，叫咩名呀？」
eng: "Hey, son mouse, where are you and what's your name?"

text: 班班眨一眨眼，發現講嘢嘅係一個巨人，佢笑住噉望住自己。
eng: Ban Ban blinked and found that it was a giant who was speaking, and he was staring at himself like this with a smile.

text: 「我叫家明，係一個探險家，你呢？」
eng: "My name is Jiaming and I'm an explorer, how about you?"

text: 「唔使驚喎，我好鍾意動物㗎。」家明繼續講。
eng: "Don't be afraid, I love animals. Jia Ming continued.

text: 「真、真、真係？」班班有啲驚青。
eng: "Really, really, really?"

text: 「梗係冇呃你啦！」家明拍晒心口話。
eng: "Of course I didn't lie to you!" said Jia Ming patting his chest.

text: 「我叫班班……都係嚟探險㗎！」班班唔驚喇，仲好大聲噉答。
eng: "My name is Banban... It's still an adventure!" Ban Ban was not afraid, and replied loudly.

text: 「噉就好喇！我啱啱揾到一條路，應該係通去啲好有趣嘅地方，你一唔一齊嚟呀？我可以保護你！」
eng: I just found a way, it should be a very interesting place, don't you go together?

text: 於是，班班跟住家明，大大方方上返路面行。
eng: So, Banban followed Jiaming and went back to the road in a generous way.

text: 佢哋穿過森林，經過河流，翻過山谷，去咗好多唔同嘅地方。
eng: They went through forests, through rivers, over valleys, and to many different places.

text: 班班對新嘢好有興趣，問咗家明好多問題。
eng: Ban Ban is very interested in Xinxian and asks him a lot of questions.

text: 「呢隻咩嚟㗎？」班班問。
eng: "What is this?" asked Banban.

text: 「呢隻係羚羊，佢頭上有角，唔止跳得遠，仲跑得好快添。」家明好細心噉答。
eng: "It's just an antelope, he has horns on his head, and he not only jumps far, but also runs fast." Jia Ming replied very carefully.

text: 「羚羊先生你好，我叫班班……」但一句話都未講完，羚羊就跳走咗。
eng: "Hello Mr. Antelope, my name is Banban..." But before he could finish his sentence, Antelope jumped away.

text: 「嘩，真係好快呀！」班班大叫。
eng: "Wow, it's really fast!" shouted Banban.

text: 佢哋繼續行。「家明，你聞唔聞到，附近啲果實好香！」
eng: They kept walking. "Jiaming, don't you smell it, the fruits nearby are very fragrant!"

text: 班班四圍望，發現樹上面有好多果實，就好興奮噉問家明係咩嚟。
eng: Ban Ban looked around and found that there were many fruits on the tree, and asked Jiaming as if he was very excited.

text: 「呢啲係木橘，味道香甜，食咗可以幫助消化。」
eng: "It is a wood orange, which has a sweet taste and can help digestion when eaten. 」

text: 佢哋眼甘甘望住啲木橘，好想食，但摘唔到……
eng: They stared at some wood oranges with envy, they wanted to eat them, but they couldn't pick them ...

text: 呢個時候，有隻大馬騮爬咗上樹，摘咗兩個木橘，然後去到佢哋面前。
eng: At this time, a large monkey climbed up the tree, picked two wood oranges, and went to them.

text: 「家明，請你哋食啦。」大馬騮遞上木橘。
eng: "Jiaming, please eat." The big monkey handed the wood orange.

text: 「哦，原來係葉猴伯伯！」家明大嗌。
eng: "Oh, it's Uncle Langur!" scolded Jia Ming.

text: 「咦，今日有新朋友喎。」
eng: "Hey, new friends today. 」

text: 「你好，我叫班班，多謝葉猴伯伯！」
eng: "Hello, my name is Banban, thank you Uncle Langur!"

text: 「乖，你哋慢慢食……」
eng: "Well, you guys eat slowly ... ..."

text: 佢哋一路食一路傾，傾下傾下，食下食下，個天開始變黑，係時候返屋企喇。
eng: They ate and talked, chatted and ate, ate and ate, the sky began to get dark, it was time to go home.

text: 班班返到屋企，將今日遇到巨人嘅事話咗畀媽咪聽。
eng: Banban came home and told his mother about meeting the giant today.

text: 媽咪聽完都好驚訝呢個世界仲有好嘅巨人。
eng: After listening to it, my mother was also surprised that there were good giants in this world.

text: 「我一開始都以為家明係設陷阱嗰啲壞人，但好彩唔係，我哋仲做咗好朋友添！」班班笑住噉話。
eng: "At first, I thought Jiaming was setting traps for those bad guys, but fortunately not, we became good friends again!" said Banban with a smile.

text: 「我哋老鼠生存唔易，每一次出去揾食都係一場冒險。
eng: "It is not easy for us rats to survive, and every time we go out to find food, it is an adventure.

text: 今次你嘅勇氣令你得到一份友誼，你要好好珍惜啊。」
eng: This time your courage will give you a friendship, and you should cherish it. 」

text: 就係噉，老鼠仔班班繼續小心翼翼噉接觸外面嘅世界，同時內心期待住下次再同家明一齊冒險……
eng: That's it, the rat child class continues to carefully contact the outside world, while looking forward to the next adventure with Ieaki ...

text: 凍檸茶
eng: Frozen Lemon Tea

text: 一個夏天嘅晏晝，嘉善同佢啲朋友仔喺樹蔭底下玩捉伊人。
eng: One summer afternoon, Jiashan and his friends were playing catching Yiren under the shade of a tree.

text: 玩啊玩，大家捉嚟捉去，又匿嚟匿去，眨下眼就過咗成個晏晝。
eng: Play and play, everyone grabs and catches, hides and hides, and the whole afternoon passes in the blink of an eye.

text: 因為天氣好熱，大家都開始覺得口渴。
eng: Because it's hot, everyone starts to feel thirsty.

text: 玩到攰嘅嘉善話：「天氣咁熱，好想飲返杯凍冰冰嘅嘢飲啊！

eng: This week is a rare long holiday, Dad said to take this opportunity to go far, so he took Amu and Mom to the New Territories,

text: 爸爸媽媽即刻笑到收唔到聲，佢哋指住眼前嘅黃色物體話畀阿木知，前面嗰啲就係香蕉喇！

text: 媽媽平時整香蕉船畀阿木食嗰陣，啲香蕉全部都切好晒，所以阿木先以為香蕉係白色嘅。

text: 精衛填海

text: 今日我要講嘅，係一個為咗向大海報復，可以去到幾盡嘅故事⋯⋯

text: 從前有一個皇帝，佢叫做炎帝。炎帝有一個女，叫做女娃。

eng: But firstly, his father was not free all day, and secondly, the sea was too far away, so the girl never saw the sea once.

text: 有一日，女娃冇同爸爸講聲，就自己向住太陽升起嘅方向，撐艇仔出海。
eng: One day, without saying a word to her father, the girl went to sea in the direction of the rising sun and supported the boat.

text: 不幸嘅係，海上突然刮起狂風大浪，風浪好似山一樣咁高，霎時間就打沉咗女娃隻艇仔。
eng: Unfortunately, there was a sudden storm on the sea, and the wind and waves were as high as a mountain, and in an instant the little boat of the girl was sunk.

text: 女娃跌咗落海，最終俾無情嘅大海吞沒，永遠都返唔到嚟。
eng: The girl is lost in the sea, and is eventually swallowed by the merciless sea, never to come up.

text: 炎帝知道消息之後好傷心。

text: 呢隻雀仔嘅叫聲好似講緊「精衛」呢兩個字噉，所以佢個名叫「精衛」。
eng: The bird's call seems to say the word "Jingwei\

text: 精衛痛恨無情嘅大海奪走咗自己嘅生命，佢決心要復仇！
eng: Jingwei hates the merciless sea for taking his life, and he is determined to take revenge!

text: 佢飛向西面嘅大山，擔咗一塊石仔，之後再飛向東面嘅大海。

text: 佢一路飛，一路悲鳴，一鬆口，石仔就跌入大海。
eng: He flew all the way, while wailing and letting go, the small stone fell into the sea.

text: 原來精衛係想填平大海。
eng: It turns out that Jingwei wants to fill the sea.

text: 大海忍唔住恥笑佢：「雀仔呀雀仔，你無謂嘥心機喇——就算你做一千年、一萬年，都唔使旨意將我填平呀！」
eng: The sea couldn't help but laugh at him: "Birds, you don't have to be scheming - even if you do it for a thousand or ten thousand years, don't expect to fill me in!"

eng: Jingwei replied: "Even if I do a thousand years, ten thousand years, achieve the end of the world, achieve the end of the universe, I will fill you in!"

text: 大海話：「點解你咁憎我呢？」
eng: Daihai Words: "Why do you hate me so much?"

text: 精衛回答：「你奪走咗我年輕嘅生命。你害得我一個，就會再害第二個、第三個人。
eng: Jingwei replied: "You took away my young life." If you hurt one of me, you will harm a second or third person.

text: 精衛不停來回飛，佢一路飛，一路擔石仔或者樹枝。
eng: Jingwei kept going back and forth, and he flew while grabbing small stones or branches.

text: 過咗一年、十年、一百年，佢都冇停過。
eng: After a year, ten years, a hundred years, he did not stop.

text: 過咗一萬年，佢嘅決心依然有增無減——
eng: After 10,000 years, his determination is still growing unabated -

text: 就算佢嘅力量係幾咁微小，佢相信終有一日，佢可以將東面嘅大海填平！
eng: No matter how small his strength is, he believes that one day, he can fill the sea to the east!

text: 只要精衛一日喺度，一日佢都唔會停。
eng: As long as Jingwei is here for a day, he will not stop for a day.

text: 我係陳凱琪
eng: I'm Kaiqi Chen

text: 陳凱琪有一身黑皮膚，眼睛圓碌碌，個鼻同個咀都唔細。
eng: Chen Kaiqi has dark skin, round eyes, a nose and a kiss.

text: 佢笑起上嚟，有一個酒窩喺左面，好得意。
eng: He laughed and had a dimple on the left side, which was cute.

text: 你班裏面係咪都有一個陳凱琪？
eng: Is there also a Chen Kaiqi in your class?

text: 噉你班裏面嗰個陳凱琪係咪好文靜㗎？
eng: Then is that Chen Kaiqi in your class very quiet?

text: 係咪好勤力讀書？佢個樣點㗎？
eng: Did he study hard? What does he look like?

text: 我講呢個陳凱琪呢，佢唔高又唔矮，排班隊嘅時候，佢成日俾老師排佢喺隊中間。
eng: I said this Chen Kaiqi, he is not tall and not short, when he is in line, he is always ranked in the middle of the line by the teacher.

text: 前面有比佢細粒嘅同學，後面有比佢高大嘅同學，佢就係被夾喺中間。
eng: There were classmates younger than him in front and classmates taller in the back, and he was caught in the middle.

text: 早會嘅時候，陳凱琪成日要趷高腳先至可以睇清楚少少講緊嘢嗰位老師個樣。
eng: During the morning meeting, Chen Kaiqi always had to lift her feet to see clearly the appearance of the teacher who was talking a little bit.

text: 不過，呢個動作，佢都已經好耐冇做過喇，
eng: However, this action, he has not done for a long time,

text: 因為啲老師訓話嚟嚟去去都係噉嘅樣，噉嘅表情，都冇乜好睇，不如擘大眼發白日夢好過。
eng: Because these teachers' admonitions come and go like this, such expressions are not very good-looking, it is better to open your eyes and daydream.

text: 其實，我講緊嗰個陳凱琪都只係一名普通嘅小學五年級學生，應該同你識嗰個差唔多啦。
eng: In fact, I'm saying that Chen Kaiqi is just an ordinary fifth-grade elementary school student, which should be similar to the one you know.

text: 不過，呢個女仔身邊嘅人總係可以好輕易噉就將佢記住喺個心度。
eng: However, the people around this girl can always easily remember it in their hearts.

text: 陳凱琪，陳凱琪，好親切噉嗌佢個名，佢就會笑瞇瞇噉應你︰「乜嘢事啊？」
eng: Chen Kaiqi, Chen Kaiqi, very affectionately call his name, and he will smile and answer you: "What's going on?"

text: 但係，最近，陳凱琪為咗一件事感到有啲煩惱。
eng: However, recently, Chen Kaiqi has been a little troubled by one thing.

text: 呢一個學期，學校嚟咗一位肥老師。
eng: This semester, a fat teacher came to the school.

text: 佢外表望落去好似個博士，塊面成個波噉，戴住一副橢圓形嘅眼鏡，眼鏡細細副，眼鏡下面有一對好細嘅眼，
eng: He looks like a doctor, a whole ball, wearing an oval-shaped pair of glasses, thin glasses, and a pair of very small eyes under the glasses.

text: 佢唔使瞇起對眼都覺得佢好似瞇起對眼噉嘅樣，眼神好慈祥，但又有啲呆呆笨笨噉。
eng: He didn't have to squint his eyes to feel as if he had squinted his eyes, his eyes were very kind, but he was a little dumb.

text: 佢每日着啲衫都一樣︰吊帶褲，加件白藍格恤衫，恤衫下突出佢嗰條又肥又白嘅頸同兩對肥手臂。
eng: He wore the same clothes every day: suspenders, a white and blue checked shirt, under which his fat and white neck and two pairs of fat arms protruded.

text: 對手臂有好多好多摺。
eng: There are many, many folds on the arm.

text: 呢位老師姓魯，同學都叫佢做魯老師。
eng: This teacher's surname is Lu, and his classmates call him Teacher Lu.

text: 的確，佢又真係好老㗎喇。
eng: Indeed, he is really old again.

text: 老老師，喺啲小朋友心目中，呢個名仲係唔夠佢真人老。
eng: Old teacher, in the minds of some children, this name is still not enough for him to be really old.

text: 有傳聞話魯老師係學校嘅前校長。
eng: It is rumored that Mr. Lu is the former principal of the school.

text: 有傳聞話魯老師係現任校長嘅老爺，噉即係現任校長係前校長嘅新抱？
eng: There are rumors that Teacher Lu is the grandfather of the current principal, that is, the current principal is the daughter-in-law of the former principal?

text: (媽啊！我好亂呀！)
eng: (Mom! I'm a mess!)

text: 更有傳聞話魯老師其實係校監，嚟教三個月視察下環境……
eng: There are even rumors that Teacher Lu is actually a school supervisor who came to teach for three months to inspect the environment ...

text: 傳聞吱吱吱噉喺校園細細聲揚開去。
eng: Rumors squeaked around the campus like this.

text: 陳凱琪關心嘅唔係呢啲嗰啲傳聞，而係……
eng: Chen Kaiqi is not concerned about these rumors, but ... ...

text: 呢一個魯老師啊，佢真係太老喇，居然唔記得佢個名。
eng: This Teacher Lu, he is so old that he actually forgot his name.

text: 陳凱琪認為自己都算係明白事理，要求合理。
eng: Chen Kaiqi believes that he is also reasonable and reasonable in his demands.

text: 佢只不過要求一位一星期教佢九堂中文嘅老師記住佢個名，而且，仲係喺魯老師教咗一個月之後先至有呢個要求。
eng: He simply asked a teacher who taught him nine Chinese a week to remember his name, and he only asked for this after Teacher Lu taught for a month.

text: 每一次，陳凱琪舉手答問題，魯老師都淨係話︰「嗰位黑鼆鼆嘅同學，係，你，請你回答啦。」
eng: Every time, Chen Kaiqi raised her hand to answer the question, Teacher Lu just said: "That black simmer classmate, yes, you, please answer."

text: 或者，連「黑鼆鼆」都慳返，淨係用佢嗰隻肥手指指住坐喺課室中間嘅陳凱琪，示意佢答問題。
eng: Or, even the "black simmer" saved it, and only pointed his fat finger at Chen Kaiqi, who was sitting in the middle of the classroom, and motioned for him to answer the question.

text: 魯老師記得張永達，佢記得趙文芳，佢又記得吳康明，硬係唔記得陳凱琪呢個名，陳凱琪覺得有啲悶悶不樂。
eng: Teacher Lu remembered Zhang Yongda, he remembered Zhao Wenfang, he remembered Wu Kangming, and he forgot the name Chen Kaiqi, and Chen Kaiqi felt a little sullen.

text: 陳凱琪希望魯老師能夠記住佢個名。
eng: Chen Kaiqi hopes that Teacher Lu can remember his name.

text: 佢試過喺小息嘅時候跑到魯老師面前，叫魯老師以後唔好再叫佢做「黑鼆鼆嘅同學」，要叫佢「陳凱琪」。
eng: He once ran to Teacher Lu when he was resting and told Teacher Lu not to call him a "black classmate" in the future, but to call him "Chen Kaiqi".

text: 魯老師係噉講對唔住，解釋話佢教嘅學生太多，有時好難記住每一個學生嘅名，
eng: Teacher Lu said sorry, explaining that he taught too many students, and sometimes it was difficult to remember the name of each student,

text: 但係佢應承今次佢會記住，仲用手輕輕拍下陳凱琪個頭，叫一聲「陳凱琪」。
eng: But he promised that this time he would remember, and gently patted Chen Kaiqi's head with his hand and called "Chen Kaiqi".

text: 陳凱琪好滿意噉走開咗喇。
eng: Chen Kaiqi walked away satisfied.

text: 但係，過咗兩日，魯老師好明顯已經唔記得咗佢個名。
eng: However, after two days, it was obvious that Teacher Lu had forgotten his name.

text: 當佢想叫陳凱琪答問題嘅時候，佢話到嘴邊又講唔出嚟嘅神情已經出賣咗佢。
eng: When he wanted to ask Chen Kaiqi to answer the question, the expression that came to his lips and couldn't say had betrayed him.

text: 於是魯老師又會裝模作樣噉去揾下個座位表，但又揾唔到喎。
eng: So Mr. Lu would pretend to look for the next seating chart, but he couldn't find it.

text: 最後佢惟有叫另一位同學黃靜儀答問題，而黃靜儀根本冇舉過手！
eng: In the end, he only asked another classmate, Huang Jingyi, to answer the question, but Huang Jingyi did not raise her hand at all!

text: 同一日嘅晏晝，第二節中文課，魯老師甚至乎已經唔記得晒上晝發生嘅事，直接叫陳凱琪做「嗰位女同學」。
eng: In the afternoon of the same day, in the second Chinese class, Teacher Lu even forgot what happened in the morning and directly asked Chen Kaiqi to be "the female classmate".

text: 陳凱琪唔好意思喺全班面前提醒老師佢自己個名，但佢喺個心度係噉諗，要諗到個方法叫魯老師記住佢個名。
eng: Chen Kaiqi was embarrassed to remind the teacher of his name in front of the class, but he thought in his heart that he wanted to think of a way for Teacher Lu to remember his name.

text: 返到屋企，佢攤開寫俾魯老師嘅周記簿，用咗二百字寫咗佢嘅小小心願，
eng: When he returned home, he spread out the weekly notebook written to Teacher Lu and wrote his little wish in two hundred words,

text: 仲表明呢個只係一個好合理嘅要求，更喺文章下低貼咗一幅佢嘅近照。
eng: This also shows that this is just a very reasonable request, and a recent photo of him is posted under the article.

text: 效果？滿意。喺交咗周記簿嘅頭一個禮拜，魯老師真係記得佢個名。
eng: Results? Satisfied. In the first week after handing in the weekly bookkeeping, Mr. Lu really remembered his name.

text: 陳凱琪做咗個小統計，佢喺中文堂舉手答問題嘅次數一個禮拜總共有四十三次，即係平均每堂四點七七七七七無限個七次。
eng: Chen Kaiqi made a small statistic, and the number of times he raised his hand to answer questions in the Chinese hall was a total of 43 times a week, which is an average of 4.777 77 77 times per class.

text: 魯老師請佢答問題嘅次數有十次，每次都叫佢「陳凱琪」，準確無誤！
eng: Teacher Lu asked him to answer the questions ten times, and each time he called him "Chen Kaiqi\

text: 陳凱琪覺得好滿意。雖然，讀住魯老師喺周記簿裏面嗰句︰「名字有時不代表什麼」，
eng: Chen Kaiqi felt very satisfied. Although, reading Mr. Lu's sentence in the weekly notebook: "Sometimes the name does not mean anything",

text: 佢其實都唔係好明魯老師想講乜，但係佢好有信心魯老師今次一定會將佢個名記住。
eng: He didn't really understand what Teacher Lu wanted to say, but he was very confident that Teacher Lu would remember his name this time.

text: 但係，原來事情冇佢想像咁順利。第二個禮拜，魯老師已經唔再成日叫佢答問題。
eng: However, it turned out that things did not go as smoothly as he thought. By the second week, Mr. Lu no longer asked him to answer questions all day.

text: 可能魯老師想俾啲機會其他同學啦。始終一班有咁多個學生，老師都唔係每一個學生都可能照顧到。
eng: Maybe Teacher Lu wants to give other students a chance. There are so many students in a class all the time, and the teacher is not likely to take care of every student.

text: 呢個道理，小學五年級嘅陳凱琪係明白嘅。
eng: Chen Kaiqi, who is in the fifth grade of primary school, understands this truth.

text: 不過，到咗第三個禮拜，魯老師已經完全唔記得咗陳凱琪個名，淨係叫佢做「嗰位靚同學」，搞到全班同學喺度笑佢。
eng: However, by the third week, Teacher Lu didn't remember Chen Kaiqi's name at all, but just called him "the beautiful classmate\

text: 有冇搞錯！「黑鼆鼆」已經唔掂，家下仲要叫我做「靚同學」。
eng: "Black Black" is no longer good, and now you have to call me a "good classmate".

text: 救命啊！陳凱琪於是又喺度動腦筋，要諗個辦法令呢位老老師記住佢個名。
eng: Chen Kaiqi was using his brain again, trying to find a way to make this old teacher remember his name.

text: 佢返到屋企用電腦造咗張好精美嘅名片，仲特登用手提電話為自己自拍一張全身學生相，加一張半身嘅。
eng: He returned home and used his computer to create a beautiful business card, and deliberately used his mobile phone to take a full-body student photo for himself, plus a half-body.

text: 全身嘅貼喺名片背面，半身嗰張就貼喺自己個名隔籬。
eng: The whole body is attached to the back of the business card, and the half one is next to his name.

text: 名片上三個字好大︰陳凱琪，用咗四十八號字體，標楷字型。名下面係佢嘅班別同埋學號。
eng: Fifteen minutes on the business card is very large: Chen Kaiqi, using a font number 48, marked in italics. Below the name is his class and student number.

text: 佢將名片拎去書局過膠，放喺自製嘅盒仔裏面，綁條絲帶，送俾魯老師。
eng: He took the business card to the bookstore and glued it, put it in a small homemade box, tied a ribbon, and gave it to Teacher Lu.

text: 魯老師笑住收小禮盒。然後，每一日喺集隊之前，魯老師都會走去陳凱琪前面叫一聲「陳凱琪，早晨。」
eng: Teacher Lu smiled and accepted the small gift box. Then, every day before assembling the team, Mr. Lu would run to Chen Kaiqi and shout, "Chen Kaiqi, good morning."

text: 雖然玩玩下突然有一位肥老師無啦啦同自己講早晨係有啲煩，但係陳凱琪都會好高興噉應一聲︰「魯老師，早晨！」
eng: Although a fat teacher suddenly told himself that he was annoyed in the morning, Chen Kaiqi would also happily answer: "Teacher Lu, early!"

text: 兩個禮拜過咗，魯老師唔記得陳凱琪個名嘅跡象又出現喇！
eng: Two weeks later, signs that Teacher Lu forgot Chen Kaiqi's name appeared again!

text: 佢首先唔再叫陳凱琪答問題，跟住就叫佢「嗰位同學」，淡忘嘅情況同之前差唔多，
eng: He first stopped asking Chen Kaiqi to answer the question, and then called him "that classmate\

text: 不幸中嘅幸運係佢冇叫陳凱琪做「靚同學」或者「黑鼆鼆」或者「有個酒粒嗰個」。
eng: Unfortunately, fortunately, he did not ask Chen Kaiqi to be a "good classmate" or "black and black" or "a wine grain".

text: 陳凱琪呢幾日，都全心全意喺度諗要點樣令魯老師永遠記得佢個名。
eng: In the past few days, Chen Kaiqi has been thinking wholeheartedly about how to make Teacher Lu remember his name forever.

text: 哈，居然變得好挑戰好好玩噉。比起佢最怕嘅數學科，呢種挑戰有趣得多。
eng: Ha, it actually became very challenging and fun. The challenge was much more interesting than the math he feared the most.

text: 早會嘅時候，陳凱琪又企喺人龍中入定，專心喺度諗令魯老師記住佢個名嘅方法。
eng: At the morning meeting, Chen Kaiqi stood in the talent again, concentrating on how to make Teacher Lu remember his name.

text: 然後，佢俾同學集體嘅交談聲帶返返嚟早會度。
eng: Then, he was brought back to the morning meeting by the collective conversation of his classmates.

text: 後邊有人話︰「都話魯老師係我哋嘅校監嚟㗎啦。」
eng: Someone behind said, "They all say that Teacher Lu is our school supervisor."

text: 左面嘅就回應話︰「原來係真㗎喎。」
eng: The one on the left responded, "It's true."

text: 右邊隔籬班同學話︰「魯老師要走喇，有啲唔捨得呀。」
eng: The classmate in the next class on the right said: "Teacher Lu should go, why can't you bear it."

text: 陳凱琪搖下個頭，想將由前後左右傳嚟嘅聲音隔開去，好好聽清楚魯老師透過擴音器傳嚟嘅説話。
eng: Chen Kaiqi shook her head, wanting to separate the voices coming from the front and back, left and right, and listen to Teacher Lu's argument through the megaphone.

text: 魯老師嘅聲音比平時更低沉更朦朧︰「好高興有機會同你哋一齊學習，我為你哋感到好自豪。
eng: Teacher Lu's voice was lower and hazy than usual: "I am very happy to have the opportunity to study with you, I am very proud of you.

text: 返去之後，我會將我呢三個月嘅觀察寫低，研究一下對你哋嚟講，乜嘢先算係最好嘅學習。」
eng: When I go back, I will write down my observations in the past three months and study what is the best study for you. 」

text: 陳凱琪旁邊嘅謝穎心喊咗出嚟。漸漸，喊嘅同學越嚟越多，一個傳染一個噉。
eng: Xie Ying next to Chen Kaiqi cried out in her heart. Gradually, more and more classmates were crying, one by one, as if infecting one by one.

text: 陳凱琪見到好多同學嘅眼圈都紅咗。
eng: Chen Kaiqi saw that many classmates' eyes were red.

text: 佢雖然覺得魯老師真係好老，又肥，又冇記性，但佢都唔捨得魯老師走啊，佢都開始流眼淚，數唔清有幾多滴淚水喇。
eng: Although he felt that Teacher Lu was really old, fat, and forgetful, he couldn't bear Teacher Lu to go, and he also began to shed tears, and he couldn't count how many tears there were.

text: 校長想講啲安撫嘅説話，不過，大家都聽唔入耳。
eng: The headmaster wanted to say something reassuring, but no one listened.

text: 堂仍然都係要上，於是，大家都靜靜噉喊住返上課室。
eng: The class still had to go to school, so everyone went back to the classroom crying quietly.

text: 最後嗰兩節由魯老師教嘅中文堂，大家都爭住問魯老師問題。
eng: In the last two Chinese classes taught by Teacher Lu, everyone rushed to ask Teacher Lu questions.

text: 你要返去邊度呀？邊個教我哋中文呀？你到底有幾老喇？你可唔可以俾你嘅電郵聯絡我哋呀？
eng: Where are you going back? Who taught us Chinese? How old are you? Can you email us?

text: 魯老師都笑住一一回答。
eng: Teacher Lu also answered one by one with a smile.

text: 然後魯老師拎咗疊信出嚟，將信一封一封噉派俾每一位同學。
eng: Then Teacher Lu took out the stacked letters and distributed them to each student one by one.

text: 信裏面有簡短幾句對同學嘅叮囑，大部份都係關於學習方面嘅。每個人都唔一樣。
eng: I believe there are a few short words of advice to students, most of which are about learning. Everyone is different.

text: 魯老師話，呢啲係佢對同學喺呢三個月裏面嘅觀察，
eng: Teacher Lu said that these are his observations of his classmates in these three months.

text: 係佢批改學生功課、默書、測驗時得到嘅結果，雖然好短，但已經用咗佢好多晚嘅時間同埋工夫。
eng: This is the result he got when he corrected students' homework, silent books, and quizzes, and although it was short, it had taken him a lot of time and effort.

text: 陳凱琪翻開佢嗰封信，信裏面寫住︰「凱琪，如果作文能多用上形容詞，會令文章更豐富。
eng: Chen Kaiqi opened his letter and believed that it said: "Kaiqi, if the composition can use more adjectives, it will make the article richer.

text: 還有，請留心寫字的筆劃。對了，名字其實真的很重要嗎？
eng: Also, pay attention to the strokes of your writing. By the way, is the name really important?

text: 我不一定記得你的名字，但我會記得那一位上課時勇於回答問題的女孩子。
eng: I don't necessarily remember your name, but I do remember the girl who was brave enough to answer questions in class.

text: 就算沒有了名字，你仍是很獨特的。」
eng: Even without a name, you're still unique. 」

text: 鐘聲響起，啲同學喊住噉同魯老師講「再見」，當然都有同學冇喊。
eng: When the bell rang, these students cried and said "goodbye" to Teacher Lu, of course, some students did not cry.

text: 平時轉堂時嘈雜嘅課室，好靜，淨係聽到紙張摺疊嘅聲音，嘶——嘶——，
eng: The noisy classroom, which is usually noisy when I transfer to the classroom, is very quiet, but I hear the sound of paper folding, hissing-hissing——,

text: 同學將魯老師嘅信，一封一封噉放返入去雪白嘅信封裏面。
eng: The classmates put Teacher Lu's letter back into the snow-white envelope one by one.

text: 愚公移山・賣油翁
eng: Where there's a will, there's a way.

text: 傳說有一位伯伯，佢叫做愚公，佢已經九十幾歲。
eng: Legend has it there was an old man named Yu Gong, who was in his nineties.

text: 愚公一直以嚟都有個煩惱：
eng: Yu Gong has always had a trouble:

text: 佢住喺兩座山嘅北面，呢兩座山加埋方圓七百公里，高七八千米。
eng: He lived on the north side of two mountains, which together were seven hundred kilometers in circumference and seven or eight kilometers high.

text: 因為呢兩座山阻住，搞到愚公去南面好唔方便，次次都要兜路行。
eng: Because these two mountains were in the way, it was very inconvenient for the Foolish Old Man to go to the south, he had to take a detour every time.

text: 終於有一日，愚公實在頂唔順喇！
eng: Finally, one day, the Foolish Old Man really couldn't stand it!

text: 佢叫晒屋企人過嚟，同佢哋商量：
eng: He called over all his family and discussed with them:

text: 「我哋一於合力剷平咗呢兩座山，再起一條路，條路一直通到南面，你哋話好唔好？」
eng: "How about we work together to level these two mountains flat and build a road straight to the south, what do you all say?"

text: 屋企人都點頭贊成，唯獨佢太太唔同意。
eng: Everyone in the family nodded in approval, only his wife disagreed.

text: 佢太太問：「憑你嘅力量，連細山都剷唔平，更何況呢兩座大山呢？
eng: His wife asked, "With your strength, you can't even level two small hills, let alone these two mountains!"

text: 再講，就算真係剷得平呢兩座山，之後啲泥土同石頭又放邊？」
eng: Besides, even if you were able to level these two mountains flat, where would you put the dirt and stone afterwards?

text: 愚公話：「將啲泥土同石頭掉去海邊，噉就冇問題啦。」
eng: The Foolish Old Man said: "We'll just get rid of the dirt and stones at the shore, then it'll be fine."

text: 愚公帶埋佢啲子子孫孫一齊挖走啲泥，又鑿開石頭，再合力將啲沙石運去海邊。
eng: The Foolish Old Man took his children and grandchildren to dig up the dirt, split the stones, and worked together to move the sand and gravel to the shore.

text: 佢哋另外有個鄰居，佢個細路雖然得七歲，但都跳下跳下嚟幫愚公佢哋手，冬天先返屋企一次。
eng: They also had a neighbor whose child, although only seven years old, enthusiastically went to help the Foolish Old Man and the others, and only came home once in the winter.

text: 呢個時候，有另一位伯伯，佢叫做智叟。
eng: This time, there was another uncle, he was called Chen Gong.

text: 智叟笑住噉阻止愚公：「你太唔聰明喇！你而家已經九十幾歲，得返幾年命。
eng: The Wise Old Man laughed and blocked the Foolish Old Man: "You're not sharp at all! You're already in your nineties now, you only have a few years left left to live."

text: 愚公長嘆一口氣，話：「你真係萌塞，萌塞到冇得救！
eng: The Foolish Old let out a long sigh, and said: "You're so dull-witted, dull to the point of no return!"

text: 我啲子子孫孫無窮無盡，而嗰兩座山又唔會越變越高，又使乜愁我哋剷唔平佢哋呢？」
eng: My descendants are boundless, however those two mountains won't be getting anymore taller, so what need is there to worry that we won't ever be able to level them flat?

text: 智叟即時啞口無言，無從反駁。
eng: The Wise Old Man was left immediately speechless, unable to say anything in response.

text: 過咗好耐好耐，又有一個叫陳公嘅神射手，佢射箭好勁，世上冇人能及，所以佢成日睇唔起人。
eng: After a long, long time, there was a sharpshooter called Old Man Chen, his archery was exceptional, unmatched by anyone in the world, so he always looked down on others.

text: 有一日，佢喺自己屋企個花園射箭。
eng: One day, he was shooting arrows in the garden of his house.

text: 伯伯睇完之後只係微微點頭，冇乜表示，似乎覺得陳公都係碎料。
eng: After watching the old man only slightly nodded his head, without much expression, almost as if he felt that Old Man Chen was just an amateur.

text: 伯伯話：「有咩咁巴閉？你只不過係熟手咋嘛。」
eng: The old man said: "What's there to be so boastful about? You're just experienced."

text: 陳公聽完之後好嬲，佢話：
eng: Old Man Chen was very angry after hearing this. He said:

text: 「你竟然睇唔起我射箭嘅技術！你又有咩咁巴閉呀？」
eng: "You look down on my archery skills!? What are you so full of yourself for?"

text: 伯伯話：「唔係話睇唔起你，因為我嘅技術……」
eng: The old man said: "I don't mean to say I'm looking down on you because my skills..."

text: 伯伯隨即拎咗一個葫蘆放喺地下，又放一個銅錢喺葫蘆口上面。
eng: The old man immediately took a bottle gourd and put it on the ground, putting a copper coin on the mouth of the gourd.

text: 佢斟咗一殼油，再穿過銅錢口，慢慢倒入去個葫蘆入面。
eng: He poured a ladle of oil, through the hole of the copper coin, slowly pouring it into the bottle gourd.

text: 成殼油斟晒喇，個銅錢都冇濕到。
eng: After the whole ladle had been emptied, the copper coin wasn't even wet.

text: 伯伯話：「你睇，我做呢啲都只係因為我熟手咋。」
eng: The old man said: "You see, I can also do this just because I'm experienced."

text: 陳公見識到伯伯嘅本事，就笑住送走呢位賣油伯伯。
eng: After seeing the old man's skills, he smiled and set the oil-selling uncle on his way.

text: 究竟咩係聰明智慧？係有口才？定係轉數夠快？
eng: What exactly is intelligence and wisdom? Is it eloquence, or is it just being quick-witted?

text: 一個人有口才，但係佢唔一定有內涵；一個人可以有急智，但睇嘢唔一定長遠。
eng: A person may have eloquence, but may not necessarily have depth; a person may have quick wits, but may not necessarily see things long term.

text: 唯有勤力，先可以將人嘅潛能發揮到極致——正所謂勤能補拙，熟能生巧，噉先係智慧之道。
eng: Only hard work can maximize one's potential - only the so-called sayings: "diligence makes up for dullness" and "practice makes perfect" are the way of wisdom.

text: 你哋又點睇？
eng: What do you all think?

text: 曾參嘅謠言同埋三隻老虎嘅故事
eng: Rumors of Zeng Sam and the story of three tigers
bookTitle: 曾參嘅謠言同埋三隻老虎嘅故事

text: 話說好耐好耐之前，有個出名孝順嘅人，佢叫做曾參，又叫做曾子。
eng: It is said that a long, long time ago, there was a famous filial man, he was called Zeng Shen, also known as Zeng Zi.
bookTitle: 曾參嘅謠言同埋三隻老虎嘅故事

text: 曾子唔單止孝順，佢仲好好人，街坊鄰里都好鍾意佢。
eng: Zeng Zi is not only filial, he is also a good person, and the neighbors also like him.
bookTitle: 曾參嘅謠言同埋三隻老虎嘅故事

text: 咁啱呢段時間，曾子同佢老師孔子出咗國，唔喺屋企。
eng: At such a coincidental time, Zeng Zi and his teacher Confucius went abroad and were not at home.
bookTitle: 曾參嘅謠言同埋三隻老虎嘅故事

text: 曾子媽媽講完呢句之後，冇再理啲鄰居。
eng: After Zeng Zi's mother said this, she didn't care about the neighbors anymore.
bookTitle: 曾參嘅謠言同埋三隻老虎嘅故事

text: 呢個時候，曾子媽媽終於開始識驚。
eng: At this time, Zeng Zi's mother finally began to be afraid.
bookTitle: 曾參嘅謠言同埋三隻老虎嘅故事

text: 佢即刻放低織布機器，急急腳爬牆走佬。
eng: He immediately put down the loom and hurriedly climbed the wall to run.
bookTitle: 曾參嘅謠言同埋三隻老虎嘅故事

text: 多人講嘅説話係咪就可信？
eng: Is what many people say credible?
bookTitle: 曾參嘅謠言同埋三隻老虎嘅故事

text: 不如講多個故仔，畀大家再諗下。
eng: It's better to tell multiple stories and give everyone another thought.
bookTitle: 曾參嘅謠言同埋三隻老虎嘅故事

text: 從前有一個大臣，佢叫做龐恭。
eng: Once upon a time there was a minister named Pang Gong.
bookTitle: 曾參嘅謠言同埋三隻老虎嘅故事

text: 龐恭要去好遠嘅地方出差，佢驚背後有人講佢壞話，於是佢就揾國王。
eng: Pang Gong was going on a business trip far away, and he was afraid that someone behind him would say bad things about him, so he looked for the king.
bookTitle: 曾參嘅謠言同埋三隻老虎嘅故事

text: 龐恭話：「大王，頭先有個人話街市有隻老虎。唔知大王你信唔信呢？」
eng: Pang Gong said, "King, just now someone said that there is a tiger in the market. I don't know if you believe it, King?"
bookTitle: 曾參嘅謠言同埋三隻老虎嘅故事

text: 龐恭話：「大王，我收到第二個人嘅消息，佢話街市真係有老虎喎，唔知大王你信唔信呢？」
eng: Pang Gong: "Dawang, I received news from the second person, he said that there are really tigers in the market, I don't know if you believe it?"
bookTitle: 曾參嘅謠言同埋三隻老虎嘅故事

text: 國王話：「街市係賣餸嘅地方，冇理由有老虎㗎。不過有兩個人噉講，話唔定真係有老虎喎。」
eng: The king said: "The market is a place to sell food, there is no reason for tigers. But two people say so, maybe there are tigers. 」
bookTitle: 曾參嘅謠言同埋三隻老虎嘅故事

text: 國王話：「我唔會畀隻老虎繼續傷害我嘅子民！人嚟，快啲派士兵去街市捉老虎！」
eng: The king said, "I will not let a tiger continue to harm my people!
bookTitle: 曾參嘅謠言同埋三隻老虎嘅故事

text: 龐恭話：「哎！大王咪住先。其實我頭先係同你講笑咋。街市入面冇老虎，更加冇人同我報告街市有老虎。」
eng: Pang Gong said, "Hey, the king waits first. Actually, I was just kidding you. There were no tigers in the wet market, and no one reported to me that there were tigers in the wet market. 」
bookTitle: 曾參嘅謠言同埋三隻老虎嘅故事

text: 國王先知道龐恭喺度玩嘢。佢問龐恭：「龐恭呀，點解你要呃我呢？」
eng: The king knew that Pang Gong was playing tricks here. He asked Pang Gong, "Pang Gong, why are you lying to me?"
bookTitle: 曾參嘅謠言同埋三隻老虎嘅故事

text: 龐恭話：「噉係因為我嚟緊要去好遠嘅地方出差，我驚有人喺背後講我壞話。
eng: Pang Gong said: "That's because I'm going to travel far away on business, and I'm afraid that someone will say bad things about me behind my back.
bookTitle: 曾參嘅謠言同埋三隻老虎嘅故事

text: 一個人講，你可能唔信。兩個人講，你就會開始半信半疑。
eng: One person says, you may not believe it. Two people say, and you will start to believe it.
bookTitle: 曾參嘅謠言同埋三隻老虎嘅故事

text: 到三個人講，無論件事係幾咁假、幾咁荒謬都好，多數人都會信到十足十。
eng: When three people say that no matter how false or ridiculous things are, most people will believe them.
bookTitle: 曾參嘅謠言同埋三隻老虎嘅故事

text: 而我走咗之後，講我壞話嘅人一定唔止三個。
eng: And after I left, there must be more than three people who spoke ill of me.
bookTitle: 曾參嘅謠言同埋三隻老虎嘅故事

text: 大王你一定要細心分析佢哋講嘅嘢真唔真呀！」
eng: King, you must analyze carefully, what they say is really not true!"
bookTitle: 曾參嘅謠言同埋三隻老虎嘅故事

text: 結果之後真係有好多人背後講龐恭壞話，而大王又真係信咗，從此遠離龐恭……
eng: As a result, there were really many people who said bad things about Pang Gong behind his back, and the king really believed it, and stayed away from Pang Gong ...
bookTitle: 曾參嘅謠言同埋三隻老虎嘅故事

text: 山海經神話與故事
eng: Mountain and Sea Classic Myths and Stories

text: 但係佢冇咗個頭喎，噉點算好呢？
eng: But he's missing, so what to do?

text: 唔緊要。過咗一陣，佢嘅心口生咗一對眼，肚臍上面生咗一個鼻哥，肚臍嗰度生咗一個嘴。
eng: It doesn't matter. After a while, a pair of eyes were born on his chest, a nose brother was born on the navel, and a mouth was born on the navel.

text: 形天左手拎盾牌，右手揸斧頭，日夜對住個天係噉劈。
eng: Holding a shield in his left hand and touching an axe with his right hand, he broke against the heavens day and night.

text: 佢諗住練習多啲，時機成熟，就可以再挑戰皇帝——佢相信佢有一日會成功……
eng: He is ready to practice a little more, and when the time is ripe, he can challenge the emperor again - he believes that he will succeed one day ...

text: 二，夸父
eng: Two, Father Qua

text: 夸父係一個巨人，佢跑步跑得好快，呢個世界冇人跑得快過佢。
eng: Father Kwa is a giant, he runs fast, and no one in this world runs faster than him.

text: 但天上面跑得最快嘅係太陽，於是佢就諗住同太陽賽跑。
eng: But the fastest runner in the sky is the sun, so he is ready to race against the sun.

text: 由太陽升起開始，佢就不停追住太陽嚟跑。
eng: From the time the sun rose, he kept running after the sun.

text: 佢不停跑，跑到太陽去到佢頭頂。
eng: He kept running, running until the sun went above him.

text: 佢跑咗好耐，好口渴，所以頂唔順要停低一陣，去湖邊飲水。
eng: He ran for a long time and was thirsty, so he couldn't stand to stop for a while and go to the lake to drink.

text: 飲完繼續跑。佢不停跑不停跑，跑到太陽就嚟要落山。
eng: Keep running after drinking. He kept running and running, and he ran until the sun was about to set.

text: 佢又好口渴，但係最近嘅河流要向北行二百公里先有。
eng: He was thirsty again, but the nearest river had to go two hundred kilometers north.

text: 最後佢嘅身體變成一個樹林，呢個樹林差唔多有幾千公里咁長。
eng: Finally his body becomes a wood, which is almost thousands of kilometers long.

text: 三，燭龍
eng: Three, Candle Dragon

text: 喺呢個世界最西北嘅地方，有一座山叫「鍾山」，鍾山住咗一個叫「燭龍」嘅神仙。
eng: In the northwesternmost part of New West, there is a mountain called "Zhongshan\

text: 佢嘅外形好特別，有蛇嘅身體，但頭係人頭。
eng: His appearance is special, with the body of a snake, but the head is a human head.

text: 佢嘅蛇身有幾千公里咁長，長到可以捲住座山幾次。
eng: His snake body is thousands of kilometers long, and it can grow several times to roll around a mountain.

text: 佢擘大對眼就係日頭，合埋對眼就係夜晚；吹一啖氣就係春天夏天，吸一啖氣就係秋天冬天。
eng: His eyes open are day, and when he closes his eyes, he is night; a breath is spring and summer, and a breath is autumn and winter.

text: 四，蠱雕
eng: four, the carving

text: 鹿吳山上面冇花草樹木，但係山腳有一條河流，入面住咗一隻怪獸，佢個樣好似雕，而且有角。
eng: There are no flowers and trees on Luwu Mountain, but there is a river at the foot of the mountain, and a monster lives in it, his appearance is like a carving, and he has horns.

text: 五，夔
eng: Five, 夔

text: 東海入面住咗一隻怪物，佢個樣好似一隻牛，但係冇角，而且全身黑鼆鼆，仲要得一隻腳。
eng: There is a monster living in the East China Sea, he looks like a cow, but he has no horns, and he is black all over and has one foot.

text: 當佢由水底浮出水面，或者由水面潛入水底嘅時候，一定會橫風橫雨。
eng: When he emerges from the bottom, perhaps from the surface to the bottom, there must be a storm.

text: 佢成身閃到好似太陽月亮咁光，叫聲好似行雷閃電咁大聲。
eng: His whole body flashed as bright as the sun and moon, and his cry was as loud as thunder and lightning.

text: 六，陵魚
eng: Six, Lingyu

text: 陵魚有人頭，手手腳腳同人一樣，只係個身係魚身，平時住喺海入面。
eng: Lingyu has a head, hands and feet are the same as people, but it is a fish body, and usually lives in the sea.

text: 另外傳說話佢哋好鍾意喊，流出嘅眼淚仲會變成珍珠。
eng: In addition, legend says that they love to cry and that the tears they shed turn into pearls.

text: 七，囂
eng: Seven, arrogant

text: 囂嘅身型同夸父一樣巨型，佢有四隻翼、一對眼，仲有條狗仔尾巴。
eng: Aran is as huge as Father Quao, he has four wings, a pair of eyes, and a puppy tail.

text: 佢嘅叫聲同雀仔好似，食咗佢嘅肉可以醫肚痛，仲可以止瀉。
eng: His call and birds seem to be that eating his flesh can fill the stomach pain and stop diarrhea.

text: 八，相繇
eng: eight, phase rein

text: 相繇有九個頭，一個蛇身，蛇身捲埋一齊。
eng: Xiang Luo has nine heads, a snake body, and the snake body is rolled together.

text: 佢好貪心，霸住九座山周圍揾嘢食。
eng: He was greedy and occupied nine mountains looking for something to eat.

text: 但凡佢停留過嘅地方，通通都會變成沼澤，空氣中嘅味道又辣又苦——唔好話人，連野獸都住唔到。
eng: Wherever he stayed, it turned into a swamp, and the smell in the air was spicy and bitter - not to mention others, even wild beasts could not live.

text: 探寶尋寶
eng: Treasure hunting

text: 探寶同爸爸生活喺一個小村莊入面，呢個小村莊叫做「寶莊」。
eng: Treasure Hunter and his father live in a small village called "Baozhuang".

text: 寶莊就好似一個寶藏噉，令人如痴如醉，所以叫做寶莊。
eng: Baozhuang is like a treasure, it is fascinating, so it is called Baozhuang.

text: 藍天白雲、小橋流水，寶莊真係好迷人呀。
eng: Blue sky, white clouds, small bridges and flowing water, Baozhuang is really charming.

text: 就算寶莊幾咁靚都好，探寶始終都係好唔開心。
eng: No matter how beautiful Baozhuang is, Tanbao is still very unhappy.

text: 佢塊面有胎記，又有雀斑，搞到佢好自卑。
eng: He had birthmarks and freckles, which made him feel inferior.

text: 佢覺得自己好醜樣，所以唔敢同朋友出去玩。
eng: He felt ugly, so he didn't dare to hang out with his friends.

text: 就算外面風景幾靚都好，佢都唔敢行出門口半步。
eng: Even if the scenery outside was quite beautiful, he did not dare to take half a step out of the door.

text: 佢每日都祈禱：「神仙神仙，快啲嚟幫我啦，我好想變得可愛啲，我想有一對迷人嘅大眼睛，白雪雪嘅皮膚，同埋細細粒嘅酒粒……」
eng: He prayed every day: "Immortals, come and help me, I want to be cute, I want to have a pair of charming big eyes, white skin, and petite grains of wine..."

text: 直到一晚，外面落緊暴雨。
eng: Until one night, it was raining heavily.

text: 探寶望出玻璃窗嗰陣，突然間見到一隻爪，隻爪不停刮個玻璃窗，仲發出恐怖嘅「吱吱」聲。
eng: When Treasure Hunter looked out of the glass window, he suddenly saw a claw, and one claw kept scraping the glass window, and also made a terrifying "squeak" sound.

text: 佢以為自己望錯聽錯，於是再望再聽，點知佢又見到同一隻爪。
eng: He thought he had misheard, so he looked and listened again, how did he know that he saw the same claw again.

text: 探寶心諗：「會唔會係神仙派嚟嘅精靈呢？」
