eng: He raised his eyes and looked out the window, only endless darkness, and the universe with no clear direction.

text: 「彼德，你睇下！出面有好多星星呀！」
eng: "Peter, look, there are a lot of stars outside!"

text: 雲妮一邊講，一邊手舞足蹈噉拉住彼德。
eng: Yunni said as she danced and grabbed Peter.

text: 「雲妮，我哋而家喺邊呀？」彼德問。
eng: "Yunnie, where are we now?" asked Peter.

text: 「你唔記得咗喇？我哋要飛去第二個星球生活，呢架係最後一班船呀。」卡文答。
eng: "Have you forgotten that we're flying to live on a second planet, and this is the last ship." Cavin replied.

text: 可能因為喺冷凍倉瞓得太耐，彼德有啲不知所云，佢諗咗諗，先醒起係佢屋企人幫佢安排呢次太空移民。
eng: Perhaps because he slept in the freezer for too long, Peter was a little confused, and he thought about it before remembering that his family helped him arrange this space migration.

text: 一種難以忍受嘅感覺衝擊彼德嘅淚腺，佢終於忍唔住默默落淚。
eng: An unbearable feeling hit Peter's tear ducts, and he finally couldn't help but cry silently.

text: 「你做咩事呀？」雲妮問。
eng: "What are you doing?" asked Yunni.

text: 「我……我唔捨得呀……」彼德喊住口噉講。
eng: "I... I can't bear ... ... Peter cried.

text: 「有咩唔捨得？你諗下，新嘅星球一定更加多姿多彩！」卡文安慰彼德。
eng: If you think about it, the new planet must be more colorful!" Kavin comforted Peter.

text: 「但係我好驚呀，你望下前面，一片黑暗，我哋連去緊邊都唔知。」
eng: "But I'm so scared, you look ahead, it's dark, we don't even know where to go."

text: 眼前嘅未知令彼德非常焦慮。
eng: The unknown in front of him made Peter very anxious.

text: 「你唔好咁擔心啦彼德，離開一個地方的確需要好大勇氣，但相信我，之後一定會好㗎！」
eng: "Don't worry so much Peter, it does take a lot of courage to leave a place, but trust me, it will be fine after that!"

text: 雲妮都幫手安慰佢。由地球去新星球嘅路好漫長，佢哋好快又要返入冷凍倉休息。
eng: Yunni also helped comfort her. The journey from Earth to the new planet was long, and they would soon have to go back to the freezer to rest.

text: 不過，就喺雲妮同卡文都休息緊嗰陣，彼德偷偷哋起身，出去撳咗回程個掣。
eng: However, while Yunni and Kavin were resting, Peter secretly got up and went out to press the return button.

text: 但正因為噉，不幸嘅事發生喇，太空船出現劇烈嘅搖晃，仲整醒咗雲妮同卡文。
eng: But because of this, something unfortunate happened, the spacecraft shook violently, and Yunni and Kavin woke up.

text: 「發生咩事呀？」雲妮同卡文衝出嚟異口同聲問。
eng: "What happened?" asked Yunni and Kavin in unison.

text: 「對唔住呀……我諗住撳掣返地球，點知……」彼德支支吾吾噉答。
eng: "I'm sorry... I'm ready to push the button back to Earth, how do I know..." Peter replied hesitantly.

text: 雲妮同卡文都冇時間責怪彼德，太空船已經衝咗入黑洞，黑洞裏面一片漆黑，連一粒星星都冇。
eng: Neither Yunni nor Cavin had time to blame Peter, the spacecraft had rushed into the black hole, and the inside of the black hole was pitch black, not even a star.

text: 「點算呀？我冇諗過會搞成噉！」彼德忍唔住喊咗出嚟。
eng: I didn't think it would be like this!" Peter couldn't help but cry.

text: 「彼德！控制桿！拉實呀！」雲妮大叫。
eng: "Peter! Lever! Pull it!" exclaimed Yunnie.

text: 「唔得呀！我做唔到呀！」彼德回答。
eng: "Nope! I can't do that!" replied Peter.

text: 「唔試過點知唔得呀？你睇下我哋，我哋而家已經踏出咗離開地球呢一步，冇得返轉頭㗎喇！
eng: Look at me, we have now taken the step of leaving the earth, and there is no turning back!"

text: 可以做嘅係靠自己！呢度最近控制桿嗰個係你呀，彼德！」卡文好激動噉講。
eng: The latest lever here is you, Peter!" said Cavin excitedly.

text: 彼德聽完之後，雖然仲係好驚，但係已經冷靜落嚟，仲開始努力嘗試捉緊身邊嘅嘢嚟平衡個人，再一步一步行去控制台。
eng: After Peter listened, although he was still afraid, he had calmed down, and began to try to balance the personal by grasping the things around him, and then walked to the console step by step.

text: 佢抹乾眼淚，捉實搖擺不定嘅控制桿，用力一拉！
eng: He wiped away his tears, grabbed the wobbly lever, and pulled hard!

text: 太空船終於穩定返落嚟，但係控制桿都仲好似同佢鬥力噉，不停左搖右擺……
eng: The spacecraft finally turned down steadily, but the control levers were still the same as his fighting power, constantly swinging left and right ...

text: 就喺彼德覺得自己支持唔住，就嚟鬆手嗰陣，兩對温暖嘅手捉住彼德對手——係雲妮同卡文！
eng: Just when Peter felt that he couldn't hold it and came to let go, two pairs of warm hands grabbed Peter's opponent - it was Yunni and Kavin!

text: 佢哋三人合力捉實控制桿，直到太空船飛出黑洞……
eng: The three of them work together to capture the lever until the spacecraft flies out of the black hole ...

text: 穿過重重黑暗之後，映入佢哋眼簾嘅係一片彩色世界。
eng: After passing through the darkness, they were greeted by a colorful world.

text: 睇座標，呢度就係佢哋嘅目的地。
eng: Look at the coordinates, this is their destination.

text: 彼德望住眼前呢片美景，先發現原來黑暗眨下眼就過。
eng: Peter stared at the beautiful scenery in front of him, only to realize that the darkness had passed in the blink of an eye.

text: 呢一刻佢哋亦堅信，佢哋會有勇氣同力量去適應呢個美麗星球嘅新生活。
eng: At this moment, they also firmly believe that they will have the courage and strength to adapt to the new life of this beautiful planet.

text: 族譜
eng: Genealogy

text: 爸爸曾經講過，佢細個嗰陣返過一次鄉下，但之後就冇再返過。
eng: Dad once said that he turned over his hometown once as a child, but he never turned it over again.

text: 所以佢成日都話，咁大個人都唔太清楚鄉下發生過咩事。
eng: So he said all day that people of this age don't quite know what happened in their hometown.

text: 而我呢，就喺香港出世，唔使講，我從來都冇返過鄉下啦。
eng: And I, on the other hand, was born in Hong Kong, and needless to say, I have never been back to the country.

text: 但記得爸爸講過我哋鄉下有本族譜，記載咗好多代人嘅資料，好似話最早可以追溯到宋朝，即係話本族譜已經有八百年以上歷史，仲早過中國四大名著呀！
eng: But I remember that Dad said that our hometown has this family tree, which records the information of many generations, as if it can be traced back to the Song Dynasty, that is, this family tree has a history of more than 800 years, earlier than the four famous names of China!

text: 至於本族譜而家係點，爸爸話唔清楚。
eng: As for how this family tree is now, Dad can't tell.

text: 之不過我係女仔，爸爸都冇十足嘅把握可以噉做，但我係佢唯一嘅後代，所以佢決定帶我返鄉下試一鋪。
eng: But I am a girl, and my father is not completely sure that he can do this, but I am his only offspring, so he decided to take me back to the country to try it once.

text: 我剩係記得佢話︰「咪試下囉，唔得都起碼叫做帶過你返鄉下睇下吖！」
eng: I just remember him saying, "Don't try it, if it doesn't work, at least it's called taking you back to the countryside to see!"

text: 我哋避開新年去，因為內地每逢過年都有春運，全國啲人都會返鄉下，到時內地各種交通工具啲位賣晒，我哋返唔返到去都會成問題，所以我哋揀咗六月去，噉返去就有大把交通選擇嘞。
eng: I avoid going to the New Year, because every New Year in the mainland there is a Spring Festival, people all over the country will return to the countryside, when all kinds of transportation points in the mainland are sold out, it will be a problem if we go back or not, so we chose to go in June, so that going back will have a transportation choice.

text: 返到去鄉下，村口係一棵幾層樓高嘅榕樹，後面有個中式牌坊，再後面就係一條路。
eng: Back in the countryside, the entrance to the village is a banyan tree several stories high, behind which there is a Chinese torii and behind it is a road.

text: 沿住條路兩邊矗立咗新同舊屋，舊嗰啲舊到清朝、類似四合院嘅都有，而新嗰啲就似係呢幾年先起好落成、有幾層高嘅瓷磚外牆屋。
eng: Along both sides of the road stand new and old houses, the old ones that are old to the Qing Dynasty, similar to courtyard courtyards, and the new ones that seem to have been completed in recent years, with multi-storey tiled exterior houses.

text: 我哋行到去村長間屋，爸爸喺門口自我介紹一番，又攞出佢細個同爺爺影嘅相，再寒喧一陣，村長就請我哋入去，話要熱情招待我哋。
eng: We went to the village chief's room, and my father introduced himself at the door, took out the pictures he had taken with his grandfather when he was a child, and after a while, the village chief invited us in and said that he would welcome us warmly.

text: 但爸爸話大家同鄉，簡簡單單就得啦——結果村長嗰晚親自下廚，請我同爸爸食飯。
eng: But Dad said that everyone was in the same country, and it was simple - as a result, the village chief personally cooked that night and invited me to eat with Dad.

text: 嗰晚我哋傾咗鄉下咁多年嚟發生嘅事，村長講到城市化係點樣令到鄉下啲後生仔出晒城，搞到條村剩返啲老年人。
eng: That night we talked about what had happened in our hometown for so many years, and the village chief talked about how urbanization had caused some young people in his hometown to go out of the city, leaving only some elderly people in the village.

text: 不過出城嘅人每年都會畀少少錢幫條村搞翻新，或者定時返嚟幫手夾錢維修。
eng: However, people who go out of the city will give a little money every year to help renovate the village, and may come back regularly to help with the repairs.

text: 席間，爸爸都有講到族譜嘅事，村長話本族譜仲喺度，一直都有更新；但對於爸爸話想加我個名落去，村長就話有保留。
eng: During the dinner, Dad also talked about the family tree, and the village chief said that the family tree was still here and had been updated; but for Dad who said that he wanted to add my name, the village chief said that he had reservations.

text: 但佢話有其他同鄉都係生獨女，亦提出過類似諗法，所以佢會再認真諗諗，如果真係成事就通知我哋。
eng: But he said that there were other fellow villagers who had only daughters and had raised similar ideas, so he would seriously consider it again, and let us know if it really happened.

text: 我哋喺嗰度留咗一晚，第二日就啟程返香港。
eng: We stayed there for one night and left for Hong Kong the next day.

text: 直到今日，爸爸都仲等緊村長嘅電話。
eng: To this day, Dad is still waiting for the call from the village chief.

text: 希望有朝一日，我個名可以出現喺本族譜度啦！
eng: I hope that one day, my name will appear in this family tree!

text: 愛的風箏
eng: The kite of love

text: 今日天氣真係好好啊，不如我哋打開窗簾睇下風景吖？」
eng: The weather is really nice today, why don't we open the curtains and take a look at the scenery?"

text: 佢好似企喺度望住我哋噉。我真係好掛住媽媽啊……」
eng: He seems to be standing here staring at us. I really miss my mom ... ..."

text: 嫲嫲反晒白眼噉話：「呢啲嘢都好信嘅？唔好嘥錢啦！」
eng: Grandma rolled her eyes and said, "Why do you believe it?

text: 於是，佢哋拎晒豬仔錢罌啲錢出嚟，但數嚟數去都係得雞碎咁多，唔夠錢買一隻風箏。
eng: So they took the piglet money and poured the money out, but they still had to count so many chickens that they didn't have enough money to buy a kite.

text: 房入面嘅氣氛突然變得好沉重……
eng: The atmosphere in the room suddenly became heavy ...

text: 終於可以開始整喇！
eng: It's finally time to start!

text: 佢哋喺風箏上面寫咗好多好多想同媽媽講嘅説話，過程越寫越激動，結果佢哋一路寫就一路喊，眼淚滴濕晒五顏六色嘅紙——
eng: They wrote a lot of things they wanted to say to their mother on the kite, and the more they wrote it, the more excited they became, and as a result, they cried while writing, and their tears dripped wet with colorful paper.

text: 哎呀，隻風箏噉就穿咗窿！
eng: Oops, only the kite is pierced like this!

text: 揾紙補返好似唔係咁好睇，睇嚟佢哋又要重新整過喇！
eng: It doesn't seem to look so good to find paper to make up, it seems that they are going to reorganize it!

text: 我好鍾意同爺爺傾計，因為佢會講好多以前嘅嘢畀我聽。
eng: I enjoyed talking to my grandfather because he would tell me a lot of old things.

text: 爺爺話，佢十歲嘅時候，即係二零一六年，個世界冇而家咁多人，但空氣污染就嚴重好多，因為嗰陣時啲車唔係用電或者太陽能，會排放好多廢氣！
eng: Grandpa said that when he was ten years old, it was 2016, and the world did not have so many people now, but the air pollution was much more serious, because the car at that time did not use electricity or solar energy, and would emit a lot of exhaust gases!

text: 除此之外，而家嘅交通意外都少咗好多，因為自動駕駛嘅車都非常安全！
eng: In addition, there are many fewer traffic accidents now, because self-driving cars are very safe!

text: 要講嗰陣同而家最大嘅分別，主要係人工智能嘅發展同普及程度。
eng: To say that the biggest difference between then and now is mainly the development and popularity of artificial intelligence.

text: 科技發展一日千里，二零一六年嘅科技就梗係冇而家咁方便啦！
eng: With the rapid development of science and technology, of course, the technology of 2016 is not as convenient as it is now!

text: 而家嘅科技仲發展到畀咗個永遠嘅好朋友我添呀！
eng: Now the technology has also developed to a good friend forever I add!

text: 佢話：「我真係唔知『悶』字係咩意思喎！」
eng: He said, "I really don't know what the word 'stuffy' means!"

text: 唔單止噉呀，佢仲成日幫我喺書櫃度拎我想要嘅書——因為我細細個就患有肌肉萎縮，企唔到起身。
eng: Not only that, but he often helped me get the books I wanted in the bookcase – because I had muscle atrophy as a child and couldn't stand up.

text: 我哋去到邊都會一齊，佢會陪我返學，陪我去公園玩，我嘅生活冇再好似之前噉咁唔方便喇！
eng: We will be together wherever we go, he will accompany me to school, accompany me to the park, and my life is no longer as inconvenient as before!

text: 而且佢記性好好，只要學識咗一樣嘢，就會永遠記住！
eng: And he has a good memory, as long as he learns one thing, he will remember it forever!

text: 「好記性？係你哋啲人類先會成日唔記得自己啲嘢擺咗喺邊咋嘛！」
eng: "Good memory, it's you humans who always forget where you are!"

text: 不過你唔好誤會喎，其實我都有好多人類朋友㗎。小息嘅時候，我會同佢哋一齊買嘢食、一齊玩。
eng: But don't get me wrong, I actually have a lot of human friends. When I take a break, I buy something to eat and play with them.

text: 「所以你鍾意我係因為我冇情緒？
eng: "So you like me because I'm not emotional?"

text: 你想睇邊本書，我拎畀你吖？定係你想玩玩具？」
eng: Which book do you want to read, and I'll give it to you, or do you want to play with toys?"

text: 冇人信我
eng: No one believes me

text: 其實，我好鍾意返學！
eng: Actually, I love going to school!

text: 因為返學可以睇好多書，又有好多文具可以用。
eng: Because you can read a lot of books and have a lot of stationery to use when you go to school.

text: 而且學校好大，有好多課室畀唔同課堂用，例如我可以去音樂室學唱歌，去視藝室學畫畫，去電腦室學上網，去操場做運動……
eng: And the school is very large, there are many classrooms for different classrooms, for example, I can go to the music room to learn to sing, go to the visual art room to learn to draw, go to the computer room to learn to surf the Internet, go to the playground to do sports...

text: 每一個角落都有好多嘢學，我好鍾意日日去唔同課室上堂！
eng: There is a lot to learn in every corner, I like to go to different classrooms every day!

text: 喺咁多地方之中，我最鍾意就係圖書館喇！
eng: Among so many places, my favorite is the library!

text: 因為呢度有好多書，我可以不停睇圖書：
eng: Because there are so many books here, I can keep reading them:

text: 小說、漫畫、雜誌、繪本、教科書，唔同類型嘅書都應有盡有！
eng: Novels, comics, magazines, picture books, textbooks, all kinds of books!

text: 每次嚟到圖書館，我都唔想離開。
eng: Every time I come to the library, I don't want to leave.

text: 學校入面有咁多嘢玩，又有咁多嘢學，我真係好鍾意返學！
eng: With so much to play and learn at school, I really enjoy going to school!

text: 雖然我好鍾意學校，但學校啲人似乎唔係咁鍾意我。
eng: Although I enjoyed the school, the school people didn't seem to like me that much.

text: 啲同學個個都話我係「書蟲」，成日睇書，講嘢又好似毛毛蟲爬下爬下噉咁慢。
eng: Each of these classmates called me a "bookworm\

text: 我同佢哋講，睇書好開心，喺書入面可以識到好多朋友，但冇人信我，冇人肯同我一齊玩。
eng: I told them that I had a lot of fun reading books and that I could meet a lot of friends in books, but no one believed me and no one wanted to play with me.

text: 有一日，我見到同學喺花園玩。
eng: One day, I saw my classmates playing in the garden.

text: 我諗住行埋去問佢哋可唔可以摻埋我玩，但係佢哋一見到我就叫我走。
eng: I was about to go over and ask them if they could play with me, but they told me to go as soon as they saw me.

text: 我好努力噉同佢哋講：「我、我真係好想同、同你哋一齊玩、玩啊！」
eng: I tried hard to say to them, "I—I really want to play with, play with you!"

text: 但係佢哋笑住話：「你同你啲書朋友玩啦！」
eng: But they laughed and said, "You're playing with your book friend!"

text: 然後就唔再睬我。
eng: Then he ignored me.

text: 最後，我只好自己一個孤零零噉走開。
eng: In the end, I had to walk away alone.

text: 從此以後，我唔敢再同同學講嘢。
eng: From then on, I didn't dare to talk to my classmates anymore.

text: 我知道，佢哋唔會信我講嘅嘢。
eng: I know they won't believe what I say.

text: 後嚟，我成日去池塘邊，同入面啲魚仔講嘢。
eng: Later, I often went to the pond and talked to the little fish inside.

text: 我知道，魚仔唔會唔聽我講嘢，而且佢哋會相信我。
eng: I know that the little fish won't disobey me, and they'll believe me.

text: 同啲魚仔熟咗之後，我發現入面有一條魚同我好似。
eng: After getting acquainted with these small fish, I noticed that there was a fish in it that looked like me.

text: 我唔知道佢屬於咩魚類，但就覺得佢同其他魚好唔同——
eng: I don't know what kind of fish he belongs to, but I think he's very different from other fish --

text: 佢係成個池塘入面唯一一條紅色魚，而且每條魚都會同埋佢哋嘅同伴一齊游，唯獨佢永遠都自己一個游。
eng: He is the only red fish in the entire pond, and each fish swims with their companions, but he is always on his own.

text: 佢喺池塘入面好似冇朋友冇同伴，同我喺學校嘅情況一樣。
eng: He seemed to have no friends or peers in the pond, just like I was at school.

text: 所以我同佢真係好似。
eng: So I'm really like him.

text: 不過，呢件事我冇同任何人講過。因為我知道冇人會信我。
eng: I haven't told anyone about it, though. Because I know no one will believe me.

text: 同學唔信我，冇同學肯同我一齊玩。
eng: My classmates didn't believe me, and none of my classmates wanted to play with me.

text: 老師見我答問題答到一嚿嚿，唔信我温過書，成日鬧我。
eng: When the teacher saw me answering questions and answering them piece by piece, he didn't believe that I had read the book, and always scolded me.

text: 屋企人都唔信我，以為我掛住睇故事書唔温書，唔同我講嘢。
eng: My family didn't believe me, thinking that I missed reading storybooks and not talking to me.

text: 冇人信我，所以我唔再同其他人講嘢。
eng: No one believed me, so I stopped talking to anyone else.

text: 不過，我都有唔少朋友。
eng: However, I also have quite a few friends.

text: 除咗池塘啲魚仔，我仲有好多玩具。
eng: In addition to the small fish in the pond, I have a lot of toys.

text: 佢哋會同我傾偈，同我一齊玩。
eng: They would talk to me and play with me.

text: 好彩有佢哋，我先唔使咁悶咋！
eng: Fortunately, with them, I don't have to be so bored!

text: 有時，我鍾意透過畫畫，畫啲朋友出嚟陪我。
eng: Sometimes, I like to draw and draw friends out to accompany me.

text: 所以，我成日喺我啲功課同課本上面畫畫。
eng: So, I always draw on top of my homework and textbooks.

text: 老師見到，會叫我唔好畫花啲書同功課。
eng: When the teacher saw it, he would tell me not to draw some books and do my homework.

text: 我同佢講呢啲係我嘅朋友，佢唔單只唔信我，仲罰我。
eng: I told him that this was my friend, and that he not only didn't believe me, but also punished me.

text: 我好唔開心，除咗因為老師唔准我畫畫之外，仲因為我唔可以畫啲朋友出嚟陪我上堂。
eng: I was very unhappy, not only because the teacher didn't allow me to draw, but also because my friends couldn't come out to accompany me to class.

text: 我去到池塘邊，諗住將呢件事話畀魚仔聽——點知畀我見到件好恐怖嘅事！
eng: I went to the pond and wanted to tell the little fish about it—how did I know that I had seen something horrible!

text: 我見到同班同學－明仔俾人推到池塘邊，明仔不斷喊住大叫「唔好」，但啲人冇放過佢，仲一手推佢落池塘！
eng: I saw my classmate, Xiao Ming, being pushed to the edge of the pond, Xiao Ming kept crying and yelling "don't\

text: 好彩池水唔算好深，有老師聽到叫聲之後趕到，救起咗佢。
eng: Fortunately, the water in the pond was not very deep, and a teacher arrived after hearing the cry and rescued him.

text: 不過推佢落水嘅人已經走咗，現場得返我一個……
eng: But the person who pushed him into the water is gone, and I'm the only one left on the scene...

text: 老師帶咗我去校務處，明仔換咗件乾爽校服之後都入埋嚟。
eng: The teacher took me to the school office, and Xiao Ming came in after changing into a dry school uniform.

text: 老師問明仔係咪俾人推落水，明仔頭耷耷噉答係，之後老師就一直睥住我——佢認定係我推明仔落水。
eng: The teacher asked Xiao Ming if he was pushed into the water, Xiao Ming lowered his head and replied yes, and the teacher has been guarding me since then - he thinks that I pushed Xiao Ming into the water.

text: 我不斷口窒窒噉話唔係我，但佢都係唔信。
eng: I kept stammering that it wasn't me, but he still didn't believe it.

text: 我只好合埋眼，唔再望老師。「唔係佢推我嘅！」
eng: I had no choice but to close my eyes and stop looking at the teacher. "He didn't push me!"

text: 呢個時候，明仔出聲，仲開始同老師講返事發經過。
eng: At this time, Xiao Ming made a voice and began to tell the teacher what had happened.

text: 老師聽完，至冇再懷疑我。
eng: After listening to this, the teacher didn't doubt me anymore.

text: 出咗校務處，我同明仔講多謝，點知佢同返我講多謝！
eng: When I got out of the school office, I said thank you to Xiao Ming, how did I know that he said thank you to me!

text: 究竟佢多謝我啲咩呢？「多謝你肯同我講嘢……」
eng: What is he thanking me for? "Thank you for speaking to me..."

text: 原來除咗我之外，明仔喺學校都冇朋友。之後我哋就成為咗好朋友。
eng: It turned out that Xiao Ming had no friends at school except for me. After that, we became good friends.

text: 佢令我知道，原來學校仲有人係相信我，願意聽我講嘢……
eng: He let me know that there were still people in the school who believed in me and were willing to listen to me...

text: 失控嘅雀仔
eng: Runaway birds

text: 佢好鍾意坐喺草地，一邊食嘢一邊望住天空。
eng: He loves to sit on the grass and stare at the sky while eating.

text: 佢覺得噉樣好寫意好舒服。
eng: He feels very comfortable like this.

text: 不過，今日同平時嘅野餐有啲唔同。
eng: However, today is a little different from the usual picnic.

text: 因為佢食食下嘅時候，嚟咗一位不速之客！
eng: Because when he was eating and eating, an uninvited guest came!

text: 佢一轉頭，見到隻雀仔已經咬住佢塊餅飛到好遠好遠……
eng: He turned his head and saw that a bird had bitten him a piece of cake and flew far, far away...

text: 為咗唔俾佢追到，雀仔決定再飛高啲，飛快啲……
eng: In order not to let him catch up, the bird decided to fly high again, fly faster...

text: 點知雀仔飛得太快，唔小心撞到啲建築物！
eng: How to know that the bird is flying too fast and accidentally hit a building!

text: 香港有好多高樓大廈，雀仔飛嘅時候，一個唔小心就好易撞親。
eng: There are many high-rise buildings in Hong Kong, and the bird flies for a long time, and it is easy to hit it if you are not careful.

text: 之後怪事就發生喇！
eng: After that, something strange happens!

text: 雀仔個樣變得越嚟越兇暴，身體都越變越大，由細細隻嘅雀仔變成一隻好強壯嘅巨鳥！
eng: The bird's appearance becomes more and more violent, and its body becomes bigger and bigger, from a thin bird to a strong giant bird!

text: 但係巨鳥冇再理佢哋，而係即刻飛走咗。
eng: But the giant bird ignored them and flew away immediately.

text: 巨鳥飛到一個市集，呢度有好多人，好熱鬧。
eng: Giant birds fly to a market where there are many people and it is very lively.

text: 巨鳥不斷向周圍衝撞，現場一片混亂。
eng: Giant birds keep crashing everywhere, and the scene is chaotic.

text: 因為巨鳥動作太快，市集啲人都阻止唔到佢。
eng: Because the giant bird moves too fast, the market people can't stop him.

text: 好彩現場有一個對鳥類深有研究嘅學者，佢即刻叫現場所有人冷靜，唔好驚！
eng: Fortunately, there was a scholar who had studied birds at the scene, and he immediately told everyone at the scene to calm down and not be afraid!

text: 學者叫大家仔細觀察巨鳥嘅行為，大家先留意到原來巨鳥並冇攻擊人，只係喺度好急切噉周圍揾食物。
eng: Scholars told everyone to carefully observe the behavior of the giant bird, and everyone first noticed that the giant bird did not attack people, but was very eager to find food everywhere here.

text: 知道有嘢食之後，巨鳥即刻冷靜落嚟，仲變到好乖。
eng: After knowing that there is something to eat, the giant bird immediately calms down and becomes very well-behaved.

text: 唔知巨鳥而家做緊咩，仲有冇餓親呢？
eng: I don't know what the giant bird is doing now, or is it starving?

text: 食月亮嘅巨龍
eng: The Dragon Who Eats the Moon

text: 喺一個風和日麗嘅假日，津津、樂仔、小文喺公園玩。
eng: On a sunny holiday, Relish, Lezai, and Xiaowen play in the park.

text: 津津喺一個巨型芒果上面爬嚟爬去，樂仔就坐埋一邊睇書，
eng: Relishly crawling around on a giant mango, Le Boy sat on the side reading a book,

text: 而小文就帶埋隻狗嚟玩彈珠，佢哋都玩得好開心。
eng: And Xiaowen brought the dog to play with marbles, and they also had fun.

text: 只要有得玩，無論平時返學有幾多功課、幾多煩惱，心情都會即刻變好。
eng: As long as you have fun, no matter how much homework and worries you usually have in school, your mood will immediately improve.

text: 更興奮嘅係，今日就係中秋節！
eng: What's more exciting is that today is the Mid-Autumn Festival!

text: 佢哋好鍾意中秋節，因為有得食月餅、玩燈籠，仲可以睇到又大又圓嘅月亮！
eng: They like the Mid-Autumn Festival very much, because they have to eat mooncakes, play with lanterns, and see the big and round moon!

text: 所以佢哋都好期待夜晚賞月。
eng: So they are looking forward to watching the moon at night.

text: 但佢哋唔知道嘅係，喺遙遠嘅太空，有條巨龍正打算食咗個月亮。
eng: But what they don't know is that in distant space, a dragon is about to eat the moon.

text: 呢條龍本身好細隻，但佢呢幾年係噉吞食唔同星球，令佢迅速長大。
eng: The dragon itself is very small, but he has devoured different planets in this way in recent years, which has made him grow rapidly.

text: 而家佢已經變成一條巨龍，但佢想再變大啲，所以佢仲係不停噉吞食其他星球。
eng: Now he has turned into a dragon, but he wants to get bigger, so he still keeps devouring other planets.

text: 而佢下個目標，就係月亮！
eng: And his next goal is the moon!

text: 如果月亮俾佢食咗，噉津津佢哋以後就睇唔到月亮，有中秋節都賞唔到月……
eng: If the moon is given to him, so that they will not see the moon in the future, and they will not be able to appreciate the moon during the Mid-Autumn Festival ... ...

text: 好彩地球有一班好勇敢嘅戰士。
eng: Fortunately, there is a group of brave warriors on Earth.

text: 佢哋知道巨龍打算食咗月亮，所以專登飛上太空阻止佢！
eng: They knew that his dragon was going to eat the moon, so they flew into space to stop him!

text: 佢哋知道巨龍好危險，一去未必有回頭，
eng: They knew that his dragon was dangerous, and there might be no turning back,

text: 但係為咗保護月亮，令世人可以繼續喺黑夜中睇月光同保住地球嘅正常運轉，佢哋決心要打倒巨龍！
eng: but in order to protect the moon, so that the world could continue to watch the moonlight in the dark and keep the normal operation of the earth, they were determined to defeat the dragon!

text: 點知佢哋離遠見到巨龍嘅時候，發現巨龍已經拎住個月亮要送入口！
eng: How did they know that when they saw the dragon in the distance, they found that the dragon was already holding the moon and was about to send it to the entrance!

text: 好多人都好灰心失望，有戰士甚至開始喊起上嚟。
eng: Many people were discouraged and disappointed, and some fighters even began to cry.

text: 「未遲㗎！大家千祈唔好放棄！」喺呢個時候，有一個人大聲噉鼓勵大家要堅持。
eng: "It's not too late, don't give up!" At this time, one person loudly encouraged everyone to persevere.

text: 火球係呢班戰士帶嚟專門對付巨龍嘅武器，因為佢哋知道巨龍最怕火！
eng: Fireballs are weapons brought by this group of warriors specifically to deal with dragons, because they know that dragons are most afraid of fire!

text: 火球喺巨龍個肚入面熊熊燃燒，巨龍全身都好痛！
eng: The fireball burned in the dragon's stomach, and the dragon's whole body was in pain!

text: 終於，巨龍頂唔順要嘔返肚入面啲火球出嚟，於是就連之前吞吞埋埋嘅月亮同其他星球都嘔埋……
eng: Finally, the dragon couldn't stand to vomit back into its stomach and lit the fireball out, so even the moon and other planets that had been swallowed before vomited ... ...

text: 嘔完火球之後，巨龍一身鬆晒。
eng: After spitting out the fireball, the dragon relaxed.

text: 不過望住一班奮勇嘅戰士，佢唔敢再食月球，唯有敗走。
eng: But staring at a group of brave warriors, he did not dare to eat the moon again, only defeated.

text: 就係噉，呢班戰士成功打敗巨龍，保護月亮同其他星球。
eng: That's it, this group of warriors successfully defeated the dragon and protected the moon and other planets.

text: 與此同時，津津、樂仔、小文依然喺公園玩緊。
eng: At the same time, Relish, Le Tsai, and Xiaowen are still playing in the park.

text: 佢哋完全唔知道太空發生緊咩事，亦唔知道佢哋好想見到嘅月亮差啲就消失。
eng: They had no idea what was going on in space, or that the moon they so much wanted to see almost disappeared.

text: 入夜之後，佢哋好似往年噉開開心心賞月。
eng: After nightfall, they enjoy the moon as they do in previous years.

text: 其實佢哋可以安心賞月，係因為有一班戰士喺遙遠嘅他方為佢哋戰鬥……
eng: In fact, they can enjoy the moon with peace of mind because there is a group of warriors fighting for them in a distant place ... ...

text: 十年之後，津津、樂仔、小文已經長大。
eng: Ten years later, Jinjin, Lezai, and Xiaowen have grown up.

text: 佢哋識到一個哥哥，佢將巨龍食月嘅故事講咗畀佢哋聽，佢哋先知道原來發生過噉嘅事。
eng: They recognize an older brother who tells them the story of the dragon eating the moon, and they know that this has happened.

text: 呢位哥哥，就係當年鼓勵佢班戰士同伴唔好放棄嘅人。
eng: This brother is the one who encouraged his fellow soldiers in his class not to give up.

text: 十年後，太空又有巨龍出現。
eng: Ten years later, dragons appeared in space.

text: 今次嗰位哥哥已經唔可以再出戰，
eng: This time that brother can no longer fight,

text: 不過取而代之嘅，係繼承佢志向嘅後人，津津、樂仔同小文就係其中一份子！
eng: But in his place are the descendants who inherit his ambitions, and Relish, Le Zi and Xiaowen are one of them!

text: 錢係咩嚟㗎？
eng: Where does the money come from?

text: 今日就係金仔生日喇！
eng: Today is the birthday of the golden son!

text: 今年生日，爸爸媽媽送咗一隻豬仔畀佢。
eng: On his birthday this year, Mom and Dad gave him a piglet.

text: 呢隻豬係咩嚟嘅呢？
eng: Where did this pig come from?

text: 爸爸媽媽話，呢隻唔係普通嘅豬，而係一隻可以幫人儲錢嘅豬仔！
eng: Mom and Dad said that this is not an ordinary pig, but a piglet that can help people save money!

text: 咁神奇？原來，呢個係一個豬仔錢罌。
eng: So amazing? It turns out that this is a piglet poppy.

text: 作為錢家嘅小朋友，爸爸媽媽一直都希望金仔可以早啲養成理財習慣。
eng: As a child of the Qian family, Mom and Dad have always hoped that Jin Son can develop financial habits early.

text: 今年送呢個豬仔錢罌畀金仔，就係想佢好好學儲錢。
eng: This year, I sent this little pig money to Jin Zi, just to want him to study and save money.

text: 但對金仔嚟講，錢仲係一樣好陌生嘅嘢。
eng: But for Jin Boy, money is still the same very strange thing.

text: 金仔問：「錢係咩嚟㗎？錢食唔食得㗎？」
eng: Jin Tsai asked, "What is money? Is the money going to be eaten?"

text: 爸爸媽媽就話：「錢雖然唔食得，但係錢可以買一啲食得嘅嘢。」
eng: Mom and Dad said, "Although money can't eat, money can buy a lot of food."

text: 原來，平時金仔最鍾意食嘅生菜，就係媽媽攞住錢去街市買返嚟嘅。
eng: It turned out that Jin's son's favorite lettuce was bought by his mother with money at the vegetable market.

text: 爸爸話畀金仔知，原來好耐好耐以前，大家都係靠換嘢嚟交易嘅。
eng: Dad told Jin Boy that it turned out that a long, long time ago, everyone traded by changing things.

text: 可能係用薯仔換生菜，又可能係用蕃茄換新衫，又或者係用一隻驢仔換一隻馬⋯⋯
eng: It could be a potato for lettuce, a tomato for new clothes, or a donkey for a horse...

text: 但係噉樣始終唔方便。
eng: But this is always inconvenient.

text: 金仔鍾意食生菜，梗係願意用薯仔換生菜啦，但係生菜嘅主人未必鍾意食薯仔啊！
eng: Jin Zai likes to eat lettuce, of course, he is willing to exchange potatoes for lettuce, but the owner of lettuce may not like to eat potatoes!

text: 要夾到可以換嘢嘅人，又要換得公平，令大家都滿意，實在唔容易。
eng: It is not easy to find someone who can change things, and to exchange it fairly, so that everyone is satisfied.

text: 於是慢慢開始出現錢呢樣嘢。
eng: So slowly things like money began to appear.

text: 大家都承認錢嘅價值，就可以透過錢呢樣工具同其他人換嘢。
eng: Everyone recognizes the value of money, and they can exchange tools for other people through money.

text: 交換嘅嘢大大細細都得。
eng: The exchange of things is very detailed.

text: 錢可以買到金仔平時喺屋企玩開嘅玩具車，又可以買到馬路上面行緊嘅私家車；
eng: Money can buy the toy car that Jin Zi usually plays with at home, and he can buy a private car on the road;

text: 可以買到金仔房入面嘅模型屋，又可以買到錢家一家三口住緊嘅呢間屋。
eng: You can buy a model house in the golden house, and you can buy a house where the Qian family of three lives.

text: 金仔又問嘞：「噉啲錢又係點嚟㗎？」
eng: The golden son asked again: "What about the money?"

text: 對小朋友嚟講，錢多數係大人畀嘅，例如爸爸媽媽畀嘅零用錢，新年向親戚逗嘅利是錢等等；
eng: Tell children that most of the money is given by adults, such as pocket money given by parents and New Year's money to relatives for the New Year, and so on;

text: 大人就要做嘢嚟賺錢，例如爸爸媽媽要去返工。
eng: Adults have to work to earn money, for example, mom and dad have to go to work.

text: 所以爸爸解釋返畀金仔聽：「我哋啲錢係返工做嘢賺返嚟嘅。
eng: So Dad explained back to Jin Tsai: "We earned this money by going to work.

text: 到你大個做嘢，都會賺到自己嘅錢。」
eng: When you grow up and work, you will earn your own money. 」

text: 爸爸媽媽聽到之後，吱一聲笑咗出嚟，一齊話：「搖錢樹咩？唔會啦！」
eng: When Mom and Dad heard this, they squeaked out loud and said together, "Cash cow?

text: 但係媽媽補充咗一句：「不過錢係有其他方法可以越儲越多嘅！」
eng: But my mother added: "But there are other ways to save more and more money!"

text: 媽媽話，小朋友想儲錢嘅話，除咗可以將錢放入豬仔錢罌之外，仲可以放喺其他地方，例如銀行。
eng: Mom said that if children want to save money, they can put it in other places, such as banks, in addition to putting money in the piggy money poppy.

text: 如果金仔將錢放入銀行，一段時間之後，銀行就會畀返少少錢金仔，呢啲錢就叫做「利息」。
eng: If both parties put money in the bank, after a certain period of time, the bank will give a little money to the enterprise, and the money is called "interest."

text: 如果啲錢唔攞走，利息就會加埋一齊滾啊滾，滾啊滾，變得越嚟越多。
eng: If the money is not taken away, the interest will be added to roll and roll, roll and roll, and become more and more.

text: 只要慢慢儲，慢慢儲，金仔嘅錢就會越儲越多。
eng: As long as you save slowly, save slowly, and the money of the golden boy will be saved more and more.

text: 到時，金仔就可以買到自己想要嘅嘢，例如零食、香蕉、蘋果、文具，甚至新電腦、新電腦檯、新電腦櫈——
eng: At that time, Jin Son can buy what he wants, such as snacks, bananas, apples, stationery, and even new computers, new computer desks, new computer cabinets.

text: 呢個時候，爸爸中途補充一句：「係呀金仔，而且錢仲可以係一種保障……」
eng: At this time, Dad added halfway: "Yes, Jin son, and money can also be a guarantee..."

text: 爸爸提起最近入咗醫院嘅嫲嫲。
eng: Dad mentioned his grandmother, who had recently been admitted to the hospital.

「爸爸你聽緊呢首係咩歌嚟㗎？咁奇怪嘅！」阿一問。

text: 如果只有一個小朋友病嘅話，就只係個別事件，但如果同一時間有幾個小朋友病咗呢？
eng: If only one child is sick, it is an isolated incident, but what if several children are sick at the same time?

text: 爸爸話，假設阿一嗰班除咗阿一之外，仲有五個小朋友喺同一日病咗，噉校長同老師就有責任查出咁多小朋友同時病嘅原因。
eng: Dad said that if there were five children in Ah Yi's group besides Ah Yi who fell ill on the same day, it was the responsibility of the principal and teachers to find out the reason why so many children were sick at the same time.

text: 係咪學校小食部供應嘅食物出咗問題呢？
eng: Is there a problem with the food served by the school snack bar?

text: 定係水機啲水唔乾淨？
eng: Or is the water machine not clean?

text: 又或者係有某個同學病咗，然後感染埋其他同學？
eng: Or is it that one of the classmates got sick and then infected other classmates?

text: 學校可以查下病咗嘅小朋友入面，有幾多個係食過同一種食物、用過同一部水機、大家之間有冇密切接觸等等。
eng: The school can check how many of the sick children have eaten the same food, used the same water machine, whether there is close contact between everyone, and so on.

text: 學校知道嘅數據越多，就越有機會揾到小朋友唔舒服嘅原因，之後就可以對症下藥，例如加強檢查小食部嘅衛生情況，多啲清洗飲水機，或者揾出其他嘅感染源頭。
eng: The more data the school knows, the more likely it is to find out why the child is unwell, and then it can prescribe the right medicine, such as strengthening the hygiene of the snack bar, cleaning the water dispenser more, or identifying other sources of infection.

text: 爸爸嘗試舉多個例子：阿一好鍾意食小食部嘅魚肉燒賣，但係有時會出現一落到去，就發現燒賣已經賣晒嘅情況。
eng: Dad tried to give several examples: Ah Yi likes to eat the fish roast in the snack bar, but sometimes he will find that the roast has been sold out as soon as he falls in.

text: 如果小食部有統計學生嘅喜好，噉每次訂燒賣嗰陣就可以訂多啲，而冇咁受歡迎嘅零食就可以訂少啲，噉阿一就有多啲機會食到燒賣，同時減少浪費賣唔晒嘅零食！
eng: If the snack department has statistics on students' preferences, you can order more every time you order a roast and sell a lot, and you can order less snacks that are not so popular, so that Ah Yi has a little more chance to eat and sell snacks, and at the same time reduce waste and sell endless snacks!

text: 「零四三四零四三四零二三二零二三二零六四六零六四六零八七八零八七八」
爸爸部音響繼續播緊《數字人生》。
eng: Dad's Department Audio continues to broadcast "Digital Life".

text: 本身阿一唔係咁鍾意呢首歌，因為入面實在有太多數字喇。
eng: Ah Yi himself doesn't like this song so much, because there are too many numbers in it.

text: 但係聽完爸爸呢番説話，阿一突然覺得呢首歌入面提到嗰啲數字，其實都唔係咁令人頭痛啫！
eng: But after listening to my father's words, I suddenly felt that the numbers mentioned in this song were actually not so headache!

text: 雖然阿一仲未話好鍾意數學，但佢都開始意識到數學嘅重要。
eng: Although Ah Yi has not yet said that he likes mathematics, he has also begun to realize the importance of mathematics.

text: 佢決定以後要畀多啲心機上數學堂！
eng: He decided to let more math lessons in the future!

text: 阿一心諗，既然數字喺生活中係無可避免，噉不如早啲學習點樣同數字相處啦！
eng: Ah Yi thought to himself, since numbers are inevitable in life, it is better to learn how to get along with numbers early!

text: 當然，能夠同數字做到朋友就最好啦！
eng: Of course, it's best to be friends with numbers!

text: 科技之外
eng: Beyond technology

text: 佢仲記得小學嘅時候，佢每次返學放學都要經過大街。
eng: He remembers when he was in elementary school, he had to go through the street every time he went to and from school.

text: 媽媽話：「呢啲係工廠嘅廢氣嚟。」
eng: Mom said, "These are factory exhaust gases. 」

text: 媽媽話：「其實種多啲植物就得，植物會吸走空氣入面嘅二氧化碳，排放返新鮮嘅氧氣……」
eng: Mom said: "In fact, just plant more plants, plants will suck carbon dioxide from the air and emit fresh oxygen..."

text: 佢開展咗個結合機械同植物嘅工程——呢啲植物除咗可以將二氧化碳轉換成氧氣之外，仲可以提供源源不絕嘅能源。
eng: He embarked on a project that combined machinery and plants that could provide an endless source of energy in addition to converting carbon dioxide into oxygen.

text: 就係噉，世界各地好多城市嘅污染問題都解決咗。
eng: In this way, the pollution problem in many cities around the world has been solved.

text: 就好似我以前噉，我好努力研究環境科技，今時今日大家先至可以享受到清新嘅空氣……」
eng: Just like I used to, I worked environmental technology, and now everyone can enjoy the clean air..."

text: 佢即刻轉頭返屋企同爸爸講：「爸爸！你快啲出嚟睇下！突然間成個城市啲空氣勁差！」
eng: He immediately turned around and went home and said to his father, "Dad, come out and take a look!

text: 明明前幾日空氣仲好好，點解今日無啦啦會變成噉？
eng: Obviously the air was still good a few days ago, why did Wulala become like this today?

text: 官員好冷靜噉話：「你嗰個機械植物前幾日正式停機喇，所以呢幾日嘅空氣咪變返十幾年之前噉囉。」
eng: The official said calmly: "Your mechanical plant officially shut down a few days ago, so don't change the air in the past few days back to more than ten years ago." 」

text: 官員話：「冇錢囉。嗰間每年都會資助政府嘅公司因為經濟唔好，今年決定唔再畀錢。
eng: The official said, "There's no money. The company that finances the government every year decided not to pay this year because of the bad economy.

text: 冇辦法之下，我哋唯有停止呢個計劃。」
eng: There is no way but to stop this plan. 」

text: 官員口窒窒噉話：「我哋年年都唔夠錢用㗎啦……」
eng: The official stammered, "We don't have enough money every year..."

text: 新聞報導員話：「政府今年大肆慶祝，用咗五千萬佈置最新嘅巡遊花車！
eng: The news reporter said: "The government has been celebrating this year with 50 million to set up the latest parade floats!

text: 大家可以見到，市長企喺花車上面，好開心噉同大家揮手！」
eng: You can see that the mayor is standing on top of the float and waving happily to everyone!"

text: 至繼續話：「至於我哋要做嘅，係唔好失去愛護環境嘅心，同埋要懷抱希望，相信終有一日，我哋嘅市長或者下屆市長會明白環境保護嘅重要……」
eng: He continued: "As for what we have to do, we must not lose our love for the environment, but also hope that one day, our mayor or the next mayor will understand the importance of environmental protection..."

text: 第二日，所有新聞嘅頭條都印住市長喺花車上面揮手個樣。
eng: The next day, all the headlines in the news were marked with the mayor waving on the float.

text: 佢帶住笑容，蹦蹦跳跳噉返學，努力將層層嘅陰霾拋諸腦後……
eng: With a smile on his face, he jumped to school like this, trying to leave the layers of gloom behind ...

text: 貓貓唔見咗
eng: Kitty is missing

text: 我朝早起身，貓貓冇同我講「早晨」。「貓貓早晨！」
eng: When I get up in the morning, Kitty does not say "Good morning". "Good morning Kitty!"

text: 我聽唔到貓貓講「早晨」。貓貓唔見咗。
eng: I cannot hear Kitty say "Good morning". Kitty is missing.

text: 「係唔係你肚餓，食咗貓貓啊？」
eng: "Are you hungry, did you eat Kitty?"

text: 衣櫃話：「我鍾意食衫同埋褲，唔食貓貓㗎喎。」
eng: The closet says: "I like to eat shirts and pants, I did not eat Kitty."

text: 我拉開佢個口，唔見貓貓。「唔好意思……」
eng: I pull his mouth open, but don't see Kitty. "Sorry..."

text: 「貓貓一定係去咗街，我要出去揾佢。」
eng: "Kitty must have gone to the street, I must go out to find her."

text: 門話：「你冇鎖匙，唔俾出去喎。」
eng: The door says, "You don't have a key, I don't let you go out."

text: 我聽到，有啲唔開心。
eng: When I heard that, I am a little unhappy.

text: 門跟住話：「貓貓都冇鎖匙，佢都出唔到去㗎。」「係喎！」
eng: The door then says, "Kitty also has no key, and she also can't get out." "Yes!"

text: 「貓貓係唔係喺你個肚入面啊？」
eng: "Is Kitty in your belly?"

text: 電視話：「你睇下。」
eng: The TV says: "You have a look."

text: 我開咗電視，睇到一個好靚嘅公園，有花，有兔仔，有雀仔，一齊唱緊歌，我都跟住一齊拍手。
eng: When I turned on the TV, I saw a beautiful park, with flowers, bunnies, with birds, singing together, and I clapped along with it.

text: 「喵！」咦？貓貓原來瞓喺櫈上面，我坐到佢條尾啊！
eng: "Meow!" What? It turns out the cat had slept on the chair, and I sat on his tail!

text: 買嘢
eng: Shopping

text: 爸爸同埋哥哥、細妹落街。兩個小朋友都話想買嘢食。
eng: Dad together with Older Brother and Younger Sister went out into the street. The two children said they wanted to buy something to eat.

text: 爸爸同佢哋講：「我一人俾二十蚊你哋，去揾你哋鍾意嘅嘢啦！」
eng: Dad said to them, "I'll give you twenty dollars each, go and find something that you like!"

text: 哥哥好鍾意朱古力，佢用晒二十蚊買咗四包。
eng: Older Brother likes chocolate a lot, he uses all twenty dollars to buy four packs.

text: 細妹好鍾意食包，佢嘅錢買到五個菠蘿包。
eng: Little Sister likes to eat buns a lot, her money is enough to buy five pineapple buns.

text: 睇到啲包，佢喺度諗：「不如都係要一個，我食唔到好多。」
eng: Seeing the buns, she thinks: "It's better to ask for one, I can't eat a lot."

text: 行多一陣，哥哥見到啲好靚嘅紙，佢好想要嚟畫嘢。
eng: After walking a while, Older Brother saw some beautiful paper, and he really wanted it to draw something.

text: 「哎吔，冇錢喇，我用咗啲錢買嘢食。」
eng: "Oh no, I have no money, I used the money to buy something to eat."

text: 細妹好想要，佢想送俾佢個公仔。
eng: Little Sister wanted it very much, she wanted to give it to her doll.

text: 「咦，係喎，我個袋入面有十六蚊喎。」
eng: "Look, yes, I have sixteen dollars in my bag."

text: 細妹用咗呢個袋仔嚟俾公仔放嘢。
eng: Little Sister used this small bag to put things for the doll.

text: 喺𨋢入面，哥哥已經好餓，開咗一包朱古力嚟食。
eng: In the elevator, Older Brother was already hungry and opened a pack of chocolates to eat.

text: 佢一啲都唔覺得飽。
eng: He didn't feel full at all.

text: 到屋企，細妹食咗個包，而家唔肚餓喇。
eng: At home, Little Sister ate the bun, and now she is not hungry.

text: 過咗一陣，媽媽同兩個小朋友出去玩。
eng: After a while, Mom and the two kids went out to play.

text: 佢哋坐巴士嚟到淺水灣沙灘。
eng: They took the bus to Repulse Bay Beach.

text: 落車喇！呢度好靚，天氣好好，又冇乜人。
eng: Out of the car! There it was beautiful, the weather was very good, and not a lot of people.

text: 沙灘好熱喎！好大太陽喎！
eng: The beach is hot! The sun is bright!

text: 佢哋覺得好口渴，想飲啲嘢。
eng: They feel thirsty and want to drink something.

text: 媽媽都俾咗二十蚊哥哥同細妹。
eng: Mom also gave twenty dollars to Older Brother and Little Sister.

text: 媽媽話：「你哋去揾啲你哋鍾意嘅嘢買嚟飲啦！」
eng: Mom said, "Go find something that you like to buy and drink!"

text: 哥哥話：「我唔買喇，好多嘢我唔係真係想要。」
eng: Older Brother said, "I don't buy anything, many things I don't really want to have."

text: 細妹話：「我都唔買喇，我要買我真係鍾意嘅嘢。」
eng: Little Sister said, "I also don't buy anything, I want to buy something that I really like."

text: 佢哋喺袋入面拎咗支水出嚟，大家一齊飲。佢哋而家唔口渴喇。
eng: From their bags they took some bottled water, then drank it together. They are not thirsty now.

text: 掛住婆婆
eng: Missing Grandma

text: 今日係中秋，夜晚個月亮會好大。
eng: Today is Mid-Autumn Festival, at night there will be full moon.

text: 我好想同我婆婆一齊玩。
eng: I would love to play with my grandma.

text: 婆婆一個人同佢隻貓喺香港，我同爸爸媽媽喺愛爾蘭。
eng: Grandma is alone with her cat in Hong Kong, me and mom and dad are in Ireland.

text: 呢兩年我哋唔坐得飛機，行路又去唔到香港。
eng: In the past two years, we have not been able to fly, and we can not walk to Hong Kong.

text: 我哋已經冇見好多日喇。
eng: We haven't seen each other for many days.

text: 婆婆短頭髮，眼好大，鼻好細，嘴好靚，個肚好大。
eng: Grandma has short hair, big eyes, a small nose, a beautiful mouth, and a big belly.

text: 佢鍾意食飯同埋菜肉包，又鍾意飲湯。
eng: She likes to eat rice and steamed buns with vegetables and meat, and she likes to drink soup.

text: 我以前日日喺婆婆屋企食好嘢。
eng: Every day I used to eat delicious food at my grandma's house.

text: 我去廁所，婆婆都跟住。
eng: When I went to the toilet, my grandma followed me.

text: 婆婆好少嬲，成日笑。
eng: Grandma rarely gets angry and always laughs.

text: 佢成日聽我講嘢，唔明又話明，明又話唔明。
eng: She always listens to me, not understanding but saying she does, or understanding but saying she doesn't.

text: 我跌親，我喊，佢知道我覺得痛，會話：「唔驚，飲水啦！」
eng: When I fall and cry, she knows I feel pain and will say, "Don't be afraid, drink water!"

text: 我真係好想飛去婆婆嗰度。
eng: I really want to fly to my grandma.

text: 我好想同婆婆唱歌，我好想同婆婆去踢波。
eng: I really want to sing with my grandma, and I want to play football with her.

text: 婆婆同我睇書，跟住又去街。
eng: My grandma and I would read a book, then go out.

text: 我哋坐車去沙灘，行路去海邊。
eng: We ride a car to the beach, then walk at the seaside.

text: 我哋一齊坐巴士，一齊搭地鐵，又坐船過海去公園。
eng: We take the bus together, take the MTR together, or take the boat to cross the harbour and go to the park.

text: 我哋一齊睇花，一齊睇樹。
eng: We look at flowers together, and look at trees.

text: 我哋一齊大叫大笑，又跑跑跳跳，郁嚟郁去真係好開心。
eng: We shout and laugh together, running and jumping, and really having fun.

text: 婆婆話：「喂，坐一陣啦！」
eng: Grandma says, "Hey, sit for a while!"

text: 而家婆婆同埋佢隻貓喺電話度——婆婆問：
eng: Now grandma and her cat are on the phone - grandma asks:

text: 「你話天空個月亮係唔係又大又靚？」
eng: "Say, is the moon in the sky big and beautiful?"

text: 媽媽答：「我哋呢度個月亮未出嚟，而家只係晏晝，天空有太陽冇月亮。」
eng: Mom replies: "Here with us the moon has not come out yet, now it's only afternoon, in the sky there's the sun and no moon."

text: 媽媽病咗
eng: Mom got sick

text: 今日三點鐘放學，我同家姐一齊搭地鐵返屋企。
eng: Today after school dismissal at three o'clock, me and my older sister took the subway home.

text: 返到屋企，一行到房門就見到媽媽瞓咗喺牀上面。
eng: When we got home, as soon as we came to the bedroom door, we saw Mom sleeping on the bed.

text: 天氣好熱，但係媽媽話覺得凍。
eng: The weather was hot, but Mom said she felt cold.

text: 我同家姐未見過媽媽瞓晏覺，覺得有啲奇怪。
eng: Me and my older sister had not seen Mom take a nap before, so we thought it was a little strange.

text: 我問家姐：「家姐，而家應該點做好？」
eng: I asked my sister, "Sister, now what should we do?"

text: 家姐答我：「我都唔知應該點做好。」
eng: My sister replied, "I also don't know what we should do."

text: 我哋兩個企咗喺房門，唔知要做啲咩好。
eng: We both stood at the bedroom door, not knowing what to do.

text: 家姐諗咗一陣，同我講：「我諗到喇！
eng: My sister thought for a moment and said to me, "I thought about it!

text: 我哋病嗰陣，媽媽會畀好多好多水我哋飲㗎！」
eng: When we got sick, Mom gives us lot and lots of water to drink!"

text: 我跑去廚房拎杯水畀媽媽。
eng: I ran to the kitchen to get a glass of water for Mom.

text: 媽媽聽到我想去拎水，細細聲同我講：「唔該晒細佬！」
eng: When Mom heard that I want to go get water, she quietly said to me, "Thank you Little Brother!"

text: 家姐入房拎電話打畀爸爸話媽媽唔舒服。
eng: My sister went into the bedroom to get the phone and call Dad to tell him Mom is not feeling well.

text: 講完電話，家姐又話：「喂，細佬，我同爸爸講咗喇！
eng: After talking on the phone, Sister spoke again, "Hey, Little Brother, I talked to Dad!

text: 爸爸話，媽媽要瞓多一陣，不如我哋幫媽媽做家務，你話好唔好？」
eng: Dad said, Mom needs to sleep a bit more, why don't we help Mom do the housework, what do you say?"

text: 我笑住點頭，話：「好啊！我去廁所洗衫褲，家姐你去抹個廳同房啦！」
eng: I smiled and nodded, then said, "Okay! I'll go to the bathroom to wash the clothing; Sister, you go to wipe the living room and bedroom!"

text: 講完，我哋兩個跑咗入房。
eng: Having said that, the two of us ran into the bedroom.

text: 我去拎啲衫褲入廁所洗，家姐入房抹牀、房門同櫃。
eng: I went to get some clothes and went to the bathroom to wash, and my sister went into the room to wipe the bed, the door and the cabinet.

text: 我哋仲一齊幫屋企兩隻兔仔同狗仔沖涼。
eng: We even gave the family's two little rabbits and puppies a shower.

text: 好快，我哋已經幫媽媽做好晒家務。
eng: Soon, we had already helped Mom with housework.

text: 媽媽見我同家姐都係好幫手，覺得好開心。
eng: When Mom saw me and my sister help out, she felt very happy.

text: 夜晚爸爸返到屋企嗰陣，媽媽已經好返晒，唔使瞓喇！
eng: In the evening when Dad had came home, Mom had gotten better and didn't need to sleep!

text: 媽媽喺牀上面起身，同我哋講：
eng: Mom sat up on the bed and said to us:

text: 「唔該晒啊，等我整啲細佬同家姐好鍾意嘅餸菜畀你哋食啦！」
eng: "Thank you, wait until I'll make something that Little Brother and Older Sister really like for you to eat!"

text: 爸爸都有讚我哋，佢話：「家姐、細佬，多謝你哋幫爸爸照顧媽媽。
eng: Dad also praised us, he said: "Older Sister, Little Brother, thank you for helping Dad take care of Mom.

text: 你哋有幫媽媽手，係大個仔大個女喇！」
eng: You have a helped Mom out, you are a big boy and a big girl!"

text: 第二日，爸爸畀咗架我好鍾意玩嘅玩具巴士我，同埋家姐好鍾意嘅衫畀家姐——佢話係乖嘅小朋友先有㗎！
eng: The next day, Dad gave me a toy bus that I like to play with, and to my sister he gave some clothes that she liked -- he said that he had well-behaved kids!

text: 我以後都要做一個幫媽媽做嘢嘅小朋友！
eng: I will also be a child who helps Mom in the future!

text: 搭巴士
eng: Taking The Bus

text: 今日係我第一日返學，朝早起身換好衫，食個包就去搭車。
eng: Today is my first day of school, in the morning I get up and change clothes, eat a bun then go to take the bus.

text: 媽媽同我一齊去搭巴士。
eng: Mom and I go together to take the bus.

text: 等咗十分鐘都冇車，太陽又大又曬，我覺得好熱。
eng: After having waited for ten minutes there still is no car, the sun is big and blinding, and I feel very hot.

text: 我話：「媽媽，我好熱，好想坐下。」
eng: I say, "Mom, I'm hot and I want to sit down."

text: 媽媽同我講：「等多五分鐘都冇巴士嚟，我哋就去搭地鐵啦！」
eng: Mom says to me, "If after waiting five more minutes no bus has come, we'll go and take the subway!"

text: 我唔見有巴士，書包又重，有啲唔開心。
eng: I don't see a bus, and my bag is heavy, so I feel a little unhappy.

text: 五分鐘後，有巴士喇。媽媽同我一齊上車。
eng: Five minutes later, there is a bus. Mom and I get in the car together.

text: 巴士入面有好多人，好多都要企。
eng: In the bus there are lots of people, and many have to stand.

text: 我冇位坐，又孭住個大書包，唔係咁開心。
eng: I don't have a seat, and I am carrying a big school bag, so I am not so happy.

text: 我同媽媽講：「媽媽，書包好重，我想坐下。」
eng: I say to Mom, "Mom, my bag is heavy, I want to sit down."

text: 媽媽話：「企一陣啦，冇位呀！」
eng: Mom says, "Stand for a while, there are no seats!"

text: 有個叔叔企起身同我講：「小朋友，呢度有個位，你坐啦！叔叔唔坐喇。」
eng: An uncle gets up and says to me, "Kid, here is a seat, sit down! Uncle doesn't sit."

text: 媽媽同叔叔講：「噉樣唔好意思嘅。」
eng: Mom says to the uncle, "Not like this, I'm sorry."

text: 叔叔話：「唔緊要，俾小朋友坐啦。」
eng: The uncle says, "It's okay, let the kid sit."

text: 媽媽話：「多謝你啊！細妹，講『多謝叔叔』啦！」
eng: Mom says, "Thank you! Little Sister, say 'Thank you, Uncle'!"

text: 我坐低之後，對住叔叔笑咗一笑：「多謝叔叔！多謝叔叔！」
eng: After sitting down, I turn to the uncle and after giving him a smile: "Thank you, Uncle! Thank you, Uncle!"

text: 過咗一陣，有個婆婆上咗巴士。
eng: After a while, a grandma got on the bus.

text: 佢望一望，架巴士企滿晒人。冇人企起身。
eng: She looks around and sees that the bus stop is full of people standing. No one gets up to stand.

text: 我諗咗一陣，最後都係企咗起身，同婆婆講：
eng: I thought for a while, but finally stood up and say to the grandma:

text: 「婆婆，婆婆！呢度有個位，你坐啦！我唔坐喇！」
eng: "Grandma, Grandma! There is a seat here, sit down! I don't sit!"

text: 巴士上嘅人都拍手話我係「叻女」。
eng: People on the bus clapped their hands and said I was a "smart girl".

text: 飲早茶
eng: Morning tea

text: 今日，爸爸媽媽、細妹同我去揾公公婆婆食飯。
eng: Today, Mom and Dad, my little sister and I went to have morning tea with Grandpa and Grandma.

text: 公公婆婆住喺旺角，我哋住屯門，所以朝早八點鐘已經要出門搭巴士。
eng: Grandpa and Grandma live in Mong Kok and we live in Tuen Mun, so we already had to go out at 8 a.m. to take the bus.

text: 我問媽媽：「媽媽，點解我哋要八點出門口？我想瞓多一陣……」
eng: I asked Mom, "Mom, why do we have to go out at eight? I want to sleep a bit longer..."

text: 媽媽同我講：「公公婆婆佢哋好早起身，好早肚餓，好早食飯。我哋九點鐘到，就可以早啲同佢哋食嘢……」
eng: Mom said to me, "Grandpa and Grandma, they wake up very early, they are hungry very early, they eat very early. When we arrive at nine o'clock, we can eat with them early..."

text: 我有兩個月冇見過公公婆婆喇！
eng: I had not seen Grandpa and Grandma in two months!

text: 公公同婆婆今日都好精神——佢哋年紀好大㗎喇，頭髮都白晒，最近天氣又熱，但係佢哋起身都會去公園行下，做運動。
eng: Grandpa and Grandma were also very lively today - they are very old, their hair is white, and the weather has been hot recently, but they always get up and go to the park for a walk and do exercises.

text: 公公婆婆一見到我同細妹，笑得好開心，又叫咗好多嘢俾我哋食：有菜、有飯、有包……我同細妹都食咗好多。
eng: When Grandpa and Grandma saw me and my little sister, they smiled so happily, and they ordered a lot of things for us to eat: vegetables, rice, buns... My little sister and I ate a lot.

text: 公公婆婆話，佢哋最鍾意見到我哋食好多嘢，覺得噉樣已經好幸福。
eng: Grandpa and Grandma said that they so liked to see us eat a lot and felt that they were blessed.

text: 婆婆見我食得開心，就話：「細佬唔好淨係食，要飲啲水。」
eng: Grandma watched me eating happily, then said, "Little Brother, don't just eat, drink some water."

text: 聽完我真係覺得有啲口渴，就拎咗個細杯飲水。
eng: After hearing that, I really felt a bit thirsty, so I took a small cup and drank water.

text: 食食下，細妹指住一碟嘢，問：「公公婆婆，呢啲係咩嚟㗎？」
eng: After eating, Little Sister pointed to a plate and asked: "Grandpa, what is that?"

text: 公公笑一笑，答：「呢啲係蛋糕嚟㗎！細妹食啲啦！」
eng: Grandpa smiled and replied: "That's cake! Little Sister, eat some!"

text: 我望住呢一碟我冇見過嘅嘢，問公公：「呢啲好唔好食㗎？」
eng: I looked at this dish that I had not seen before, and asked Grandpa: "Does this taste good?"

text: 公公話：「你婆婆最鍾意食呢啲㗎，你同細妹都食下啦！」
eng: Grandpa said: "Your Grandma likes this one best, you and your little sister eat some!"

text: 媽媽拎咗少少俾我食，又真係幾好食喎！
eng: Mom took a little bit for me to eat, and it was really delicious!

text: 我問媽媽：「呢啲叫咩名啊？」
eng: I asked Mom, "How do you call this?"

text: 媽媽同我講：「呢啲係馬拉糕。婆婆冇牙，馬拉糕易咬，所以好啱佢食㗎！」
eng: Mom said to me, "This is Malay sponge cake. Grandma has no teeth, and Malay cake is easy to bite, so it is very suitable for her to eat!"

text: 我拎咗一件畀婆婆，同佢講：「婆婆，噉我畀你食啦！」
eng: I took one for Grandma and said to her: "Grandma, then I give this to you to eat!"

text: 見婆婆食得開心，我都覺得好開心！
eng: Seeing Grandma eating happily, I also felt very happy!

text: 咩聲嚟㗎？
eng: What is that sound?

text: 有一日，貓仔、鹿仔、同埋松鼠仔喺公園行。
eng: One day, Little Kitten, Little Deer, and Little Squirrel were walking in the park.

text: 行行下，佢哋聽到啲聲：「啦啦啦啦啦⋯⋯」
eng: As they walked, they heard a sound: "La la la ..."

text: 鹿仔問：「呢啲聲係喺邊度嚟㗎？」
eng: Little Deer asked, "Where is this sound coming from?"

text: 松鼠仔話：「係唔係周圍都有㗎？」
eng: Little Squirrel said, "Isn't it everywhere?"

text: 貓仔答：「唔係啊，係喺嗰度嚟㗎！」
eng: Little Kitten replied, "No, it's coming from here!"

text: 佢哋三個跟住啲聲行。行行下，佢哋又聽到啲聲：「啦啦啦啦啦⋯⋯」
eng: The three of them followed the sound. As they walked, they heard the sound again: "La la la ..."

text: 鹿仔問：「又有喇！係唔係喺天空嚟㗎？」
eng: Little Deer asked, "Again! Is it in the sky?"

text: 松鼠仔話：「係唔係喺啲樹嗰度嚟㗎？」
eng: Little Squirrel said, "Is it coming from a tree there?"

text: 貓仔答：「唔係啊，係喺草叢嗰度嚟㗎！」
eng: Little kitten replied, "No, it's coming from the underbrush!"

text: 佢哋三個跟住啲聲行去草叢嗰度。行行下，佢哋又聽到啲聲：「啦啦啦啦啦⋯⋯」
eng: The three of them followed the sound to the underbrush there. As they walked, they heard the sound again: "La la la ..."

text: 鹿仔問：「又有喇！係唔係黑色㗎？」
eng: Little Deer asked, "Again! Is it black?"

text: 松鼠仔話：「係唔係白色㗎？」
eng: Little Squirrel said, "Is it white?"

text: 貓仔答：「唔係啊，係啡色㗎！」
eng: Little Kitten replied, "No, it's brown!"

text: 佢哋三個跟住啲聲行。行行下，佢哋又聽到啲聲：「啦啦啦啦啦⋯⋯」
eng: The three of them followed the sound. As they walked, they heard the sound again: "La la la ..."

text: 鹿仔問：「又有喇！係唔係有人講嘢啊？」
eng: Little Deer asked, "Again! Is there anyone talking?"

text: 松鼠仔話：「係唔係喊聲啊？」
eng: Little Squirrel said, "Is it a crying sound?"

text: 貓仔答：「唔係啊，係有人唱歌啊！」
eng: Little Kitten replied, "No, someone is singing!"

text: 佢哋三個企喺草叢入面傾計。
eng: The three of them stood in the underbrush chatting.

text: 鹿仔問：「係唔係兔仔呢？」
eng: Little Deer asked, "Is it a little rabbit?"

text: 松鼠仔話：「係唔係雀仔呢？」
eng: Little Squirrel said, "Is it a little bird?"

text: 貓仔答：「唔係啊，係⋯⋯」「啦啦啦啦啦⋯⋯」
eng: Little Kitten replied, "No, it's ..." "La la la ..."

text: 佢哋三個一齊行過去，話：「係驢仔唱歌啊！我哋都一齊唱歌啦！」
eng: The three of them walked over together, and said "It's the little donkey singing! Let's sing together!"

text: 雀仔
eng: Birds

text: 你哋都應該知道，雀仔鍾意喺個天空度飛。
eng: You all should know, birds like to fly in the sky.

text: 你又知唔知道，雀仔有一樣好重要嘅事要做，就係幫小朋友傳口訊去天空度。
eng: Do you also know, birds have a very important thing to do, which is to help children spread word of mouth to the sky?

text: 傳乜嘢口訊？乜嘢都得㗎！
eng: What kind of message? Anything!

text: 每一個小朋友都有一隻雀仔幫佢傳口訊。
eng: Every child has one bird to help him send a message.

text: 嗰隻幫小靜，呢隻幫大明，又有一隻小雀仔去幫小澄澄。
eng: That one helps Jenny, this one helps Ming, and another little bird goes to help Jackie.

text: 小靜想瞓瞓唔着，佢同佢隻雀仔講︰「我要數雀仔。」
eng: Jenny wants to sleep but can't, she says to her bird: "I want to count the birds."

text: 雀仔飛上天，叫埋佢啲朋友仔。
eng: The bird flies into the sky and calls his little friends.

text: 一隻、兩隻、三隻、四隻……小靜瞓着咗喇。
eng: One, two, three, four ... Jenny fell asleep.

text: 大明聽日要踢波，天空落雨落唔停。
eng: Ming wants to play football tomorrow, but in the sky it is raining non-stop.

text: 佢對住天空叫︰「唔該出太陽！」
eng: He calls to the sky: "Please come out sun!"

text: 大明隻雀仔飛上天，轉咗十個圈，啲雨就停咗。
eng: Ming's bird flew to the sky, turned ten circles, and the rain then stopped.

text: 姨姨話俾佢知，公公有個新屋企，唔會再返嚟。
eng: His aunt let him know, Grandpa has a new home, and he won't return.

text: 叔叔又話要送一隻新手錶畀公公，同埋新電視。
eng: His uncle also said they need to send a new watch to Grandpa, and a new TV.

text: 小澄澄見到好大火，就噉樣，公公嘅手錶電視就冇咗。
eng: Jackie saw a big fire, and this way, Grandpa's new wristwatch and TV were gone.

text: 小澄澄成日見唔到公公，夜晩望住個天空。
eng: Jackie always cannot see Grandpa, but every night he watches the sky.

text: 佢見到有隻小雀仔，喺佢頭上飛。
eng: He saw a little bird, flying above his head.

text: 佢同雀仔講︰「我好想見公公。」
eng: He said to the bird, "I would love to see Grandpa."

text: 雀仔飛上天。小澄澄喺個天空度，見到公公對住佢笑。
eng: The bird flew into the sky. Jackie was in the sky, he saw Grandpa smiling at him.

text: 生日快樂
eng: Happy Birthday

text: 昌仔今日生日，佢七歲喇！佢哥哥家姐想送一條金魚畀佢。
eng: Today is Tristan's birthday, he is seven years old! His brother and sister want to give him a goldfish.

text: 佢哋一齊坐小巴去金魚街。條街好熱，上到小巴好凍。
eng: Together they take a minibus to Goldfish Street. The streets are hot, but in the minibus it's cold.

text: 有個伯伯話：「喂，唔該郁一郁，畀我坐一坐。」
eng: An uncle says: "Hey, please move, let me have a seat."

text: 到喇！到喇！佢哋落咗小巴，條街好熱。
eng: Arrived! Arrived! When they got off the minibus, the street was hot.

text: 「嘩！有好多金魚！」昌仔拍手大叫。
eng: "Wow! There are a lot of goldfish!" shouted Tristan clapping his hands.

text: 昌仔見到一條魚喺水度游嚟游去。條魚個口又喺度郁下郁下。
eng: Tristan looked at a fish swimming around in the water. The mouth of the fish is moving as well.

text: 昌仔問佢哥哥家姐：「條魚係唔係口渴？條魚係唔係喺度飲緊水？」
eng: Tristan asked his brother and sister, "Is the fish thirsty? Is the fish there drinking water?"

text: 哥哥答：「唔係。」
eng: The brother replied, "No."

text: 昌仔又問：「噉條魚係唔係肚餓？條魚係唔係喺度食緊嘢？」
eng: Tristan asked again, "Then, is the fish hungry? Is the fish eating?"

text: 家姐答：「唔係。」
eng: My sister replied, "No."

text: 有個叔叔行過嚟，佢話條魚喺度呼吸緊。
eng: An uncle came up, he says the fish is breathing.

text: 叔叔又問：「細路，有冇邊條魚你想要？」
eng: The uncle also asked, "Kids, is there any fish you want?"

text: 昌仔見到有一條魚，條尾又長又靚，佢同叔叔講佢想要嗰條魚。
eng: Tristan saw a fish with a long and beautiful tail, and he told the uncle that he wanted that fish.

text: 「呢條？好！噉不如要埋啲魚糧啦？細細粒，啲魚好鍾意食㗎。」
eng: "That one? Good! Well how about some fish food? Fine-grained, the fish really like to eat it."

text: 條街好熱，昌仔拎住一袋二袋，跟住哥哥家姐一齊上小巴，小巴好凍。
eng: The street is very hot, Tristan takes one bag, two bags, then with his brother and sister he got on the minibus, the minibus is so cold.

text: 條魚喺個袋度游嚟游去，佢個口又喺度郁下郁下。
eng: The fish swims around in the bag, with his mouth moving again.

text: 叻叻花貓
eng: Smart Pussycat

text: 「救命！」媽媽喺個廳嗰度大叫。
eng: "Help!" Mom shouted in the living room.

text: 琦琦跑入去，見到媽媽企喺張枱上面。
eng: Kay ran inside, and saw Mom standing on the table.

text: 佢個口好大，對眼好細，對手好長，放咗喺個頭上面。
eng: Her mouth wide, her eyes small, her hands long and put on her head.

text: 琦琦問媽媽︰「乜嘢事咁驚？」
eng: Kay asked Mom, "What is so scary?"

text: 「老鼠！」「哦！花貓又曳曳。」琦琦一啲都唔驚。
eng: "Mouse!" "Oh! Pussycat is naughty again." Kay was not afraid at all.

text: 花貓住喺琦琦屋企，鍾意日日朝早落街玩，晏晝又搭𨋢上嚟。
eng: Pussycat lives in Kay's home, and everyday in the morning likes to go down to the street to play; on the afternoon he takes the lift to come up again.

text: 花貓今日同埋隻老鼠一齊入嚟屋企，老鼠喺佢個口入面。
eng: Today Pussycat came home together with a mouse, the mouse inside of her mouth.

text: 佢想送老鼠俾琦琦一家人。
eng: She wanted to give the mouse to Kay's family.

text: 花貓行到入廳，見到媽媽，細細聲叫︰「喵……喵……」
eng: When Pussycat walked into the living room, and saw Mom, she quietly called: "Meow... meow ..."

text: 嗰隻老鼠喺佢個口度跳出嚟。
eng: That mouse jumped out of her mouth.

text: 媽媽驚到飛咗上張枱上面。
eng: Mom was afraid and flew onto the table.

text: 老鼠驚到跑咗入個櫃下面。
eng: The mouse was afraid and ran under the cabinet.

text: 花貓呢？去咗張牀上面瞓覺。
eng: And Pussycat? Went onto the bed to sleep.

text: 媽媽話︰「琦琦，你一定要幫我揾隻老鼠出嚟。」
eng: Mom said: "Kay, you really must help me find the mouse to get it out."

text: 琦琦點點頭。琦琦一啲都唔驚。
eng: Kay nodded his head. Kay was not afraid at all.

text: 佢諗咗一諗，打開大門口，又唔俾花貓瞓。
eng: He thought a bit about it, then opened the door, and deterred Pussycat from sleeping.

text: 花貓轉入去個櫃下面。而家個櫃下面好嘈呀！
eng: Pussycat turned and went under the cabinet. Now, under the cabinet it was noisy!

text: 「吱！吱！」「喵！喵！」老鼠跑咗出大門口，花貓冇跟住跑出去。
eng: "Squeak! Squeak!" "Meow! Meow!" The mouse ran out of the door, but Pussycat did not follow her out.

text: 「花貓，你真係叻！」琦琦摸下佢個頭。
eng: "Pussycat, you are so smart!" Kay scratched her neck.

text: 海龜
eng: Turtle

text: 出嚟喇！海龜出嚟喇！海龜喺隻海龜蛋度出嚟喇！
eng: It's out! The turtle is out! The turtle is coming out of that turtle egg!

text: 佢啲細佬細妹一隻一隻噉喺嗰啲海龜蛋度出嚟喇！
eng: His younger brothers and sister, one by one, come out of those turtle eggs!

text: 海龜喺蛋入面乜都見唔到，出到嚟蛋外面，海龜見到好多沙，又見到個大海。
eng: The turtle can not see anything inside the egg, and when it comes out of the egg, the turtle sees a lot of sand, and it sees the sea.

text: 佢啲細佬細妹都見到好多沙，又見到個大海。
eng: His younger brothers and sisters also see a lot of sand, and they see the sea.

text: 你估下，海龜有冇耳仔？海龜係有耳仔㗎！
eng: Can you guess, do turtles have ears? Turtles do have ears!

text: 佢對耳仔好細，同我哋嗰對耳仔好唔同。
eng: His ears are very small, very different from our ears.

text: 你估下，海龜有冇腳？海龜係有腳㗎！
eng: Can you guess, do turtles have feet? Turtles do have feet!

text: 海龜四隻腳好短，同狗仔嗰四隻腳好唔同。
eng: The turtle's four legs are very short, very different from the four legs of a puppy.

text: 你估下，海龜有冇尾？海龜係有尾㗎！
eng: Can you guess, do turtles have tails? Turtles do have tails!

text: 海龜條尾又係好短，同豬仔條尾好唔同。
eng: The turtle's tail is also very short, very different from a piglet's tail.

text: 咦，海龜呢？唔見咗海龜喎！啊！佢爬緊去個大海度！
eng: Look, the turtle? We've lost the turtle! Ah! He's crawling into the ocean!

text: 好夜喇，海龜都唔瞓。佢同佢啲細佬細妹一齊爬入海。
eng: It's late, and turtles don't sleep. He, together with his younger brothers and sisters, climbs into the sea.

text: 一啲都唔易㗎！哎吔！啲浪一個接一個打埋嚟。
eng: It's also not easy at all! Ouch! Waves, one after another, hit them.

text: 啲小海龜又要再爬過喇。佢哋好用力噉爬……
eng: These little turtles also need to crawl again. They climb very hard ... ...

text: 睇下！佢哋喺個海入面喇！
eng: Look! They're in the ocean!

text: 啲海水有少少凍……但啲海龜話咁快就唔見晒喇！
eng: This sea water is a little cold ... ... But the turtles have quickly all disappeared!

text: 兔仔要走喇
eng: Little Rabbit needs to leave

text: 兔仔住喺呢個樹林好開心，佢成日同佢班好同學一齊玩。
eng: Little Rabbit lived happily in these woods, all day long he played together with his good classmates.

text: 上晝一齊温書，下晝一齊去打波。
eng: In the morning they studied together, in the afternoon they went together to play ball.

text: 佢哋一齊去好多唔同嘅地方玩。
eng: They went together to many different places.

text: 有一日，兔仔喺度沖涼，媽媽喺廁所出面大叫︰
eng: One day, Little Rabbit was taking a shower, when Mom outside of the bathroom shouted:

text: 「出嚟去爸爸媽媽間房，我哋有嘢要同你講。」
eng: "Come out and go to Mom and Dad's room, we have something to tell you."

text: 「我哋要離開呢個樹林，呢度啲樹越嚟越少，好難揾嘢食。」爸爸話畀兔仔知。
eng: "We must leave these woods, here the trees get fewer and fewer, and it's hard to find something to eat." Dad let Little Rabbit know.

text: 「你明唔明白？」兔仔點點頭，但係有啲唔開心。
eng: "Do you understand?" Little Rabbit nodded his head, but he was a bit unhappy.

text: 佢打電話畀佢班同學仔，兔仔話︰「我聽日朝早十點鐘要走喇。」
eng: He called his classmates on the phone, Little Rabbit said: "Tomorrow morning at 10 o'clock I must leave."

text: 而家兔仔間屋好亂。
eng: Now Little Rabbit's home is a mess.

text: 佢放咗……一盞燈、兩張櫈、三個碗、四隻碟、五隻杯、六對鞋、七對襪、八條褲、
eng: He put ... One lamp, two chairs, three bowls, four plates, five cups, six pairs of shoes, seven pairs of socks, eight pairs of pants,

text: 九件衫、同埋十個毛公仔，喺一個好大好大嘅袋入面。
eng: nine shirts, and ten stuffed animals, into one very large bag.

text: 佢班好同學一大朝早企喺兔仔屋企門口，有個男仔話︰「你不如唔好走啦！」
eng: His good classmates early in the morning stood at Little Rabbit's front door; a boy said: "How about you don't leave!"

text: 有個女仔話︰「你不如唔好走啦！」
eng: A girl said: "How about you don't leave!"

text: 兔仔同埋佢班同學仔，大家一齊喊。
eng: Little Rabbit together with his good classmates, everyone cried together.

text: 「我都同你哋一樣，好唔想走。」兔仔喊住講。
eng: "I'm like you, I really don't want to leave", Little Rabbit said while crying.

text: 「對唔住……我要同我爸爸媽媽一齊。」
eng: "I'm sorry... I need to go with my mom and dad."

text: 「多謝晒……拜拜……我哋一定會再見㗎！」
eng: "Thank you all ... Bye bye ... We will definitely see each other again!"

text: 我有一隻狗
eng: I have a dog

text: 我同家姐有一隻狗仔，我哋去行街嗰陣，會拖住狗仔一齊行。
eng: I and my older sister have a puppy; when we go shopping with him, we will drag the puppy to walk together with us.

text: 佢真係好可愛，啲人好鍾意走過嚟同佢玩，佢都好鍾意同啲人玩。
eng: He's really cute, people love to come over and play with him, and he loves to play with people.

text: 我哋叫狗仔做小高。
eng: We call the puppy Gordon.

text: 我哋同小高去唔同嘅地方，等佢跑嚟跑去，跳嚟跳去，一齊打波，一齊玩。
eng: We and Gordon go to different places, wait for him to run around, jump around, play ball together, play together.

text: 我哋一齊去公園，一齊去行山，一齊去海邊。
eng: We go together to the park, go hiking together, go to the beach together.

text: 小高好鍾意去海邊，因為跑完可以去游水。
eng: Gordon likes to go to the beach, because after running he can go swimming.

text: 由頭濕到落腳，好好玩，不過媽媽話游完水之後要沖涼，我同小高都唔鍾意沖涼。
eng: We got wet from head to toe, which is so fun; but Mom says after swimming we need to take a shower, but I and Gordon both don't like taking a shower.

text: 小高口渴，我畀水佢飲；佢肚餓，我揾嘢畀佢食。
eng: When Gordon is thirsty, I give him water to drink; when he is hungry, I find something for him to eat.

text: 我畀我啲飯佢食，仲有菜同埋肉。
eng: I give him some of my rice to eat, also vegetables and meat.

text: 我畀朱古力同埋提子小高食，小高唔食，佢話：「我唔食得，食咗會肚痛㗎。」
eng: When I gave chocolate and raisins to Gordon, Gordon did not eat it, he said, "I can't eat that, if I eat it I will have a stomachache."

text: 我話：「我知道喇，對唔住。」
eng: I said, "I know, I'm sorry."

text: 如果小高大聲叫，好嘈，我會同佢講：「噉樣唔得㗎，會嘈住隔籬嘅婆婆。
eng: When Gordon barks loudly, it's very noisy, and I will say to him, "This is not okay, it will be noisy at next door's Grandma.

text: 不如做隻叻叻狗，聽我講，坐好，坐定定郁都唔郁。」
eng: Better be a good dog, listen to what I say, sit down, sit still and don't move."

text: 跟住我一定會畀啲狗餅佢食，話畀佢知佢係一隻叻叻狗。
eng: And then I surely will give him some dog biscuit to eat, tell him he is a good dog.

text: 大霧山嘅最後日子
eng: The last days of the Great Smoky Mountains

text: 喺大霧山上住咗個探險家，佢叫做超英。
eng: On the Great Smoky Mountains lived an explorer called Superhero.

text: 超英好鍾意行山，佢行山嗰陣好鍾意影相，影相嗰陣會好開心。
eng: Superhero likes to climb mountains, he likes to take pictures when he climbs mountains, and he will be happy when taking pictures.

text: 有一日佢散緊步嘅時候，聽到樹林裏面有喊聲，但佢唔肯定啲喊聲喺邊度傳嚟。
eng: One day he was walking and heard cries in the woods, but he wasn't sure where they were coming from.

text: 佢沿住喊聲嘅方向行，期間遇到一隻上身甩咗色嘅老虎，一半係灰色，一半係橙黃色。
eng: He walked in the direction of the cry, during which he encountered a tiger with its upper body discolored, half gray, half orange-yellow.

text: 超英認得佢，知道佢叫小武，係一隻好勇敢嘅老虎。
eng: Chaoying recognized him and knew that his name was Xiaowu, and he was a very brave tiger.

text: 但今日嘅小武一見到超英就豎起條尾，用閃縮嘅眼神望一望佢就轉身跑走咗。
eng: But today's Xiao Wu raised his tail as soon as he saw Chaoying, looked at him with shrunken eyes, and turned and ran away.

text: 佢繼續行，繼續行，見到好多螞蟻走晒出地面，抬住好多食物；
eng: He kept walking, kept walking, and saw a lot of ants walking out of the ground, carrying a lot of food;

text: 見到大笨象，聽到佢哋話自己咁大隻，唔知有咩地方可以生活；
eng: Seeing elephants, hearing them say that they are so big, they don't know where to live;

text: 見到長頸鹿，長頸鹿話佢哋咁顯眼，一行出樹林就會俾人發現……
eng: Seeing giraffes, giraffes say that they are so conspicuous that they will be spotted as soon as they leave the woods ...

text: 雖然啲動物擔心嘅嘢唔同，但一樣嘅係，佢哋一見到超英，就退到好後好後，走得好快好快。
eng: Although some animals are worried about different things, the same thing is that as soon as they see the superhero, they retreat well and run very fast.

text: 超英唔明白，明明大家平時都會傾計，點解今日一遇到就掉頭走？
eng: Chaoying doesn't understand, obviously everyone usually talks about calculations, why do they turn around and leave as soon as they meet today?

text: 「究竟發生咩事？點解啲動物會咁不安？」超英細細聲問自己。
eng: Why are these animals so upset?" asked himself in a low voice.

text: 佢繼續揾喊聲，終於發現喊緊嘅原來係一棵樹。
eng: He continued to look for crying, and finally found that it was a tree crying.

text: 呢棵樹叫阿澤，唔知點解冇晒頭髮，剩得光禿禿嘅身體。
eng: The tree is called Aze, and I don't know why there is no hair at all, only a bare body.

text: 「啲動物個個都話要搬屋，以後我哋咩都冇喇……」阿澤喊住噉同超英講。
eng: "Some of the animals everyone said they were going to move, and then we had nothing left... Aze cried and said to Superhero.

text: 「發生咩事？點解佢哋要走？」
eng: "What happened, why should they go?"

text: 「海豚千里傳音同我哋講，有人類打算夷平呢度嚟起樓，樹木就會斬落嚟運去北方做柴燒。
eng: "The dolphin told us that if humans planned to raze this place to build buildings, the trees would be cut down and transported to the north for firewood.

text: 明明呢度至係佢哋屋企，但啲人竟然反過嚟話係野豬入侵咗佢哋嘅生活，話係野豬傷害佢哋！
eng: Obviously, this is their home, but people actually say that wild boars have invaded their lives, saying that wild boars hurt them!

text: 我哋究竟做錯啲咩，點解啲人類要噉樣對我哋？」
eng: What are we doing wrong, and why do these humans do this to us?"

text: 等到阿澤情緒稍有緩和，超英就問：「噉所以啲動物就唔敢再住喺度？」
eng: When Aze's mood eased a little, Chaoying asked, "So the animals don't dare to live here anymore?"

text: 「我都唔敢呀，但我哋走唔到……爸爸媽媽話啲動物走晒嘅話，樹木冇晒佢哋啲糞便做養份，就會唔夠營養，就算啲人類唔斬樹，呢片樹林遲早都會走向衰亡……」
eng: "I don't dare, but we can't go ... Mom and Dad said that if these animals are gone, the trees will not have their manure for nutrients, and even if humans do not cut down trees, this forest will decline sooner or later..."

text: 超英聽到好傷心，唔知點樣安慰阿澤。
eng: Chaoying was very sad to hear it and didn't know how to comfort Aze.

text: 佢見到其他花草樹木，全部都愁眉苦面。
eng: When he saw the other flowers and trees, they were all sad.

text: 超英諗起一直以嚟同大家相處嘅時光，諗起自己由細到大都係喺呢度生活，同每一位都係好朋友；
eng: Chaoying remembers the time he has been with everyone, remembers that he has lived here since he was a child, and he is a good friend with everyone;

text: 但今時今日，竟然要睇住佢哋一個一個噉離開，睇住呢個山頭一點一點噉消失……
eng: But now, I have to watch them leave one by one like this, and watch this mountain disappear little by little ...

text: 山頭教咗佢好多知識，畀咗佢好多難忘嘅經歷，但今日佢好似咩都做唔到，亦冇力阻止自私嘅人嘅惡行……
eng: The mountain has taught him a lot and given him many unforgettable experiences, but today he seems to be unable to do anything, nor can he stop the evil deeds of selfish people ...

text: 呢個時候，佢只能夠默默攞起相機，好好影低呢度嘅一事一物。
eng: At this time, he could only silently pick up the camera and take a good picture of everything here.

text: 佢執起一棵毋忘我，温柔噉講︰「聽日嘅事冇人知道，我哋能夠做嘅，就係過好今日。
eng: He picked up a forget-me-not tree and said gently, "No one knows what will happen tomorrow, what we can do is to live today."

text: 就好似我哋而家呼吸緊嘅新鮮空氣，我哋就趁佢仲係美好嘅時候，好好把握同享受啦。
eng: Just like the fresh air we are breathing now, let's take advantage of it while he is still beautiful.

text: 噉將來就算係俾風吹走，都起碼叫做有過美好回憶，留有努力活過嘅證據……」
eng: In the future, even if it is blown away by the wind, it is at least called having good memories, leaving evidence of trying to live..."

text: 佢遠遠望到鹿仔，又向佢大嗌︰「喂！呢度仲有啲草，仲係好靚㗎，你哋要食多啲呀！」
eng: He looked at the deer from a distance and cursed at him: "Hey, there's still grass here, it's still beautiful, you have to eat too much!"

text: 終於行到太陽落山，佢對住山頭影完佢今日嘅最後一幅相，就大嗌︰
eng: Finally walking to the setting sun, he cursed after taking his last picture of the day at the top of the mountain.

text: 「我相信有一日，你哋會返嚟同我哋重聚㗎！」
eng: "I believe that one day, you will come back and reunite with me!"

text: 菜肉包
eng: Vegetable and meat buns

text: 今日上晝，細佬一起身就大叫：「好想食菜肉包啊！」
eng: This morning, just when Little Brother has woken up he shouted, "I really want to eat some vegetable and meat buns!"

text: 細妹同哥哥講：「細佬話好想食菜肉包！」
eng: Younger Sister said to Older Brother: "Little Brother says he wants to eat some vegetable and meat buns!"

text: 哥哥又同媽媽講：「細妹話細佬好想食菜肉包！」
eng: Older Brother then said to Mom: "Younger Sister says Little Brother really wants to eat vegetable and meat buns!"

text: 媽媽話：「吓，屋企冇肉喎！」
eng: Mom said, "What? There is no meat at home!"

text: 跟住哥哥問兔仔邊度有肉，但係兔仔玩緊捉伊人。
eng: Then, Older Brother asks Little Rabbit where is the meat, but little rabbit is playing hide and seek.

text: 細妹就問豬仔，豬仔瞓咗覺冇答佢。
eng: Younger Sister then asks Little Piggy, but Little Piggy was asleep and did not answer her.

text: 到細佬問魚仔，魚仔唔記得佢問咩。
eng: Then Little Brother asks Little Fish, but Little Fish forgot what he asked.

text: 哎吔！細佬喊住問媽媽：「噉而家點算好？」
eng: Oh! Little Brother cried and asked Mom, "What to do now?"

text: 媽媽話：「食菜啦，菜又健康又好食！」
eng: Mom said, "Eat vegetables, vegetables are healthy and delicious!"

text: 細佬又問：「噉包呢？邊處有包？」
eng: Little Brother then asked, "And the bun? Where is the bun?"

text: 媽媽答佢：「包？你要自己問佢喎——」
eng: Mom replied to him, "Bun? You need to ask yourself..."

text: 呢個時候，有把聲喺細佬肚入面講：「你琴晚食咗我啦……」
eng: At this point, there was a sound in Little Brother's stomach, saying, "You ate me last night..."

text: 揾啱屋企
eng: Find a suitable home

text: 家朗同小艾一齊咗好多年，佢好想早日同小艾建立一個屬於兩個人嘅屋企。
eng: Jialang and Xiao Ai have been together for many years, and he really wants to establish a home with Xiao Ai as soon as possible.

text: 家朗打開收埋嘅紅簿仔嚟睇，用咗成晚嚟計數：計嚟計去，莫講話買間納米屋同小艾一齊住，連租樓都有啲掹掹緊。
eng: Jia Lang opened the hidden red book and looked at it, and it took one night to calculate: calculate and calculate, not to mention buying a nano house to live with Xiao Ai, and even renting a house is a little bit of taking.

text: 頭痕咗一星期，家朗決定要用盡佢所有精力去努力揾錢，等佢快啲揾夠錢，就可以同小艾搬新屋。
eng: After a week of trouble, Jia Lang decided to use all his energy to try to make money, so that he could quickly find enough money to move to a new house with Xiao Ai.

text: 家朗嘅工作時間由公司原本指定嘅朝九晚五，變成朝八晚十，甚至朝七晚三——
eng: Jialang's working hours have changed from 9 to 5 to 8 to 10, or even 7 to 3 -

text: 有時佢同事朝早返工，仲會喺公司廁所見到家朗喺度瞌住眼瞓噉唧牙膏刷牙……
eng: Sometimes his colleagues go to work in the morning, and they will see Jialang here in the company toilet drowsing their teeth with such a jack toothpaste ... ...

text: 家朗越做越唔識攰，星期六日佢唔係繼續加班，就係揾方法進修嚟增值自己；
eng: Jia Lang will not get tired the more he does it, he either continues to work overtime on Saturdays and Sundays, or finds ways to study to increase his value;

text: 變相佢可以陪小艾嘅時間得返好少，有時星期六日都見唔到面，只係講一陣電話就算。
eng: In disguise, he can accompany Xiao Ai with very little time, and sometimes he can't see each other on Saturdays and Sundays, just talk on the phone for a while.

text: 有一朝，家朗瞓醒覺覺得頭重重、周身都好痛、明明流住汗但係又打冷震。
eng: For a time, Jia Lang woke up and felt heavy head, pain all over his body, obviously sweating but shivering.

text: 佢想起身返工，點知一坐喺度，個胃就漲到想嘔。
eng: He remembered to go to work, how did he know that as soon as he sat here, his stomach rose to the point of wanting to vomit.

text: 家朗知道自己落唔到牀，就打咗個電話返公司請病假，然後同小艾講自己唔舒服……
eng: Jia Lang knew that he couldn't get off, so he called back to the company to take sick leave, and then told Xiao Ai that he was not feeling well ... ...

text: 小艾即刻放低晒手頭工作去藥房買藥，然後衝上家朗屋企。
eng: Xiao Ai immediately put down her work to go to the pharmacy to buy medicine, and then rushed to Jialang's house.

text: 小艾煲咗個白粥畀家朗食，又餵佢飲水同食藥。
eng: Xiao Ai cooked a porridge for Jia Lang to eat, and fed him water and medicine.

text: 家朗瞓著嘅時候，小艾忍唔住幫佢執屋，一次過揼咗好多食淨嘅杯麵同咖啡罐……
eng: When Jia Lang was asleep, Xiao Ai couldn't help but help him clean up the house, and beat a lot of clean cup noodles and coffee cans at once ... ...

text: 家朗瞓醒嗰陣已經退咗燒。佢見到小艾喺自己隔籬瞓著咗：小艾瞓著個樣，好靚好平靜。
eng: Jia Lang woke up with a fever. He saw Xiao Ai falling asleep next to him: Xiao Ai fell asleep, very beautiful and calm.

text: 佢伸手好温柔噉摸一摸小艾塊面。
eng: He reached out and touched the noodles of Xiao Ai very gently.

text: 家朗突然發現，「屋企」唔應該只係局限喺一間以呎數嚟計嘅單位——屋企係一份安全感。
eng: Jia Lang suddenly discovered that "home" should not be limited to a unit measured in feet – home is a sense of security.

text: 而佢嘅屋企，就係小艾。
eng: And his home is Xiao Ai.

text: 觀塘交通日常
eng: Traffic in Kwun Tong daily

text: 唉，我又塞咗喺度差唔多一個鐘喇……
eng: Alas, I've been stuck here for almost an hour again ... ...

text: 自從要去觀塘返工開始，我每日都要為放工搭咩車返屯門而煩惱。
eng: Since I started commuting to Kwun Tong, I have had to worry every day about what bus to take back to Tuen Mun after work.

text: 啱啱嚟呢度返工嗰陣，我係搭港鐵嘅，不過觀塘港鐵站永遠都係咁多人，我成日都要排隊等幾班先上到車。
eng: When I first went to work here, I took the MTR, but there are always so many people at Kwun Tong MTR Station that I have to wait in line all day to get on the bus.

text: 上到車之後，一大班人塞喺車廂入面，個身郁都郁唔到，好逼好辛苦。
eng: After getting on the bus, a large group of people were crammed into the carriage, unable to move, it was very crowded and hard.

text: 夏天嘅時候，呢個空間仲會瀰漫住一大陣嘅臭汗味——
eng: In summer, this space will also be filled with a large smell of stinky sweat -

text: 如果企喺身邊嗰個咁啱係成身大汗嘅，佢一逼埋嚟，隨時同佢有肌膚之親，感覺佢啲汗水會黐晒落我度囉……
eng: If the one standing next to him who happens to be sweating all over his body, as soon as he is forced over, he will have skin kisses with him at any time, and he feels that his sweat will stick to me here...

text: 所以我決定轉搭巴士。
eng: So I decided to switch to buses.

text: 雖然車程好耐，但至少有位坐，又唔使同人逼。
eng: Although the drive is long, at least there is one person to sit and there is no need to force people.

text: 始終返咗成日工，好攰好眼瞓，返屋企嗰程車都想坐低抖下。
eng: I have always turned over the whole day, I am very tired and sleepy, and I want to sit down and shake the car home.

text: 更重要嘅係，巴士可以由觀塘直達屯門，唔似港鐵噉要中途轉車。
eng: What's more, buses can run directly from Kwun Tong to Tuen Mun, unlike MTR (MTR) which requires intermediate transfers.

text: 不過，就喺我第一次放工搭巴士返屋企嗰日，發生咗件好「神奇」嘅事。
eng: However, on the day I first took the bus home from work, something "magical" happened.

text: 記得嗰日係星期一，我收工嗰陣已經好攰，六點半左右已經上咗巴士上層最前排個位坐。
eng: I remember that it was Monday, and I was very tired when I finished work, and I was already in the front row of the bus at about six-thirty.

text: 冇耐我就瞌着咗，一心諗住可以喺呢一個鐘車程休息下，瞓醒就返到屯門。
eng: It didn't take long for me to doze, thinking that I could rest during the hour's drive and wake up and return to Tuen Mun.

text: 瞓咗一段時間，我就俾好多響銨聲嘈醒。
eng: After sleeping for a while, I was woken up by a lot of loud frog sounds.

text: 我擘大眼，見到前面有好多架車停低晒。
eng: I opened my eyes and saw a lot of cars stopping ahead.

text: 我再望一望周圍熟識嘅建築，就知道我仲喺觀塘……
eng: I looked at the familiar buildings everywhere and knew that I was still in Kwun Tong ...

text: 嗰陣天色已經好黑，我睇一睇錶：已經係八點！
eng: It was already dark, and I looked at my watch: it was already eight o'clock!

text: 換言之，我竟然喺觀塘塞車塞咗一個半鐘！
eng: In other words, I was stuck in traffic in Kwun Tong for an hour and a half!

text: 最後，我返到屯門嗰時已經九點幾。
eng: Finally, when I returned to Tuen Mun, it was past nine o'clock.

text: 疫情關係，餐廳夜晚十點後冇得堂食，所以好多餐廳都係九點半左右截單。
eng: Due to the epidemic, restaurants do not eat after ten o'clock at night, so many restaurants cut off orders around half past nine.

text: 我揾咗好耐先揾到可以外賣嘅餐廳。
eng: It took me a long time to find a restaurant to take away.

text: 結果，我返到屋企食埋飯，沖完涼，已經成十一點。
eng: As a result, I went home to eat and take a shower, and it was already eleven.

text: 我拿拿聲瞓覺，準備第二日朝九晚六嘅打工仔生涯——
eng: I went to bed with Nasheng, preparing for my 9-to-6 career the next day -

text: 我發誓以後都唔會再搭巴士返屯門！
eng: I swear I will never take a bus back to Tuen Mun again!

text: 就係噉，我又轉返搭港鐵。
eng: That's it, I switched back to MTR.

text: 好在港鐵後來開通咗屯馬線，我依家只需搭到鑽石山轉一次車，就可以直達屯門。
eng: Fortunately, the MTR later opened the Tuen Ma Line, and I now only need to take a transfer to Diamond Hill to get directly to Tuen Mun.

text: 雖然屯馬線都係好多人好逼，而且每程車費貴幾蚊，但至少唔使塞車……
eng: Although the Tuen Ma Line is crowded with many people, and the fare is a few dollars more expensive per way, at least there is no traffic jam ...

text: 我一睇就知大鑊，我唔記得咗約咗佢今晚七點鐘睇戲，仲要係屯門嘅巴黎倫敦紐約米蘭戲院！
eng: I know the trouble as soon as I look at it, I don't remember making an appointment for him to watch a movie at seven o'clock tonight, or the Tuen Mun Theatre in Paris, London, New York, and Milan!

text: 我即時屈指一算，發現無論搭巴士定港鐵，都好難趕得切。
eng: I immediately calculated that whether I took the bus or MTR, it was difficult to come by.

text: 於是我決定放手一博，一放工就馬上搭的士去屯門！
eng: So I decided to let go and go to Tuen Mun as soon as I got off work!

text: 結果我都係逃唔出觀塘嘅塞車魔咒：唉，我又塞咗喺度差唔多一個鐘喇……
eng: As a result, I still couldn't escape the traffic jam in Kwun Tong: alas, I've been stuck here for almost an hour ...

text: 再聽住時間一分一秒過去嘅手錶滴答聲，我開始心驚膽跳：
eng: Listening to the ticking of my watch as time passed, I began to frighten:

text: 睇嚟呢程車嘅代價，會非常沉重……
eng: It seems that the price of this ride will be very heavy ...

text: 叮叮
eng: Ding Ding

text: 「上唔到咪等下一班囉，『叮叮』係咁慢㗎啦——」
eng: "If you can't get on it, you will wait for the next train, and the "Ding" will continue to slow down-"

text: 「一早講咗搭巴士，你又係都要坐電車。」
eng: "I have long said that if you take the bus, you have to take the tram."

text: 「我哋又唔係趕時間，咁急做咩啫。」
eng: "We're not in a hurry, why are we in such a hurry."

text: 其實佢噉講又冇錯嘅，電車本身就好慢，如果趕時間我哋一早坐咗巴士啦……
eng: Actually, he was right about it, the tram itself is very slow, if we were in a hurry we would have already taken the bus...

text: 叮──叮──我哋由鰂魚涌出發，一直坐到去西營盤。
eng: Ding – Ding – We started from Quarry Bay and sat until we went to Sai Ying Pun.

text: 阿莎又好似平時噉上去上層坐車尾個位。
eng: Asha went up to the upper deck to sit in the trunk as usual.

text: 電車冇窗，啲風係噉由外面吹入嚟，撞正夏天，啲風係熱嘅，而且我成日覺得電車入面有浸罨味，但又講唔出具體係咩味。
eng: The train has no windows, the wind blows in from the outside, it happens to be summer, the wind is hot, and I always feel that there is a soaking smell in the train, but I can't tell what the specific smell is.

text: 呢架老嘢真係好慢，我哋放工已經六點幾，由公司行到電車站已經熱到我成件恤衫濕晒。
eng: This old car is really slow, we left work at six o'clock, and walking from the office to the tram stop was already hot enough that my whole shirt was wet.

text: 望住窗外一架一架巴士喺身邊駛過，我開始燥燥地。
eng: Staring out the window at the bus passing by, I started to get bored.

text: 「喂，嚟吖，我幫你影張相。」
eng: "Hey, come on, I'll take a picture for you."

text: 阿莎走咗去我對面坐低，然後拎起菲林相機對住我。
eng: Asha walked over and sat down across from me, then picked up a film camera and pointed it at me.

text: 「畀啲反應先啦你，你啲動作好遲鈍呀。」
eng: "Give a little reaction first, you, your movements are very slow." "

text: 「配合返架電車啫。」
eng: "Cooperate with the return tram gel."

text: 咔嚓──其實我一直都唔知佢影成點，因為佢影咁耐相，一張都冇俾我睇過。
eng: Click—Actually, I never knew he was shooting a point, because he had taken so long and he hadn't let me see a single one.

text: 每次問佢拎返嚟睇，佢都話未拎去曬。
eng: Every time he was asked to take it back, he said he didn't take it to dry.

text: 不過睇佢揸機個動作就知唔會影得靚——佢連自己隻手指入咗鏡都唔知。
eng: But just look at the way he smokes the machine and you know it's not going to be beautiful—he doesn't even know if his finger is in the mirror.

text: 影完我之後，阿莎又好快轉返身，對住條街亂影一通。
eng: After filming me, Asha quickly turned around and walked across the street.

text: 我由細到大都好憎坐電車，不過阿莎就好鍾意。
eng: I grew up hating trams, but Asha did.

text: 我哋都係住西營盤，以前基本上日日都坐電車返學，就算就嚟遲到都好，阿莎都要坐電車，佢對電車有種奇怪嘅執著。
eng: We both live in Sai Ying Pan, and we used to take the tram to school basically every day, even if we were late, Asha had to take the tram, and he had a strange attachment to the tram.

text: 「你唔覺得電車係香港嘅清泉嚟嘅咩？個個做乜都要趕住去投胎噉，係得佢堅持慢慢行，細細欣賞身邊嘅事物。」
