eng: "Don't you think that the tram comes from the clear spring of Hong Kong, everyone has to rush to reincarnate in everything they do, and only he insists on walking well and appreciating the things around him."

text: 「係呀係呀，就連啲阿伯都係香港嘅清泉添。今日實遲到喇，我哋留堂班見啦八婆。」
eng: "Yes, yes, even a little Arbor is a clear spring Tim in Hong Kong." I'm definitely late today, so let's stay after school to continue the class and see you Bag. "

text: 出嚟做嘢之後，咁啱我哋又係喺鰂魚涌返工，於是又變返中學嗰陣噉成日一齊坐車，只不過今次唔係返學，而係放工。
eng: After the dedication, then we were going to work in Quarry Bay again, so we changed back to middle school and always took the car together, only this time instead of going to school, we were off work.

text: 諗落原來我哋由小學開始，計計埋埋都識咗十幾年，周圍嘅人都以為我哋拍緊拖，但其實我哋只係住得近，加上我阿媽又係阿莎阿媽啲雀友，我哋先成日一齊。
eng: Think about it turns out that we have known each other for more than ten years since elementary school, and everyone around us thinks that we are filming, but in fact, we only live close, plus my mother is Asha's mother and some bird friends, we are always together.

text: 叮──叮──電車終於到站，呢段時間嘅西營盤好多人，成條街都好逼。
eng: Ding-ding-Ding-The tram finally arrived, and during this time there were many people in Xiyingpan, and the whole street was crowded.

text: 落車之後，阿莎伸咗隻食指出嚟對住我——呢個係我哋細個嗰陣嘅慣性動作，因為阿莎小學嗰陣好細粒，試過喺條街度逼逼下唔見咗人，返到屋企之後我俾阿媽鬧到痴線，話我做咩唔睇住佢。
eng: After getting out of the car, Asha stretched out and pointed out to me - this is our habitual movement when we were children, because Asha was very young in elementary school, and once disappeared under the crowded streets, and when I got home, I was scolded by my mother for being neurotic, saying why didn't I look at him.

text: 於是後來就出現咗呢個拉食指嘅動作，以防佢走失。
eng: So later there was this action of pulling the index finger in case he got lost.

text: 我望咗望，冇畀反應。
eng: I looked and was not reacted to.

text: 「喂，唔好咁遲鈍得唔得？」阿莎長嘆一口氣。
eng: "Hey, don't be so sluggish?" let out a long sigh.

text: 「仲細呀？」我表示嫌棄。
eng: "Still young?" I said with disgust.

text: 「唔拉就算。」阿莎好快收返起隻手。
eng: "If you don't pull, forget it." Asha quickly withdrew her hand.

text: 而家諗返起，自從中學之後我哋就再冇噉做。
eng: Looking back now, we haven't done this since middle school.

text: 最令我後悔嘅係，當時嘅我冇意識到，原來嗰日係我最後一次機會可以拉住佢隻手。
eng: What I regret the most is that I didn't realize that day was my last chance to hold his hand.

text: 幾年之後，我收到阿莎喺英國寄返嚟嘅信，係之前影落嘅菲林相——
eng: A few years later, I received a letter from Asha from England with a film photograph taken earlier –

text: 同埋可能因為少咗隻腳，我阿媽呢幾年打少咗麻雀；
eng: And maybe because of the lack of a foot, my mother has played less sparrows in recent years;

text: 我放工之後都冇再搭過電車返屋企——因為「叮叮」真係好慢，而時間係快到唔等人㗎……
eng: I haven't taken the tram home after work - because "dingding" is really slow, and time is too fast to wait for...

text: 新同事
eng: New colleagues

text: 「咁多位同事，放一放低手頭上嘅嘢，望一望過嚟先。」
eng: "Colleagues, put down what you have at hand and look over first. 」

text: 阿頭無啦啦嗌停晒我哋。
eng: The leader stopped us without shouting.

text: 「企我隔籬嘅呢位，係我哋嘅新同事阿文。
eng: "The one standing next to me is our new colleague Arwen.

text: 佢係新加坡人，啱啱喺分公司嗰邊調過嚟。
eng: He is Singaporean and has just been transferred from the branch.

text: 噉我而家交時間畀佢介紹下自己。」
eng: Then I will now give him the time to introduce myself. 」

text: 我喺一間報社做，而我個部門負責報導國際新聞。
eng: I work at a newspaper and my department covers international news.

text: 公司一路想請個普通話流利嘅人嚟幫手處理國際新聞，估唔到佢哋最後會喺新加坡調人過嚟。
eng: The company wanted to hire someone fluent in Mandarin to help with international news, but they didn't expect to end up in Singapore.

text: 「哈哈，普普通通啦。」阿文摸摸個頭，少少怕醜噉笑。
eng: "Haha, it's ordinary. Arwen touched his head and smiled a little shyly.

text: 呢個時候阿頭仲要加把口：「就係因為阿文廣東話好，公司先會調佢嚟幫手啊！
eng: At this time, the boss also had to add: "It's because Arwen is good at Cantonese, the company will call him to help!"

text: 「吓？唔使嘅，邊好意思啊！」
eng: "Scared? No need, what's so embarrassing!"

text: 阿頭拍拍阿文膊頭，講笑噉話：「公司規矩，新人就要畀人請飲茶。」
eng: The boss patted Arwen on the shoulder and joked: "The company rules that newcomers must treat people to tea. 」

text: 「你啲廣東話真係好好喎，點學返嚟㗎？」
eng: "You are really good at Cantonese, how do you learn it back?"

text: 「我啲廣東話一般㗎咋。而我點解識講，有三個原因嘅：
eng: "I speak Cantonese." And why I would say this, there are three reasons:

text: 一係大學嗰陣我嚟過香港交換半年；二係我鄉下其實係廣州，爺爺嫲嫲都有教我講下。」
eng: Either I came to Hong Kong for half a year for exchange when I was in college; second, my hometown is actually Guangzhou, and my grandparents also taught me to talk about it. 」

text: 「哦，唔怪得之啦。噉第三個原因呢？」
eng: "Oh, no wonder. And the third reason?"

text: 「三就係我好鍾意周星馳嘅戲。」「我都係喎！」
eng: "The third is that I like Stephen Chow's movies very much. "Me too!"

text: 「『乜咁啱啊』！周星馳喺海外好紅㗎：
eng: Stephen Chow is very popular overseas:

text: 我估有唔少人學廣東話都真係因為佢，至少我女朋友係其中之一。」
eng: I think a lot of people learn Cantonese because of him, at least my girlfriend is one of them. 」

text: 「吓…乜你有女朋友㗎嗱…」
eng: "Scared... How do you just have a girlfriend..."

text: 「係啊，只係冇同我一齊過嚟香港。」
eng: "yes, just didn't come with me to Hong Kong. 」

text: 我喺側邊聽到都覺得尷尬。
eng: I was embarrassed to hear it next to me.

text: 最初知公司會請個講普通話嘅新同事嗰陣，其實我真係好擔心，因為我啲普通話講得真係好差好差，我好驚日日都要講。
eng: When I first knew that the company would hire a new colleague who spoke Mandarin, I was actually really worried because I spoke Mandarin really poorly and poorly, and I was so afraid to speak it every day.

text: 我不停記起中學畢業旅行同一班朋友去上海玩，我開親口講普通話，啲人好似都聽唔明我講咩噉樣…
eng: I kept thinking of my trip to Shanghai after graduating from high school and a group of friends going to Shanghai, and I spoke Mandarin myself, and people didn't seem to understand what I was saying...

text: 不過見到阿文嘅廣東話咁叻，總算鬆一口氣，一天都光晒！
eng: But seeing that Arwen is so smart in Cantonese, I finally breathed a sigh of relief and suddenly became cheerful!

text: 數腳仔
eng: Counting little legs

text: 今日上數學堂，老師教我哋數數字。
eng: Today in math class, the teacher teaches us to count numbers.

text: 老師話：「同學仔，我哋一齊數下呢度有幾多隻腳啦！」
eng: The teacher says, "Little schoolmates, let's count how many legs there are here!"

text: 老師話：「樹上面有一隻雀仔講緊嘢。」
eng: The teacher says, "In the tree there's a bird singing."

text: 我哋一齊數：「雀仔有一、二，兩隻腳。」
eng: Let's count together: "The bird has one, two; two legs."

text: 老師話：「海邊有一隻白鷺行緊。」
eng: The teacher says, "By the seaside there is an egret walking."

text: 我哋一齊數：「白鷺有一、二，佢都有兩隻腳。」
eng: Let's count together: "The egret has one, two; he also has two legs."

text: 老師話：「白鷺企咗喺隻牛上面！」
eng: The teacher says, "The egret stood on a cow!"

text: 我哋一齊數：「牛有一、二、三、四，四隻腳。」
eng: Let's count together: "The cow has one, two, three, four; four legs."

text: 老師話：「公園入面有一隻大笨象行嚟行去。」
eng: The teacher says, "In the park there's an elephant walking around."

text: 我哋一齊數：「大笨象有一、二、三、四，佢都有四隻腳。」
eng: Let's count together: "The elephant has one, two, three, four; he also has four legs."

text: 老師話：「有一隻蟬喺樹上面瞓緊喎。」
eng: The teacher says, "There is a cicada sleeping on a tree."

text: 我哋一齊數：「蟬有一、二、三、四、五、六，六隻腳。」
eng: Let's count together: "The cicadas has one, two, three, four, five, six; six legs."

text: 老師話：「有一隻螢火蟲喺公園飛緊。」
eng: The teacher says: "There is a firefly flying in the park."

text: 我哋一齊數：「螢火蟲有一、二、三、四、五、六，佢都有六隻腳。」
eng: Let's count together: "The firefly has one, two, three, four, five, six; it also has six legs."

text: 老師話：「哇！屋企隻窗門有一隻蜘蛛！」
eng: The teacher says: "Wow! At home in the window there is a spider!"

text: 我哋一齊數：「蜘蛛有一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八，八隻腳。」
eng: Let's count together: "The spiders has one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight; eight legs."

text: 老師話：「海入面有一隻八爪魚，佢拎緊好多嘢！」
eng: The teacher says, "In the sea there's an octopus, he's holding a lot of things!"

text: 我哋一齊數：「八爪魚有一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八，佢都有八隻腳。」
eng: Let's count together: "The octopus has one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight; it also has eight legs."

text: 數晒喇。老師笑一笑，同我哋講：
eng: Finished counting. The teacher smiles and says to us:

text: 「大家都好叻仔叻女。呢度真係有好多隻腳啊！」
eng: "Everyone is a very smart boy and girl. There are really a lot of legs here!"

text: 我話：「我有一、二，兩隻腳，如果我有八隻腳就好喇，噉我就會跑得好快！」
eng: I say, "I have one, two; two feet; if only I had eight feet, then that would be good, I would run very fast!"

text: 大家都笑。
eng: Everyone laughed.

text: 呢個係我哥哥
eng: This is my older brother

text: 呢個係我哥哥，佢叫明仔，而家四年班。
eng: This is my older brother, his name is Manson, he is in fourth grade now.

text: 呢個係我，我而家一年班。
eng: This is me, I'm in first grade now.

text: 我哋都係喺沙田返學。
eng: We all go to school in Sha Tin.

text: 朝早八點，我哋都要一齊返學。
eng: At eight o'clock in the morning, we also have to go to school together.

text: 我自己着衫。哥哥幫我着鞋。
eng: I dress myself. My brother helps me put on my shoes.

text: 我哋一齊出去。哥哥同我一齊踩單車。
eng: We go out together. My brother and I together ride bicycle.

text: 哥哥睇好大本嘅書，本書講雀仔。
eng: My brother reads a big book, the book is about little birds.

text: 我都好鍾意雀仔，我鍾意同哥哥一齊睇呢本書。
eng: I also like little birds and I like reading this book together with my brother.

text: 哥哥好鍾意喺本書入面寫字。
eng: My brother loves to write in this book.

text: 呢個係我嘅書包仔，入面有一支鉛筆。
eng: This is my little school bag, inside there is a pencil.

text: 哎呀！今日我唔記得帶擦膠呀！
eng: Oh no! Today I forgot to bring an eraser!

text: 三點鐘放學，哥哥鍾意同三個好朋友一齊去公園打波。
eng: At three o'clock after school, my brother likes to go to the park together with three good friends to play ball.

text: 我喺公園坐低，睇哥哥同佢啲朋友一齊打波。
eng: I sit down in the park to watch my brother play ball with his friends.

text: 哥哥入波，我拍手。
eng: When my brother scores, I clap my hands.

text: 今日好熱，哥哥買雪條畀我哋食。
eng: Today it's hot, so my brother buys some popsicles for us to eat.

text: 佢買咗五條，我、哥哥、同埋佢三個好朋友，個個都有得食，一人一條。
eng: He buys five popsicles, for me, my brother, and his three good friends, everyone has some to eat, one for each person.

text: 我同哥哥講：「多謝哥哥！」
eng: I say to my brother, "Thank you, brother!"

text: 六點喇，要返屋企食飯喇！
eng: It's six o'clock, it's time to go home for dinner!

text: 我同哥哥講：「哥哥！要返屋企食飯喇！爸爸媽媽等緊我哋㗎！」
eng: I say to my brother, "Brother! We need to go home for dinner! Mom and Dad are waiting for us!"

text: 哥哥同佢啲朋友講：「拜拜！」跟住哥哥拖住我一齊行返屋企。
eng: My brother says to his friends, "Goodbye!" Then my brother takes my hand and we go home together.

text: 太細個喇!
eng: Too small!

text: 「你太細個喇！」
eng: "You're too small!"

text: 呢句話，我成日聽到。
eng: I hear this phrase a lot.

text: 爸爸媽媽因為我太細，好多嘢都唔准我做。
eng: Mom and Dad were too young to do a lot of things.

text: 例如，唔可以自己一個出街、唔可以夜瞓、唔可以飲咖啡等等。
eng: For example, you can't go to the street by yourself, you can't go to bed late, you can't drink coffee, and so on.

text: 我問佢哋，點解我年紀細就唔可以做呢啲，佢哋話我大個就會明。
eng: I asked them why I couldn't do this when I was young, and they said I would understand when I grew up.

text: 試過有一次，我睇住媽媽煮飯。
eng: Once, I watched my mother cook.

text: 我覺得如果我學識煮飯，就可以幫媽媽手，等佢唔使咁辛苦。
eng: I think if I learn to cook, I can help my mother and wait until he doesn't have to work so hard.

text: 直到有一日，媽媽掛住做嘢，冇返屋企煮飯畀我同家姐食。
eng: Until one day, my mother missed work and did not come home to cook for me and my sister.

text: 我同家姐都好肚餓，但又唔識嗌外賣，唔知點算好。
eng: My sister and I were hungry, but we couldn't order takeout and didn't know what to do.

text: 於是我自告奮勇下廚煮嘢食。
eng: So I volunteered to cook and eat.

text: 我好似媽媽平時噉煮飯煲湯，順利煮好呢餐飯。
eng: I cooked soup like my mother usually did, and cooked the meal smoothly.

text: 我同家姐終於有飯食，家姐仲讚我煮得好味。
eng: My sister and I finally had a meal, and my sister praised me for cooking it very deliciously.

text: 媽媽返到屋企，見我同家姐食緊飯，佢好意外，問我哋啲嘢食係邊個煮。
eng: When my mother came home and saw me and my sister eating, he was surprised and asked who cooked our food.

text: 我好興奮噉認頭，以為媽媽一定會讚我，點知媽媽皺起眉頭話：
eng: I was excited to recognize my head, thinking that my mother would definitely praise me, how did I know that my mother frowned:

text: 「你太細個喇！唔好有下次！」
eng: "You're too young, don't have a next time!"

text: 又有一次，爸爸裝修屋企。
eng: Another time, Dad renovated the house.

text: 不過佢髹油髹得好慢，啲顏色仲要東一忽西一忽，好難睇。
eng: However, he painted very slowly, and the color had to be one piece of east and west, so ugly.

text: 於是我決定幫佢髹油。
eng: So I decided to help him paint.

text: 結果，牆上嘅顏色係好睇咗好多，但我就唔小心整到成身都係油。
eng: As a result, the color on the wall was much better, but I accidentally finished my whole body with oil.

text: 唔緊要啦，最緊要係啲顏色髹得靚呀嘛！
eng: It's okay, the most important thing is to look good!

text: 我以為爸爸見到之後一定會讚我，點知結果同上次一樣，我又俾人鬧喇。
eng: I thought that my father would praise me after seeing it, how did I know that the result was the same as the last time, and I was scolded again.

text: 雖然我幫咗佢，仲整到自己成身都係油，但佢反而鬧我：
eng: Although I helped him and was so full of oil that he was all over his body, he scolded me instead:

text: 「你太細個喇！唔好咁多事！」
eng: "You're too small, don't do so much!"

text: 我好唔開心，點解我明明幫咗佢哋，佢哋都係鬧我？
eng: I'm very unhappy, why did I obviously help them, they all scolded me?

text: 我之所以做呢啲事，就係因為大人冇做好應份嘅事，甚至連做都冇做。
eng: The reason why I do these things is because adults don't do their part, or even do it.

text: 唔通我噉都有錯？噉究竟我有啲咩係可以做㗎呢？
eng: Am I wrong with that? What exactly can I do?

text: 定係，因為我太細個，所以就乜都唔做得？
eng: Or, because I'm too young, I don't do anything?

text: 上星期，我同家姐帶貓仔去公園玩。
eng: Last week, my sister and I took our kittens to the park.

text: 玩玩下，貓仔竟然爬咗上樹，唔識落返嚟。
eng: What to play, the kitten actually climbed up the tree and will not be thrown back.

text: 咁啱家姐顧住踩單車，冇發現到；附近又冇大人，我揾唔到人幫手。
eng: It happened that my sister was riding a bicycle and didn't notice it; there were no adults nearby, so I couldn't get someone to help.

text: 貓仔喺樹上面好驚，攬到棵樹實一實。
eng: The kitten is so scared in the tree, and it must be solid to hug a tree.

text: 我試過安慰貓仔，等佢冇咁驚就可以慢慢爬返落嚟。
eng: I used to comfort the kitten that he could slowly climb down when he was less afraid.

text: 可惜無論我講啲咩，佢都仲係咁驚。
eng: Unfortunately, no matter what I say, he is still so scared.

text: 如果貓仔繼續留喺樹上面，我怕佢會有危險。
eng: If the kitten continues to stay on the tree, I am afraid that he will be in danger.

text: 所以我決定爬上去，救佢落嚟！
eng: So I decided to climb up and save him down!

text: 好彩，棵樹都唔算好高，我順利抱返佢落嚟，總算有驚無險。
eng: Good luck, the tree is not very tall, I successfully carried him down, and finally there was no danger.

text: 我帶貓仔去揾返家姐，家姐一直掛住踩單車，完全唔知發生咩事。
eng: I took the kitten to retrieve my sister, who had always missed riding a bike and had no idea what was going on.

text: 當我講返件事畀佢聽嘅時候，個心仲諗：
eng: When I told him something back, I thought:

text: 唔知家姐會唔會好似爸爸媽媽噉，話我太細個，唔應該噉做呢？
eng: I wonder if my sister will be like my parents and say that I am too young to do this?

text: 點知——「嘩！好彩有你，貓仔至冇事咋！你做得好好呀！」
eng: Who knows--"Wow, thanks to you, the kitten is just fine!

text: 聽到家姐呢句話，我好開心！
eng: I am so happy to hear my sister's words!

text: 終於有人認同我做嘅嘢喇！
eng: Finally someone agrees with what I did!

text: 家姐將件事講咗畀爸爸媽媽聽。
eng: My sister told my parents about it.

text: 佢哋聽到之後，抱起我讚我叻。
eng: When they heard it, they picked me up and praised me for being great.

text: 我趁機問佢哋：「係咪我細個，所以好多嘢都唔做得？」
eng: I took the opportunity to ask them, "Was it that when I was a child, I couldn't do a lot of things?"

text: 媽媽答：「一個行為啱定唔啱，唔關年紀事。
eng: Mom replied, "Whether an act is right or not, it doesn't matter how old it is."

text: 如果你係為咗幫人，又唔會傷害到自己或者其他人，就可以去做。」
eng: If you're doing it to help someone else without hurting yourself or others, do it. 」

text: 爸爸又話：「係呀，所以除咗睇對錯，仲要睇能力。
eng: Dad said, "Yes, so in addition to looking at right or wrong, you also look at ability."

text: 而能力多多少少係同年紀掛勾嘅——所以有啲嘢，爸爸媽媽唔畀你做，主要都係因為我哋擔心你能力未夠，夾硬去做反而整傷自己。」
eng: And ability is more or less linked to age - so there are some things that Mom and Dad don't do for you, mainly because we are worried that you are not capable enough, and forcing you to do it will hurt yourself. 」

text: 聽完佢哋噉講，我先明白自己之前一直誤解咗爸爸媽媽嘅苦心……
eng: After listening to them say this, I realized that I had been misunderstanding the painstaking efforts of my parents ...

text: 「不過，我哋都應該適時放手畀你去學習同探索嘅……」媽媽有啲感觸。
eng: "However, we should also let you learn and explore in due time... Mom was a little touched.

text: 我即時兩眼發光，大聲承諾：「我以後做啲咩危險嘢，都一定會揾大人在場睇住，唔會有事㗎！」
eng: My eyes immediately lit up, and I promised loudly: "If I do anything dangerous in the future, I will definitely make adults present and watch, and nothing will happen!"

text: 「唉，真係冇你辦法！」爸爸媽媽笑住話。
eng: "Oh, there's really no way you can do it!" Mom and Dad said with a smile.

text: 尋找雪豹
eng: Look for snow leopards

text: 鈴子打掃嘅時候，發現喺雜物入面有一個朱古力包裝袋，上面有一隻喜馬拉雅山雪豹。
eng: While Suzuko was cleaning, she found a chocolate bag with a Himalayan snow leopard on it.

text: 鈴子靈機一觸，打電話畀媽媽。
eng: Suzuko touched her mind and called her mother.

text: 鈴子：「阿媽，過幾日我會去尼泊爾。」
eng: Suzuko: "Mom, I'll go to Nepal in a few days."

text: 媽媽：「你唔使返工咩？」
eng: Mom: "Don't you have to go to work?"

text: 鈴子話：「我請咗假。」
eng: Suzuko said, "I took a leave of absence."

text: 媽媽有少少嬲，話：「你都成四十歲人，就算放假都唔好去咁遠！放假應該留喺香港，同老公仔女一齊玩吖嘛——」
eng: My mother was a little angry, "You are also a forty-year-old, even if you have a holiday, don't go so far!

text: 鈴子好快就收咗線。
eng: Suzuko quickly closed the thread.

text: 鈴子唔理所有人嘅反對，收拾好行李，一個星期之後就到咗尼泊爾。
eng: Ignoring everyone's objections, Suzuko packed her bags and arrived in Nepal a week later.

text: 佢揀咗一間平價嘅旅館入住，打聽好喜馬拉雅山嘅行山路線，準備出發。
eng: He chose a cheap hotel to stay in, inquired about the Himalayan climbing route, and prepared to go.

text: 喺旅館門口，鈴子畀一個二十歲左右嘅女仔截停咗。
eng: At the entrance of the hotel, Suzuko called a halt to a girl in her twenties.

text: 少女話：「請問你係咪香港人？係咪都係去喜馬拉雅山揾雪豹？」
eng: Girl: "Are you from Hong Kong, are you still going to the Himalayas to pick snow leopards?"

text: 鈴子話係。少女話：「我都係！不如一齊去吖？我叫小花！」
eng: Suzuko said yes. The girl said, "Me too! Why don't we go together? My name is Little Flower!"

text: 鈴子覺得無所謂，就同小花一齊上山。
eng: Suzuko felt that it didn't matter, so she went up the mountain with Xiaohua.

text: 小花一邊行，一邊不停講嘢：「呢度冬天可以去到零下四十度㗎！
eng: As Xiaohua walked, she kept talking: "You can reach minus 40 degrees here in winter!"

text: 而家係夏天，我哋先可以上嚟睇雪豹！聽講好難揾到㗎！」
eng: It's summer, so we can come up and see the snow leopard!

text: 鈴子話：「我以前去過零下二十度嘅地方。」
eng: Suzuko said, "I've been to minus 20 degrees before. 」

text: 小花好震驚：「真㗎？」
eng: Xiaohua was shocked: "Really?"

text: 鈴子：「係啊，喺俄羅斯。當時我同你一樣都係啱啱大學畢業。」
eng: Suzuko: "Yes, in Russia. Like you, I had just graduated from college. 」

text: 小花話：「噉你而家咪已經去過好多地方囉？」
eng: Xiaohua: "So you've been to a lot of places now?"

text: 行下行下，佢哋見到一群鹿。
eng: Walking down, they saw a herd of deer.

text: 鈴子覺得雪豹一定會嚟揾獵物，就打算匿喺附近等睇雪豹。
eng: Suzuko thinks that the snow leopard will definitely come to find its prey, so she plans to hide nearby and wait for the snow leopard.

text: 小花揾到一舊大石，佢哋就係匿埋喺大石後面。
eng: Little Flower finds a big rock, and they just hide behind the big rock.

text: 鈴子喺背囊攞咗個三文治出嚟，分咗一半畀小花。
eng: Suzuko took a sandwich out of her backpack and gave half to Xiaohua.

text: 小花一路食一路講：「我將來一定要去好多好多地方！你都係！你有幾耐冇去長途旅行喇？」
eng: Xiaohua said while eating, "I must go to many, many places in the future!

text: 鈴子話：「大大話話都有十年喇……」
eng: Suzuko: "It's been ten years..."

text: 鈴子好忙，除咗返工，仲要照顧仔女，有十幾年連上興趣班嘅時間都冇。
eng: Suzuko is very busy, in addition to going to work, but also to take care of her children, and for more than ten years she has not even had time to attend interest classes.

text: 鈴子話：「我有十幾年冇為自己打算過喇。」
eng: Suzuko said, "I haven't planned for myself in more than a decade. 」

text: 大家靜靜欣賞山上美景同埋小鹿你追我逐。
eng: Everyone quietly admires the beautiful scenery on the mountain and the deer chasing me.

text: 過咗一陣，小花感嘆：「喜馬拉雅山真係好！喺呢度收唔到電話，上唔到網，我哋淨係需要考慮自己開唔開心。」
eng: After a while, Xiaohua exclaimed: "The Himalayas are so good! We can't get a phone call here, we can't get on the Internet, we just need to think about whether we are happy or not."

text: 鈴子話：「係啊。」
eng: Suzuko said, "Yes. 」

text: 小花又問：「你覺得平時幸唔幸福？」
eng: Xiaohua asked again, "Do you think you are usually happy?"

text: 鈴子諗咗一陣，話：「我覺得幸福好短暫。就好似結婚噉，最幸福就係新婚嗰段日子。
eng: Suzuko thought for a while and said, "I think happiness is short-lived. Just like getting married, the happiest is the day of the new marriage.

text: 嗰陣仲會對將來嘅生活有期盼——我覺得嗰種期待嘅感覺就係幸福。」
eng: At that time, there is also a hope for the future life - I think that feeling of anticipation is happiness. 」

text: 小花：「就好似入大學之前嗰個暑假，好興奮，好期待噉？」「係啊。」
eng: Xiaohua: "Just follow up the summer vacation before college, very excited, very looking forward to it?"

text: 小花諗咗好耐，然後意有所指噉笑住話：「我哋而家等緊雪豹。」「係啊。」
eng: Xiaohua thought for a long time, and then said with a smile: "We are waiting for the snow leopard now. "yes. 」

text: 鈴子覺得好温暖。
eng: Suzuko felt warm.

text: 突然，小花捉住鈴子隻手，眼望前方，細細聲話：「雪豹！」
eng: Suddenly, Xiaohua grabbed Suzuko's hand, looked ahead, and whispered, "Snow leopard!"

text: 佢哋喺大石後面偷望，見到一隻黑斑點嘅白色雪豹一枝箭噉飛撲埋去其中一隻鹿度！
eng: They peeked behind the boulder and saw a black-spotted white snow leopard flying like an arrow into one of the deer!

text: 鹿群受驚跳走，雪豹急起直追，幾秒鐘已經跑到好遠，想影相都影唔切。
eng: The deer herd jumped away in fright, and the snow leopard rushed to chase, and in a few seconds it had run far away, and it was impossible to take pictures if they wanted to.

text: 佢哋唯有將呢一幕印喺心底。
eng: They can only imprint this scene in their hearts.

text: 鈴子忍唔住驚嘆：「雪豹好靚！」「的確。」
eng: Suzuko couldn't help but exclaim, "The snow leopard is beautiful!"

text: 小花一邊收拾背囊，一邊講：「鈴子，不如我哋而家落山？尼泊爾有一個湖好靚，我哋一齊去好唔好？」
eng: While packing her backpack, Xiaohua said, "Suzuko, why don't we set now? There is a beautiful lake in Nepal, shall I go together?"

text: 鈴子好興奮，話：「好啊！」
eng: Suzuko was excited, "Okay!"

text: 呢次毅然出走，令鈴子揾返佢心入面嘅雪豹——佢已經急不及待要去發掘未知喇！
eng: This time he resolutely runs away and allows Suzuko to find the snow leopard in his heart - he can't wait to discover the unknown!

text: 其實每次仔女長大踏入新階段，鈴子都會有種期待嘅幸福感嘅，只係嗰種付出同壓力真係不足為外人道……
eng: In fact, every time her children grow up and step into a new stage, Suzuko will have a sense of happiness that she looks forward to, but the kind of effort and pressure is really not enough for outsiders ...

text: 而家見啲仔女開始大個，鈴子至敢踏出去追尋自己嘅夢想。
eng: Now seeing these children begin to grow up, Suzuko dares to step out and pursue her dreams.

text: 我哋嘅歌聲
eng: Our singing

text: 小娟喺課室個窗望出去，會見到一棵老榕樹，佢樹幹叉開個樣，好似想畀個大大嘅擁抱我哋噉。
eng: When Xiao Juan looked out the window of the classroom, she would see an old banyan tree, his trunk was forked, as if he wanted to give us a big hug.

text: 喺老榕樹嘅樹蔭下，就算嗰日天氣幾熱，都會覺得好涼爽。
eng: In the shade of the old banyan tree, even if it was quite hot that day, it would feel very cool.

text: 但係呢棵老榕樹好百厭，每當有微風吹過，佢一粒粒細小嘅果實就會跌落小娟身上，有時仲會有雀仔匿喺樹葉之間偷偷哋去廁所——「啪」一聲，雀屎就滴咗落小娟個頭度……
eng: But this old banyan tree is very naughty, whenever a breeze blows, his tiny fruits will fall on Xiaojuan, and sometimes there are birds hiding between the leaves to secretly go to the toilet - "pop\

text: 每日小息嘅時候，小娟都會陪阿樂同小明跑去老榕樹下面休息。
eng: Every day when she took a break, Xiao Juan would accompany Ah Le and Xiao Ming to rest under the old banyan tree.

text: 小明次次都跑得最快，之後仲會擺出一副得戚樣。
eng: Bob runs the fastest every time, and then puts on a good look.

text: 老榕樹下面唔單止涼爽，有時仲會有蝴蝶或者蜜蜂飛過，陪大家一齊小息。
eng: Not only is it cool under the old banyan tree, but sometimes butterflies or bees fly by to accompany everyone to rest.

text: 今日，小娟竟然跑得快過小明，但係喺佢哋前面嘅老榕樹下，好似仲有其他訪客。
eng: Today, Xiao Juan actually ran faster than Xiao Ming, but under the old banyan tree in front of them, there seemed to be other visitors.

text: 係邊個呢？喺地下有一隻用樹枝同樹葉做成嘅「碗」。你睇！
eng: On the ground there is a "bowl" made of twigs and leaves. You see!

text: 「碗」入面仲有隻小生物，眼仔轆轆噉望住大家。
eng: There is also a small creature in the "bowl\

text: 「你好！」小娟同呢位新朋友打招呼，但新朋友唔應佢。
eng: "Hello!" Xiaojuan greeted the new friend, but the new friend didn't want him.

text: 小明問：「唔通佢係年幼嘅翼龍？」
eng: Xiao Ming asked, "Could it be that he is a young pterosaur?"

text: 小明睇《侏羅紀公園》嘅時候見過翼龍，喺天空飛嚟飛去好威風。
eng: Xiao Ming saw pterosaurs when he watched "Jurassic Park\

text: 「可能真係一隻小恐龍。」小娟都噉樣認為。
eng: "It could really be a little dinosaur." Xiao Juan also thinks so.

text: 「冇可能，雀仔會叫㗎嘛！
eng: "No way, the birds will call!"

text: 「知唔知人係點樣學識用語言嚟表達自己？」阿樂問。
eng: "Do you know how others learn to express themselves in words?" asked Le.

text: 小娟同小明都搖頭。
eng: Xiao Juan and Xiao Ming both shook their heads.

text: 阿樂解釋：「人類係有人教先識得講嘢，而雀仔係用歌聲去表達自己嘅，話唔定隻雀仔係因為冇人教，所以先未識叫呢？」
eng: Le explained: "Human beings are taught to speak, and birds express themselves with song, maybe a bird is because no one taught it, so it can't call?"

text: 小娟聽完之後好擔心：「如果佢唔識得唱歌表達自己，就唔可以同同伴溝通，噉佢會好孤獨㗎喎……」
eng: After listening to it, Xiaojuan was worried: "If he doesn't know how to sing and express himself, he can't communicate with his companions, he will be very lonely..."

text: 於是，小娟、小明同阿樂實行「救救雀仔行動」，決心要教識呢隻雀仔唱歌。
eng: Therefore, Xiao Juan, Xiao Ming and Le carried out the "Save the Bird Action\

text: 佢哋用棉花同紙盒造咗一張牀，然後裝住隻雀仔去學唱歌嘅地方—音樂中心。
eng: They made a stew out of cotton and cardboard boxes, and then loaded a bird to the music center, where they learned to sing.

text: 「呼、呼……」有人喺度吹長笛，然後係小號、鋼琴、小提琴、結他……
eng: "Whew, phew..." Someone was playing the flute, then the trumpet, piano, violin, guitar...

text: 佢哋帶雀仔去上唔同嘅音樂堂，每次都問：「雀仔雀仔，呢把係咪你嘅歌聲呀？」
eng: They took the birds to different concert halls and each time asked, "Birds and birds, is this your singing?"

text: 但係，雀仔依然好安靜，粒聲唔出噉望住大家。
eng: However, the birds remained quiet, staring at everyone silently.

text: 小娟好失望，但仍然堅持同雀仔講：「唔使擔心，我哋一定會幫你。」
eng: Xiaojuan was disappointed, but still insisted on telling the bird: "Don't worry, we will definitely help you."

text: 佢哋又叫又唱，仲用媽媽部電話播放唔同鈴聲，每次都問：「雀仔雀仔，呢把係咪你嘅歌聲呀？」
eng: They called and sang, and played different ringtones on their mother's phone, each time asking, "Birds, birds, is this your singing?"

text: 雀仔依然好安靜。「咕……」小明個肚餓到打鼓。
eng: The birds are still quiet. "Oh..." Xiao Ming drummed with hunger.

text: 原來佢哋為咗雀仔，連午餐都唔記得食。
eng: It turned out that for the sake of the birds, they did not even remember to eat lunch.

text: 但係佢哋都繼續行動：「雀仔雀仔，呢把係咪你嘅歌聲呀？」
eng: But they also continued to act: "Birds and birds, is this your song?"

text: 雀仔依然好安靜。「叮噹、叮噹！」唔通雀仔嘅歌聲係門鐘聲？
eng: The birds are still quiet. "Jingle bell, jingle bell!" Could it be that the bird's song is the doorbell?

text: 佢哋周圍㩒鐘，但雀仔依然好安靜。
eng: They rang the doorbell everywhere, but the birds remained quiet.

text: 唔通，「救救雀仔行動」要宣告失敗？
eng: Is Operation Save the Birds going to fail?

text: 小明好灰心噉問：「我哋仲可以點做？」
eng: Bob was discouraged and asked, "What else can we do?"

text: 小娟答：「我哋揾到隻雀仔，但係雀仔揾唔到自己嘅歌聲……」
eng: Xiaojuan replied, "We found a bird, but the bird couldn't find its own song..."

text: 小明好唔開心噉講：「明明我哋已經周圍都揾過晒——」
eng: Xiao Ming said unhappily: "Obviously, we have already looked everywhere--"

text: 「但係佢都仲係粒聲唔出……」阿樂都忍唔住大喊。
eng: "But he still didn't say a word..." Le Du couldn't help but shout.

text: 而且雀仔佢仲有你哋，係咪？
eng: And the birds he still has you, doesn't he?

text: 你哋唔會因為佢唔識唱歌而離開佢，係咪？」
eng: You're not going to leave him because he can't sing, are you?"

text: 大家都大力點頭：「當然唔會！」
eng: Everyone nodded vigorously: "Of course not!"

text: 「好！我哋一於畀啲耐性陪隻雀仔啦！」
eng: "Okay, let's just give some patience to accompany a bird!"

text: 而未餓嘅小娟就同雀仔講：「嗱雀仔雀仔，你打開耳仔，如果聽到有你鍾意嘅聲音，你就將佢變成你嘅歌聲，我哋會同你一齊唱，好冇？」
eng: And Xiaojuan, who was not hungry, said to the bird: "Bird, you open your ears, if you hear a sound you like, you turn it into your song, and we will sing with you, right?"

text: 「嘶——」「吱吱！」雀仔望住小明啱啱撕開嘅麵包袋點頭。
eng: "Shhh.." "Squeak!" the bird nodded as she stared at the bread bag that Xiao Ming had just torn.

text: 我唔係鹹濕仔
eng: I'm not an obscene son

text: 我唔鍾意作文堂要寫「我的爸爸」。
eng: I don't like essay halls to write "my dad".

text: 我好鍾意我阿爸，但係，我實在唔想話俾我啲老師同埋同學聽，我阿爸係做乜嘢嘅。
eng: I like my dad a lot, but I really don't want to tell my teachers and classmates what my dad does.

text: 我阿爸其實係……開報紙檔㗎。我知道阿爸工作好辛苦。
eng: My dad is actually ... ... Newsstand. I know Dad works hard.

text: 每日一大朝早，個天仲係好黑嗰陣時，阿爸就要起身開始佢一日嘅工作。
eng: Every morning, when it was still dark, Dad would get up to start his day's work.

text: 佢話俾我聽，佢要起身起得比任何人都早，因為屋邨裏面嗰個最早起嘅客人會俾十蚊佢買報紙。
eng: He told me that he was going to get up earlier than anyone else, because the first customer in the low-rent house would buy a newspaper for ten dollars.

text: 阿爸嘅指頭總係黑鼆鼆。我知道其實係報紙嘅油墨，混埋阿爸啲手汗，搞到佢隻手黑晒。
eng: Dad's fingers were always black. I knew that it was actually the ink of the newspaper, which mixed with the sweat of my father's hands, and made his hands black.

text: 阿媽本來都買咗對棉手套，叫阿爸戴住去賣報紙。但係阿爸用咗兩日，就將手套抌埋一邊。
eng: Mom also bought a pair of cotton gloves and told Dad to wear them to sell newspapers. But my dad used it for two days and put the gloves away.

text: 佢覺得手套減慢咗佢派報紙嘅速度，啲顧客成日都好趕，唔慢得㗎。
eng: He felt that the gloves slowed down the speed at which he delivered the newspaper, and some customers were in a hurry all day.

text: 於是阿爸對手，長年累月積滿咗油墨，啲油墨滲入皮膚入面，洗唔甩。
eng: So Dad's opponent has accumulated ink for many years, and the ink has penetrated into the skin and cannot be washed off.

text: 阿爸嘅背脊有啲彎，因為佢成日要坐喺張好細張嘅圓摺櫈上面做買賣找贖嘅工夫。
eng: Father's back was a little bent, for he always had to sit on a very small round folding stool to do business and ransom.

text: 其實阿爸都算高大，但係因為佢個背脊彎咗，令佢矮咗成截。
eng: Actually, Dad is also tall, but because his back is bent, he is shorter.

text: 我成日喺度諗，如果阿爸可以企返直條腰，佢會比嗰個肥仔明嘅老竇高最少成個頭！
eng: I always thought that if Dad could stand up straight, he would be at least a whole head taller than that little fat man understood!

text: 肥仔明係我今年嘅同班同學。原來佢住喺我屋企附近。我好討厭佢。
eng: Little Fat Man Ming is my classmate this year. It turned out that he lived near my house. I hate him.

text: 佢成日同陳明坤、李志傑一齊笑我係「鹹濕仔」。我當然知道點解佢哋會噉樣笑我。
eng: He always laughed with Chen Mingkun and Li Zhijie that I was an "obscene son". Of course I know why they laugh at me like that.

text: 但係，我比佢哋都正人君子啊。我間中會一個人幫阿爸睇下報紙檔，等佢可以去隔籬個投注站買馬仔。
eng: However, I am more upright and gentlemanly than them. From time to time, I would help my dad look at the newsstand by himself so that he could go to the betting shop next door to buy a little brother.

text: 如果嗰陣時肥仔明佢哋經過，噉我就慘喇。
eng: If the little fat man had understood what they had passed by at that time, then I would have been miserable.

text: 佢哋會喺檔口前不停噉笑我，話我鹹濕仔喺度賣鹹濕書，直到佢哋見到我阿爸喺冇幾遠行返嚟，佢哋先即刻跑走。
eng: They would laugh at me in front of the stall and say that I was a pornographic kid selling pornographic books here, and they didn't run away until they saw my dad coming back from a short walk away.

text: 我當然知道阿爸做嘢好辛苦，辛苦到天未光就要爬起身﹔辛苦到對手都黑晒，個背脊又彎埋。
eng: Of course, I knew that Dad worked very hard, so hard that he had to get up before dawn, and so hard that his opponents were all black, and his back was bent again.

text: 阿爸賣嗰啲雜誌都只係為咗揾多啲錢，我知道。
eng: Dad sells all those magazines just to make a little more money, I know.

text: 所以，我都唔敢話俾佢同阿媽聽我成日因為噉俾啲同學恥笑。
eng: Therefore, I didn't dare to tell him and my mother that I was always laughed at by some classmates because of this.

text: 呢個星期作文堂，又要寫「我的爸爸」。
eng: This week, I will write "My Dad" again.

text: 黃老師話，年級唔同，寫嘅題目即使一樣，都會有唔一樣嘅內容同埋深度。
eng: Teacher Huang said that the grades are different, and even if the topics written are the same, they will have different content and depth.

text: 老師叫我哋喺屋企預備一下，小心觀察，過幾日就喺堂上寫篇關於父親嘅文章。
eng: The teacher told us to prepare at home, observe carefully, and write an essay about my father in class in a few days.

text: 落咗堂之後，我返去報紙檔幫阿爸手睇檔。
eng: After I got out of class, I went back to the newsstand to help my dad look at the files.

text: 有時候，我會故意將啲報紙分散啲噉擺，用佢哋覆蓋住嗰啲雜誌。
eng: Sometimes, I deliberately scatter the newspapers like this and cover them with them.

text: 但係，用報紙遮掩其實都唔係好得，因為有時報紙啲圖片都好恐怖。
eng: However, it's not a good idea to cover up with newspapers, because sometimes newspaper pictures are scary.

text: 不過，阿爸好快就會發覺呢啲遮遮掩掩。
eng: However, Dad will soon find out about these secrets.

text: 然後，佢會鬧我點解要顧客自己揾佢哋要嘅嘢，又鬧我點解唔收拾好個檔口。
eng: Then, he would scold me why customers should find what they wanted, and why I didn't clean up the stall.

text: 噉阿爸又唔會鬧得好惡，我都會乖乖噉幫佢收拾返，將我之前覆上去雜誌嗰啲報紙疊好。
eng: That dad won't scold him very badly, and I will obediently help him clean it up and stack the newspapers that I covered with magazines before.

text: 其實，雜誌報章上啲文字，我都唔係完全明白，好多時都唔係好知佢講乜。
eng: Actually, I don't fully understand some of the words in magazines and newspapers, and I don't really know what he says many times.

text: 只係見到嗰啲影像，已經覺得好唔舒服，但又感到好好奇。
eng: I just saw those images, and I already felt very uncomfortable, but I also felt very curious.

text: 我又見到肥仔明喺街尾向住我個報紙檔走過嚟。
eng: I saw the little fat man running towards my newsstand at the end of the street.

text: 肥仔明經過報紙檔，又對住我伸脷扮鬼扮馬整色整水。
eng: The little fat man passed by the newsstand, and stuck out his tongue at me and pretended to be tricky.

text: 阿爸睇到喇！佢好兇狠噉望肥仔明一眼，肥仔明就即刻跑開。
eng: Dad saw it! He looked at the little fat man very fiercely, and the little fat man ran away immediately.

text: 阿爸又望住我，問︰「阿生，點解佢叫你鹹濕仔？」
eng: My father looked at me again and asked, "Ah Sheng, why did he call you an obscene son?"

text: 我耷低頭，用手指指下啲雜誌，好細聲噉話︰「阿爸，我都唔鍾意俾人叫做鹹濕仔……」
eng: I bowed my head, pointed to the magazine under my finger, and whispered, "Dad, I don't like to be called an obscene son..."

text: 阿爸即刻話︰「唉，阿生，你知唔知道，我哋都要揾食㗎。
eng: Dad immediately said, "Oh, Ah Sheng, do you know or not, we also have to look for food.

text: 阿爸讀書唔多，自細跟根叔開報紙檔，我淨係識開檔㗎咋。
eng: My dad doesn't read much, and I opened a newsstand with Uncle Gen since I was a child, and I can only do business.

text: 好多年我都冇再賣嗰啲要用膠套封住嘅書喇，你知道㗎，係咪？
eng: I haven't sold books that have to be sealed in plastic sleeves for years, you know, haven't I?

text: 噉呢啲雜誌……都只係閒書嚟啫，冇乜嘢嘅……賺錢吖嘛，好多人買嚟睇㗎……」
eng: These magazines ... It's just an idle book, nothing ... It's a lot of money, a lot of people buy it..."

text: 阿爸雖然讀書唔多，外表又粗魯，又會跟朋友買下馬，但係佢好少郁手郁腳打人，粗口都唔多句，仲成日同我講道理，好多人都叫佢做斯文報紙佬。
eng: Although my father didn't read much, his appearance was rude, and he would buy horses with friends, he rarely beat people with his hands and feet, didn't say much dirty words, and often reasoned with me, and many people called him a Sven newspaperman.

text: 佢繼續解釋，我已經聽唔入耳。諗起聽日堂作文堂，我決定好似以前噉，寫我阿爸係一位文員算喇。
eng: He went on to explain that I couldn't hear it anymore. Thinking of the Aminerando Composition Hall, I decided to write that my dad was a staff member as before.

text: 到咗作文堂喇。題目係︰我的爸爸。黃老師先請幾位同學喺班上介紹佢哋嘅爸爸。
eng: It's time for the composition hall. The title is... Teacher Huang asked a few students to introduce their fathers in the class.

text: 陳瑞芳個阿爸係一個消防員。古淑瑩個阿爸係一個菜販。劉福明個阿爸係巴士司機。
eng: Chen Ruifang's father is a firefighter. Gu Shuying's father is a vegetable vendor. Liu Fuming's father is a bus driver.

text: 「張得生，你呢？」我已經將個頭耷到好低，估唔到老師都仲會揀中我。
eng: "Zhang Desheng, what about you?" I had already lowered my head very low, and I didn't expect the teacher to pick on me.

text: 我都未企起身，肥仔明就喺個位度大叫︰「張得生個老竇係賣鹹書㗎！」
eng: Before I could stand up, the fat man Ming shouted in the single position: "Zhang Desheng's father is selling yellow books!"

text: 接住落嚟，我就聽到全班同學一齊喺度大笑！
eng: Then I heard the whole class laughing here!

text: 我感覺到我塊面好熱，然後耳仔啦，條頸啦，直到全個人全身都好熱。
eng: I felt my noodles being hot, and then my ears and neck, until my whole body was hot.

text: 我坐喺個位度，唔敢郁。
eng: I sat in my seat and didn't dare to move.

text: 黃老師就對全班同學講︰「張得生嘅爸爸有個報紙檔。
eng: Teacher Wong said to the class, "Cheung Tak Sang's father has a newsstand.

text: 王偉明，報紙檔度有好多唔同嘅報章雜誌，又有漫畫書，仲可能有啲小玩具呀，香口膠呀、紙巾噉，點解你淨係會話佢爸爸賣色情刊物呢？
eng: Wang Weiming, there are many different newspapers and magazines in the newspaper file, there are comic books, maybe there are some small toys, chewing gum, paper towels, why do you only say that his father sells pornographic publications?

text: 唔通你對眼淨係見到呢啲？」全班同學又一齊大笑。
eng: Is that all you see with your eyes?" the class laughed again.

text: 小息嘅時候，黃老師約咗我傾計。
eng: When I was resting, Mr. Huang asked me to talk about it.

text: 個班房一個人都冇，佢問我王偉明係咪成日噉樣笑我，又問我鍾唔鍾意我阿爸賣嗰啲報紙雜誌。
eng: There was no one in the room, and he asked me if Wang Weiming often laughed at me like this, and asked me if I liked my father selling newspapers and magazines.

text: 佢又話俾我知其實佢都唔鍾意嗰啲雜誌，有時讀完一啲報紙都想嘔，問我會唔會。
eng: He also let me know that he didn't like those magazines either, and sometimes he wanted to vomit after reading a little newspaper and asked me if I would.

text: 我一直係噉點頭。
eng: I've always nodded like this.

text: 佢問我︰「你認為可唔可以叫爸爸唔好賣呢啲報紙雜誌呢？」
eng: He asked me, "Do you think you can tell Dad not to sell newspapers and magazines?"

text: 我諗一諗，諗返起阿爸噚日講過嗰番説話，我冇出聲。
eng: I thought about it and remembered what my dad said yesterday, and I didn't say anything.

text: 「係唔係好困難？」我又點下個頭。
eng: "Isn't it difficult?"

text: 「噉可以點做呢？」呢個時候，上堂鐘聲響起。
eng: "What can I do about that?" At this time, the class bell rang.

text: 「張得生，要去上堂喇。不如你返屋企諗下，聽日我哋再傾，好唔好？」
eng: "Zhang Desheng, I'm going to class. Why don't you go home and think, we'll talk tomorrow, okay?"

text: 黃老師輕輕拍咗我個膊頭一下，然後就催我去球場集隊。
eng: Mr. Huang gently patted me on the shoulder, and then urged me to go to the stadium to assemble the team.

text: 放咗學之後，我一個人返屋企。
eng: After school, I went home alone.

text: 阿爸噚日話我知，我唔使再去報紙檔幫忙喇。
eng: Dad said yesterday that I know, I don't have to go to the newsstand anymore to help.

text: 佢話我大個仔，可以一個人留喺屋企。
eng: He said I was grown up and could stay at home alone.

text: 返到屋企，我諗返起黃老師番説話，諗返起肥仔明喺全班面前笑我，又諗返起黃老師點樣教訓肥仔明，心裏面一陣時又嬲一陣時又開心。諗下諗下，就瞓著咗。

text: 免費雪條
eng: Free popsicles

text: 炎炎夏日，藍天白雲，小美喺天台望住隻錶，佢等緊咩呢？
eng: In the hot summer, the blue sky and white clouds, Xiaomei is staring at the watch on the rooftop, what is he waiting for?

text: 佢等緊雪條車嚟呀！
eng: He's waiting for the popsicle cart to come!

text: 「鈴鈴鈴……鈴鈴鈴……」小美聽到雪條車嘅鈴鈴聲，即刻跑咗出去！
eng: "Bell bell bell... Ringing bells ... ... Xiaomei heard the bell of the popsicle cart and immediately ran out!

text: 老伯伯笑住話：「小美，你好準時喎。」
eng: The old uncle smiled and said, "Xiaomei, you are so punctual. 」

text: 小美話：「我驚伯伯啲雪條俾人買晒啊。」
eng: Xiaomei said, "I'm afraid that my uncle's popsicles have been bought."

text: 老伯伯話：「你唔使驚，我呢度有一百支雪條！
eng: Old Uncle: "Don't be afraid, I have a hundred popsicles here!"

text: 噉你今日想要幾多支雪條呀？」
eng: So how many popsicles do you want today?"

text: 小美話：「爸爸同媽媽每人要食一支雪條，細佬又要食一支。」
eng: Xiaomei said, "Dad and Mom each need to eat a popsicle, and my brother needs another one. 」

text: 小美一路數手指，一路計數。
eng: Xiaomei side fingers, while calculating.

text: 小美話：「一加一再加一，等如……三。
eng: Xiaomei: "One plus one adds one over and over again, and so on... Three.

text: 但係一支雪條要五蚊，三支雪條要……」
eng: But 1,000 yuan popsicles cost five, and 3,000 yuan popsicles cost ..."

text: 小美突然醒起：「我知啦，要用乘數！
eng: Xiaomei suddenly remembered: "I know, I want to use a multiplier!"

text: 五乘以三，老師教嘅九因歌係……五一如五，五二得一十，五三……」
eng: Five times three, the nine-cause song taught by the teacher is ... Five one is like five, five two gets ten and five three..."

text: 應用題(一):每支雪條五元，三支雪條共付多少元？
eng: Application Question (1): How much do I pay for each popsicle for 5 yuan?

text: 「但我又記得細佬講過，嫲嫲成日話唔食雪條，但其實佢夜晚會偷食！
eng: "But I remember my brother saying that grandma always said not to eat popsicles, but in fact he would steal them at night!"

text: 成日講大話，所以佢至會甩晒啲大牙……」
eng: He always lied, that's why he lost some molars..."

text: 老伯伯問：「噉你而家即係要幾多支呀？」
eng: The old uncle asked, "So how many do you want now?"

text: 小美好苦惱，佢要慢慢計數，佢細細聲講：
eng: Little beautiful distress, he had to calculate slowly, he whispered:

text: 「三加一等如四，五再乘以四即係五四……」
eng: "Three plus one is like four, and five multiplied by four is five four..."

text: 應用題(二):小美想要多少支雪條？她總共需多少元買雪條？
eng: Application Question (2): How many popsicles does Xiaomei want?

text: 老伯伯打斷小美：「仲有你自己呢？你都好鍾意食雪條㗎喎。」
eng: The old uncle interrupted Xiaomei: "And yourself? 」

text: 「係喎！」小美拍一下手，笑住話：「哈哈！
eng: "Yes!" Xiaomei clapped her hands and said with a smile: "Haha!

text: 我都唔記得要計埋自己嗰份添！等我又計下幾多錢先。
eng: I don't remember counting my share! Wait until I calculate how much money first.

text: 四加一等如五，五乘五即係五五……」
eng: Four plus one is like five, and five times five is five five..."

text: 應用題(三):買五支雪條，小美共需付多少元？
eng: Application Question (3): How much does Xiaomei need to pay to buy five popsicles?

text: 小美畀完錢，好開心噉拎咗雪條準備食住走。
eng: After Xiaomei gave the money, she happily took the popsicle and prepared to eat and leave.

text: 突然，一隻雀仔飛過，一下搶走咗小美支雪條！
eng: Suddenly, a small bird flew by and snatched the little beauty popsicle!

text: 小美好唔開心，因為佢頭先已經用晒身上嘅二十五蚊喇……
eng: Xiao Mei was unhappy, because he had just used up the twenty-five pieces on his body ...

text: 應用題(四):小美現在剩餘多少元？
eng: Application question (4): How much money does Xiaomei have left?

text: 老伯伯見到小美想喊，唔忍心，就主動送多一支雪條畀佢。
eng: The old uncle saw that Xiaomei wanted to cry, but he couldn't bear it, so he took the initiative to send him another popsicle.

text: 小美即刻開心返晒！
eng: Xiaomei is happy to be all back immediately!

text: 應用題(五):老伯伯的雪條車內剩餘多少支雪條？
eng: Application Question (5): How many popsicles are left in the old uncle's popsicle cart?

text: 老伯伯推住佢架雪條車繼續叫賣，小美呢個時候至發現，原來成條街嘅小朋友都流晒口水等緊老伯伯啲雪條！
eng: The old uncle pushed his popsicle cart to continue to sell, and Xiaomei only found out at this time that the children on the whole street were drooling and waiting for the old uncle to order popsicles!

text: 甚至有小朋友為咗唔俾爸爸媽媽發現，要靜靜雞喺窗口吊個購物籃落嚟買！
eng: There are even children who secretly hang a shopping basket in the window to buy it in order not to let their parents find out!

text: 咁好味嘅雪條，你要唔要食一支呀？
eng: Do you want to eat such a delicious popsicle?

text: 應用題(六):你想買多少支雪條呢？你共需付多少元買雪條？
eng: Application Question (6): How many popsicles do you want to buy?

text: 答案：(一)五乘以三等如一五共付一五元。
eng: Answer: (1) Five times three equal as one and five pay a total of one and a half dollars.

text: (二)四支五乘以四等如二零共需二零元。
eng: (2) Four sticks, five times four, etc., such as 20, a total of 20 yuan.

text: (三)五乘以五等如二十五共需付二十五元。
eng: (3) Five times five, such as 25, a total of 25 yuan will be charged.

text: (四)零元
eng: (4) Zero yuan

text: (五)一百-五-一等如九十四剩餘九十四支。
eng: (5) One hundred-five-one, such as ninety-four, remaining ninety-four.

text: (六)每支雪條五元，我想買_支雪條。五乘以_等如_共需付_元。
eng: (6) Five yuan per popsicle, I want to buy _ popsicle. Five times _ and so on, if _ in total, you need to pay _ yuan.

text: 貓、老鼠同平面圖形
eng: Cat, mouse and flat graphics

text: 貓貓同老鼠係好朋友，佢哋每日嘅活動就係一齊玩、一齊瞓覺、一齊食嘢。
eng: cats and mice are good friends, and their daily activities are to play together, think together, and eat together.

text: 你睇，佢哋喺個窩度瞓得幾稔，我哋要細聲啲呀。
eng: You see, how much they sleep in a nest, we have to be quiet.

text: 應用題(一)﹕牠們睡覺的地方是甚麼形狀？
eng: Application question (1): What is the shape of where they sleep?

text: 貓貓好鍾意玩貓捉老鼠，佢哋會喺屋企後面嘅樹林追嚟追去，又會跳上跳落，
eng: Cats and cats like to play cat and mouse, they will chase around in the woods behind the house, and they will jump up and down,

text: 仲試過跳咗上個好高嘅屋頂，個屋頂係三角形，斜落嚟嗰邊仲可以當滑梯瀡㗎！
eng: they have jumped on a very high roof, the roof is a triangle, and it can be used as a slide when diagonally down!

text: 應用題(二)﹕你知道三角形有甚麼特別嗎？
eng: Application question (2): Do you know what is special about the triangle?

text: 應用題(三)﹕圖中有多少棵樹？這些樹是甚麼形狀？
eng: Application question (3): How many trees are in the picture? What are the shapes of these trees?

text: 做咗咁多運動，老鼠肚餓喇。
eng: After doing so much exercise, the mice are hungry.

text: 比起芝士，其實佢更鍾意食麵包！
eng: He actually prefers bread to cheese!

text: 佢啱啱揾到一塊方包，係長方形嘅。
eng: He just found a square bag, which is rectangular.

text: 喺四邊形當中，有四個直角，對邊長度相等，就叫做長方形。
eng: In a quadrilateral, there are four right angles, and the opposite sides are equal in length, which is called a rectangle.

text: 應用題(四)﹕圖中還有哪些物件是長方形？
eng: Application question (4): What other objects in the picture are rectangular?

text: 食飽飽，玩返陣靜態遊戲先。
eng: Eat enough and play a static game.

text: 唔知你哋平時又會玩啲咩桌上遊戲呢？
eng: I wonder what table games you usually play?

text: 喺四邊形當中，有四個直角，四邊長度相等，就叫做正方形。
eng: In a quadrilateral, there are four right angles, and the four sides are equal in length, which is called a square.

text: 休息完一輪，又要出去放電喇！
eng: After resting for a while, they have to go out to discharge again!

text: 佢哋去咗公園放紙鷂，個紙鷂又紅又大，喺空中特別搶眼，真係好靚呀！
eng: They go to the park to release the wind harrier, the wind harrier is red and big, especially eye-catching in the air, it is really beautiful!

text: 應用題(五)﹕這個紙鷂是甚麼形狀？
eng: Application question (5): What shape is this wind harrier?

text: 應用題(六)﹕你可以多畫一個菱形紙鷂給牠們嗎？
eng: Application Question (6): Can you draw one more diamond-shaped paper harrier for them?

text: 到下午茶時間喇，貓貓想揾蜜糖搽麵包畀老鼠食。
eng: It's tea time, and the cat wants to find honey to rub bread for the mice.

text: 佢着晒成套保護衣，好小心噉行去蜂巢拎蜜糖。
eng: He wears a full protective suit and carefully walks to the hive to get the honey.

text: 你睇唔睇得出個蜂巢係咩形狀？
eng: Can you see what shape a hive is?

text: 應用題(七)﹕數一數，蜜蜂巢有多少條邊？
eng: Application question (7): Count, how many sides does the honeycomb have?

text: 蜜蜂巢是甚麼形狀？玩咗成日，差唔多要瞓覺喇！
eng: What is the shape of the honeycomb? After playing all day, I almost have to go to sleep!

text: 貓貓好注重乾淨衛生，瞓覺前會刷牙，順便照下鏡，執下個樣。
eng: Cats and cats pay attention to cleanliness and hygiene, brush their teeth before going to bed, take pictures by the way, and pick them up.

text: 貪靚嘅貓貓就連塊鏡都靚過人，係藍色橢圓形嘅。
eng: The cat who loves beauty is beautiful even with a mirror, which is blue oval.

text: 你知唔知橢圓形同圓形有咩唔同呀？
eng: Did you know what's the difference between an oval and a circle?

text: 應用題(八)﹕請你把平面圖形及它們的名字連起來。
eng: Application Question (8): Please connect the flat figures with their names.

text: 答案：(一)圓形
eng: Answer: (i) Circle

text: (二)有三條邊、三隻角
eng: (2) Has three sides, three corners

text: (三)有一二棵樹，三角形
eng: (3) There are one or two trees, triangle

text: (四)綠色外框、綠色相架、綠色方格背景
eng: (4) Green frame, green frame, green checkered background

text: (五)菱形
eng: (5) Diamond

eng: (7) Six sides, hexagon.

text: 喺某個遙遠嘅國家，有一條風景優美嘅小村莊，條村俾山圍繞，附近仲有一個好靚嘅湖泊添！
eng: In some distant country, there is a small village with beautiful scenery, this village is surrounded by mountains, and there is a very beautiful lake Tim nearby!

text: 雖然村入面住嘅人唔多，但可以自給自足，所以佢哋每日都生活得好開心！
eng: Although there are not many people living in the village, they can be self-sufficient, so they live happily every day!

text: 遠處嘅同學聽到，唔知講咗啲咩，笑住噉跑走咗。
eng: The classmates in the distance heard it, didn't know what to say, and ran away laughing.

text: 突然，佢離遠見到湖對面有嘢郁緊……
eng: Suddenly, he saw something moving across the lake in the distance ... ...

text: 於是佢放輕腳步，靜靜雞噉行過去，想睇下係咩嚟。
eng: So he relaxed his steps and sneaked over to see what it was.

text: 身形細小嘅梅花鹿喺湖邊低頭飲水。
eng: The tiny sika deer was drinking water from the lake.

text: 小小梅花鹿不但冇反抗，仲好似好享受添！
eng: The little sika deer not only did not resist, but also seemed to enjoy it!

text: 「拜拜！」佢同小小梅花鹿講完就轉身離開。
eng: "Goodbye!" he said to the little sika deer and turned to leave.

text: 小鹿唔識講嘢，梗係答唔到佢呢個問題啦！
eng: Fawn can't speak, of course can't answer his question!

text: 點知呢一幕畀跟喺佢後面嘅同學仔見到晒！
eng: How did he know that this scene was seen by the classmates who followed him!

text: 「冇問題！我哋仲可以幫佢揾下附近有冇梅花鹿添！」同學仔都拍晒心口話。
eng: "No problem, we can also help him find out if there is a sika deer in the vicinity!"

text: 希望小鹿可以快啲揾返屋企人，回歸大自然啦！
eng: I hope the fawn can quickly find its homecoming and return to nature!
